## Athletico’s Toll-Free Injury Hotline

Athletico has created an Injury Hotline available to anyone who sustains an injury or has questions
about chronic pain, strains or injuries. A certified and licensed athletic trainer (AT) will answer
your questions regarding your injury and direct you appropriately for care. ATs are highly skilled
allied health professionals who are trained to assess injuries sustained during athletic events.
Through Athletico’s Injury Hotline, an AT will discuss the injury and educate the caller on how to
safely care for their injury until they can be seen by a doctor. They can also determine if an
individual’s injury is significant enough to seek immediate medical attention. Callers may access
the Injury Hotline by calling toll-free: 1-877-ATHLETICO (877-284-5384)

## Insurance/Billing

Athletico’s business staff will assist you on an individual basis filing all insurance claims. In
addition to accepting numerous insurance plans, Athletico is also Medicare certified. We will do
everything in our power to accommodate each individual. Please feel free to contact our Billing
Center associates at 630-575-6250 for assistance.

## Athletico’s Toll-Free Injury Hotline

Athletico has created an Injury Hotline available to anyone who sustains an injury or has questions
about chronic pain, strains or injuries. A certified and licensed athletic trainer (AT) will answer
your questions regarding your injury and direct you appropriately for care. ATs are highly skilled
allied health professionals who are trained to assess injuries sustained during athletic events.
Through Athletico’s Injury Hotline, an AT will discuss the injury and educate the caller on how to
safely care for their injury until they can be seen by a doctor. They can also determine if an
individual’s injury is significant enough to seek immediate medical attention. Callers may access
the Injury Hotline by calling toll-free: 1-877-ATHLETICO (877-284-5384)

## Insurance/Billing

Athletico’s business staff will assist you on an individual basis filing all insurance claims. In
addition to accepting numerous insurance plans, Athletico is also Medicare certified. We will do
everything in our power to accommodate each individual. Please feel free to contact our Billing
Center associates at 630-575-6250 for assistance.

#### Leadership Development

We fully recognize that people are our most important asset. Our success depends entirely on the
strength of our talented employees and leaders, which we build from within and manage through a
disciplined process.

Our approach to developing leaders at Athletico is simple—we see every employee as having leadership
potential, and we incorporate the best evidence-based training and strategies to help our leaders at
every level grow.

##### Athletico’s Purpose and Values

Our purpose and values are the foundation on which we develop leaders. Our shared purpose—to help
people enhance their health and quality of life—unifies us as we collaborate internally and sustains
us as we engage externally. Taken together, our purpose and values are the foundation for our unique
culture and leadership approach.

##### We Hire the Best

Through a strategic, quality-driven hiring experience that establishes first the alignment of the
candidate with the company’s core values, followed by a “best fit” process, Athletico consistently
attracts top talent from across the nation because of our reputation for clinical excellence.
Subsequently, our future leaders are able to be prepared from the early stages of their career and
developed throughout their professional life.

##### We Develop and Engage Our Team

We believe there’s no substitute for hands-on experience when it comes to leadership development.
That’s why we create early, meaningful responsibilities for every employee. Typical assignments
require collaboration inside and outside the organization, fostering strong project management
skills and keeping our team connected to current healthcare trends and operations.

##### Our Signature Leadership Development Programs

###### Toolbox Topics

**Audience:** All Athletico employees seeking to grow their professional and leadership skills.

**Leadership Pathway:** Foundational Skills for Leading Self and Others

###### Emerging Leaders Program

**Audience:** Individual contributors aspiring to be people leaders.

**Leadership Pathway:** Leading Self

###### LEAD – Learn. Engage. Achieve. Develop.

**Audience:** Clinic Managers
Gain tactical leadership skills to succeed in your operational role.

**Leadership Pathway:** Leading Teams

###### Advanced Leadership Development Program

**Audience:** Senior leaders aspiring to move into an executive level role.

**Leadership Pathway:** Leading Leaders and Leading Athletico

In alignment with our mission and values, our STRONG leadership competencies provide a common
language for defining leadership at every level and are embedded in all of our leadership
development programs and initiatives. Each program focuses on the behaviors and actions outlined in
this framework, and employees enrolled can expect to learn through on-the-job application
activities, group coaching, eLearning, and self-assessments. This reflects our commitment to setting
employees up for success early in their careers and preparing new and seasoned leaders to
confidently step into any leadership role.

# Outpatient Physical Therapy

We’re part of the largest physical therapy network in the U.S. With almost 2,000 outpatient physical
therapy centers and 7,000-plus licensed therapists, we’re a leader in physical therapy excellence.

We’re also your partner in wellness. We offer occupational and hand therapy, sports medicine,
workplace injury treatment and prevention, and specialized rehabilitation services.

Our focus every day is on exceptional patient care. Your health and wellness goals are our goals. We
help you maintain your health or recover your health to get back to the activities and life that you
love.

[Action shot of Tom outside cross-country skiing in a black outfit]
Clinician Spotlight: Tom Videtich Bye
He may not immediately tell patients about his previous life as an elite athlete, but when it fits
into conversation and instruction, Physical Therapist Tom Videtich Bye opens up. He was a Division I
cross-country skier who competed on the national and international stages as a junior and was once
in the pool for the U.S. national team. Ultimately, Tom switched gears; his focus now is helping
patients attain their goals.
[Read his story here][70]
[A child with glasses sits on her mother's lap while the daughter is using her tablet]
Augmentative and alternative communication - helping kids connect through pediatric speech therapy
When it comes to kids with communication difficulties, high-tech and screen time often tip the scale
toward good rather than bad for many reasons. Learn how high-tech communication tools enhance work
done with pediatric speech therapists to help kids understand and communicate with the world around
them.
[Click here to learn more][71]

confidence.

Recent Google Reviews

“I had lower back pain and could barely walk. I was only able to stand for about one minute. After 11 sessions, I can stand, walk, and am getting back to running. Ariana, Arav, and Priya were phenomenal, and Elizabeth was wonderful. This place truly helped me get my life back.”

Twin Boro Physical Therapy – Martinsville, NJ

“I went to PT Solutions in Souderton for rehab after back surgery. I cannot express how great the experience was. Every time I went for PT I was greeted with a smile and genuine inquiry on how I was feeling from Faith and Danielle. Danielle would make sure I was always challenged even if she had to make a simple exercise more difficult so I would get the most out of it. If I ever need PT again there is no doubt that I will be going back here. Thank you for my speedy recovery and support.”

PT Solutions of Souderton – Souderton, PA

“I recently started PT and I didn’t have high hopes for any relief. I was injured during my service overseas and the VA sent me here for help. Kale is my Physical Therapist and he is truly one of a kind. He explains the process slowly and understandably and listens to my questions and needs. The facility is very nice and clean. After starting therapy here, I finally feel hopeful about my recovery.”

PT Solutions of Somerset – Somerset, KY

“I hate going to PT however going to PT Solutions makes it so much better. Everyone is so nice there and makes your PT go by so much easier. Don’t get me wrong they work you but they make you feel like they have known you for years. James is excellent!! This is my second time having him. He is so nice and so knowledgeable. Answers all my questions and makes sure I understand what he is telling me. I have MS so my brain sometimes just doesn’t wanna cooperate and he explains it so I get it. I definitely recommend PT Solutions to anyone looking for PT.”

PT Solutions of Fort Oglethorpe – Fort Oglethorpe, GA

“I have gone to PT Solutions on two different occasions. This most recent was the longest for a lower back and hip issue. Omar was incredible! His knowledge in answering my questions were thorough and professional. He is very kind and after 14 visits at 3x a week, both my back and hip has improved greatly! I will now go once a week for 6 weeks to ensure I follow Omar’s plan at home and continue to improve. The environment is very positive between the PT therapists too. I highly recommend PT Solutions!”

PT Solutions of Lenexa – Prairie Star, KS

“I love all of the people at PT Solutions. I work with Emily, who keeps me in check and reminds me that recovery takes time. She knows when to slow me down and when to push me. All of the therapists are great, and you can see how they truly care about each patient and support one another.”

PT Solutions of Ocean Springs – Ocean Springs, MS

“The staff at PT Solutions are a first-class organization. I’ve been to other physical therapists before but this group was far more effective. Special thanks to Andrew and Melissa for getting me back to normal after hip replacement with only three months of PT. I am back to doing the things I love—pickleball, long-distance biking, and other activities—at 100% of what I was before surgery. Truly amazing to have my lifestyle back.”

PT Solutions of Valley Road – Wayne, NJ

“My experience at PT Solutions of Acworth East was truly the best. I was very skeptical about my recovery at first, but the therapist and entire staff made me feel safe, supported, and genuinely cared for every step of the way. Dakota and Faith were hands down amazing. Their knowledge, encouragement, and dedication made all the difference in my recovery.”

PT Solutions of Acworth East – Acworth, GA

“Did you know there’s a Certified Hand Therapist in Roswell? Linda Clinton is an experienced CHT and can provide therapy from fingertips to shoulder. She’s a lovely person and I look forward to her care and coaching for my trigger finger. I’m glad I located a specialist.”

PT Solutions of Roswell – Roswell, GA

“Today I had my initial visit with Cooper Grigsby and was extremely impressed. I’ve been going to PT in Colorado for about one year and found a difference between the two offices. Cooper was thorough and very helpful in introducing new exercises to increase the strength in my shoulder. I appreciated the precise measurements he took, which I did not experience at my prior PT office. Great job Dr. Cooper Grigsby!”

PT Solutions of Tyler – Tyler, TX

# Our Story

From our humble beginnings with just a few employees to our nationwide expansion, we remain grateful
for the countless opportunities to impact people’s lives every day.

## Our Story Overview

Founded in 2003 by our CEO Dale Yake, PT Solutions Physical Therapy is a privately held physical
therapy practice based in Atlanta, Georgia, with more than 550 points of service across 25 states.
PT Solutions provides physical and occupational therapy, speech-language pathology, athletic
training, and sports medicine services in outpatient, inpatient rehabilitation, and acute care
settings.

Earning a spot on Inc. 5000’s list of fastest-growing private companies for nine consecutive years,
PT Solutions continues to expand its national footprint through its unique model of hospital
partnerships, private acquisitions, and de novo clinics. Through its APTA-accredited residency
program, PT Solutions educates, trains, and trusts its professionals to provide research-supported
care in hospitality-driven and service-oriented environments.

## PT Solutions Timeline

We care about our patients, our people, and our communities. Our goal is to provide transformative
care to our communities through evidence, experience, and exceptional customer service because
everyone deserves the chance to be unstoppable.
* #### 2003

Founded by Dale Yake in Eufaula, AL
* #### 2004

Established first hospital relationship and expanded into Georgia and Florida
* #### 2005

Launched first of its kind APTA accredited residency program to establish rigor in teaching and
quality
* #### 2016

Geographic expansion into IL, KS, KY, LA, MO, NC, SC, TN, VA
* #### 2017

Hit 100-clinic milestone and expanded partnership model, working with 25+ hospital partners
* #### 2022

4,000+ employees
* #### 2023

Hit 500-clinic and 70-hospital milestones and entered 25th state; 200+ Residency program graduates
* #### 2024+

National recruiting platform, affiliated with 30 universities and recruiting from 150+

# Private Practice

Watch your practice flourish with our capital, recruiting, and marketing resources. Whether you’re
pushing for growth or need a succession plan, PT Solutions works with you to expand your practice’s
opportunities and build on what has made you successful and unique.

#### Promoting Growth Through Partnership

## What Makes PT Solutions The Right Fit?

Integrating PT Solutions with your practice is simple, painless, and 100% collaborative. The entire
process is confidential with a deal structure that aligns completely with your personal goals. Use
our resources to achieve the vision you’ve always dreamed of.
* Supported by a well-established equity partner
* Has a national recruiting presence to source top talent
* Uses top-quality sales and marketing teams
* Works with you directly to create an integration plan
* Values & perpetuates your emotional investment in your business

## Ensure Your Company’s Future

PT Solutions has met every modern challenge of the physical therapy landscape, and we’re just
getting started! When you partner with us, our capital, recruitment strategy, and marketing
resources ensure that your company and employees will flourish well into the future.

# Team Up Speak Up with Concussion Legacy Foundation

The word concussion often conjures up the image of a large blow to the head with loss of
consciousness, amnesia or other major on-field event. However, a concussion is often much more
subtle. The severity of a hit or collision is not a reliable predictor of concussion or concussion
severity^{1,2}. In fact, in a study done with nearly 450 collegiate football and hockey athletes,
half of the 48 concussions identified had no specific large impact event associated with the
injury³.

So how do we detect [concussion][61] if it is often times difficulty to acutely identify from the
sidelines? Many current models rely on an athlete to self-report symptoms to a coach, trainer or
parent. However, one must ask if we can safely rely on an individual who has suffered a mild
[traumatic brain injury][62] to accurately report his or her symptoms? A person suffering from
common acute symptoms including dizziness, confusion, mental fogginess or other cognitive complaints
may not be the most reliable source of information during this critical time.

[Team Up Speak Up][63] Day, an initiative from the [Concussion Legacy Foundation][64], encourages
teammates to look out for one another and speak up if they see signs and symptoms of a concussion.
During a given season, one in five high school athletes in [Georgia][65] will sustain a concussion
and, of those, one-third will report suffering from two or more concussions in a given year⁴. We
encourage you to [take the pledge][66] and talk to your team about the importance of protecting each
other from this often silent injury.

**Sources**:
1. McCrory P, Meeuisse W, Dvorak J, et al. Consensus statement on concussion in sport- the 5^{th}
international conference on concussion in sport held in Berlin, October 2016. Br J Sports Med.
2017;51: 838-847.
2. Iverson GL, Gerdner AJ, Terry DP, et al. Predictors of clinical recovery from a concussion: a
systematic review. Br J Sports Med 2017;51:941-948.
3. Duhaime AC, Beckwith JG, Maerlender AC et al. Spectrum of acute clinical characteristics of
diagnosed concussions in college athletes wearing instrumented helmets. J Neurosurg. 2012 Dec;
117(6): 1092-1099.
4. Marar M, Mcilvain NM, Fields SK et al. Epidemiology of concussions among United States high
school athletes in 20 sports. Am J Sports Med. 2012;40(4):747-755.

**Author:** Lindsay Walston, PT, DPT, NCS

# A leader in post-acute recovery and rehabilitation

Select Medical is one of the largest providers of critical illness recovery hospitals, inpatient
rehabilitation hospitals and outpatient rehabilitation centers in the United States. Guided by our
mission to provide an exceptional patient care experience that promotes healing and recovery in a
compassionate environment, our more than 45,000 healthcare professionals help to restore quality of
life for thousands of people and their families every day.

## Select Medical Continuum of Care

**Recover.  Rebuild.  Resume.**

No one plans to get sick or hurt, it just happens. That's why we're here -- to help you heal,
restore function and get you back to your everyday life. We call this the Select Medical Continuum
of Care because we're able to guide you through every step of recovery from hospital to home.
* Critical Illness  Recovery
* Inpatient Rehabilitation
* Outpatient Rehabilitation
* [Women with a trach walks down a hallway using a cane with her care team.]
  Critical illness recovery
  In our specialty hospitals, we help patients with even the most complex, chronic medical
  conditions recover and have quality of life.
  [Critical Illness Recovery][35]
* [A women uses an exoskeleton to walk down the hospital hall with her therapist.]
  Inpatient rehabilitation
  Following a stroke, spinal cord injury or brain injury, we help you rebuild function so you can
  return to life.
  [Inpatient Rehabilitation][36]
* [Patient lays on his back on a table while physical therapist stretches his leg.]
  outpatient rehabilitation
  When injury, an accident, aches or chronic pain occur, we help you resume the activities you
  enjoy.
  [Outpatient Rehabilitation][37]

Why Choose Us

## How Our Values Prioritize You

These are our Core Values and what they mean for you:

**People first.** Our patient needs are our #1 priority.

**Results that are meaningful.** We partner with you to set, measure, and achieve the goals that are
most important to you.

**Openness and Transparency.** We believe an educated consumer is our best patient and we encourage
open communication between patient and therapist. Each plan of care is developed through a
combination of proven best-practices and the unique needs expressed by the patient.

**Positivity and Optimism.** We only hire positive and optimistic people. Work and therapy should be
enjoyable and supportive.

**Treat people like family. **Our team supports and encourages each other. We have long-term patient
relationships going back decades, with care of grandparents, parents, and children. We genuinely
care about our patients, their families, each other, and our community.

[Learn More][67]

We Offer

## Treatments For Active Individuals Of All Ages

Our physical therapists design treatment plans specific to each person’s needs, challenges, and
goals, regardless of age. While we offer many treatment options, post-operative therapy is a strong
focus. After surgery, your tissues, muscles and bones go through a period of healing. Often,
limiting mobility during recovery can reduce range of motion, flexibility and functionality.
Post-operative physical therapy encourages your body to heal through specific exercises ideal for
each phase of your recovery.

Welcome to Atherton Physiotherapy and Sports Injury Clinic

covering Wigan, Bolton, Atherton and Manchester

Atherton Physiotherapy & Sports Injury Clinic offer a range of professional services by an expertly qualified team of physiotherapists and sports rehabilitators. Based in the Wigan borough, our clinic can help you achieve your goals and improve any pain or discomfort you may be experiencing.

Our dedicated team have a wealth of experience in all areas of rehabilitation, sports injury and musculoskeletal physio, with the overall aim of improving and maintaining your quality of life. At our Manchester clinic, you will feel confident that all of your concerns are heard during a thorough assessment, where we will offer advice and solutions to your problems.

As well as being one of Greater Manchester’s leading Sports Injury clinics we also offer home visits , massage therapy and many other health and wellbeing services.

Our Treatment Services

Physiotherapy

Back in Motion has engaged a team of knowledgeable and experienced therapists to treat a wide range of injuries and conditions in our state-of-the-art clinics located across the Lower Mainland. Click below to learn more about your physiotherapy options. Learn More

Registered Massage Therapy

Our experienced Registered Massage Therapists at Back in Motion can help you with a variety of challenges, including the restoration of postural alignment, proper biomechanics, and relieving muscle tension related to sports injuries or auto accidents. Click below to learn more. Learn More

Active Rehab/Kinesiology

If you have an injury that has kept you from enjoying your everyday life activities, our professional Kinesiologists will develop a customized recovery plan to ensure you are back on track quickly. Learn about one-on-one Kinesiologist guided exercise therapy. Learn More

Acupuncture

Acupuncture is a form of Chinese medicine that uses needles to stimulate the balance and flow of Qi energy, which can reduce swelling, relieve pain, and promote faster healing. Click below to learn more about your acupuncture options. Learn More

Dry Needling – IMS

Dry Needling Intramuscular Stimulation is based on Western medicine principles and research, and involves multiple advances of a filament needle into the skin and muscle at a myofascial trigger point. Click below to learn more about your IMS options. Learn More

Sports Rehab

Return to sport quicker, stronger, and better prepared. No matter if you are a professional athlete, a competitive player, or a recreational athlete, you all have the same goal: to achieve a full return to performance with a minimal risk of re-injury. Learn More

Shockwave Therapy

Heal faster and stronger. Shockwave therapy is a safe, non-invasive procedure often recommended by Orthopedic Surgeons for treating many tendon, muscle and joint disorders. Click below to learn more about your Shockwave Therapy options. Learn More

Pelvic Floor Physiotherapy

The Back in Motion Pelvic Floor Physiotherapy consists of the assessment and treatment of various conditions that involve the pelvic floor (muscles, ligaments, nerves and connective tissue), or symptoms presented in the area. Learn More

Concussion Clinic

The Back in Motion Concussion Clinic provides early management of a concussion by offering an individual assessment focused on your specific symptoms, providing timely intervention to prevent longer term difficulties and facilitate a full recovery. Learn More

Dizziness and Vertigo

Vertigo, a sense of dizziness, or feeling that the room is spinning around you, can significantly affect your day-to-day functioning, ability to work, social relationships, and quality of life. Many factors can cause these symptoms. Learn More

Telehealth

We are now offering Physiotherapy and Kinesiology through video conferencing technology and telephone. Our Telehealth services allow clients to connect with their physiotherapist and kinesiologist in a secure, easy, innovative and convenient way! Learn More

Our Story

Proudly Serving The Lower Mainland.

Born out of the motivation to make a real difference in the lives of others, Back in Motion was the first private organization in BC to specialize in the rehabilitation of individuals with chronic back pain, to help them get back to work.

Back in Motion’s five founders used their combined expertise in clinical psychology, physiotherapy, and business to help a Richmond man start anew, after being told he would never return to his career in logging.

This founding success defined Back in Motion’s purpose to help people  improve their health, enhance their opportunities,  and  live better lives .

Our Mission

To inspire meaningful change through accessible health and lifework solutions.

Why Choose Us

We offer the best possible treatment options (in-person and through Telehealth), supported by modern technology and research, and delivered with enthusiasm by our experienced and dedicated healthcare professionals, each committed to helping you achieve your physical and personal goals.

Our Core Values

Achieve Excellence - Do What It Takes

Ask Questions - Seek Solutions

Teamwork – Achieve More Together

Respect All – Always

Measure Up – Evidence-Informed Practices & Innovation

Honour Our Word – Do the Right Thing

WorkSafeBC Claims

Workplace injuries are usually due to trauma or overuse. If you have been injured as a result of a workplace activity, our team of experts at Back in Motion can perform a comprehensive assessment and develop a treatment plan to reduce your symptoms and rehabilitate your injury.

If your claim is approved by WSBC, your initial assessment is 100% covered with a WorkSafeBC Claim number. Once your claim has been accepted by WorkSafeBC, the full treatment cost of your appointments will be funded (within the approved time parameters). When you are ready, your physiotherapist will work with you, your employer, physician, and WorkSafeBC Case Manager to develop a safe and appropriate return to work plan. If your claim has been denied or is disallowed, the expenses will need to be covered by the Client.

### New Patients

New clients and walk-ins are welcome

If you are a new patient, you may book your appointment by [phone][71], or you may [book a walk-in

### Existing Patients

[Call us][76] to book or change your appointment, or [book/re-schedule your appointment online][77].

If you have any questions or non-urgent inquires, please email us at our [Medical Clinic Email.][78]

### Healthcare Providers

Inquiries, referrals, and prescriptions: please call [778-729-1302][79]. Press 2 for healthcare
providers. Choose to speak with a representative or leave a voice message.

To send a fax, please call [778-262-0747][80].

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Are you accepting new patients?**

Yes, new patients and walk-ins are welcome.

**Do I need to book an appointment?**

Walk-ins are welcome without an appointment. But if you prefer to book a walk-in appointment, you
may [book online][81].

**How do I book my medical appointment online?**

New Clients may schedule an appointment by [calling us][82] or [book a walk-in appointment
online][83].

Existing Clients may book by [phone][84] or [book/re-schedule an appointment online][85]

If you experience any challenges with our booking portal, please contact us via email and our
friendly staff will get back to you.

**Do you accept walk-in patients?**

Yes, our North Vancouver Medical Clinic welcomes walk-in patients.

**I would like to refill my prescription, do I need to book an appointment?**

You may book an appointment to refill your prescription. You may also request your pharmacy to send
the request to us.

**Is the medical appointment covered by insurance?**

If you are a British Columbia resident and are enrolled in MSP, medical services are covered under
your benefits. MSP is the provincial insurance program that pays for required medical services.
These include medically necessary services provided by physicians and midwives, dental and oral
surgery performed in a hospital, eye examinations if medically required and some orthodontic
services. In addition, MSP pay for diagnostic services including X-rays. For more information on
services covered by MSP, visit the [Government of British Columbia, MSP webpage][86].

## Insurance Claims & Information

*Get Back to Health after an Accident or Workplace Injury.*

### Extended Health Coverage

Back in Motion offers direct billing to most Extended Health plans to the majority of our services.
Some services (like Clinical Counselling), do not offer direct billing. In such instances, Back in
Motion provides a medical receipt to be used on request for reimbursement. See an updated list of
providers by clicking the ‘Learn More’ button below.

### ICBC Insurance Claims

Back in Motion’s team of clinicians, including Physiotherapists, Massage Therapists, Occupational
Therapists, Psychologists, Counsellors, and Kinesiologists, all have extensive experience in
administering ICBC treatments. We are here to help! Click the ‘Learn More’ button for additional
details.

### WorkSafeBC Claims

Workplace injuries are usually due to trauma or overuse. If you have been injured as a result of a
workplace activity, our team of experts at Back in Motion can perform a comprehensive assessment and
develop a treatment plan to reduce your symptoms and rehabilitate your injury.

If your claim is approved by WSBC, your initial assessment is 100% covered with a WorkSafeBC Claim
number. Once your claim has been accepted by WorkSafeBC, the full treatment cost of your
appointments will be funded (within the approved time parameters). When you are ready, your
physiotherapist will work with you, your employer, physician, and WorkSafeBC Case Manager to develop
a safe and appropriate return to work plan. If your claim has been denied or is disallowed, the
expenses will need to be covered by the Client.

# About Back in Motion

Since 1993, Back in Motion has been dedicated to helping people improve their health, enhance their
opportunities, and live better lives.

[Book Now][62]

> ### Who we are

Since 1993, Back in Motion has been dedicated to helping people improve their health, enhance their
opportunities, and live better lives.

We deliver flexible and accessible health services that recognize and celebrate the uniqueness of
each individual. Known for our creative solutions and exceptional results, we ensure the needs of
our clients are met, and expectations are exceeded. Back in Motion helps people work, and live
happy, healthy lives.

We have over 250 dedicated and professional staff serving over 13,000 people annually at 15
convenient locations across Metro Vancouver, all of which are fully accessible and barrier-free.

Back in Motion is an industry leader for Physiotherapy, Massage Therapy, Active Rehabilitation,
Occupational Therapy, Psychological Services and Multidisciplinary Treatment programs.

We offer the best possible treatment options (in-person and through Telehealth), supported by modern
technology and research, and delivered with enthusiasm by our experienced and dedicated healthcare
professionals, each committed to helping you achieve your physical and personal goals.

## Our Mission

To inspire meaningful change through accessible health and lifework solutions.

## What we do

#### **Health & Telehealth**

Back in Motion Health has helped over 100,000 people lead happier, healthier, and more productive
lives. We provide a unique combination of physical health, mental health, brain injury, and
vocational solutions to our diverse base of customers.

We have over 27 years of experience in delivering services that maximize an individual’s potential.
We believe a fulfilled life includes a return to normal daily activities, including recreational
pursuits and work. Our goal is to work respectfully with injured customers to ensure that our
recommendations help individuals to achieve their functional goals, which may include a timely,
safe, and durable return to work.

Working with individuals, health authorities, insurance companies, WorkSafeBC, and government
ministries, our team of experienced professionals provide evidence-based treatment and
collaborative, flexible solutions.

We offer physiotherapy, massage therapy, active rehab, sports medicine and sport therapy, shockwave
therapy, acupuncture, dry needling (IMS), concussion clinic, vestibular therapy (for dizziness and
vertigo). We also physiotherapy, kinesiology and psychological services through [Telehealth][63].

Learn more about [Our Services][64].

If you are a clinician looking for work opportunities, visit [Work with Us][65] page.

### Purpose

Helping people live better, healthier lives.

### Mission

To inspire meaningful change through accessible health and lifework solutions.

### Core Values

**Achieve Excellence – Do What it Takes**

We strive to be the best at everything we do, and continually evaluate our services in order to
improve them. We accept responsibility for our actions, and do whatever it takes in order to achieve
excellence.

**Ask Questions – Seek Solutions**

We recognize we do not have all of the answers, and work together to provide solutions. We provide
an environment of trust, which is an essential prerequisite to ask questions and learn from
mistakes.

**Teamwork – Achieve More Together**

We believe we can accomplish more as a cohesive team than as a group of individuals. Our strength
lies in working together in a coordinated way to achieve collective goals. Everybody in our
organization plays a unique and critical role in our success.

**Respect All – Always**

We believe that everybody we work with deserves respect at all times, and that accurate, timely, and
continuous communication is essential. We value input from everybody, and respect differences of
opinion.

**Measure Up – Evidence-Informed Practices & Innovation**

We provide disability management, rehabilitation and employment services founded upon a solid
research base. We keep abreast of the literature, and share what we learn.

**Honour Our Word – Do the Right Thing**

In order to satisfy customers, clients, and staff, we follow through with our promises. We make
decisions guided by a strong sense of corporate ethics, and follow our principles to ensure we do
the right thing.

# Active Rehab and Kinesiology in the Lower Mainland

Kinesiologists are educators that help you take control of your body and lead a better and more
active lifestyle!

[Book Now][62]

## About Active Rehabilitation and Kinesiology

[Book Now][63]

Back in Motion offers one-on-one Kinesiologist guided exercise therapy to identify and resolve areas
of weakness and restriction to ensure a return to health.

Active rehabilitation/ Kinesiology session includes an assessment to identify areas of weakness and
restriction, customized exercise prescription, and education regarding pain-management techniques,
pacing, and injury prevention. The goal of these sessions is to help return our clients to their
regular life activities, through the education on active rehabilitation (strengthening, mobility and
stretching exercises).

### Is Active Rehabilitation right for me?

Generally, individuals with musculoskeletal conditions respond well to active rehabilitation
(Telehealth or in-person). Kinesiology sessions through Telehealth are right for you if you have
been in a motor vehicle accident, have sustained a mild sport injury, neck pain, lower back pain,
shoulder pain, knee pain, arthritis, osteoarthritis, as well as individuals that would like to
maximize your physical well-being and fitness levels.

Kinesiology has proven to be highly effective for individuals:

Injured in a motor vehicle accident

Experiencing lower back, neck, shoulder, knee pain

With mild sports injuries

With arthritis or osteoarthritis

Interested in maximizing their health and fitness

If you have an injury that has kept you from enjoying your everyday life activities, our
professional Kinesiologists will develop a customized recovery plan to ensure you are back on track
quickly.

### Did you know Kinesiology sessions are covered in active ICBC claims?

Individuals with an active ICBC claim have 12 kinesiology and active rehabilitation sessions covered
by ICBC, to support their recovery after a car accident.

Back in Motion Kinesiologists will support you throughout your car accident recovery. Customized
exercise and stretching prescriptions will help you manage pain and discomfort, and correct muscle
imbalances.

Our experts will also educate you on how to modify your daily activities throughout your recovery.

Back in Motion Health also offers Physiotherapy and Massage Therapy treatments, also covered under
ICBC active claims. You may access different services at the same time, and pair appointments
back-to-back, so you get the best out of each treatment and save you time. Learn more about [ICBC
Services][64].

### Why Choose Kinesiology at Back in Motion Health?

Our Team treats a wide range of injuries and conditions in our state-of-the-art health centres. Each
clinic features private treatment rooms and the latest in therapy, exercise equipment and treatment
techniques.
* Experienced and knowledgeable team of clinicians.
* Wide range of treatment and services under the same roof.
* In-person and Telehealth services.
* Convenient locations across the Lower Mainland and Victoria.
* Easy Online Booking.
* Free Parking.

Kinesiology may be fully or partially covered by ICBC or other private insurance companies or
providers. If you have any questions, call us today and our friendly staff will be able to help you.

The Health and Safety of our clients and staff is Back in Motion’s #1 priority. Back in Motion
internal Health & Safety Committee has developed and implemented a comprehensive Safety Plan, to
make our clinics safe for clients and staff. We have made changes to the facilities, operational and
administrative processes. To review our plan, review our [Communicable Disease Prevention
Plan][65] page.

Back in Motion Health also offers Kinesiology through [Telehealth][66]. Learn more about
[Kinesiology Telehealth][67].

### Before Your Appointment

If there are any specific preparations required for your appointment, you will be advised prior to
your appointment day.

### During Your Appointment

Your Kinesiologist will perform an assessment to identify areas of weakness and restriction,
customize an exercise prescription and provide education regarding pain-management techniques,
pacing, and injury prevention.

At the end of the session, you will be reminded to book your follow-up appointments, when needed.
You may do that with your Kinesiologist, call one of our locations, or [book online][68].

### After Your Appointment

If applicable and needed for your treatment plan, you Kinesiologist will email exercises
descriptions, pictures and videos. This content is accessed through an app on your phone, computer
or tablet. Through this app, you and your Kinesiologist are able to track your progress towards the
exercises you should be performing at home.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What’s the difference between in-person and Telehealth Kinesiology?**

Telehealth sessions and in-person appointments follow the same structure. During Telehealth
sessions, there is no hands-on treatment, but with video access, your clinician is able to ensure
proper technique and completion of exercises. Kinesiologists will assist you to perform your
exercise routine with what you have around the house instead of typical gym equipment. Learn more
about [Telehealth][69] and [Kinesiology Telehealth][70].

**How can I book an appointment with a Kinesiologist?**

At Back in Motion Health, appointments may be booked via phone, online or in-person. Visit our
contact page to call the most convenient location for you. You may also call our main toll free
number [1-866-205-9000][71] and choose the most convenient location from the directory.

**I am not sure if active Rehabilitation/ Kinesiology is right for me. How can I tell?**

If you need to better understand which services we offer and which ones can benefit your own
conditions and circumstances, our friendly staff is here to help! Call us [1-866-205-9000][72] and
we will navigate you through services that may help you.

**Is my Active Rehabilitation/ Kinesiology appointment covered by my extended health plan?**

Clients should refer to their specific Extended Medical Plan coverage for details on services and
coverage available. If you have coverage, Back in Motion Health directly bills most Extended Health
Plans (verify if your plan is on our [list][73]), or provides a medical receipt to be used on
request for reimbursement.

Workplace injuries are usually due to trauma or overuse. If you have been injured as a result of a

appointments will be funded (within the approved time parameters). When you are ready, your
physiotherapist will work with you, your employer, physician, and WorkSafeBC Case Manager to develop
a safe and appropriate return to work plan. If your claim has been denied or is disallowed, the
expenses will need to be covered by the Client.

# Acupuncture Therapy in the Lower Mainland

Acupuncture is a safe, non-invasive technique, with limited or minor side effects, utilized at Back
in Motion as an alternative or adjunct treatment.

[Book Now][62]

## About Acupuncture

[Book Now][63]

Acupuncture is a form of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) that uses needles to stimulate the
balance and flow of Qi energy through the body.

According to TCM, Qi energy flows along the meridians, with are pathways connected throughout the
whole body. When the energy of flow is smooth, the body is in good health – the yin/yang balance is
known as homeostasis. The TCM belief is that when the flow of energy is deficient or obstructed, it
indicates a susceptibility for illness and/or certain conditions.

Acupuncture is a safe and effective alternative treatment. Physiotherapists combine this knowledge
of TCM with Western medicine, evidence-informed practice, to provide this alternative or adjunct
treatment.

Through the insertion of needles in specific points of the body, this technique works by:
* stimulating the release of endorphins (body’s natural pain relief hormones)
* altering various biochemical and physiological processes
* affecting the functioning of the hormonal system

Thereby acupuncture can:
* assists with the natural healing process
* decrease inflammation
* increase circulation
* relieve pain

### **Is Acupuncture Therapy recommended for me?**

Acupuncture can be used to treat individuals from all ages, from children to seniors. At Back in
Motion, it is often utilized in combination with other techniques or services. When used in
conjunction with physio or massage therapy, acupuncture can be recommended to help treat conditions
such as:

Pain (any area of the body)

Bursitis

Frozen shoulder

Epicondylitis

Tendonitis

Low back pain

Chronic pain

Sciatica

Carpal Tunnel Syndrome

Muscle and joint dysfunctions

Muscle tension

Whiplash (i.e. motor vehicle accident)

Fibromyalgia

Osteoarthritis

Neuropathy/ neuralgia

Headaches

Concussion management and symptoms

Acupuncture is one of the services available for individuals who have been involved in a motor
vehicle accident, along with massage therapy and physiotherapy. Back in Motion health offer the
services you need to increase function.

### Benefits of Acupuncture At Back in Motion Health

Acupuncture is a non-invasive technique, with limited or minor side effects, helps to:
* Relieve pain
* Reduce spasms
* Reduce swelling
* Promote faster healing
* Improve body function and mobility
* Enhanced quality of life for individuals with chronic pain

A recommended course of treatment can be made after a complete assessment by one of our trained Back
in Motion Physiotherapists. Contact us today to book an appointment or to learn more about these
services.

### Why Choose Acupuncture at Back in Motion Health?

Our Team treats a wide range of injuries and conditions in our state-of-the-art health centres. Each
clinic features private treatment rooms and the latest in therapy, exercise equipment and treatment
techniques.
* Experienced and knowledgeable team of clinicians.
* Wide range of treatment and services under the same roof.
* Convenient locations across the Lower Mainland and Victoria.
* Easy Online Booking.
* Free Parking.
* Direct Billing to most Extended Health Providers.

### Before Your Appointment

If there are any specific preparations required for your appointment, you will be advised prior to
your appointment day.

### During Your Appointment

On the appointment day, it is recommended to wear loose fitting clothes that can easily be rolled up
or maneuvered. In certain cases, clinicians will give you a gown to wear in order to access the area
of treatment.

Your clinician may ask you a few questions (additional to the comprehensive assessment performed in
your first appointment) to better determine if acupuncture is recommended for you, and what you
should expect from the treatment.

Sessions usually last between 15 and 30 minutes, although your therapist may choose to take/leave
the needles sooner or longer. Relief may be immediate or occur within a few hours or days following
treatment.

Most people find their acupuncture treatment relaxing. A few individuals experience minimal
discomfort. Acupuncture needles are very fine, metallic, thin, and have rounded tips, which makes
them quite painless upon insertion. Everyone experiences acupuncture differently, but most feel no
pain or very minimal pain as the needles are inserted.

During the treatment, you may experience a small amount of bleeding at the needle site, which may
cause mild bruising.

It is common to feel aching, warmth/heat and heaviness in the area of application, which is not
perceived as an undesirable outcome. These symptoms may be present from a few seconds/minutes to a
few hours after the treatment. Individuals may also experience fatigue, dizziness, tingling,
sweating, nausea or fainting.

Your clinician will monitor your symptoms throughout the session and will decide to continue or
interrupt treatment.

At the end of the session, you will be reminded to book your follow-up appointments, when needed.
You may do that with your clinician, call one of our locations, or [book online][64].

### After Your Appointment

After your session you will be able to move the body part normally, and you may notice relief of
symptoms after the session. If you experienced small amounts of bleeding during the needle
insertion, you may notice mild bruising at the needle site.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Is Acupuncture Safe?**

Yes, acupuncture is a safe technique. Needles are sterile and meant for a single-use, so there is no
risk of infection or transmission of disease. Back in Motion Clinicians that apply acupuncture have
CAFCI designation, are trained to safely use acupuncture, and understand the precautions and
contraindications to this technique.

Individuals may experience minimal discomfort during treatment. It is common to feel aching, heat
and heaviness during the treatment, which is not perceived as an undesirable outcome. These symptoms
may be present from a few seconds to a few hours after the treatment. During the treatment, you may
also experience small amount of bleeding at the needle site, which may case mild bruising.
Individuals may also experience fatigue, dizziness, tingling, sweating, nausea, or fainting.

** Does Acupuncture have any side effects?**

Acupuncture treatments have very few adverse effects and complications from its use. After
treatment, very few individuals presented are nausea, fainting, and mild bruising in the area of
application.

**Does Acupuncture hurt?**

Acupuncture is a gentle treatment that causes none to minimal discomfort. Most patients find the
technique relaxing and effective for their individual needs. Acupuncture needles are very fine,
metallic and thin, which makes it painless upon insertion.

**Is Acupuncture appointment covered by my extended health plan?**

Clients should refer to their specific Extended Medical Plan coverage for details on services and
coverage/limits available. Generally speaking, most insurance plans offer coverage for this
treatment. If you have coverage, Back in Motion Health directly bills most Extended Health Plans
(verify if your plan is on our [list][65]), or provides a medical receipt to be used on request for
reimbursement.

If you have sustained a workplace injury, or have been involved in a car accident, acupuncture may

The Back in Motion Concussion Clinic provides early management of a concussion by offering an

# Dry Needling – Intramuscular Stimulation IMS in the Lower Mainland

Dry Needling is a modern and effective approach for treating a multitude of musculoskeletal
problems.

[Book Now][62]

## About Dry Needling – Intramuscular Stimulation IMS

[Book Now][63]

Dry Needling Intramuscular Stimulation (IMS) is a modern approach that uses sterile, single-use
disposable needles, with the main goal to release myofascial trigger points. Myofascial trigger
points are points in the muscle that feels tight and painful on compression, stretch or movement.

This approach is based on Western medicine principles and research, and involves multiple advances
of a filament needle into the skin and muscle.

Dry needling use techniques called pistoning or sparrow pecking. Both of these techniques rely on
in-and-out needle insertion. This makes this therapy different from acupuncture (in which the needle
stay inserted in the skin for longer period of time). The needle may be inserted in the area of
pain, or the surrounded area.

The length of time of the treatment is determined by your clinician.

### **Is Dry Needling Therapy recommended for me?**

Dry Needling is effective for treating a multitude of musculoskeletal problems, including:

Neck, back and shoulder pain

Tendinopathies (Tennis Elbow, Golfer’s Elbow)

Headaches

Sciatica

Carpal Tunnel Syndrome

Repetitive Strain Injuries

Chronic Pain

Fibromyalgia

Sports Injuries

At Back in Motion, Dry Needling is one of the techniques utilized by Physiotherapists to support
your treatment. A recommended course of treatment can be made after a complete assessment by one of
our trained Back in Motion therapists. Contact us today to book an appointment or to learn more
about these services.

### Benefits of Dry Needling IMS:

Dry Needling is a safe and effective alternative treatment. Through the insertion of needles in
specific points of the body, this technique:
* relieves pain (by the release of inflammatory chemicals)
* relieves muscles spasms
* increase flexibility and range of motion
* increased blood flow in the area

### Why Choose Dry Needling IMS at Back in Motion Health?

Our Team treats a wide range of injuries and conditions in our state-of-the-art health centres. Each
clinic features private treatment rooms and the latest in therapy, exercise equipment and treatment
techniques.
* Experienced and knowledgeable team of clinicians
* Wide range of treatment and services under the same roof
* Convenient locations across the Lower Mainland and Victoria
* Easy Online Booking
* Direct Billing
* Free Parking

### Before Your Appointment

If there are any specific preparations required for your appointment, you will be advised prior to
your appointment day.

### During Your Appointment

On the appointment day, it is recommended to wear loose fitting clothes that can easily be rolled up
or maneuvered. In certain cases, clinicians will give you a gown to wear in order to access the area
of treatment.

Your clinician may ask you a few questions (additional to the comprehensive assessment performed in
your first appointment) to better determine if dry needling IMS is recommended for you, and what you
should expect from the treatment.

The approach involves the insertion in-and-out of the needle, which may cause a reflexive response
of the muscle – like a twitch. When needling the trigger point, it causes a rapid release of a tense
muscle band, decreasing tightness and sensitivity.

Patients may experience a mild discomfort when occasional twitching occurs, as well as cramping
sensation or dull ache during treatment. The dull ache may last up to 24 hours post-treatment.

During the treatment, you may also notice a small amount of bleeding at the needle site, which may
cause mild bruising. Individuals may also experience fatigue, dizziness or fainting. Your clinician
will monitor your symptoms throughout the session and will decide to continue or interrupt
treatment.

At the end of the session, you will be reminded to book your follow-up appointments, when needed.
You may do that with your clinician, call one of our locations, or [book online][64].

### After Your Appointment

It is normal to have mild to moderate muscle soreness after dry needling treatment. Drink water,
stretch, move your body and apply heat to the sore muscles to reduce the duration of the soreness.
Side effects include mild muscle soreness and bruising in some patients. If you are experiencing any
other symptoms at the site of the application, contact us to speak with your clinician.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Is Dry Needling IMS safe?**

Yes, dry needling IMS is a safe technique. Needles are sterile and meant for a single-use, so there
is no risk of infection or transmission of disease. Back in Motion Clinicians that utilizes this
technique are trained to safely apply the needles, and understands the precautions and
contraindications to this technique.

Individuals may experience minimal discomfort during treatment. It is common to feel aching during
and after treatment, up to 24 hours. During the treatment, you may also experience a small amount of
bleeding at the needle site, which may cause mild bruising afterwards. Individuals may also
experience fatigue, dizziness, and fainting.

**Does Dry Needling IMS have any side effects?**

Dry Needling IMS treatment have very few adverse effects and complications from its use. After
treatment, very few individuals presented are dull ache and/or bruising at the site of application,
and fainting.

**Does Dry Needling IMS hurt?**

Dry Needling IMS involves the insertion in-and-out of the needle, which may cause a reflexive
response of the muscle – like a twitch. When needling the trigger point, it causes a rapid release
of a tense muscle band, decreasing tightness and sensitivity. Patients may experience a mild
discomfort when occasional twitching occurs, as well as cramping sensation or dull ache during
treatment. The dull ache may last up to 24 hours post-treatment.

**Is Dry Needling IMS appointment covered by my extended health plan?**

Clients should refer to their specific Extended Medical Plan coverage for details on services and
coverage/limits available. Generally speaking, most insurance plans offer coverage for this
treatment if the plan includes coverage for physiotherapy. If you have coverage, Back in Motion
Health directly bills most Extended Health Plans (verify if your plan is on our [list][65]), or
provides a medical receipt to be used on request for reimbursement.

## About Hand Therapy in Coquitlam

[client receiving hand therapy on their right thumb][client receiving hand therapy on their right
thumb]
[Book Online][64]
[Call Us][65]

Your hands are vital to everyday life, and we proudly offer specialized hand therapy services at
Back in Motion Health in Coquitlam. With a dedicated and local therapist available at our Coquitlam
location, we’re committed to helping you regain optimal function and mobility in your hands, wrists,
elbows and shoulders.

[Contact us today][66] to schedule an appointment.

## What’s Hand Therapy?

Hand therapy is a specialized form of rehabilitation focused on assessing and treating various
conditions affecting the hands and upper extremities. It combines occupational and physical therapy
elements to address multiple issues, including injuries, chronic conditions and post-surgical
rehabilitation. Hand therapists are highly trained occupational therapists (OT) or [physical
therapists (PT)][67] with extensive experience treating hand and upper extremity conditions.

## **Conditions that Hand Therapy Treats**

Our hand physiotherapist can address various conditions, including:
* Fractures and dislocations
* Tendon and nerve injuries
* Arthritis and rheumatic diseases
* Crush injuries
* Carpal tunnel syndrome
* Dupuytren’s contracture
* Repetitive strain injuries
* Sports-related injuries

Our hand therapist in Coquitlam also provides care for individuals experiencing chronic conditions
that impact the function of their upper extremities, including autoimmune disorders, neurological
conditions, pain syndromes, diabetes-related complications, focal dystonia, congenital anomalies and
psychogenic disorders.

If you want to find out if hand physio is right for you, [contact us today][68] to schedule a
consultation.

## Your Coquitlam Hand Therapist

### Paramjot (Param) Dhillon

#### Meet Param

Paramjot obtained a **Master’s in Physiotherapy (Musculoskeletal)** from **Punjabi University,
India** in **2009**. She has over **13 years of experience** working with orthopedic injuries.
Paramjot has worked as an **Associate Professor** in **Christian Medical College and Hospital,
India**. She has **9 research articles** published in reputable journals. Her approach involves
exercise prescription, soft tissue mobilization/myofascial release, patient education, correction of
posture and movement patterns. She is certified in **Dry Needling Level 1 and 2**, **Pelvic Floor
Level 1 and Level 2**, and specializes in pelvic pain, pregnancy, and pelvic girdle pain. Param has
completed numerous advanced certifications, including **Certified Hand Therapist** from the **Hand
Therapy Certification Commission**, and has also taken additional courses in **Wound Care for Hand
Specialists**, **Mulligan Manual Therapy**, **Sports-related Concussion**, **Post-Concussion
Syndrome**, **Vestibular Rehabilitation**, **Temporomandibular Disorders (TMD)**, **Orofacial
Pain**, and **Mechanical Diagnosis and Therapy (MDT)** for the lumbar spine from the **Robin
McKenzie Institute**.

## Frequently Asked Questions – FAQ

Get answers to some of the most common questions about Hand Therapy.

**How Does Hand Therapy Improve Function?**

Hand therapy goes beyond simply treating symptoms — it aims to improve overall hand function and
quality of life. It addresses the underlying cause of the issue to implement targeted interventions.
In short, hand therapy can help you regain independence and confidence in performing daily
activities.

**What Does Hand Therapy Treatment Involve?**

Hand therapy treatment is tailored to each individual’s specific needs and goals. It may include
therapeutic exercises, including strength exercises, dexterity training, nerve desensitization, scar
management and [deep tissue massage][69]. The goal of treatment is to improve strength, range of
motion, dexterity and function while reducing pain and swelling.

When you meet with a certified hand therapist at Back in Motion Health in Coquitlam, we’ll work
closely with you to develop a personalized treatment plan to address your unique challenges. Whether
recovering from surgery, managing a chronic condition or rehabilitating an injury, our team is here
to support you every step of the way.

# Mental Health Support for ICBC Clients

Compassionate Care from Registered Psychologists & Counsellors. Call Now or email us to Book Your
Initial Assessment.

[Phone: 604-575-5681][62]
[Email Us][63]

## About Mental Health Support for ICBC Clients

Recovering from a motor vehicle accident (MVA) involves more than physical healing. Many people
experience emotional, cognitive, and psychological challenges in the weeks and months following a
collision. At **Back in Motion Health**, our team of **Registered Psychologists and Clinical
Counsellors** provides specialized mental health care to help you regain confidence, stability, and
wellbeing.

## ICBC Covers Mental Health Treatment

If you have an active ICBC claim, you are **pre-approved for 12 counselling or psychology
sessions** with no upfront cost.This means you can begin receiving support right away — no physician
referral needed.

[Phone: 604-575-5681][64]
[Email Us][65]

## Common Symptoms After a Motor Vehicle Accident

It’s completely normal to experience psychological changes after an accident, even if physical
injuries seem minor.

Our mental health team can help if you’ve noticed:

**Trauma-Related Symptoms**
* Intrusive thoughts or memories of the accident
* Avoidance of reminders (e.g., intersections, night driving)
* Feeling on edge, jumpy, or easily startled
* Flashbacks or emotional distress when recalling the event

**Driving Anxiety & Travel Avoidance**
* Fear, panic, or discomfort while driving
* Hesitation or inability to get back on the road
* Avoiding certain routes, conditions, or highways

**Sleep Disruptions**
* Difficulty falling or staying asleep
* Waking up throughout the night
* Nightmares or restless sleep

**Anxiety & Depression**
* Persistent worry or fear
* Feeling overwhelmed or emotionally “shut down”
* Low mood, sadness, or loss of joy
* Feeling hopeless or disconnected

**Low Motivation & Fatigue**
* Difficulty returning to daily routines
* Reduced productivity or engagement
* Feeling exhausted or mentally drained

**Cognitive Changes**
* Trouble concentrating
* Memory lapses
* Feeling mentally foggy or distracted

## How Our Mental Health Team Helps

Our Psychologists and Counsellors use evidence-based treatments tailored to MVA-related trauma and
emotional recovery, including:
* Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT)
* Trauma-focused CBT
* Cognitive Processing Therapy (CPT)
* Mindfulness Based Cognitive Therapy (MBCT)
* Mindfulness-based stress reduction
* Supportive counselling and coping strategies

## Why Mental Health Support Matters in Your ICBC Recovery

Addressing psychological symptoms early can:
* Improve physical healing
* Reduce long-term disability risk
* Restore confidence on the road
* Support return to work and daily life
* Improve sleep, mood, and overall functioning

You don’t have to wait until symptoms become severe. Early support makes a significant difference.

## Getting Started Is Easy

With an active ICBC claim, you can begin therapy immediately.

**ICBC pre-approves 12 sessions** with a Registered Psychologist or Counsellor.We direct bill ICBC,
and our team handles all documentation required for your claim.

## You’re Not Alone — We’re Here to Support Your Recovery

Whether you’re dealing with trauma, anxiety, disrupted sleep, or loss of motivation, our team is
here to provide compassionate, evidence-based care.At Back in Motion Health, we’ll help you rebuild
confidence, restore emotional wellbeing, and move forward with strength.

## ICBC Services – Frequently Asked Questions

**I have an active claim. What services can I utilize? Can I see more than one therapist at once?**

With an active ICBC claim (within 3 months of the date of the accident), most patients are approved
for Kinesiology, Massage Therapy, Physiotherapy and Counselling. Clients may see more than one
therapist at the simultaneously. In some instances, Occupational Therapists may also be approved to
be part of your treatment plan.

**What therapies are accessible to me under my claim?**

Clients may be eligible to:
* Physiotherapy (25 sessions)
* Massage Therapy (12 sessions)
* Kinesiology and Active Rehabilitation (12 sessions)
* Counselling (12 sessions)

Your claim will contain details of pre-approved treatments and costs.

* Please note that for RMT subsequent appointments, ICBC partly covers the 45-minute (or longer)
sessions. An additional user fee applies and must be paid by the patient. You may be able to claim
the additional costs under your Extended Health provider. This additional cost cannot be done
through direct billing; you will need to submit your receipts and request reimbursement directly
from your Extended Health provider.

**How do I pay my treatment if I have an active ICBC claim?**

Back in Motion does direct billing of pre-approved treatment costs to ICBC.

**How should I structure my appointments?**

Each service will have an assessment and subsequent treatment sessions. In order to maximize the
benefits of each therapy, Back in Motion suggests some treatment pairings. Your clinician will be
able to guide you and recommend therapies that are aligned to your treatment plan.

You may book your appointment(s) online. If you require assistance booking appointments
back-to-back, speak with our friendly staff today. They will help you to find a treatment pairing
appointment that is convenient for you.

**How soon can I get back to exercise?**

Movement is Medicine! It is important to maintain healthy muscles by doing movements and light
exercises to keep them healthy and strong. You can start working with a Kinesiologist within days of
your accident.

**How much does it cost?**

Your claim will contain details of pre-approved treatments and costs. Clients that utilize their
pre-approved costs will not incur any cost. All treatment costs covered by ICBC will be directly
billed to ICBC.

Please note that for RMT subsequent appointments, ICBC partly covers the 45-minute (or longer)
sessions. An additional user fee applies and must be paid by the patient.

If Client opts for booking longer appointments (from what has been pre-approved), clients are
responsible for paying the additional cost. These costs may be covered by your extended health plan,
but they cannot be claimed through direct billing. Back in Motion will provide you receipts for the
additional cost, and you will be responsible for submitting the reimbursement requests directly to
your health plan.

**What if I am still in pain after the initial 3 months?**

Some people will require more treatments and your therapist will request that to ICBC on your
behalf. Most happy patients are discharged from the therapists’ care but given a continued path to
follow on their own (i.e.: to kinesiology, home exercises, and/or maintenance treatment plan).

**Are there any additional user fees?**

ICBC partly covers the 45-minute (or longer) registered massage therapy sessions. An additional user
fee must be paid by the patient. Some extended health plans may cover the additional fee. Direct
billing is available for the ICBC portion, but not available for the user fee. More details are
available upon inquiry.

**Can I go for treatment in two different clinics under the same claim?**

Clients may attend different therapy treatments at different clinics and/or different therapists.
For example, you may attend Physiotherapy appointments in one clinic/location and Massage Therapy in
another clinic/location. However, clients are not allowed to use the same treatment in different
clinics and locations; i.e. go for a Physiotherapy appointment today in a clinic/location and
tomorrow go to another clinic/location.

**My claim is older than 3 months, what should I do?**

Physician referral is required to extend your claim, and ICBC approval will be required prior to
booking your appointment. If you attend an appointment and pay privately, when your claim is
approved, you will receive the reimbursement from us.

**Can I get longer appointments than the ones covered by ICBC?**

Yes. Additional user fees apply to the sessions longer than the ones covered by ICBC. Clients are
responsible for paying for the additional cost if they book longer than 45-minute appointments. You
may be able to claim the additional costs under your Extended Health provider. This additional cost
cannot be done through direct billing; you will need to submit your receipts and request
reimbursement directly from your Extended Health provider.

For RMT subsequent appointments, ICBC partly covers the 45-minute (or longer) sessions. An
additional user fee applies and must be paid by the patient.

**How soon (after an accident) is it safe for me to get treatment?**

As soon as you can! The old idea of “rest for a few days” has been disproven as harmful to one’s
recovery. The best thing you can do after an injury is stay engaged in your care, get assessed and
treated as soon as you’re able, and light, pain-free movement!

**How long before I feel better?**

Your recovery will depend on your injury, timing between accident and access of treatment, your
treatment plan and commitment to recovery. Your practitioner team will assess and propose the best
treatment plan, individualized for your needs. Throughout treatment, you will be re-assessed and
asked about changes/progress in your symptoms. Your treatment will be modified as needed to support
your recovery.

**What happens when my sessions are completed?**

At the end of your sessions, each therapist you see will conduct a re-assessment to see where you
are at in your recovery. This will be communicated with you so you know what your next steps will
be. You may be able to continue with a maintenance program after your claim has ended.

## About Pelvic Floor Physiotherapy

[Book Appointment Now][63]

**About Pelvic Floor Physiotherapy**

The Back in Motion Pelvic Floor Physiotherapy consists of the assessment and treatment of various
conditions that involve the pelvic floor (muscles, ligaments, nerves and connective tissue), or
symptoms presented in the area. Our Physiotherapist, specialized in female Pelvic Floor, will assess
and prescribe exercises and therapies to rehabilitate and strengthen the muscles lining of the
pelvic floor.

This service is available at Back in Motion Health Abbotsford location for female clients.

### **The Pelvic Floor**

The pelvic floor supports muscles and organs (bladder, rectum and reproductive system). When this
support weakens (due to certain conditions and circumstances), individuals may experience pain,
incontinence, organ prolapse, and other symptoms related to the pelvic area.

### **Is Pelvic Floor Physiotherapy the best therapy for me?**

If you are experiencing one or more symptoms listed below, you may benefit from seeing a
Physiotherapist specialized in pelvic floor rehabilitation:

Incontinence (stress, urge, overflow, functional)

Constipation or bowel strains

Lower back or hip pain

Pain or pressure in the pelvic region, genitals or rectum

Discomfort during sexual intercourse

Muscle spasms in the pelvic area

### Pelvic Floor Physiotherapy also benefits the following conditions/circumstances:
* Post pelvic surgery
* Prostatitis and post-prostatectomy
* Prolapse of pelvic organs
* Pregnancy and post-partum
* Bed-wetting in children
* Recurrent urinary tract infections
* Aging
* Menopause

If you are unsure if this treatment is recommended for you, call us for a free consultation. We will
guide you through treatments available that can support your specific needs.

### **Benefits **

Most patients notice an improvement/relief of symptoms after 4 to 6 weeks of treatment, but it may
take a couple of months to see a major change. You will notice:
* Symptom’s management
* Pain relief
* Reduction of the level of incontinence
* Higher awareness and muscle control in your pelvic area
* Increased mobility of the pelvic area
* Increased functionality to return to your daily life activities

### Why Choose Pelvic Floor Physiotherapy at Back in Motion Health?

Our Team treats a wide range of injuries and conditions in our state-of-the-art health centres. Each
clinic features private treatment rooms and the latest in therapy, exercise equipment and treatment
techniques.
* Experienced and knowledgeable team of clinicians

### Before Your Appointment

If there are any specific preparations required for your appointment, you will be advised prior to
your appointment day.

### During Your Appointment

Your Physiotherapist will perform a thorough assessment of your medical history, and a physical exam
to evaluate your posture, range of motion and strength of muscles. An internal exam may be required
to assess prolapse, tender or tight areas.

After the assessment, an individualized, evidence-based treatment plan is created to address your
symptoms, and rehabilitate your pelvic floor. Your treatment may include specific exercises to the
pelvic floor area, back and hip; stretching and strengthening of muscles; manual therapy;
bladder/bowel retraining; breathing techniques and more. Our treatment approach provides you with
education and behavioural changes. Your Physiotherapist may also suggest other treatment options,
including referral to other professionals (with your consent), if beneficial for your own needs.

Pelvic Floor Physiotherapy treatment requires client consent, which may be withdraw at any point.
You may bring a family member or friend to your appointment, or request for a witness during your
appointment. We provide a safe, respectful and inclusive environment at all times during your
treatment, so you can concentrate on getting better. Contact us is you have any questions, or to
book your free consultation.

At the end of the session, you will be reminded to book your follow-up appointments, when needed.
You may do that with your clinician, call one of our locations, or [book online][65].

## About Physiotherapy

[Book Now][64]

Physiotherapy is a healthcare profession that assists people to restore, maintain and maximize their
movement, function, strength and overall health. The treatment includes all aspects of the client
care: interview, assessment, diagnosis, treatment recommendations and planning, exercise
prescription, education, and functional/activity level progressions.

Your physiotherapist will screen to make sure no further medical investigations or consultations are
needed. Your Physiotherapist will work with you to create relevant, achievable goals of treatment.

### **Is Physiotherapy for me?**

The treatment is intended for anyone with acute or chronic musculoskeletal pain, or difficulties
with physical function, and/or chronic health conditions where exercise or activity modifications
are recommended. You do not need a physician referral, and most insurance carriers cover Telehealth
through direct billing.

The following common injuries or conditions are successfully treated through Physiotherapy:

Back Pain

Neck Pain

Shoulder/Elbow/Wrist Pain

Hip/Knee/Ankle Pain

Fractures, Sprains & Strains

Arthritis

Pre & Post-Surgery Rehabilitation

Dizziness & Balance Issues

Concussions

Pelvic Conditions

Back in Motion Health also offers Physiotherapy through Telehealth. Learn more about [Physiotherapy
Telehealth][65].
