# Registered Massage Therapy

Our experienced Registered Massage Therapists at Back in Motion can help you with a variety of
challenges, including the restoration of postural alignment, proper biomechanics, relieving muscle
tension related to sports injuries, motor vehicle accidents and stress.

[Book Online][62]
[Contact Us][63]

## About Massage Therapy

[Book Now][64]

Massage therapy is a type of treatment in which a trained and registered professional (RMT)
manipulates the soft tissue of your body (joints, muscles, ligaments, tendons, connective tissue and
skin, using a variety of techniques, pressure and movement, with the goals to alleviate pain,
improve blood flow and mobility, and promote healing.

Registered Massage Therapists (RMTs) in British Columbia are health care professionals committed to
restoring and maintaining optimal health for their patients. They are educated to assess and treat
using a variety of techniques.

### Is Massage Therapy for me?

Massage Therapy is recommended for a variety of health-related purposes, including:

Upper/lower back, neck, shoulder pain

Whiplash

Discomfort associated to a car accident

Discomfort associated with acute and chronic health conditions

Recovery for sports and activities

Carpal tunnel syndrome

Plantar fasciitis

Temporomandibular joint disorder (TMD)

Headaches

Osteoarthritis

Fibromyalgia

Stress-related tension

Cancer-related stress, pain and fatigue

Sleep disorders

Multiple sclerosis

High blood pressure

Stroke

Diabetes

Mental health conditions

Pregnancy

### Why Choose Massage Therapy at Back in Motion Health?

Our Team treats a wide range of injuries and conditions in our state-of-the-art health centres. Each
clinic features private treatment rooms and the latest in therapy, exercise equipment and treatment
techniques.
* Experienced and knowledgeable team of clinicians.
* Wide range of treatment and services under the same roof.
* Convenient locations across the Lower Mainland and Victoria.
* Easy Online Booking.
* Free Parking.
* Direct Billing to most Extended Health Providers.

### Back in Motion Health Massage Therapy sessions may help:
* relieve pain (due to a specific condition, injury or muscle soreness)
* reduce joint pain and tenderness
* increase flexibility, mobility, function and range of motion
* promote relaxation
* decrease muscle tension and muscle spasm
* improve muscle strength, endurance and tone
* reduce insomnia, and improve sleep
* increase blood circulation, and promote healing
* rehabilitate sports injuries
* reduce stress, anxiety and depression
* manage symptoms of lymphedema
* reduce disability
* enhance quality of life and promote overall wellness

### Types of Massage Therapy:
* Deep Tissue Massage
* Sports Massage
* Relaxation massage
* Prenatal massage
* Postnatal massage
******
Note**: No physician referral is needed for Register Massage Therapy.

### Before Your Appointment

If there are any specific preparations required for your appointment, you will be advised prior to
your appointment day.

### Your First Appointment

In your first appointment, your RMT will do a comprehensive intake and ask you about your medical
history related to the reason of your appointment. After better assessing you and your condition,
your RMT will discuss your treatment plan and expected results. As needed, your treatment will also
include a gradual plan to return to hobbies and physical activities.

As a reference, you may also watch the ‘What to expect from your first visit’ video created by
Registered Massage Therapists Association of British Columbia at
[https://www.rmtbc.ca/rmt-and-you/firstvisit][65].

### Subsequent Appointments

Your RMT will continue to evaluate your condition and how you are feeling in every session. You
should expect a portion of your visit to be used to review your treatment plan. Techniques utilized
during your appointment will be chosen accordingly to clinical findings and condition progress.

At the end of the session, you will be reminded to book your follow-up appointments, when needed.
You may do that with your clinician, call one of our locations, or [book online][66].

### After Your Appointment

Your RMT may follow up with you after your appointment, if needed. If you have any questions or
concerns about your appointment or your condition, call us.

You are always invite to provide feedback about the services and our clinics. We take feedback
seriously, and we implement comprehensive quality improvements plans to better serve you, every day.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How can I book an appointment with a Registered Massage Therapist?**

At Back in Motion Health, appointments may be booked via phone, online or in-person. Visit our
contact page to call the most convenient location for you. You may also call our main toll free
number [1-866-205-9000][67] and choose the most convenient location from the directory.

**I am not sure if Massage Therapy is right for me. How can I tell?**

If you need to better understand which services we offer and which ones can benefit your own
conditions and circumstances, our friendly staff is here to help! Call us [1-866-205-9000][68] and
we will navigate you through services that may help you.

**Is my Massage Therapy appointment covered by my extended health plan?**

Clients should refer to their specific Extended Medical Plan coverage for details on services and
coverage available. If you have coverage, Back in Motion Health directly bills most Extended Health
Plans (verify if your plan is on our [list][69]), or provides a medical receipt to be used on
request for reimbursement.

### WorkSafeBC Claims

Workplace injuries are usually due to trauma or overuse. If you have been injured as a result of a

If your claim is approved by WSBC, your initial assessment is 100% covered with a WorkSafeBC Claim
number. Once your claim has been accepted by WorkSafeBC, the full treatment cost of your
appointments will be funded (within the approved time parameters). When you are ready, your
physiotherapist will work with you, your employer, physician, and WorkSafeBC Case Manager to develop
a safe and appropriate return to work plan. If your claim has been denied or is disallowed, the
expenses will need to be covered by the Client.

(Nordel and Southpoint) through our subsidiary company, [Legacies Health Centre][66].

Interns offer relaxation massage treatments while they wait to take their licensing exams to become
fully registered RMTs.

The Intern massage therapy session is a great alternative and is recommended for clients who:

* want extra care in between their regular visits with their RMT

book, or [book online][68].

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Do I need a referral to book an intern massage session?**

**Are interns trained to do massage?**

Yes! Student interns are graduates from the rigorous [2200 hour British Columbia Registered Massage
Therapy Program][73], and are offering relaxation massages while they wait to take their licensing
exams to become fully registered RMTs.

**What is the Internship Program?**

Legacies Health Centres (a subsidiary company of Back in Motion) has been offering an Internship
Program for massage therapy students for the past few years.

Our Student Intern Program is a 12-week mentored, education-based internship that allows for new
graduates to work hands-on as an intern therapist while being mentored personally by a Clinical Team
Leader and learning skills that would otherwise not be accessible elsewhere in the industry. If you
want to learn more about the program or are interested in participating, visit the [Legacies Student
Intern Program][74] webpage.

# Shockwave Therapy

Shockwave therapy is a safe, non-invasive procedure often recommended by Orthopedic Surgeons for
treating many tendon, muscle and joint disorders.

[Book Now][62]

## About Shockwave Therapy

[Book Now][63]

Shockwave therapy, also known as Extracorporeal Shock Wave Therapy (ESWT), is a non-invasive
procedure that creates a series of pressurized air wave pulsations applied to the skin where the
injury is located.

Shockwave therapy stimulates the body’s soft tissues (muscles, tendons, and connective tissue)
natural self-healing process and can be very effective in treating subacute, sub chronic, chronic
conditions as well as recurrent or unresolved conditions.

Administered by one of our registered physical therapists, shockwave therapy is a non-surgical
option that in some cases, can provide results as effective as surgery, in as little as three to
five sessions.

### Is Shockwave Therapy recommended for me?

This therapy is often utilized the treatment of musculoskeletal conditions (involving connective
tissues such as tendons and ligaments), and it is an effective modality for pain management and to
increase function/ mobility in various conditions, such as:

Plantar Fasciitis

Achilles Tendinopathy

Elbow Tendinopathy (tennis and golfer’s elbow)

Patellar Tendinopathy (Jumper’s Knee)

Calcific Tendinopathy

Hip Bursitis

Trigger Points

Hallux Rigidus

Rotator cuff tendinopathy

Chronic Myofascial Pain

Hamstring Strain

Your Physiotherapist will assess your condition and determine if Shockwave Therapy is ideal for you.
Shockwave Therapy is not appropriate for the following health conditions: open wounds, cancer,
pregnancy, infection, circulatory disorder, nerve disorder, and individuals taking blood-thinning
medications.

### Why Choose Shockwave Therapy at Back in Motion Health?

Our Team treats a wide range of injuries and conditions in our state-of-the-art health centres. Each
clinic features private treatment rooms and the latest in therapy, exercise equipment and treatment
techniques.
* Experienced and knowledgeable team of clinicians.
* Wide range of treatment and services under the same roof.
* Convenient locations across the Lower Mainland.
* Easy Online Booking.
* Free Parking.

### Benefits of Shockwave Therapy
* Non-invasive
* Limited/mild side effects
* Effective modality for chronic conditions that don’t seem to respond well to other therapies
* Relieves pain
* Increase function and mobility
* Enhanced quality of life for individuals with chronic pain.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Does Shockwave Therapy have any side effects?**

Side effects are limited to mild soreness, tenderness, bruising, swelling, numbness or tingling in
the treated area.

**How can I book a Shockwave Therapy appointment?**

At Back in Motion Health, appointments may be booked via phone, [online ][64]or in-person. Visit our
contact page to call the most convenient location for you. You may also call our main toll free
number [1-866-205-9000][65] and choose the most convenient location from the directory.

**I am not sure if Shockwave Therapy is right for me. How will I know?**

During your appointment, your Physiotherapist will be able to assess if Shockwave Therapy is
recommended for your injury or health condition.

**Is Shockwave Therapy appointment covered by my extended health plan?**

Clients should refer to their specific Extended Medical Plan coverage for details on services and
coverage available. If you have coverage, Back in Motion Health directly bills most Extended Health

expenses will need to be covered by the Client.

# Sports Rehabilitation in the Lower Mainland

Return to sport quicker, stronger, and better prepared.

[Book Now][62]

## About Sports Rehab

[Book Now][63]

Sports Rehab is a safe therapeutic approach focused on helping individuals manage symptoms, return
to normal function (or pre-injury state), and enhance sport/activity performance.

No matter if you are a professional athlete, a competitive player, or a recreational athlete, you
all have the same goal: to achieve a full return to performance as soon as possible, with a minimal
risk of re-injury.

Sports rehab consists of targeted exercises to:
* return to pre-injury function
* reduce mobility restrictions
* prevent re-injury or worsening of the condition
* optimize performance
* education on gait, posture, form of movement

Back in Motion Health Sports Rehab team (Physiotherapist and/or a Kinesiologist) will perform a full
physical examination of your biomechanical alignment, joints, ligaments, muscles/tendons, and nerves
to determine a precise diagnosis of your injury and measure the extent of any damage.

Our trained clinicians will review your history to identify any potential training errors, as well
as prescribe a sport-specific strengthening and stretching plan, necessary to prevent recurrence of
injury.

Treatment options may include:

Graston Technique

Exercise Prescription

Shockwave Therapy for chronic recurrent problems

Athletic Taping

Neuromuscular Stimulation for “slow-to-fire” muscles

### Why Choose Sports Rehab at Back in Motion Health?

Our Team treats a wide range of injuries and conditions in our state-of-the-art health centres. Each
clinic features private treatment rooms and the latest in therapy, exercise equipment and treatment
techniques.
* Experienced and knowledgeable team of clinicians.
* Wide range of treatment and services under the same roof.
* In-person and Telehealth services.
* Direct Billing.
* Easy Online Booking.
* Free Parking.

### **Is a Sports Rehab right for you?**

Sports Rehab treats a variety of conditions, such as:
* Pain (any area of the body) associated to sports/activity
* Acute sport injuries
* Overuse injuries
* Dislocations
* Strains
* Sprains
* Muscle, ligaments or tendons injury
* Tendonitis
* Meniscus tears
* Surgery rehabilitation

**Benefits**

The main goals of Sports Rehab is to:
* Reduce pain
* Increase function and mobility
* Reduce mobility restrictions
* Achieve optimal performance
* Learn how to prevent recurrent injury or worsening on the existing one

### Before Your Appointment

If there are any specific preparations required for your appointment, you will be advised prior to
your appointment day.

### Your First Appointment

In your first appointment, your Physiotherapist will do a comprehensive assessment, provide you with
a diagnosis and share your treatment plan, which will include pain-management techniques, education,
guidance and prevention. As able, your treatment will also include a gradual plan to return to
hobbies, physical activities or sport.

### **Subsequent Appointments**

Your Physiotherapist will perform an assessment to verify progress and check how the treatment and
exercise plan is working for you. The treatment in each session will be determined by your
Physiotherapist based on your treatment plan and goals. Techniques and modalities in your treatment
plan will be chosen accordingly to clinical findings and condition progress. Your Physiotherapist
may also suggest including a Kinesiologist in your treatment team, if more in-depth strength and
conditioning is needed.

At the end of the session, you will be reminded to book your follow-up appointments, when needed.
You may do that with your clinician, call one of our locations, or [book online][64].

### After Your Appointment

You will receive subsequent exercises and educational materials (if applicable), and exercises to
perform at home between appointments.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Do I need a referral to book this appointment?**

No, a referral is not required to book Sports Rehab services with a Physiotherapist.

**I am not sure if Sports rehab is right for me. How will I know?**

No matter if you are a professional athlete, a competitive player, or a recreational athlete, you
all have the same goal: to achieve a full return to performance as soon as possible, with a minimal
risk of re-injury. We can help you to create a path to full recovery as well as how to prevent
recurrence. If you are not sure if this may help you, call our clinics and our staff will be able to
provide you guidance and options for treatment.

**Is Sports Rehab covered by my extended health plan?**

Clients should refer to their specific Extended Medical Plan coverage for details on services and
coverage available. This service may be covered under Physiotherapy or Kinesiology. If you have
coverage, Back in Motion Health directly bills most Extended Health Plans (verify if your plan is on
our [list][65]), or provides a medical receipt to be used on request for reimbursement.

# Vertigo & Dizziness Treatment in the Lower Mainland

Spinning? Dizzy? Our Experts Can Help.

[Book Now][62]

## About Vertigo & Dizziness Treatment

[Book Now][63]

Vertigo, a sense of dizziness, or feeling that the room is spinning around you, can significantly
affect your day-to-day functioning, ability to work, social relationships, and quality of life.
Factors such as head trauma, ear infections, or age can cause these symptoms.

Our Back in Motion vestibular therapists will work with you to develop an individualized treatment
plan, based on specialized exercises to retrain the system and rehabilitate the inner ear. With a
comprehensive plan in place, full recovery can often be made in as little as one to three visits.

## Insurance Claims & Information

*Get Back to Health after an Accident or Workplace Injury.*

### Extended Health Coverage

Back in Motion offers direct billing to most Extended Health plans to the majority of our services.
Some services (like Clinical Counselling), do not offer direct billing. In such instances, Back in
Motion provides a medical receipt to be used on request for reimbursement. See an updated list of
providers by clicking the ‘Learn More’ button below.

### ICBC Insurance Claims

Back in Motion’s team of clinicians, including Physiotherapists, Massage Therapists, Occupational
Therapists, Psychologists, Counsellors, and Kinesiologists, all have extensive experience in
administering ICBC treatments. We are here to help! Click the ‘Learn More’ button for additional
details.

### WorkSafeBC Claims

Workplace injuries are usually due to trauma or overuse. If you have been injured as a result of a
workplace activity, our team of experts at Back in Motion can perform a comprehensive assessment and
develop a treatment plan to reduce your symptoms and rehabilitate your injury.

If your claim is approved by WSBC, your initial assessment is 100% covered with a WorkSafeBC Claim
number. Once your claim has been accepted by WorkSafeBC, the full treatment cost of your
appointments will be funded (within the approved time parameters). When you are ready, your
physiotherapist will work with you, your employer, physician, and WorkSafeBC Case Manager to develop
a safe and appropriate return to work plan. If your claim has been denied or is disallowed, the
expenses will need to be covered by the Client.

# Contact Back in Motion Health – Richmond

For over 25 years, Back in Motion has been dedicated to helping people improve their health, enhance
their opportunities, and live better lives.

[Book At Our Richmond Clinic][62]

At Back in Motion Health Richmond, we are proud to be part of a trusted network of clinics
recognized across British Columbia for delivering exceptional, client-centred care. As a leader in
multidisciplinary health services, we are committed to helping individuals overcome pain, recover
from injury, and achieve their wellness goals through evidence-based treatment and compassionate
support.

Whether you’re suffering from a chronic condition, recovering from an accident, or simply looking to
improve your overall well-being, Back in Motion Health in Richmond is here to guide you. Our
integrated approach combines physiotherapy, kinesiology, psychological services, and more, ensuring
you receive the right care, at the right time, from the right professionals.

## [Directions][67] to Back in Motion Health Richmond

Back in Motion Health Richmond location is situated at unit 140, 6651 Elmbridge Way, Richmond,
Postal Code V7C5C2, across the street from WorkSafeBC Richmond.

If you are driving, we have ample free parking available to our Clients, please look for parking
plates designated to Back in Motion. If you are taking transit, we are located at less than a
3-minute walk from the bus stop at New Westminster, which connects with the nearest SkyTrain:
Richmond – Brighouse Station.

## Services Offered at Back in Motion Health Richmond

At Back in Motion Health, we count on an experienced team of professionals to offer you a wide range
of health care services near you in Richmond. Some of the key treatments available at our clinic
include:

### [Physiotherapy][68]

Our physiotherapy services can help you restore movement and reduce pain of affected areas. From
sports injuries to chronic pain, our experienced physiotherapists use manual therapy, exercise
prescription, and advanced techniques to support your recovery and long-term health.

[Learn More][69]

### [Kinesiology & Active Rehabilitation][70]

Our kinesiologists specialize in active rehab programs that promote strength, mobility, and
endurance. Whether you’re recovering from an injury or managing a long-term condition, we create
personalized exercise plans to help you regain confidence and return to your daily activities
safely.

[Learn More][71]

### [ICBC Services][72]

If you’ve been injured in a motor vehicle accident, our ICBC-approved programs provide coordinated
care to support your recovery. We offer physiotherapy, kinesiology, and psychological services under
one roof, streamlining your treatment and helping you get back on track faster.

[Learn More][73]

create holistic treatment plans. Here is an overview of the health care services we provide in the
Surrey area, designed to help you recover, regain function, and prevent future issues.

### [Physiotherapy][68]

Physiotherapy is centred on diagnosing and treating a broad spectrum of injuries, pain, and physical
conditions. Our knowledgeable and experienced physiotherapists employ personalized treatment plans
to restore movement, improve strength, and help you return to your optimal level of function.

[Learn More][69]

### [Registered Massage Therapy][70]

Our registered massage therapists (RMTs) deliver therapeutic massage tailored to address each
client’s specific needs and goals. RMT can help with a variety of challenges, including relieving
muscle tension associated with sports injuries, auto accidents, or postural strain.

[Learn More][71]

### [Active Rehab/Kinesiology][72]

Our active rehabilitation programs are developed and guided by professional kinesiologists, focusing
on movement and exercise therapy to restore function after injury. This service is essential if an
injury has prevented you from participating in daily activities or work.

[Learn More][73]

### [ICBC Services][74]

Back in Motion Health is fully equipped to manage and administer treatments for those recovering
from motor vehicle accidents (MVA) through ICBC claims. Our multidisciplinary team, including
physiotherapists, RMTs, and kinesiologists, possesses extensive experience in coordinating MVA
rehabilitation.

If you are driving, we have dedicated Back in Motion stalls in the building parking, accessed
through the back-lane. Please dial 208 at the keypad by the gate, and reception staff will open the
parking gate for you. If you are taking transit, buses numbers: 3, 8, 9, 19, 19 and 99 have stops

# Back in Motion Health – Goderich

For over 25 years, Back in Motion has been dedicated to helping people improve their health, enhance
their opportunities, and live better lives.

[Book At Our Goderich Clinic][46]

Born out of the motivation to make a real difference in the lives of others, Back in Motion was the
first private organization in British Columbia to specialize in the rehabilitation of individuals
with chronic back pain, helping them return to work.

Back in Motion’s five founders combined their expertise in clinical psychology, physiotherapy, and
business to assist a Richmond man in starting anew after being told he would never return to his
career in logging. This founding success defined Back in Motion’s purpose to help people improve
their health, enhance their opportunities, and live better lives.

We are excited to announce that we now serve in Goderich, Ontario, expanding our mission to support
even more individuals on their journey to recovery.

Conveniently located in West London, we serve clients from across the city, including
nearby neighbourhoods such as Downtown, Old South, Southcrest, Oakridge, Westmount, Highland, Old
North, and Medway.

## [Directions][56] to Back in Motion Health London

You’ll find us on the south side of Oxford Street West, in the Chelsey Park residences building,
right beside the pharmacy. Our clinic is easily accessible and centrally located in West London,
making it a convenient stop for residents across the city.

## Our Treatment Services in London

At Back in Motion Health London, we offer a range of specialized services designed to help you
recover, restore, and thrive. Our multidisciplinary team works collaboratively to deliver
personalized care in a welcoming and modern environment.

### [Physiotherapy][57]

Our London physiotherapists provide expert care for a wide range of injuries and conditions, from
sports-related issues to post-surgical rehabilitation. Using evidence-based techniques and
personalized plans, we help you regain mobility and reduce pain in a supportive setting.

[Learn More][58]

### [Registered Massage Therapy][59]

Our Registered Massage Therapists in London focus on restoring balance and relieving tension.
Whether you’re dealing with stress, injury recovery, or chronic pain, our RMTs use therapeutic
techniques to improve posture, biomechanics, and overall well-being.

[Learn More][60]

### [Pelvic Floor][61]

Our specialized Pelvic Floor physiotherapists in London assess and treat conditions related to the
pelvic floor, including pain, incontinence, and postpartum recovery. We provide compassionate,
confidential care to support your comfort and confidence.

[Learn More][62]

### [Shockwave Therapy][63]

Accelerate your healing with shockwave therapy at our London clinic. This non-invasive treatment is
ideal for tendon, muscle, and joint disorders, and is often recommended by orthopedic specialists.
Discover how shockwave therapy can contribute to a faster and stronger recovery.

[Learn More][64]

### [Osteoarthritis Service][65]

Our osteoarthritis service brings together a knowledgeable, experienced team of clinicians who
deliver personalized assessments, pain‑management strategies, and functional rehabilitation in our
state‑of‑the‑art clinics.

faster recovery and long-term results.

### Chiropractic Care

Our chiropractic services in Brampton focus on restoring proper alignment, relieving back and neck

better and feel better.

Our registered massage therapy services help relieve muscle tension, reduce stress, and promote
relaxation. Massage therapy is also highly effective for injury recovery, improving circulation, and
enhancing flexibility.

### **Osteopathy in Brampton**

osteopathic treatments help relieve pain, improve mobility, and restore balance by addressing
restrictions in muscles, joints, and tissues.

accelerate healing for chronic conditions like tendonitis and plantar fasciitis, providing faster

# Telehealth Service

Back in Motion now offers Physiotherapy and Kinesiology services through video conferencing
technology and telephone. Our Telehealth services allow clients to connect with their
physiotherapist and kinesiologist in a secure, easy, innovative and convenient way!

[Call Us Now!][62]

## About Telehealth

[Call Us Now!][63]

**Telehealth** is the service delivery of healthcare, whether clinical or educational, through
telecommunication channels (telephone or video-conferencing). **Telerehabilitation** is a sub-group
of Telehealth that describes the delivery of Physiotherapy, Occupational Therapy and Kinesiology via
telecommunication channels.

The same expectations outlined by each profession’s regulatory body with respect to standards of
conduct and code of practice apply regardless if the session is delivered in-person or virtually.

Telehealth services is in full compliance with Professional Regulatory Bodies (Psychology, Physical
Therapy, Occupational Therapy, Physicians) with respect to guidelines, policies and practice
directives.

Both Telehealth and Telerehabilitation feature all aspects of patient care:

Interview

Assessment and Diagnosis

Treatment Planning

Application of exercise software

Lifestyle Progression (gradual return to hobbies/activities)

Education

### Why Choose Telehealth at Back in Motion Health?
* Our Telehealth services allow clients to connect with their clinicians in a secure, easy,
innovative and convenient way!
* Our clinicians have extensive training on delivering services through this channel. We take
professionalism and privacy seriously, and our care is, as always, client-focused.
* Continuity of care may be provided through telehealth, in-person services or a combination of
both.
* Your privacy is our priority. Back in Motion utilizes a secure Telehealth platform; and our
Clinicians are intensively trained to be professional, respectful and follow industry and services
best practices and guidelines (similar to the in-person appointments).

### Is Telehealth for me?

Our knowledgeable staff will be able to determine if **Telehealth **is an appropriate format of
service delivery for your unique needs. Generally speaking, individuals experiencing difficulties
with physical function or mental health would benefit from **Telehealth **services, through the
provision of assessment, treatment, education, and ongoing guidance and support.

[Call today][64] for a free consultation to find out if **Telehealth** is appropriate for you.

**Benefits of Telehealth**

Telehealth services offer clients a flexible, convenient and easy access to healthcare services:
* Get the treatment you need from home (or desired location)
* No need to worry about childcare, commuting or parking
* Fit with you busy schedule: book your appointment between meetings or commitments
* Rapid access to healthcare services (no wait times)
* Your location, or mobility barriers are no longer a challenge to attend an appointment
* Easy to connect (internet access, tablet/desktop/laptop with microphone and camera)
* Ease access to services for clients in remote areas

A 2019 study (conducted by J.D. Power) indicates that Telehealth has one of the highest satisfaction
scores of all healthcare sector. Other studies show a positive impact with respect to client
satisfaction and outcomes, due to increased focus on self-management.

### Back in Motion Health Telehealth includes the following services:

Back in Motion delivers the following services through Telehealth:
* Physiotherapy Telehealth – [read more][65] (Assessment 40-minute session and Treatment 20-minute
session)
* Kinesiology Telehealth – [read more][66] (Assessment 40-minute session and Treatment 20-minute
session)
* Clinical Counselling and Psychological Services (Assessment and Treatment 60-minute session)

### Before Your Appointment

To attend a Telehealth appointment, you will need a Jane App account, a desktop/laptop computer or
tablet (with camera and microphone), internet connection and an account with our scheduling
software. No software installation is required. Staff will guide you on how to obtain all required
steps.

You will receive an email confirming your appointment and providing you with the link to connect
with your healthcare provider.

You will receive a notification prior to your scheduled appointment, to remind you to connect.

You will also receive any documentation or forms to review or complete prior to your appointment.

You may connect to your appointment by clicking on the link provided in the orientation email, or by
logging-in to your Jane App account. Once you click on the appointment link, your clinician will be
waiting for you. Easy as that!

If there are any specific preparations required for your appointment, you will be advised prior to
your appointment. day.

### During Your Appointment

In your first appointment, you will sign a consent for services being delivered through Telehealth.

Your clinician will do a comprehensive assessment, provide you with a diagnosis and share your
treatment plan, which will include pain-management techniques, education, guidance and prevention.
In addition to that, you will be set-up with a Physitrack account, a world leader in remote patient
engagement through an exercise platform. Through this software, your Clinician will prescribe you an
individualized exercise routine to support you through recovery. As needed, your treatment will also
include a gradual plan to return to hobbies and physical activities.

### After Your Appointment

At the end of the session, you will be reminded to book your follow-up appointments. You may do that
with your clinician or call one of our locations.

If applicable, and part of your treatment session, you may receive subsequent exercises and
educational materials via email.

You will also receive an email to complete a client satisfaction form, to provide you with the
opportunity for feedback and suggestions. We take feedback seriously, and we implement comprehensive
quality improvements plans to better serve you, every day.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Is Telehealth secure? Will my information be private?**

Privacy of Information is priority for us. Back in Motion Telehealth services utilizes secure
platforms and our Clinicians are intensively trained to be professional, respectful and follow
industry and services best practices and guidelines (similar to the in-person appointments).

**Can I combine Telehealth and in-person services?**

Healthcare services can be delivered in-person, through Telehealth, or a combination of both.

**Is my Telehealth appointment covered by my extended health plan?**

**Telehealth **is covered with direct billing by most insurance companies and extended health plans,
with limited exceptions. To inquire about your coverage, please call any of our locations to speak
with a staff member. Clients should also refer to their specific Extended Medical Plan coverage for
details on services and coverage available. If you have coverage, Back in Motion Health directly
bills most Extended Health Plans (verify if your plan is on our [list][67]), or provides a medical
receipt to be used on request for reimbursement.

**How can I book a Telehealth appointment?**

At Back in Motion Health, we offer Physiotherapy, Kinesiology, Clinical Counselling and
Psychological Services Through telehealth. You may book appointments may be booked via phone or
in-person. Visit our contact page to call the most convenient location for you. You may also call
our main toll free number [1-866-205-9000][68] and choose the most convenient location from the
directory.

**I am not sure if Telehealth is right for me. How can I tell?**

If you need to better understand which services we offer and which ones can benefit your own
conditions and circumstances, our friendly staff is here to help! Call us [1-866-205-9000][69] and
we will navigate you through services that may help you.

# Telehealth Kinesiology

Back in Motion Telehealth Kinesiology aims to mimic the usual in-person sessions.

[Book Now][62]

## About Telehealth Kinesiology

[Book Now][63]

Back in Motion Telehealth Kinesiology aims to mimic the usual in-person sessions. This includes an
assessment to identify areas of weakness and restriction, customized exercise prescription, and
education regarding pain-management techniques, pacing, and injury prevention. The goal of these
sessions is to help return our clients to their regular life activities, through the education on
active rehabilitation (strengthening, mobility and stretching exercises).

Telehealth Kinesiology sessions are done in a one-on-one setting, from the comfort of your own home,
using the equipment you have on hand.

Back in Motion Telehealth services allow clients to connect with their kinesiologist in a secure,
easy, innovative and convenient way!

### **Did you know?**

Kinesiologists are educators that help you take control of your body and lead a better and more
active lifestyle!

Telehealth Kinesiology sessions are fully covered by ICBC, and may be fully or partially covered by
other private insurance companies or providers. To inquire about your coverage, [call][64] any of
our locations to speak with a staff member that can answer your questions.

### Kinesiology Services

– Kinesiology > Assessment Sessions > 40 min
– Kinesiology > Treatment Sessions > 20 min

Kinesiology services can be delivered in-person, through Telehealth, or a combination of both.

Other services:

– [Telehealth Physiotherapy][65]
– [Telehealth Counselling][66]
– [Active Rehab][67]

### **Who May benefit from Telehealth Kinesiology?**

Generally, individuals with musculoskeletal conditions respond well to active rehabilitation
(Telehealth or in-person). Kinesiology sessions through Telehealth are right for you if you have
been in a motor vehicle accident, have sustained a mild sport injury, neck pain, lower back pain,
shoulder pain, knee pain, arthritis, osteoarthritis, as well as individuals that would like to
maximize your physical well-being and fitness levels.****

### **Benefits of Kinesiology through Telehealth**

Kinesiology Telehealth sessions help clients to increase their physical activity as well to support
their rehabilitation (either through an injury, a car accident, etc.). Clients that participate on
Telehealth Kinesiology Sessions also benefit from:

– Telehealth services offer clients a flexible, convenient and easy access to healthcare services–
Get the treatment you need from home (or desired location)– No need to worry about childcare,
commuting or parking– Fit with you busy schedule: book your appointment between meetings or
commitments– Rapid access to healthcare services (no wait times)– Your location, or mobility
barriers are no longer a challenge to attend an appointment– Easy to connect (internet access,
tablet/desktop/laptop with microphone and camera)– Ease access to services for clients in remote
areas.

A 2019 study (conducted by J.D. Power) indicates that Telehealth has one of the highest satisfaction
scores of all healthcare sector. Other studies show a positive impact with respect to client
satisfaction and outcomes, due to increased focus on self-management.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is the difference between Telehealth and In-Person Appointments**

Telehealth sessions and in-person appointments follow the same structure for Kinesiology sessions.
During Telehealth sessions, there is no hands-on treatment, but with video access, your clinician is
able to ensure proper technique and completion of exercises. Kinesiologists will assist you to
perform your exercise routine with what you have around the house instead of typical gym equipment.

# Telehealth Physiotherapy in the Lower Mainland

Back in Motion Telehealth Physiotherapy aims to mimic the usual in-person sessions.

## About Telehealth Physiotherapy

[Book Now][63]

Physiotherapy Telehealth, also known as Telerehabilitation, includes all aspect of patient care:
Interview, Assessment and Diagnosis, Treatment recommendations and planning, exercise prescription,
education, and functional/activity level progressions. The physiotherapist will screen to make sure
no further medical investigations or consultations are needed. Your Physiotherapist will work with
you to create relevant, achievable goals of treatment.

### **Did you know?**

Research shows that Physiotherapy through Telehealth has higher client satisfaction and improved
physical and functional outcomes, as compared to in-clinic treatment. This is due to the nature of
Telehealth: in addition to a specific treatment plan, your Practitioner will empower you with
valuable insight, guidance, and self-management tools that leads to lasting success.

Back in Motion Telehealth services allow clients to connect with their physiotherapist in a secure,
easy, innovative and convenient way!

### **Physiotherapy Services**

– Physiotherapy > Assessment Sessions > 40 min
– Physiotherapy > Treatment Sessions > 20 min

Physiotherapy services can be delivered in-person, through Telehealth, or a combination of both.

### **Other services:**

– [Telehealth Kinesiology][64]
– [Telehealth Counselling][65]
– [Physiotherapy][66] in-person

### **Who May benefit from Telehealth Physiotherapy?**

Telehealth/ Telerehabilitation with BIM is intended for anyone with acute or chronic musculoskeletal
pain, or difficulties with physical function, and/or chronic health conditions where exercise or
activity modifications are recommended. You do not need a physician referral, and most insurance
carriers cover Telehealth through direct billing.

### **Conditions**

The following common injuries or conditions are successfully treated through Physiotherapy
Telehealth: back pain, neck pain, shoulder/elbow/wrist pain, hip/knee/ankle pain, , sprains and
strains, arthritis, dizziness, and concussions.

### **Benefits of Physiotherapy through Telehealth**

**Telehealth** services offer clients a flexible, convenient and easy access to healthcare services:

– Get the treatment you need from home (or desired location)– No need to worry about childcare,
commuting or parking– Fit with you busy schedule: book your appointment between meetings or
commitments– Rapid access to healthcare services (no wait times)– Your location, or mobility
barriers are no longer a challenge to attend an appointment– Easy to connect (internet access,
tablet/desktop/laptop with microphone and camera)– Ease access to services for clients in remote
areas

A 2019 study (conducted by J.D. Power) indicates that **Telehealth** has one of the highest
satisfaction scores of all healthcare sector. Other studies show a positive impact with respect to
client satisfaction and outcomes, due to increased focus on self-management.

**What is the difference between Telehealth and In-Person Appointments**

Some Physiotherapy treatment modalities utilized in in-person appointments are not available through
Telehealth. However, the majority of injuries and conditions respond well to powerful treatment
interventions that are utilized through Telehealth.

Looking for a Kinesiologist and active rehabilitation in Richmond? We can help you regain your
strength, flexibility and function.

## About Kinesiology and Active Rehabilitation Services in Richmond

[Kinesiologist supervising patient’s exercise during Kinesiology session.][Kinesiologist supervising
patient’s exercise during Kinesiology session.]
[Book Online][64]
[Call Us][65]
[Clinic Details][66]

At [Back in Motion][67], your physical well-being is our priority. We understand how challenging
suffering from muscle imbalances, chronic pain and injuries can be. For this reason, our clinic
offers active rehabilitation and kinesiology services in Richmond.

Our team includes Kinesiologists who have years of experience in helping clients manage and address
their physical symptoms. Contact us to schedule an appointment for kinesiology treatment at our
Richmond centre.

## Is Kinesiology or Active Rehabilitation Right for Me?

Kinesiology focuses on your overall health to provide you with holistic treatments that can improve
many areas of your life. We treat a wide range of patients, including those who have been in motor
vehicle accidents to those who suffer from lower back pain. Our treatment can accommodate diverse
concerns and even improve your athletic performance. You may benefit from our services if you:
* Have been injured in a motor vehicle accident
* Are experiencing lower back, neck, shoulder or knee pain
* Have mild sports injuries
* Struggle with arthritis or osteoarthritis
* Seek help with posture correction
* Need guidance for a healthier lifestyle and physical fitness

## The Benefits of Kinesiology

Kinesiology and active rehabilitation offer numerous benefits, including:

### Improved physical health

Kinesiologists help you enhance your strength, flexibility and cardiovascular health, contributing
to your overall well-being.

### Pain management

Kinesiology techniques can alleviate and prevent chronic pain through tailored exercise plans.

### Injury recovery

If you’re recovering from an injury or surgery, kinesiology can support your rehabilitation process,
helping you regain function and mobility.

### Performance enhancement

Athletes can benefit from kinesiology to optimize their performance, prevent injuries and improve
their training routines.

### Lifestyle transformation

Kinesiology provides guidance for individuals looking to make healthier lifestyle choices, including
weight management and stress reduction.

## **What Do Kinesiologists Do?**

Our Kinesiologists employ a variety of techniques and treatments to address your specific concerns
and goals. These may include:
* **Resistance training** involves using weights, resistance bands or bodyweight exercises to
strengthen muscles. It helps build muscle mass, improve endurance and increase overall strength.
* **Balance and agility training** aims to enhance stability and coordination. Exercises focus on
improving balance and agility, which is crucial for activities that require quick movements or
maintaining equilibrium.
* **Range of motion and flexibility exercises** aim to increase the body’s ability to move through
its full range of motion. These exercises can enhance joint mobility, reduce the risk of injury
and alleviate muscle tension.
* **Postural assessments **evaluate an individual’s body alignment and posture to identify any
irregularities or imbalances. These assessments are essential for addressing issues like back pain
or poor posture.
* **Cardiovascular training** focuses on improving heart and lung health. It includes activities
like running, cycling and swimming that raise the heart rate to enhance endurance and
cardiovascular fitness.
* **Coaching**. Kinesiology coaching involves personalized guidance and support to help you set and
achieve your health and fitness goals. Coaches provide motivation, exercise plans and expert
advice to assist clients in reaching their objectives.

To learn more about our kinesiology and active rehabilitation services, [contact Back in Motion
Health at our Richmond clinic][68].

## ICBC Claims for Kinesiology

The [Insurance Corporation of British Columbia (ICBC)][70] provides coverage for those who require
kinesiology because of injuries in a motor vehicle accident. We can directly bill ICBC and also work

process and managing the pain associated with an accident.

To learn more, read our blog: [Involved in a Car Accident? What now?][72]

## What to Expect from Your Kinesiology Appointment

Here’s what to expect during a kinesiology appointment at Back in Motion Health in Richmond:

### Assessment

Our Kinesiologists will perform a thorough evaluation of your physical condition, considering your
medical history, movement patterns and fitness goals.

### Exercise Prescription

Based on the assessment, the Kinesiologist will create a customized exercise program to target your
specific needs. These exercises may include strength training, flexibility routines and
cardiovascular exercises.

### Education

Kinesiologists provide you with valuable information about your condition, lifestyle and how to
exercise safely and effectively. They help you understand your body better, empowering you to take
control of your health.

### Rehabilitation

If you’re recovering from an injury or surgery, our Kinesiologists will guide you through a
structured rehabilitation program to promote healing and regain function.

### Preventative Measures

Kinesiology can also focus on preventing injuries by improving your body mechanics, posture and
movement patterns.

## Insurance Claims & Information

*Get Back to Health after an Accident or Workplace Injury.*

### Extended Health Coverage

Back in Motion offers direct billing to most Extended Health plans to the majority of our services.
Some services (like Clinical Counselling), do not offer direct billing. In such instances, Back in
Motion provides a medical receipt to be used on request for reimbursement. See an updated list of
providers by clicking the ‘Learn More’ button below.

### ICBC Insurance Claims

Back in Motion’s team of clinicians, including Physiotherapists, Massage Therapists, Occupational
Therapists, Psychologists, Counsellors, and Kinesiologists, all have extensive experience in
administering ICBC treatments. We are here to help! Click the ‘Learn More’ button for additional
details.

### WorkSafeBC Claims

Workplace injuries are usually due to trauma or overuse. If you have been injured as a result of a
workplace activity, our team of experts at Back in Motion can perform a comprehensive assessment and
develop a treatment plan to reduce your symptoms and rehabilitate your injury.

If your claim is approved by WSBC, your initial assessment is 100% covered with a WorkSafeBC Claim
number. Once your claim has been accepted by WorkSafeBC, the full treatment cost of your
appointments will be funded (within the approved time parameters). When you are ready, your
physiotherapist will work with you, your employer, physician, and WorkSafeBC Case Manager to develop
a safe and appropriate return to work plan. If your claim has been denied or is disallowed, the
expenses will need to be covered by the Client.

# Pelvic Floor Physiotherapy in Coquitlam and Burnaby

A safe, respectful and inclusive approach to support individuals with Pelvic Floor concerns.

[Call Us][63]

## About Pelvic Floor Physiotherapy in Coquitlam and Burnaby

[clinician showing a client what the pelvic area is to a client]
[Book Online][64]
[Call Us][65]

Are you looking for professional [pelvic floor physiotherapy][66]? Serving patients in both Burnaby
and Coquitlam, Back in Motion Health provides a wide range of pelvic floor physiotherapy services.

Your pelvic floor muscles are important for several essential body functions. A healthy pelvic floor
allows you to breathe properly, maintain your core stability, and adopt proper posture. It also
assists with the healthy functioning of your bladder and bowel.

Are you preparing for a pregnancy? Our physiotherapists are also specialized in female pelvic floor
health and will gladly support you on your pregnancy journey.

## When Should You See a Pelvic Floor Physiotherapist?

Not sure when to seek help from a pelvic physiotherapist? Pelvic floor physiotherapy treatment is
recommended for patients suffering from the following symptoms:
* Incontinence
* Pelvic pain
* Lower back pain
* Pain or discomfort during intercourse
* Irregular or too frequent urination
* Irregular bowel movements
* Discomfort experienced before and after birth

Pelvic physio is also highly beneficial in the following circumstances:
* Post pelvic surgery
* Pelvic organ prolapses
* Pregnancy
* Postpartum care
* Frequently occurring urinary tract infections
* Aging
* Menopause
* Prostatitis and post-prostatectomy
* Bed-wetting in children

## Benefits of Pelvic Floor Physiotherapy

Here at Back in Motion Health, our physiotherapists are dedicated to helping you find solace and
relief from your pelvic conditions by using evidence-based techniques and by putting together
personalized treatment plans designed to address your unique health concerns. Our goal is to provide
long-term improvements in your pelvic floor health, as well as help you achieve and maintain better
overall health.

Here are some of the main benefits of using physiotherapy to treat pelvic conditions and to promote
better pelvic floor health:
* Pelvic floor physiotherapy helps improve your bladder control. This in turn helps address issues
such as frequent or irregular urination.

* It is also beneficial in regulating bowel movement. This is particularly helpful for patients who
suffer from constipation and irregular or uncomfortable bowel movement.

* Pelvic floor physiotherapy is also useful for the management of pelvic pain and discomfort.

* It helps reduce the occurrence of pain during intercourse and can also provide better overall
sexual function and satisfaction.

* Pelvic physiotherapy helps strengthen the muscles of the pelvic floor, leading to better
coordination and mobility.

## Your Coquitlam and Burnaby Pelvic Floor Physiotherapists

### Jaslyen Singh

#### Meet Jaslyen

Jaslyen grew up in Abbotsford; she participated in a variety of sports in her childhood and remains
a sports fanatic to this day. In addition to enjoying an active lifestyle, Jaslyen has a fondness
for travel that stemmed from her education in French, English, and Punjabi. She earned a Bachelor of
Kinesiology from the University of the Fraser Valley in 2016 while on a basketball scholarship and
went on to graduate as Doctor of Physiotherapy (DPThy) from Bond University (Australia) in 2019 with
high distinction. Jaslyen travelled to work in rural Australia, Stanford University, and Vietnam
while in graduate school. Since graduating in 2019, she has served patients at clinics and schools
in Melbourne, Abbotsford, Northern BC and the Caribbean. Jaslyen believes strongly in active
rehabilitation, manual therapy, patient education, and injury prevention. She has special interest
in women’s health, concussion rehabilitation, dry needling, pilates, and geriatric physiotherapy.

## Why Choose Back in Motion Health for Pelvic Floor Physiotherapy?

Our physiotherapists specialize in women’s pelvic floor physiotherapy and have the expertise
necessary to effectively address a wide range of pelvic conditions affecting women.

We offer personalized treatment plans tailored to each patient’s unique needs.

We strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment for all our patients. Our aim is to help
you achieve your treatment goals through a comfortable and positive rehabilitation experience.

We attribute tremendous importance to holistic health practices and offer a comprehensive approach
to the treatment of pelvic floor conditions by offering a wide range of treatments, including
physiotherapy and massage therapy, all under the same roof.

## Professional Pelvic Floor Therapy in Coquitlam and Burnaby

Whether you are about to embark on a new pregnancy journey or need professional support for the
management of incontinence or pelvic pain, Back in Motion Health is here to help. Our goal is to
help our patients enjoy better pelvic floor health. Serving [Burnaby and Coquitlam][67], we offer
comprehensive assessments to pinpoint the source of your condition and provide non-invasive
treatment solutions to help you find relief from pain. Contact us today for more information about

# Chiropractic Care in London, Ontario

Chiropractic Care in London: a combination of manual adjustments and soft tissue release

[Book Now][52]

## About Chiropractic Care in London

[Book Now][53]

Chiropractic care is a regulated health profession focused on diagnosing, treating, and preventing
musculoskeletal disorders, particularly those involving the spine. Chiropractors in Ontario are
trained to perform manual adjustments to the spine and other parts of the body, aiming to improve
mobility, alleviate pain, and support overall health.

The practice is overseen by the College of Chiropractors of Ontario (CCO), which ensures that
chiropractors meet professional standards and are licensed to practice. Chiropractic care is popular
among individuals seeking non-invasive treatments for back pain, neck pain, headaches, and other
joint or muscle issues. Contact us to schedule an appointment with a chiropractor in London.

## Is Chiropractic Care recommended for me?

In your first appointment, your Chiropractor will perform a comprehensive assessment (physical and
medical history), and provide you with a diagnosis and explain the recommended treatment. Your
Chiropractic will evaluate if this treatment is recommended for you. When appropriate, chiropractors
refer patients to medical doctors or other health practitioners for additional treatment.

Keeping current with latest methods, our Chiropractors use a variety of techniques to give you the
best chiropractic treatments for many types of pain and joint-related problems. Chiropractors treat
many conditions affecting the nervous system and musculoskeletal system, like:
* Back, lower back and neck (cervicalgia) pain
* Sciatica pain
* Whiplash
* Scoliosis
* Discopathies
* Repetitive strains
* Headaches
* Foot Care (orthotics)
* Sports related injuries
* Motor vehicle related injuries
* Arthritis
* Injuries from a fall
* Arthropathies, tendinopathies, sprains and strains
* Postural issues and conditions
* Neuralgias (nerve pain)
* Immobility and stiffness
* Pregnancy discomfort and/or pain
* Concussions

Chiropractors use adjustments and joint mobilizations to restore function and to support the nervous
system. Chiropractic treatment can also include modalities, joint bracing/taping, orthotics, cold
laser therapy, shockwave therapy, exercise and stretching prescription, instrument-assisted soft
tissue mobilization, soft-tissue therapies, lifestyle recommendations, fitness coaching and
nutritional advice. These will be chosen according to your injury/condition, aligned to your
individual needs and to your treatment plan.

The Chiropractors at Back in Motion Health’s London clinic are experienced to find a treatment or
combination of treatments to help you get better. This may include referral out for further testing
or imaging if needed, or co-management with other therapists at the clinic.

## Benefits of Chiropractic Care
* Restore mobility and function (in full or partially)
* Promote tissue healing
* Reduce or eliminate pain
* Improve function and/or performance
* Help prevents re-injury

## What to Expect from Your Chiropractic Appointment

### Before Your Appointment

If there are any specific preparations required for your appointment, you will be advised prior to
your appointment day. If applicable, please bring along any diagnostic test results you may have had
done in the past (X-ray, MRI, CT scan, etc.)

### Your First Appointment

Your first visit consists of a comprehensive assessment, where your Chiropractor will get to know
you better through the collection of your medical history and a physical examination (posture,
movement, muscle tone, and neurological signs and symptoms).

Your Doctor of Chiropractic will provide you a diagnosis and explain the recommended treatment for
your condition, individualized needs and goals. If needed, and to help you achieve better results,
your Chiropractor may refer you to further testing or imaging, or to other therapists at our clinic.

If time allows, your first visit will also include a treatment.

### Subsequent Appointments

The chiropractic treatment itself is individualized and very specific to your diagnosis and health
history. Using manual (hands-on) techniques, the chiropractor will manipulate soft tissue and joints
to influence healing and return your body to a state of pain-free function. These chiropractic
techniques are non-invasive and most often painless. Your chiropractor will reassess the results
from the treatment, and will provide you with home-care methods to optimize results, which often
include heat/cold techniques and specific exercises.

Your Chiropractor will constantly re-assess your condition and make any adjustments required to the
treatment plan.

At the end of the session, you will be reminded to book your follow-up appointments, when needed.
You may do that with your clinician, call one of our locations, or [book online][55].

### After Your Appointment

Although most patients feel improvement after, it is normal to feel some soreness or tenderness in
the areas worked on for a day or two following treatment.

You will be advised by your chiropractor on what home care to do following your visit. This may
include heat or ice, exercises, stretches, and certain postural changes.

## Frequently Asked Questions – FAQ

Get answers to some of the most common questions about Chiropractic Care.

**Do I need a referral to book a Chiropractic appointment?**

No, a referral is not required for a Chiropractic appointment.

**How can I book a Chiropractic Appointment?**

At Back in Motion Health, appointments may be booked via phone (604-591-5569), [online ][56]or
in-person. Visit our contact page to call the most convenient location for you.

**I am not sure if Chiropractic is right for me. How will I know?**

Chiropractors at Back in Motion Health offer a complimentary 10-minute consultation to assess if
chiropractic care is recommended for you.

**Is Chiropractic covered by my extended health plan?**

Clients should refer to their specific Extended Medical Plan coverage for details on services and
coverage available.

**Is my appointment directly billed to my Extended Health Plans?**

If you have coverage, Back in Motion Health directly bills most Extended Health Plans Take a look at
our [list of direct billing insurers][57] to see if we direct bill to yours, or call us at
604-591-5569 to confirm.

If your plan is not in our list of direct billing providers, Back in Motion Health provides a
medical receipt to be used on request for reimbursement.

**What is a chiropractic adjustment?**

An adjustment is a safe technique applied by the chiropractor to a specific joint to improve
mobility.

**Do Chiropractors only do adjustments on the back and neck?**

No, chiropractors do not only perform adjustments on the back and neck. While spinal adjustments are
a key part of chiropractic care, chiropractors are trained to assess and treat a wide range of
musculoskeletal issues throughout the body. This includes joints, muscles, and nerves in areas like
the shoulders, hips, knees, ankles, wrists, and even the jaw. Chiropractors may also provide soft
tissue therapy, exercises, lifestyle advice, and ergonomic recommendations to support overall health
and well-being.

**What is the “cracking” sound heard with adjustments?**

This is created from a pressure change of small pockets of air in the synovial fluid of the joint
tissues that are stretched during an adjustment.

**How much education and training do Doctors of Chiropractic have?**

Chiropractors are spinal health and well-being specialists who have a minimum of 7 years of
post-secondary education. Many have a Bachelor’s degree and all have a Doctor of Chiropractic (DC)
degree.

## About ICBC Physiotherapy Services

[Book Now][64]

Motor vehicle accidents are more common than you think; Between [2013 and 2022][65], an average of
82,800 people per year sustained injuries from an average of 289,500 yearly ICBC-reported crashes.
Whether minor or major, motor vehicle accidents can cause injuries that affect the daily lives of
motorists all over British Columbia.

When rehabilitating an injury from a motor vehicle accident, a physiotherapist can be a great help
to reduce pain and prevent further injuries. Back in Motion Health provides ICBC physiotherapy
services to aid you in your motor vehicle accident injury recovery. We welcome patients from across
the Lower Mainland at our locations in Vancouver, Richmond, Coquitlam, Surrey-Newton, Abbotsford and
North Vancouver.

## Why Seek Physiotherapy After a Car Accident?

Accidents are stressful, and there is no denying that adrenaline often plays a part in keeping you
upright and alert following impact. While injuries from car accidents are not always severe in
appearance, they can severely impact the victim’s life over time.

If you have been in an accident, a [physiotherapist][66] can be helpful in assisting you in your
recovery from the following:
* Whiplash
* Back pain
* Neck pain
* Shoulder/elbow/wrist pain
* Hip/knee/ankle pain
* Fractures, sprains, and strains
* Pre and post-surgery rehabilitation
* Concussions

A skilled physiotherapist can help with many aspects of your recovery and rehabilitation journey.

**Recovery Support**

Physiotherapists can help find the root cause of pains and aches, stiffness, and newfound
limitations in motion and design a physiotherapy program to help get you back to your day-to-day
activities.

**Pain Reduction**

ICBC physiotherapy is not a magic cure for all injuries and it requires work, but certain exercises,
stretches, and therapies can help alleviate your pain and reduce it over time, making your daily
life more manageable.

**Surgery Prevention**

While some surgeries post-accident may be inevitable depending on the severity of your injuries, a
well-tailored physiotherapy regimen can help heal tears and strains that would have required surgery
before a physiotherapist’s intervention.

**Function Restoration**

It’s normal to lose some ability when injured. Muscle stiffness, pains, strains, and pains can
impair your body’s normal functions, and delaying treatment only makes those issues worse. With the
help of ICBC physiotherapy, you may be able to return to your pre-accident range of motion and see
little-to-no after-effects from the motor vehicle accident in which you were involved.

**Long-term Damage Prevention**

Rehabilitating injuries is a time-sensitive issue. An improperly handled injury can lead to poor
healing and complications down the line. With a physiotherapist’s assistance in your recovery, you
increase your chances of healing well and avoid complications associated with delayed healing.

## Frequently Asked Questions About ICBC-Covered Physiotherapy

**How Do I Get Approved for ICBC Physiotherapy?**

You must file a claim with ICBC. Where fault lies in the accident does not matter; if you were
injured in a motor vehicle accident, you qualify, even if you were a cyclist or pedestrian.

**When Can I Start My Physiotherapy Treatment?**

Once you have filed your claim with ICBC, you can start any treatment under ICBC’s pre-approved
treatment list. You then have 3 months to start and complete your treatment plan. The quicker you
seek out a physiotherapist, the bigger the benefits as you will be able to complete more visits and
address any issues as soon as possible.

**How Many Physiotherapy Sessions Are Covered? **

25 sessions of a minimum of 20 minutes are covered.

**How Much Does It Cost? **

Because Back in Motion offers direct billing to ICBC, you will incur no out-of-pocket cost when
seeking physiotherapy under your pre-approved treatment costs. If you seek longer appointments than
those covered by ICBC, you will need to pay the difference, but Back in Motion can provide you with
receipts to submit to your private insurance provider.

**What Do I Need to Start My Treatment? **

When booking an appointment, you will need your personal health number (PNH) and your ICBC claim
number.

## About ICBC Kinesiology and Active Rehabilitation Services

[Client doing exercises with a kinesiologist][Client doing exercises with a kinesiologist]
[Book Now][64]

At Back in Motion Health, we’re here to support you every step of the way after a motor vehicle
accident. Our specialized ICBC kinesiology services are designed to help you recover with compassion
and care. Our dedicated kinesiologists work closely with you to regain strength, mobility, and
confidence through personalized active rehabilitation programs tailored to your unique needs. We are
committed to helping you feel better and get back to living your life fully.

## Kinesiology and Active Rehab for ICBC-Covered Injuries

Kinesiology is essential in treating injuries from car accidents and aiding in recovery. Our
ICBC-approved kinesiology services are focused on addressing a variety of injuries that result from
motor vehicle accidents, such as:
* **Whiplash:** Targeted exercises to improve neck mobility and reduce pain.
* **Knee injuries:** Strengthening and stabilization techniques for optimal joint function.
* **Back pain:** Core strengthening and posture correction to alleviate discomfort.
* **Concussions:** Gradual return-to-activity protocols and balance training.
* **Soft tissue injuries:** Specialized exercises to promote healing and prevent chronic issues.

Our kinesiologists work closely with you to develop a tailored treatment plan that addresses your
needs and goals.

## Benefits of Kinesiology after a Car Accident

Kinesiology and active rehabilitation offer numerous benefits for individuals recovering from car
accidents:
* **Pain reduction:** Targeted exercises to alleviate discomfort and improve function.
* **Improved mobility:** Techniques for improving range of motion and flexibility.
* **Strength building:** Progressive resistance training to rebuild muscle strength.
* **Injury prevention:** Education on proper body mechanics to reduce re-injury risk.
* **Faster recovery:** Accelerated healing through guided, evidence-based exercises.
* **Enhanced quality of life:** Restoration of daily activities and return to pre-injury function

## What to Expect from an ICBC Kinesiology Session

During your ICBC kinesiology session at Back in Motion Health, you can expect:
* **Initial assessment:** A thorough evaluation of your injuries, limitations, and goals
* **Customized treatment plan:** Development of a personalized active rehabilitation program
* **Guided exercises:** Hands-on instruction and supervision of therapeutic exercises
* **Progress monitoring:** Regular assessments to track your improvement and adjust the plan as
needed
* **Education:** Instruction on proper form, body mechanics, and home exercise programs
* **Collaboration:** Integration with other healthcare providers for comprehensive care

## Why Choose Back in Motion Health for ICBC Kinesiology?

When selecting a provider for your ICBC kinesiology and active rehab needs, Back in Motion Health
stands out for several reasons:
* We offer convenient direct billing to ICBC, eliminating the need for out-of-pocket expenses.
* Our multidisciplinary approach allows you to combine kinesiology with other treatments, such as
physiotherapy, chiropractic care, and massage therapy, all under one roof.

## When Should I See a Kinesiologist in Vancouver?

Kinesiology and active rehabilitation are suitable for a wide range of individuals who want to
improve their physical health and functionality. You may benefit from our services if you:
* Have been injured in a motor vehicle accident
* Are experiencing lower back, neck, shoulder or knee pain
* Have mild sports injuries
* Struggle with arthritis or osteoarthritis
* Seek help with posture correction
* Need guidance for a healthier lifestyle and physical fitness

Kinesiologists are experts in human movement and exercise, making them the ideal choice for anyone
aiming to restore or improve their physical condition. From athletes to individuals dealing with
injuries, our kinesiology services can be tailored to meet your unique needs.

## **What Do Kinesiologists Do?**

Our Kinesiologists employ a variety of techniques and treatments to address your specific concerns
and goals. These may include:
* **Resistance training** involves using weights, resistance bands or bodyweight exercises to
strengthen muscles. It helps build muscle mass, improve endurance and increase overall strength.
* **Cardiovascular training** focuses on improving heart and lung health. It includes activities
like running, cycling and swimming that raise the heart rate to enhance endurance and
cardiovascular fitness.
* **Postural assessments** evaluate an individual’s body alignment and posture to identify any
irregularities or imbalances. These assessments are essential for addressing issues like back pain
or poor posture.
* **Balance and agility training** aims to enhance stability and coordination. Exercises focus on
improving balance and agility, which is crucial for activities that require quick movements or
maintaining equilibrium.
* **Range of motion and flexibility** **exercises** aim to increase the body’s ability to move
through its full range of motion. These exercises can enhance joint mobility, reduce the risk of
injury and alleviate muscle tension.
* **Coaching**. Kinesiology coaching involves personalized guidance and support to help you set and
achieve your health and fitness goals. Coaches provide motivation, exercise plans and expert
advice to assist clients in reaching their objectives.

To learn more about our kinesiology and active rehabilitation services, [contact Back in Motion
Health at our Vancouver clinic][68] serving Mount Pleasant and surrounding neighbourhoods.

## About Registered Massage Therapy in Abbotsford

[Patient receiving a relaxation massage by an intern therapist to treat a sports injury][Patient
receiving a relaxation massage by an intern therapist to treat a sports injury]
[Book Online][64]
[Contact Us][65]

Registered massage therapy is a therapeutic, hands-on treatment used to relax and relieve pain. It
involves the manipulation of the soft tissues of your body to improve blood flow, relieve pressure
on nerves, and restore normal joint movement.

At Back in Motion Health in [Abbotsford][66], our Registered Massage Therapists (RMT) are registered
with the College of Massage Therapists of British Columbia. As such, you can rest assured that your
treatment will be guided by professional practices and concern for restoring and maintaining your
optimal health.

## Conditions that Can Benefit from Massage Therapy

Massage therapy can is an effective treatment for a wide range of conditions, including:
* Upper/lower back, neck, shoulder pain
* Whiplash
* Discomfort associated with a car accident
* Discomfort associated with acute and chronic health conditions
* Recovery for sports and activities
* Carpal Tunnel syndrome
* Plantar fasciitis
* Temporomandibular joint disorder (TMD)
* Headaches
* Osteoarthritis
* Fibromyalgia
* Stress-related tension
* Cancer-related stress, pain and fatigue
* Sleep disorders
* Multiple sclerosis
* High blood pressure
* Stroke
* Diabetes
* Mental health conditions
* Pregnancy

## Types of Massage Therapy

There are over 80 types of massage that are practised by RMTs. They range from active and intense to
gentle and relaxing. Professional RMTs are trained to assess your needs and provide the appropriate
type of massage for your needs. Common massage therapies offered at Back in Motion in Abbotsford
include:

### **Deep Tissue Massage**

Exactly as it sounds, this type of massage therapy targets the deeper muscle layers to release
chronic muscle tension, reduce pain, improve posture, and break up scar tissue. It is effective for
addressing chronic pain in the neck, shoulders, and lower back. It can also help reduce stress by
lowering cortisol levels.

### **Sports Massage**

Sports massage can be used as part of a training program or separately as a pre-event warm-up or
post-event cooldown. Sports massage can also assist with injury prevention and help reduce muscle
soreness. It can have a positive effect on heart rate, blood pressure, and stress hormonal levels.

### **Relaxation Massage**

One of the gentler types of massage, relaxation massage incorporates smooth strokes and gentle
kneading to reduce muscle tension, improve circulation, ease muscle pain, and more. It can help
manage anxiety and promote overall well-being.

### **Prenatal Massage**

Specifically tailored for pregnant women, prenatal massage aims to reduce swelling, relieve lower
back pain, improve sleep, and prepare the body for labour. It offers a natural way to manage
pregnancy-related discomfort.

### **Postnatal Massage**

Offered to improve circulation, reduce stress, alleviate muscle tension from pregnancy, and so much
more, postnatal massage uses a variety of techniques to help women after giving birth. Postnatal
massage can enhance sleep quality, help regulate hormones, and support emotional well-being during
this time.

We provide expert physiotherapy services in London, with a focus on pain relief, injury recovery,
and rehabilitation. Our experienced physiotherapists deliver evidence-based treatment plans in a
supportive and professional environment.

## Our Services

We provide expert physiotherapy care across a range of conditions and needs. Our services are
designed to help you recover, move confidently, and regain control of your physical health.

## Stroke and Neurological Physiotherapy

We support individuals recovering from strokes, Parkinson’s, multiple sclerosis, and other
neurological conditions by improving movement, coordination, and independence.

## Musculoskeletal Physiotherapy

Our treatments aim to restore comfort and alignment by addressing joint pain, spinal issues,
arthritis, and posture through guided movement and hands-on care.

## Sports Injuries Physiotherapy

We help athletes and active individuals recover from sprains, strains, and other sports-related
injuries with tailored treatment plans focused on safe and effective healing.

## Paediatric Physiotherapy

Our physiotherapists provide gentle, age-appropriate care to children facing developmental delays,
injuries, or neurological challenges to support their growth and mobility.

## Elderly Physiocare and Rehabilitation

We promote strength, balance, and confidence in older adults through personalised programs that
enhance mobility and reduce fall risks.

## Home Visit / Mobile Physiotherapy

Our mobile service brings expert physiotherapy to your home, offering convenience and privacy for
individuals with limited mobility or busy schedules.

## Ultrasound-Guided Injections

We provide precise, ultrasound-guided joint and soft tissue injections to reduce pain and
inflammation, ensuring targeted treatment and faster relief.

## Our Services

We provide expert physiotherapy care across a range of conditions and needs. Our services are
designed to help you recover, move confidently, and regain control of your physical health.

## Stroke and Neurological Physiotherapy

We support individuals recovering from strokes, Parkinson’s, multiple sclerosis, and other
neurological conditions by improving movement, coordination, and independence.

## Musculoskeletal Physiotherapy

Our treatments aim to restore comfort and alignment by addressing joint pain, spinal issues,
arthritis, and posture through guided movement and hands-on care.

## Sports Injuries Physiotherapy

We help athletes and active individuals recover from sprains, strains, and other sports-related
injuries with tailored treatment plans focused on safe and effective healing.

## Paediatric Physiotherapy

Our physiotherapists provide gentle, age-appropriate care to children facing developmental delays,
injuries, or neurological challenges to support their growth and mobility.

## Elderly Physiocare and Rehabilitation

We promote strength, balance, and confidence in older adults through personalised programs that
enhance mobility and reduce fall risks.

## Home Visit / Mobile Physiotherapy

Our mobile service brings expert physiotherapy to your home, offering convenience and privacy for
individuals with limited mobility or busy schedules.

## Ultrasound-Guided Injections

We provide precise, ultrasound-guided joint and soft tissue injections to reduce pain and
inflammation, ensuring targeted treatment and faster relief.
