Our Unique Approach to Physiotherapy in Singapore

Our approach to physiotherapy focuses on addressing imbalances and restoring movement through personalised care tailored to individual needs.

▸
1. Integrative Hands-On Techniques

We combine manual therapy with modern physiotherapy techniques to address muscle imbalances and restore balance in the body. These hands-on methods help alleviate pain and improve mobility.
▸
2. Cultural Sensitivity in Care

We tailor treatments to the unique physical challenges influenced by Singapore’s lifestyle, such as long hours of desk work or the demands of caregiving. For office workers, prolonged sitting and poor ergonomics often contribute to back discomfort. In such cases, we may recommend physio treatment for lower back pain that addresses both posture-related strain and long-term mobility. This ensures therapy remains relevant, practical, and aligned with each individual’s daily routines.
▸
3. Personalised Treatment Plans

Every physiotherapy plan is customised based on individual needs, taking into account the patient’s specific lifestyle, goals, and health history to support recovery and long-term well-being. Our musculoskeletal physio services cover all major pain points of the body, from the neck and shoulders to the back, hips, and knees, allowing treatment to be tailored to each condition.

Why More Singaporeans Are Turning to Physiotherapy to Relieve Pain

In Singapore, physiotherapy addresses a wide range of issues, from postural pain to recovery, helping individuals stay active and manage discomfort.

▸
1. Increasing Sedentary Lifestyles

With long hours spent at desks and on screens, many Singaporeans are experiencing desk-related pain, making physiotherapy an essential solution for managing posture and alleviating tension. Over time, prolonged sitting without proper ergonomics can contribute to stiffness in the neck , shoulders , and lower back , as well as reduced flexibility. Physiotherapy not only helps to ease this discomfort but also equips individuals with corrective exercises and movement strategies that prevent recurring pain. By addressing these issues early, patients can improve their posture, maintain mobility, and reduce the risk of chronic musculoskeletal conditions developing later in life.
▸
2. Aging Population Seeking Active Lifestyles

As the senior population grows, many older individuals turn to physiotherapy to maintain mobility, reduce pain, and support recovery, allowing them to stay active and independent in their later years. For those who find it inconvenient to travel, opting for physio at home provides the flexibility of receiving care in a familiar environment, making sessions more accessible and comfortable.
▸
3. Proactive Health Management Across All Ages

Physiotherapy is becoming a proactive approach to health, not just for injury recovery, but for preventing chronic pain and maintaining flexibility for people of all ages. Younger adults are increasingly seeking physiotherapy to counteract the effects of long working hours and stress, while older adults benefit from tailored programmes that preserve mobility and independence. Even athletes and active individuals turn to physiotherapy for preventive care, ensuring their bodies remain strong and resilient against strain. This shift reflects a growing awareness in Singapore that investing in physiotherapy early can help avoid long-term health complications, reduce the likelihood of surgery, and support overall quality of life.

# About Us

Rehab and Beyond was founded in early 2018 by Jaden with the objective of providing high quality and
affordable rehabilitation and allied health services beyond the four walls of the hospital and into
the community.

Read More About Our Story

Jaden saw how the high quality allied health services in the hospital benefited those who were
admitted for inpatient care. A person with a new stroke may receive physiotherapy, occupational
therapy, speech therapy and other services such as stroke education and dietary counseling to manage
his recovery and minimise the risk of getting another stroke in the future. However, these cares
were not easily accessible for patients who have been discharged and are transitioning back into
their homes and community.

Seeing these significant needs unaddressed, Jaden decided to make all these services available, with
intention that patients will now have access to a skilled and coordinated care to assist their
rehabilitation and prevention measure. While the health ministry and its agencies are already
working hard to address these issues

Our Unique Approach to Physiotherapy in Singapore

Our approach to physiotherapy focuses on addressing imbalances and restoring movement through personalised care tailored to individual needs.

▸
1. Integrative Hands-On Techniques

We combine manual therapy with modern physiotherapy techniques to address muscle imbalances and restore balance in the body. These hands-on methods help alleviate pain and improve mobility.
▸
2. Cultural Sensitivity in Care

We tailor treatments to the unique physical challenges influenced by Singapore’s lifestyle, such as long hours of desk work or the demands of caregiving. For office workers, prolonged sitting and poor ergonomics often contribute to back discomfort. In such cases, we may recommend physio treatment for lower back pain that addresses both posture-related strain and long-term mobility. This ensures therapy remains relevant, practical, and aligned with each individual’s daily routines.
▸
3. Personalised Treatment Plans

Every physiotherapy plan is customised based on individual needs, taking into account the patient’s specific lifestyle, goals, and health history to support recovery and long-term well-being. Our musculoskeletal physio services cover all major pain points of the body, from the neck and shoulders to the back, hips, and knees, allowing treatment to be tailored to each condition.

Why More Singaporeans Are Turning to Physiotherapy to Relieve Pain

In Singapore, physiotherapy addresses a wide range of issues, from postural pain to recovery, helping individuals stay active and manage discomfort.

▸
1. Increasing Sedentary Lifestyles

With long hours spent at desks and on screens, many Singaporeans are experiencing desk-related pain, making physiotherapy an essential solution for managing posture and alleviating tension. Over time, prolonged sitting without proper ergonomics can contribute to stiffness in the neck , shoulders , and lower back , as well as reduced flexibility. Physiotherapy not only helps to ease this discomfort but also equips individuals with corrective exercises and movement strategies that prevent recurring pain. By addressing these issues early, patients can improve their posture, maintain mobility, and reduce the risk of chronic musculoskeletal conditions developing later in life.
▸
2. Aging Population Seeking Active Lifestyles

As the senior population grows, many older individuals turn to physiotherapy to maintain mobility, reduce pain, and support recovery, allowing them to stay active and independent in their later years. For those who find it inconvenient to travel, opting for physio at home provides the flexibility of receiving care in a familiar environment, making sessions more accessible and comfortable.
▸
3. Proactive Health Management Across All Ages

Physiotherapy is becoming a proactive approach to health, not just for injury recovery, but for preventing chronic pain and maintaining flexibility for people of all ages. Younger adults are increasingly seeking physiotherapy to counteract the effects of long working hours and stress, while older adults benefit from tailored programmes that preserve mobility and independence. Even athletes and active individuals turn to physiotherapy for preventive care, ensuring their bodies remain strong and resilient against strain. This shift reflects a growing awareness in Singapore that investing in physiotherapy early can help avoid long-term health complications, reduce the likelihood of surgery, and support overall quality of life.

# About Us

Rehab and Beyond was founded in early 2018 by Jaden with the objective of providing high quality and
affordable rehabilitation and allied health services beyond the four walls of the hospital and into
the community.

Read More About Our Story

Jaden saw how the high quality allied health services in the hospital benefited those who were
admitted for inpatient care. A person with a new stroke may receive physiotherapy, occupational
therapy, speech therapy and other services such as stroke education and dietary counseling to manage
his recovery and minimise the risk of getting another stroke in the future. However, these cares
were not easily accessible for patients who have been discharged and are transitioning back into
their homes and community.

Seeing these significant needs unaddressed, Jaden decided to make all these services available, with
intention that patients will now have access to a skilled and coordinated care to assist their
rehabilitation and prevention measure. While the health ministry and its agencies are already
working hard to address these issues, Rehab and Beyond was born to fill up this gap.

## Our Team

[Image]

### Jaden

Jaden holds a Master’s degree from Australia and has a decade of experience in public and private
hospitals. He is well-versed in sports injury management, post-surgery physiotherapy, and
rehabilitation for people with medical conditions such as stroke and Parkinson's disease. Jaden is
passionate about providing physiotherapy treatment that is backed by science and research. He was
even invited to present some of his own award-winning research papers in local and international
conferences.

Recently, he partnered prominent orthopaedic specialists to give talks to Netball club players (on
knee & ankle injuries) and GP doctors (on common shoulder injuries). He has also conducted workshops
for other physios on the post-surgery management of hip & knee conditions. Jaden believes that
"people do not care how much you know until they know how much you care". He strives to understand
his clients’ needs, goals and priorities before selecting the most appropriate treatment approach.
For his dedication and professionalism, he has earned many positive reviews as well as three Service
Excellence Awards in as many years.

Singapore

Master of Clinical Rehabilitation (Australia)

[Image]

### Debra

Debra Ow Pei Li is a physiotherapist with a strong passion in the management of musculoskeletal /
orthopaedic rehabilitation and geriatric care. She worked in Tan Tock Seng Hospital (TTSH) for 7
years as a senior physiotherapist, and has extensive experience in the acute, outpatient as well as
community setting. She has rich experience working with patients in the home, seeing an array of
musculoskeletal, neurological and orthopaedic conditions. She has a keen interest in promoting
healthy living,and is an advocate of the phrase – Live Well, Age Well.

In the community scene, she worked closely with community partners to co-curate exercise programmes
and conducted public talks on frailty as well as healthy ageing.

Debra is also a certified AHPC supervisor and clinical educator, who has supervised students from
Singapore Institute of Technology (SIT) during their clinical placements.

# Why Us

# Well equiped clinics

All our clinic locations are well-equipped with gyms and a wide range of equipment specific for
therapy.

# Strategic Locations

We have 3 locations for clinics for you to choose from, including one right in the CBD if you are
working there!

# We Speak Your Language

We have a team of qualified local therapists who can manage most conditions and speak your language
and/or dialect.

# Affordable Home Therapy

We provide dedicated home therapy with specialised and portable equipment at a reasonable rate.

# Tailored to your environment

Home therapy sessions are designed with your home environment in mind. You won't have a situation
where you cannot do the treatment because you don’t have the machines needed.

# Diverse range of qualifications

Our therapists have a diverse range of qualifications and certifications from Australia, Ireland,
New Zealand, UK and USA.

# Convenient time and place

Too busy? Most clinics closed by the time you end work? Our therapist can see you at your own home
after your work, there is no need to make a separate trip out to have therapy.

> While we provide wide-ranging rehabilitation services in our acute hospitals, we need to do more
> to shift the gravity of care into the community so that patients can be cared for in an
> environment that they are familiar with
> - Lam Pin Min, Senior Minister of State for Health (2017)

## Go beyond rehab

BEYOND THE DIAGNOSIS
Client Centered Philosophy of Care
Learn More

We see you as who you are - the athlete, the parent, the achiever, the overcomer, and not just
another patient with an injury or a diagnosis. We tailor made your treatment care based on YOU

We do this through a systematic approach of:
1. Treating you as a unique individual and seeking to understand your needs, priorities, and goals
2. Assessing your condition thoroughly and identifying the root cause of the problem and other
contributing factors
3. Helping you understand your condition and available treatment options to enable you to make
informed decisions on the therapy plan
4. Encouraging you (and your caregiver) to participate in the process of setting your rehab goals
5. Enabling you to take control of your own health by participating actively in rehab and taking
practical steps to achieve your health goals
6. Tailoring a custom-made treatment plan for you, and conducting regular reviews to help you
progress to the next stage of rehab
7. Initiating prompt referral(s) to other medical & health professionals for additional attention
when appropriate

BEYOND THE CURRENT PHYSICAL INJURY
Strong Network of Medical, Health and Fitness Collaborators
Learn More

We collaborate and work closely with a community of sports physiologist and fitness trainers to
reduce future risks of health problems and enhance your fitness performance. Here are some of the
professionals that we work together with:
* Medical Specialists
* MLD Therapist
* Podiatrist
* Exercise Physiologist
* Dieticians and Nutritionists
* Allied Health & Wellness Professionals
* Fitness Trainers
* Orthotist

BEYOND THE FACILITIES
Multiple Locations
Learn More

“The best gym is the one that you actually go to”

We are always looking to improve your experience and bring convenience and accessibility to you.
Check out our clinics in Tanjong Pagar and Novena.

Live or work in the East or West? Call us to enquire about the clinic that is closest to you.

Not comfortable with gyms? Difficulty leaving the house? We can bring the clinic to you.

[**Find our location nearest to yours**][29]

BEYOND 6PM
Extended Clinic Hours
Learn More

Frustrated that most clinics are closed by the time you get off work? We open extra longer just for
you!
* Core Collective open until 8pm
* Open during selected public holidays
* All clinics open during lunch
* Options for Home Therapy

BEYOND THE CLINIC
Dedicated Home Therapy Service
Learn More

Your body is your greatest equipment and the best program is the one the you actually do regularly.
Learn how to lead an active self management program utilizing your home environment and facilities.
Fancy doing some agility training in the local park? In Rehab & Beyond, home therapy doesn’t mean
exercising in the bed

Why Home Therapy?
* Save time & travelling
* No need to take time off work
* We bring the equipment to you
* Practical for long term self management (utilizing home environment and facilities such as gym &
swimming pool)

BEYOND STANDARD CARE
Experienced Therapist & Best Practices
Learn More

Our therapist underwent further training in reputable institutions from Singapore, Australia, New
Zealand, USA, UK and Ireland.

Why our therapist is awesome and why you would love them:
* They are certified in the following disciplines: Clinical Pilates, Rock Taping, PNF, Kinetic Link
Training
* They are also able to connect with clients who speak: Cantonese, Hokkien, Teochew, Bahasa
Indonesia?
* Sensitive to local culture
* Sessions can last up to an hour and are individualised for your unique needs
* Speakers at local and international health and medical conferences
* Therapist are regularly invited to share in public forums and peer conferences

Whether it's correction or prevention, willingness and perseverance is the key to your health.

# About Us

Rehab and Beyond was founded in early 2018 by Jaden with the objective of providing high quality and
affordable rehabilitation and allied health services beyond the four walls of the hospital and into
the community.

Read More About Our Story

Jaden saw how the high quality allied health services in the hospital benefited those who were
admitted for inpatient care. A person with a new stroke may receive physiotherapy, occupational
therapy, speech therapy and other services such as stroke education and dietary counseling to manage
his recovery and minimise the risk of getting another stroke in the future. However, these cares
were not easily accessible for patients who have been discharged and are transitioning back into
their homes and community.

Seeing these significant needs unaddressed, Jaden decided to make all these services available, with
intention that patients will now have access to a skilled and coordinated care to assist their
rehabilitation and prevention measure. While the health ministry and its agencies are already
working hard to address these issues, Rehab and Beyond was born to fill up this gap.

> other services such as stroke education and dietary counseling to manage his recovery and minimise
> the risk of getting another stroke in the future.

## Our Team

[Image]

### Jaden

Jaden holds a Master’s degree from Australia and has a decade of experience in public and private
hospitals. He is well-versed in sports injury management, post-surgery physiotherapy, and
rehabilitation for people with medical conditions such as stroke and Parkinson's disease. Jaden is
passionate about providing physiotherapy treatment that is backed by science and research. He was
even invited to present some of his own award-winning research papers in local and international
conferences.

Recently, he partnered prominent orthopaedic specialists to give talks to Netball club players (on
knee & ankle injuries) and GP doctors (on common shoulder injuries). He has also conducted workshops
for other physios on the post-surgery management of hip & knee conditions. Jaden believes that
"people do not care how much you know until they know how much you care". He strives to understand
his clients’ needs, goals and priorities before selecting the most appropriate treatment approach.
For his dedication and professionalism, he has earned many positive reviews as well as three Service
Excellence Awards in as many years.

Full registration (Physiotherapy) with Allied Health Professions Council (AHPC), Ministry of Health,
Singapore
AHPC certified Clinical Supervisor (Physiotherapy)
Master of Clinical Rehabilitation (Australia)
American College of Sports Medicine (ACSM) Certified Clinical Exercise Physiologist (CEP)
ACSM / American Cancer Society Certified Cancer Exercise Trainer (CET)
[Image]

### Debra

Debra Ow Pei Li is a physiotherapist with a strong passion in the management of musculoskeletal /
orthopaedic rehabilitation and geriatric care. She worked in Tan Tock Seng Hospital (TTSH) for 7
years as a senior physiotherapist, and has extensive experience in the acute, outpatient as well as
community setting. She has rich experience working with patients in the home, seeing an array of
musculoskeletal, neurological and orthopaedic conditions. She has a keen interest in promoting
healthy living,and is an advocate of the phrase – Live Well, Age Well.

In the community scene, she worked closely with community partners to co-curate exercise programmes
and conducted public talks on frailty as well as healthy ageing.

Debra is also a certified AHPC supervisor and clinical educator, who has supervised students from
Singapore Institute of Technology (SIT) during their clinical placements.

AHPC Clinical Supervisor
Clinical Educator (SIT)
Otago Exercise Leader
ACE Certified Personal Trainer

## Our Process

You are unique because you have your distinctive circumstances, and we can help you to become a
better version of yourself. Our services are catered to your own special needs.

prevent it from happening again. We will recommend our Exercise Physiologist to help you with the
physical conditioning required to return to your game at a higher level of fitness.

We provide cardiac rehab and dietary advice to you, to strengthen the heart and body through
exercise and improve your lifestyle to prevent another heart attack.

Injuries that keep happening or persistent restrictions in your range of motion

## How Physiotherapy Works

What to Expect From Physiotherapy at HealX Physio & Rehab

When you step into our Woodbridge Rehabilitation Centre, our expert physiotherapists study your
medical history and conduct a thorough evaluation of your condition, including physical examination,
and movement analysis. This comprehensive assessment allows us to identify the root cause of your
pain or dysfunction and establishes a baseline for your treatment journey.

Based on the findings from the initial assessment, we at HealX Physio & Rehab develop a clear
diagnosis and set realistic and achievable goals for your welfare. We discuss treatment options
specific to your condition, expected timeline, and create a personalised care plan tailored to your
needs and lifestyle.

Our experts provide hands-on Physiotherapy Treatment in Woodbridge such as joint mobilisation, soft
tissue massages, and targeted stretching. We also provide guidance for various specific therapeutic
exercises designed to improve strength, flexibility, and function, ensuring you perform them
correctly for maximum benefit.

We keep monitoring your progress through objective measurements and subjective feedback. Based on
your response to the treatment, our professionals adjust the treatment, modify exercises, and refine
techniques to ensure you are on the optimal path to recovery.

At our Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation Centre in Woodbridge, we not only treat your condition but
also provide valuable education about the ailment, proper body mechanics, and injury prevention
strategies. This knowledge will help you to maintain your improvements independently and prevent
future issues, ensuring long-term success.

Even after you have achieved your recovery goals, we continue to support your long-term wellbeing.
Whether through maintenance sessions, updated exercise programs, or periodic reassessments, our team
ensures you stay strong, active, and confident in your daily activities.

## How Physiotherapy Works

What to Expect From Physiotherapy at HealX Physio & Rehab

When you step into our Woodbridge Rehabilitation Centre, our expert physiotherapists study your
medical history and conduct a thorough evaluation of your condition, including physical examination,
and movement analysis. This comprehensive assessment allows us to identify the root cause of your
pain or dysfunction and establishes a baseline for your treatment journey.

Based on the findings from the initial assessment, we at HealX Physio & Rehab develop a clear
diagnosis and set realistic and achievable goals for your welfare. We discuss treatment options
specific to your condition, expected timeline, and create a personalised care plan tailored to your
needs and lifestyle.

Our experts provide hands-on Physiotherapy Treatment in Woodbridge such as joint mobilisation, soft
tissue massages, and targeted stretching. We also provide guidance for various specific therapeutic
exercises designed to improve strength, flexibility, and function, ensuring you perform them
correctly for maximum benefit.

We keep monitoring your progress through objective measurements and subjective feedback. Based on
your response to the treatment, our professionals adjust the treatment, modify exercises, and refine
techniques to ensure you are on the optimal path to recovery.

At our Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation Centre in Woodbridge, we not only treat your condition but
also provide valuable education about the ailment, proper body mechanics, and injury prevention
strategies. This knowledge will help you to maintain your improvements independently and prevent
future issues, ensuring long-term success.

Even after you have achieved your recovery goals, we continue to support your long-term wellbeing.
Whether through maintenance sessions, updated exercise programs, or periodic reassessments, our team
ensures you stay strong, active, and confident in your daily activities.

BENEFITS & OUTCOMES

## Benefits of Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation

Experience the transformative benefits of professional physiotherapy services - designed to restore
your flexibility and improve your quality of life.

### Reduced Pain and Inflammation

At HealX Physio & Rehab, we use evidence-based treatment techniques to target the root cause of your
pain and not just the symptoms. Through manual therapy, therapeutic exercises, and personalised
sessions with our experts, we help reduce inflammation and the discomfort naturally. With our
services you will experience lasting relief without having to rely solely on pain medications.

### Improvement in Mobility and Flexibility

With our personalised strengthening and stretching exercises, you will be able to freely move again.
Our experts will work with you to restore your range of motion, improve muscle flexibility, and
enhance overall functional mobility. Visit our Woodbridge Rehabilitation Centre to get back to doing
the activities you love with confidence and ease.

### Faster Recovery after an Injury or Surgery

Through our comprehensive rehabilitation programs, we will accelerate your healing process. By
combining hands-on therapy with progressive exercise protocols and providing education to optimise
tissue healing, we will restore movement and improve your recovery timeline. Return to your daily
life sooner with our expert-guided recovery approach.

### Reduced Dependency on Medication

Visit our clinic in Woodbridge to experience natural, drug-free solutions that will help manage your
pain and improve your health. Our Physiotherapy Treatments are tailored to address the underlying
causes of your condition, reducing the need for long-term medication. Achieve better outcomes
through movement, manual therapy, and lifestyle modifications that support your body's natural
healing abilities.

### Prevention of Injuries in the Long Run

At HealX Physio & Rehab, we help you understand your body's mechanics, movement patterns and train
you in strengthening strategies to protect yourself from future injuries. Our physiotherapists
provide the education you need to maintain optimal physical health and prevent recurring problems.
We will enable you to build resilience and stay active for years to come with our preventive care
approach.

### Improves Overall Physical Performance

Visit our Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation Centre in Woodbridge to enhance your day-to-day physical
performance. Through targeted exercises and guided training, we strengthen your key muscle groups,
improve joint stability, correct movement patterns, and refine balance and coordination. You will be
able to walk, lift, and climb stairs easily, while also improving agility, endurance, and control in
sports related activities.

FAQs

How do I know if my insurance will cover HomePhysio.com.my?

We have many patients under insurance and have successfully completed their treatment sessions. We
do recommend our customers to always check with their respective [agency][25] first.

What do I need to have prepared for my Tele-Consultation?

In order to get the most from your Tele-consultation service, please come prepared with the
following:
1. Loose, appropriate clothing to assist examination e.g. sports attire
2. A spacious environment so that you could perform tests and movements
3. Any necessary [medical scans][26] or documents for reference

Do I need a referral to have an online Physical Therapy consultation?

No, you do not require a referral to have Tele-Consultation.

What is Home Physiotherapy?

Home physiotherapy provides basically the same physiotherapy services that you can find in
hospitals, but in the comfort of your own home. So you don’t have to suffer the hassle and pain when
travelling out of the house.

FAQs

How do I know if my insurance will cover HomePhysio.com.my?

We have many patients under insurance and have successfully completed their treatment sessions. We
do recommend our customers to always check with their respective [agency][25] first.

What do I need to have prepared for my Tele-Consultation?

In order to get the most from your Tele-consultation service, please come prepared with the
following:
1. Loose, appropriate clothing to assist examination e.g. sports attire
2. A spacious environment so that you could perform tests and movements
3. Any necessary [medical scans][26] or documents for reference

Do I need a referral to have an online Physical Therapy consultation?

No, you do not require a referral to have Tele-Consultation.

What is Home Physiotherapy?

Home physiotherapy provides basically the same physiotherapy services that you can find in
hospitals, but in the comfort of your own home. So you don’t have to suffer the hassle and pain when
travelling out of the house.

Mobile Physiotherapy in Melbourne

Mobile Physiotherapy Experts for Physical Challenges

Khy Physio brings mobile physiotherapy directly to your home across Melbourne. We support seniors, people with disabilities, and those managing falls and balance issues, mobility difficulties, and muscle and joint pain.

Our physiotherapists deliver personalised, in-home care to help you move safely, build strength, and regain confidence – whether you’re recovering from surgery, managing age-related changes, or living with a physical condition.

Whom We Help

Seniors with frailty who have falls and balance difficulties

Individuals after joint replacements or hip and knee procedures

NDIS participants with mobility, balance challenges and muscle pain

Anyone experiencing muscle weakness, reduced physical function or chronic pain

Book an appointment

Our Services at Khy Physio

Our Services
at Khy Physio.

/ 01

Mobile Physiotherapy for Seniors

Khy Physio specialises in in-home physiotherapy for seniors managing age-related muscle weakness, balance and mobility problems, muscle and joint pain, osteoporosis, and post-surgery recovery, all delivered in the comfort of your own home.

/ 02

Mobile Physiotherapy for NDIS participants

Khy Physio is a registered NDIS provider delivering mobile physiotherapy for people living with physical disability. Our NDIS physiotherapists support those with Strokes, Parkinson’s disease, MND, FND, and other neurological and physical conditions.

/ 03

Hydrotherapy in Melbourne

Khy Physio hydrotherapy physiotherapists use water buoyancy to improve strength, function, and pain management in a safe, low-impact environment. Ideal for chronic pain, joint replacements, arthritis, and significant muscle weakness, we offer NDIS, Support at Home, and private hydrotherapy options.

/ 04

Mobile Physiotherapy in Melbourne

Khy Physio brings expert physiotherapy directly to your home across Melbourne — no clinic, no waiting rooms. We help you recover from injury, manage pain, and stay mobile and independent, with focused one-on-one care built around your goals.

/ 05

Mobile Physiotherapy for DVA clients

Khy Physio provides gap-free mobile physiotherapy for eligible Department of Veterans’ Affairs (DVA) clients. We support veterans managing mobility challenges, pain, and functional limitations – helping you stay active and independent.

/ 06

Mobile Physiotherapy for TAC clients

For those who were unfortunately in transport related accident, Khy Physio is here to help. We aim to reduce the stresses of receiving quality care by delivering physiotherapy to your home. We support TAC clients who have been approved for provider travel due to a clinical need, ensuring you receive high-quality care when attending a clinic isn’t safe or practical.

/ 07

Mobile Physiotherapy for Support at home clients

At Khy Physio, we support older Australians under the Support at Home program (formerly Home Care Packages), delivering in-home physiotherapy that helps you stay strong, mobile and independent in the comfort of your own home.

/ 08

Mobile Physiotherapy for WorkCover clients

Khy Physio’s WorkCover mobile physiotherapists support you after a work-related injury. We understand the pressure of juggling medical reviews, insurer requirements, and employer updates while trying to recover – delivering quality in-home care so getting better is one less stress.

Not sure where to start?

Reach out and we’ll guide you through the next steps toward in-home physiotherapy.

Get started

Mobile Physio Excellence

Driven by Purpose.
Guided by Evidence.

/ 01

Genuine Care – Real Connections

We see you, and we hear you. At Khy Physio, we take the time to understand each and every individual, and to put ourselves in their shoe. That’s why our clients often say they can feel how much we care.

/ 02

Experienced Evidence Based Practice

Our experienced physiotherapists use current evidence-informed practice to guide treatment aimed at supporting balance, mobility, and participation in everyday activities. Your progress is reviewed regularly so your care can be adapted to suit your individual needs and goals.

/ 03

Trusted Quality – Mobile Physio

We’ve supported hundreds of clients to maintain mobility, independence, and confidence at home. As trusted mobile physiotherapists across Melbourne, we provide personalised, evidence-based care tailored to each person’s needs.

/ 04

Personalised Care – Designed For You

Your goals, Our plan. Every treatment plan is developed specific to your situation, goals, condition, and home environment. We ensure a thorough assessment, expert guidance, and continuous monitoring for meaningful results.

/ 05

Advanced Progress Tracking

Using Clinical-Grade equipments such as handheld dynamometers and evidence-based outcome measures, we monitor your strength, function, and key points that matter to you, so every milestone is celebrated, and we achieve real progress through evidence, not luck.

/ 06

Comprehensive Support

Behind every visit is a whole team of physiotherapists with diverse clinical backgrounds and specialties. Whether you need neurological rehab, aged care support, post-surgery recovery, or NDIS goal-focused therapy, we match you with the right expertise and that expertise is always close by if your needs change.

Mobile Physiotherapy in Melbourne

Mobile Physiotherapy Experts for Physical Challenges

Khy Physio brings mobile physiotherapy directly to your home across Melbourne. We support seniors, people with disabilities, and those managing falls and balance issues, mobility difficulties, and muscle and joint pain.

Our physiotherapists deliver personalised, in-home care to help you move safely, build strength, and regain confidence – whether you’re recovering from surgery, managing age-related changes, or living with a physical condition.

Whom We Help

Seniors with frailty who have falls and balance difficulties

Individuals after joint replacements or hip and knee procedures

NDIS participants with mobility, balance challenges and muscle pain

Anyone experiencing muscle weakness, reduced physical function or chronic pain

Book an appointment

Our Services at Khy Physio

Our Services
at Khy Physio.

/ 01

Mobile Physiotherapy for Seniors

Khy Physio specialises in in-home physiotherapy for seniors managing age-related muscle weakness, balance and mobility problems, muscle and joint pain, osteoporosis, and post-surgery recovery, all delivered in the comfort of your own home.

/ 02

Mobile Physiotherapy for NDIS participants

Khy Physio is a registered NDIS provider delivering mobile physiotherapy for people living with physical disability. Our NDIS physiotherapists support those with Strokes, Parkinson’s disease, MND, FND, and other neurological and physical conditions.

/ 03

Hydrotherapy in Melbourne

Khy Physio hydrotherapy physiotherapists use water buoyancy to improve strength, function, and pain management in a safe, low-impact environment. Ideal for chronic pain, joint replacements, arthritis, and significant muscle weakness, we offer NDIS, Support at Home, and private hydrotherapy options.

/ 04

Mobile Physiotherapy in Melbourne

Khy Physio brings expert physiotherapy directly to your home across Melbourne — no clinic, no waiting rooms. We help you recover from injury, manage pain, and stay mobile and independent, with focused one-on-one care built around your goals.

/ 05

Mobile Physiotherapy for DVA clients

Khy Physio provides gap-free mobile physiotherapy for eligible Department of Veterans’ Affairs (DVA) clients. We support veterans managing mobility challenges, pain, and functional limitations – helping you stay active and independent.

/ 06

Mobile Physiotherapy for TAC clients

For those who were unfortunately in transport related accident, Khy Physio is here to help. We aim to reduce the stresses of receiving quality care by delivering physiotherapy to your home. We support TAC clients who have been approved for provider travel due to a clinical need, ensuring you receive high-quality care when attending a clinic isn’t safe or practical.

/ 07

Mobile Physiotherapy for Support at home clients

At Khy Physio, we support older Australians under the Support at Home program (formerly Home Care Packages), delivering in-home physiotherapy that helps you stay strong, mobile and independent in the comfort of your own home.

/ 08

Mobile Physiotherapy for WorkCover clients

Khy Physio’s WorkCover mobile physiotherapists support you after a work-related injury. We understand the pressure of juggling medical reviews, insurer requirements, and employer updates while trying to recover – delivering quality in-home care so getting better is one less stress.

Not sure where to start?

Reach out and we’ll guide you through the next steps toward in-home physiotherapy.

Get started

Mobile Physio Excellence

Driven by Purpose.
Guided by Evidence.

/ 01

Genuine Care – Real Connections

We see you, and we hear you. At Khy Physio, we take the time to understand each and every individual, and to put ourselves in their shoe. That’s why our clients often say they can feel how much we care.

/ 02

Experienced Evidence Based Practice

Our experienced physiotherapists use current evidence-informed practice to guide treatment aimed at supporting balance, mobility, and participation in everyday activities. Your progress is reviewed regularly so your care can be adapted to suit your individual needs and goals.

/ 03

Trusted Quality – Mobile Physio

We’ve supported hundreds of clients to maintain mobility, independence, and confidence at home. As trusted mobile physiotherapists across Melbourne, we provide personalised, evidence-based care tailored to each person’s needs.

/ 04

Personalised Care – Designed For You

Your goals, Our plan. Every treatment plan is developed specific to your situation, goals, condition, and home environment. We ensure a thorough assessment, expert guidance, and continuous monitoring for meaningful results.

/ 05

Advanced Progress Tracking

Using Clinical-Grade equipments such as handheld dynamometers and evidence-based outcome measures, we monitor your strength, function, and key points that matter to you, so every milestone is celebrated, and we achieve real progress through evidence, not luck.

/ 06

Comprehensive Support

Behind every visit is a whole team of physiotherapists with diverse clinical backgrounds and specialties. Whether you need neurological rehab, aged care support, post-surgery recovery, or NDIS goal-focused therapy, we match you with the right expertise and that expertise is always close by if your needs change.

At Khy Physio, we are highly experienced in providing in-home physiotherapy for seniors who are
experiencing ageing related muscle weakness, balance and mobility problems. Whether you are
recovering from a surgery or manage age related changes such as muscle and joint pain, osteoporosis
or other conditions, we are confident in helping you.

disease, MND, FND and others.

buoyancy to improve strength, function and manage pain in a safe, low-impact environment. Ideal for

provide NDIS, Support at Home program, and private hydrotherapy options for all abilities.

focused one-on-one care that fits around your life.

evidenced approach to improving strength, function and manage pain, and have helped hundreds of
older Australians improve and maintain their health and wellbeing.

[Visit Service ][40]

For those who faced work related accident, our WorkCover mobile physiotherapists are to help you. We

Pricing & Funding

# Pricing & Funding

Most of our clients pay little or nothing out of pocket — mobile physiotherapy is covered by a range
of funding programs. Here’s how it works.

[Ask for a quote ][32] [03 8824 0712][33]

How it’s funded

## Ways to fund your physiotherapy.

We work with all the major funding streams for in-home physiotherapy across Melbourne. Tell us your
situation and we’ll confirm your options and any costs up front — no surprises.

/ 01

### NDIS

We’re a registered NDIS provider. We deliver mobile physiotherapy for self-managed, plan-managed and
NDIA-managed participants, billed to your plan in line with the NDIS Price Guide.

/ 02

### Home Care Package

If you have a Home Care Package, physiotherapy can be funded from your package budget. We work with
your provider and case manager to arrange regular visits.

/ 03

### Support at Home

Under the Support at Home program, in-home physiotherapy is funded as part of your allied health
supports. We’ll liaise with your provider to get you started.

/ 04

### DVA

Gap-free mobile physiotherapy for eligible Department of Veterans’ Affairs (DVA) clients with a
valid referral — no out-of-pocket cost to you.

/ 05

### TAC

Recovering from a transport accident? For approved TAC clients we bill TAC directly, so you can
focus on getting better in the comfort of home.

/ 06

### WorkCover

Injured at work? With an accepted WorkCover claim we bill your insurer directly for approved
physiotherapy — no upfront cost while your claim is active.

/ 07

### Medicare (CDM/EPC)

With a GP Chronic Disease Management (CDM/EPC) plan, Medicare covers a set number of allied health
visits each calendar year. A small gap fee may apply.

/ 08

### Private / self-funded

No funding? No problem — and no referral needed. Private session rates are quoted on enquiry, based
on your location and care needs.

/ 09

### Private health insurance

If your “extras” cover includes physiotherapy, you can claim part of each session through your
private health fund. We provide an itemised receipt so you can claim straight back from your
insurer.

/ 10

### My Aged Care (CHSP)

Through My Aged Care and the Commonwealth Home Support Programme (CHSP), eligible older Australians
can access subsidised in-home physiotherapy. We’ll help you understand your referral and
entitlements.

Fees are charged in line with each program’s schedule (for example, the NDIS Price Guide). Private
and self-funded rates are quoted on enquiry, as they depend on your location and care needs.
[Contact us for a quote][34].

## We don’t just help you feel better — we help you stay mobile and independent, at home, with Khy
## Physio.

FAQ

## Pricing & funding questions.

Still unsure? Call us on [03 8824 0712][35] and we’ll talk it through.

Do I need a referral to see a physiotherapist?
No — you can book directly with us for private physiotherapy. A GP referral or care plan is only
needed for certain funding (for example Medicare CDM/EPC or DVA), and we’re happy to help you
arrange one.
How much does a home visit cost?
It depends on your funding. NDIS, Home Care Package, Support at Home, DVA, TAC and WorkCover clients
usually pay little or nothing out of pocket. Private session rates are quoted on enquiry based on
your area and needs — just ask.
Which funding programs do you work with?
NDIS, Home Care Packages, the Support at Home program, DVA, TAC, WorkCover, Medicare (CDM/EPC) and
private/self-funded. We’ll confirm what you’re eligible for before your first visit.
Is there a travel or call-out fee?
We come to you across Melbourne. Any travel component is built into your program’s billing or
included in your quote — we’ll always make the costs clear up front.
Can you bill my plan or insurer directly?
Yes. For NDIS (plan- and NDIA-managed), Home Care Packages, DVA, TAC and WorkCover we bill your
plan, provider or insurer directly wherever your approval allows.
How do I get started?
Complete our [new-patient form][36] or call us on 03 8824 0712. We’ll confirm your funding and book
your first in-home visit — often within the same week.

##### Arrive a little early and check-in

If you’re a first-time client at our Townsville physio clinic, make sure you arrive a few minutes
early to complete our [Patient Information Sheet][47].  It’s always advisable to check-in as you
arrive, so we don’t miss you in the waiting room.

plan for you.  In most cases you will be prescribed a home program with advice on how to manage your
condition until your next appointment.

## Questions

Does NQ Physio offer home visits or private physiotherapy services?

We do offer off-site physiotherapy services for individuals who are unable to visit our Townsville
physio clinic in person, such as home visits, workplace assessments, as well as virtual telehealth
consultations. 

If you have mobility issues or are unable to find suitable transportation to our clinic, please
reach out to our friendly team at (07) 4729 0055 or send us an email enquiry to inform us of your
physiotherapy needs. We will be in touch promptly to offer a suitable service, whether it’s a
physiotherapy session at your place of residence, work, or other location.

Does NQ Physio accept health insurance?

Yes, we accept most types of health insurance claims, including but not limited to:
* Medicare
* WorkCover claims
* DVA referrals
* Enhanced Primary Care referrals
* Other third party insurer claims

We request that you bring along the relevant document such as your policy information and details to
your physiotherapy session in order for us to help you process your claim smoothly and easily.

Do I need a referral from a doctor to book an appointment?

No, you can still book a session with our physiotherapists regardless of whether you have a doctor’s
referral. We are able to process your private health insurance claims via the Health Industry Claims
and Payments Service (HICAPS).

However, there are several instances where a doctor’s referral will be required: 
* if you have been injured as a result of a workplace accident and wish to submit a WorkCover claim
* if you are a Veteran and want to submit a claim under the DVA
* If you have an applicable chronic condition that is covered by the Enhanced Primary Care Medicare
  program. (Please note that only COMMONWEALTH CONCESSION CARD HOLDERS are bulk billed.  If you do
  not hold a commonwealth concession card mixed billing will apply at our private rates)

Under the above circumstances, you will need to provide a doctor’s referral before you will be
eligible to attend a physiotherapy session for treatment. If you are unsure of whether you need a
doctor’s referral, please call our team who will be able to provide confirmation for your unique
situation.

Do I need to see a physiotherapist?

Generally speaking, physiotherapy aims to promote, sustain, and facilitate the restoration of
overall physical health. There are many forms of treatment applicable to different types of injuries
and conditions, and it’s important for you to know what you need help with before seeing a
physiotherapist.

There is no strict requirement for attending physiotherapy. If you are experiencing any physical
discomfort that impedes or prevents you from carrying out certain activities, it is a potential
cause for attending physiotherapy. Some example signs that you may need physiotherapy include:
* Sustaining an injury that does not fully recover or results in persistent pain, discomfort, or
  loss of mobility.
* Having poor posture that causes lingering aches and pains
* Frequent headaches
* Poor sleeping patterns
* Loss of flexibility in joints

How soon can I expect to see results from treatment?

It really depends on the extent and root cause of your condition or injury. Most isolated issues
such as a sprained ankle or pulled muscle can often be treated directly and quickly, with

Our Townsville physiotherapists are qualified to complete Functional Capacity Evaluations,

## Your first Physio Visit

If you are visiting a physiotherapist for the first time you may have questions regarding your
appointment. We believe proper preparation prior to your sessions results in better outcomes and an
improved recovery.

Allow approximately 45 minutes for your initial appointment.  A slightly longer appointment allows
us to take a detailed history of your complaint and to complete a thorough examination.  Follow up
appointments are approximately 30 minutes duration.

Everything you need to know about your first physio appointment including what to bring, length of
sessions, what to wear and more.

[Read More][46]

##### What to bring & What to wear

You don’t need a referral to see a Physiotherapist.  However, if you have a referral please bring
it. Wear comfortable clothing which allows you to move freely.

##### Arrive a little early and check-in

If you’re a first-time client at our Townsville physio clinic, make sure you arrive a few minutes
early to complete our [Patient Information Sheet][47].  It’s always advisable to check-in as you
arrive, so we don’t miss you in the waiting room.

##### What to expect during & after

We will take a detailed history and undertake a thorough examination to formulate the best treatment
plan for you.  In most cases you will be prescribed a home program with advice on how to manage your
condition until your next appointment.

## Frequently

## Questions

[Email Enquiry][50]

Does NQ Physio offer home visits or private physiotherapy services?

We do offer off-site physiotherapy services for individuals who are unable to visit our Townsville
physio clinic in person, such as home visits, workplace assessments, as well as virtual telehealth
consultations. 

If you have mobility issues or are unable to find suitable transportation to our clinic, please
reach out to our friendly team at (07) 4729 0055 or send us an email enquiry to inform us of your
physiotherapy needs. We will be in touch promptly to offer a suitable service, whether it’s a
physiotherapy session at your place of residence, work, or other location.

Does NQ Physio accept health insurance?

Yes, we accept most types of health insurance claims, including but not limited to:
* Medicare
* WorkCover claims
* DVA referrals
* Enhanced Primary Care referrals
* Other third party insurer claims

We request that you bring along the relevant document such as your policy information and details to
your physiotherapy session in order for us to help you process your claim smoothly and easily.

Do I need a referral from a doctor to book an appointment?

No, you can still book a session with our physiotherapists regardless of whether you have a doctor’s
referral. We are able to process your private health insurance claims via the Health Industry Claims
and Payments Service (HICAPS).

However, there are several instances where a doctor’s referral will be required: 
* if you have been injured as a result of a workplace accident and wish to submit a WorkCover claim
* if you are a Veteran and want to submit a claim under the DVA
* If you have an applicable chronic condition that is covered by the Enhanced Primary Care Medicare
  program. (Please note that only COMMONWEALTH CONCESSION CARD HOLDERS are bulk billed.  If you do
  not hold a commonwealth concession card mixed billing will apply at our private rates)

Under the above circumstances, you will need to provide a doctor’s referral before you will be
eligible to attend a physiotherapy session for treatment. If you are unsure of whether you need a
doctor’s referral, please call our team who will be able to provide confirmation for your unique
situation.

Do I need to see a physiotherapist?

Generally speaking, physiotherapy aims to promote, sustain, and facilitate the restoration of
overall physical health. There are many forms of treatment applicable to different types of injuries
and conditions, and it’s important for you to know what you need help with before seeing a
physiotherapist.

There is no strict requirement for attending physiotherapy. If you are experiencing any physical
discomfort that impedes or prevents you from carrying out certain activities, it is a potential
cause for attending physiotherapy. Some example signs that you may need physiotherapy include:
* Sustaining an injury that does not fully recover or results in persistent pain, discomfort, or
  loss of mobility.
* Having poor posture that causes lingering aches and pains
* Frequent headaches
* Poor sleeping patterns
* Loss of flexibility in joints

How soon can I expect to see results from treatment?

It really depends on the extent and root cause of your condition or injury. Most isolated issues
such as a sprained ankle or pulled muscle can often be treated directly and quickly, with
improvements feeling more pronounced after about 4-6 weeks of starting treatment. In other more
severe cases, recovery can take months or even a year with consistent treatment.

There are a multitude of factors that can affect your recovery time, from the frequency of your
physiotherapy sessions to the proper application of self-guided exercises at home as prescribed by
your physiotherapist. The important thing to remember is that your recovery will not happen
overnight. 

That being said, our physiotherapists will provide you with a detailed timeline and treatment plan
outlining your recovery during the initial consultation. This will help you better understand when
you should be seeing results, and how you can prepare for it accordingly.

# Kinesiology Services | Kinesiologist in Langley BC

## Kinesiology Services In Langley

We’re excited to offer you a complete range of kinesiology services that can help you achieve your
health and fitness goals. Our team of skilled kinesiologists will work closely with you to create
customized exercise plans that are tailored specifically to your individual needs and fitness
levels. Whether you’re looking to recover from an injury, improve your overall health, or boost your
athletic performance, our kinesiologists are here to guide and support you every step of the way.

Active rehabilitation treatments are designed for patients after a recent injury or recovering from

Kin can also help provide active rehabilitation to athletes with health and general fitness, sports
activity performance, athletic training, and wellness to help them succeed in their sport.

## Do kinesiologists provide active rehabilitation treatment?

Yes, Kinesiologists provide active rehabilitation treatment, which involves personalized exercise

and function.

## Do kinesiologists provide strength training?

Yes, kinesiologists provide strength training that targets muscle strength, power, and endurance.
They can design tailored programs to meet individual goals, fitness levels, and physical conditions,
incorporating exercises like weightlifting, resistance band workouts, and bodyweight exercises.
Other exercise modalities, such as cardiovascular training or flexibility work, may also be
included.

## How can kinesiologist help me recover from an injury?

Kinesiologists can help patients recover from injury by designing exercise programs tailored to
their specific needs and abilities. They can also help patients improve their range of motion,
strength, and flexibility, which are important factors in recovery. They offer an initial
assessment, exercise prescription, injury rehabilitation, sports performance training, education and
lifestyle modifications to help you maintain your physical health and prevent injury

## Can kinesiologist help me manage chronic pain?

Yes, kinesiologists can help manage chronic pain by designing exercise programs that help alleviate
pain and improve functionality. They devise a conditioning program to help manage your symptoms and
reduce pain on a day-to-day basis.

## What exercises are best for my specific injury or condition?

The best exercises for a specific injury or condition will depend on the individual and the nature
of the injury or condition. Rehabilitation specialists can assess your needs and develop an exercise
program that is safe and effective for you.

The role of kinesiology in post-surgical rehabilitation is to design exercise programs that help
patients regain strength, range of motion, and functionality and recover post-operatively. The
physical activity experts work closely with other healthcare providers to ensure that patients are
progressing appropriately.

Proper body mechanics are crucial in preventing injury and maintaining physical health. They help
you maintain proper alignment, distribute forces effectively, and reduce any strain on muscles,
bones, and joints. Poor body mechanics can lead to injuries, chronic conditions, and muscle
imbalances. By practicing good body mechanics, you can reduce the risk of developing future injuries
and chronic conditions, improve your physical health, and enhance your overall well-being.

movement patterns and provide feedback to improve techniques during sports.

designing personalized exercise programs to improve physical function and enhance the quality of
life in individuals with movement disorders.

# Antima Jain – Registered Physiotherapist

**Antima Jain**

## About Antima Jain – PT

Licensed Physiotherapist since 2018, Antima Jain brings over 12 years of hands-on clinical
experience in musculoskeletal care. A graduate of the Master of Physiotherapy (MSc PT) program with
a musculoskeletal (MSK) specialization (2012), she has built a reputation for thorough assessments
and individualized treatment plans that address not only symptoms but also the root causes of
chronic and non-traumatic musculoskeletal pain.

### Education and Credentials
* **Master of Physiotherapy (MSc PT)**, Musculoskeletal Specialization. 2012.
* **Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT)**, 2009.

### Clinical Experience

> **Total Practice**: 12+ years
> **Licensed Physiotherapist**: Since 2018

Throughout her career, Antima has successfully managed a diverse caseload, including:
1. **Orthopedic Injuries**
* Post-operative rehabilitation (ACL reconstruction, joint replacements)
* Fracture management and return-to-function protocols
2. **Sports-Related Conditions**
* Acute sprains, strains, and tendonopathies
* Performance enhancement and injury prevention programs
3. **Chronic Musculoskeletal Pain**
* Complex regional pain syndrome and myofascial dysfunction
* Low back and neck pain of non-traumatic origin

### Treatment Philosophy

Antima believes in a patient-centred, evidence-based [physiotherapy treatment][62] approach. Her
goals are to:

**1. Identify Underlying Drivers**

Delve beyond presenting symptoms to uncover biomechanical imbalances, postural habits, and lifestyle
factors that contribute to chronic pain.

**2. Empower Through Education**

Teach self-management strategies—ranging from therapeutic exercises to ergonomic adjustments so that
patients can sustain progress independently.

**3. Apply Manual & Therapeutic Techniques**

Blend hands-on interventions with active rehabilitation to restore mobility, strength, and
functional performance.

### Certifications & Special Skills
* **Mulligan Concept® Manual Therapy**
* **Certified Dry Needling Practitioner**
* Continuing professional development in sports taping, kinetic control, and advanced therapeutic
exercise modalities

### Outside the Clinic

When she’s not helping patients reclaim their pain-free lives, Antima loves to:
* **Explore New Destinations **– From coastal hikes to cultural city tours
* **Quality Family Time** – Weekend brunches, board games, and beach outings

## Frequently asked questions

## What is physiotherapy?

Physiotherapy is a branch of healthcare that specializes in preventing, diagnosing, and addressing
movement and physiological functions. It can help someone regain mobility and flexibility or manage
injury or chronic pain. It can provide various health benefits while addressing and treating issues
related to chronic illnesses and pain conditions and generally improve patients’ quality of life.

Physical therapy is the answer if you’ve tried everything else and still suffer from pain. It’s also
a great way to keep your body healthy, whatever activity level you are in.

## What are the advantages of physiotherapy?

Some of the benefits of PT treatment are
* Helps in recovery from muscle or joint injuries, strains, sprains, fractures and dislocations
* It presents an opportunity for people to focus on their work and reduce any injuries. It also
helps improve quality of life with lifestyle and work improvement measures.
* It is less expensive than surgery and a conservative approach to physical rehabilitation.
* It can be done at your own convenient time.
* It is a non-invasive therapy and helps reduce the need for medication.
* Helps reduce long-term pain and disability.
* It can reduce the risk of repetitive strain injuries and prevent re-injury.
* It can reduce the risk of falls or accidents.
* Helps improve the range of movement and physical function, muscle strength, endurance, and
flexibility.
* Providing treatments for different types of injuries and conditions.
* It is a cost-effective recovery option.

# Registered Massage Therapist in Langley | RMT in Langley

We’re pleased to provide **registered massage therapy (RMT) services in Langley** at Opal
Physiotherapy and Health Clinic. This specialized service caters to various health and wellness
needs of clients. Our registered massage therapists are committed to promoting your overall health
through the healing power of touch.

## Meet our massage therapists in Langley.

Our highly skilled and **certified massage therapists** specialize in various areas, ensuring that
we can provide the right care for your unique needs. Our therapists are registered and trained to
offer personalized treatments, making your wellness journey our top priority.

Contact Us

## What is registered massage therapy (RMT)?

Registered Massage Therapy (RMT) refers to massage therapy performed by a registered massage
therapist who is licensed or certified to practice massage professionally. RMTs are highly trained
healthcare practitioners who manipulate the body’s soft tissues to treat physical dysfunction,
injuries, pain, and disorders and promote overall health and well-being.

Learn more about [our Registered Therapist][62]

## Our massage therapy services Include
* **Senior Preventative and Rehab Care:** Tailored massage therapy to address the specific needs of
seniors, promoting mobility, preventing injuries, and supporting overall wellness.
* **Prenatal and Postnatal Care:** Gentle and nurturing RMT alleviates pregnancy-related pain and
discomfort and promotes postnatal recovery.
* **Women’s Health:** Specialized massage therapy to support [women’s health][63] concerns,
providing relief and promoting balance.
* **Migraines:** Targeted massage techniques to alleviate migraine symptoms and provide relief from
headache-related discomfort.
* **Recurring Daily Pain Issues:** Address everyday muscle discomfort and muscle tension through
***personalized massage therapy*** sessions.
* **Postural Issues:** [Target and improve postural imbalances][64] by targeting the tight muscles
to enhance overall comfort and flexibility.
* **Relaxation and Tension Issues:** Indulge in a calming massage experience designed to promote
relaxation and alleviate tension.
* **Chronic Pain:** Comprehensive massage therapy to manage and alleviate [chronic pain
conditions][65].
* **Sports Injuries:** Tailored massage techniques to aid in the recovery and prevention of
sports-related injuries.
* **Anxiety and Depression:** Holistic massage therapy to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and
support mental wellness.

## Benefits of RMT Massage

Registered massage therapy provides many benefits for both physical and mental health:
* [Relieves muscle tension][66], spasms and pain.
* Improves joint mobility and range of motion.
* Enhances circulation and lymphatic drainage.
* Reduces stress, anxiety, and depression.
* Promotes relaxation and sleep quality.
* Speeds recovery from injuries.
* Improves posture and body mechanics.

RMTs use several techniques to address issues like back/neck pain, headaches, arthritis,
fibromyalgia, sports injuries, and more. Massage can also be used as part of treatment plans for
various chronic illnesses.

## Choosing an RMT

When selecting a registered massage therapist, look for one who is licensed and insured.
* Ask about their training, experience, and specialties.
* Make sure you feel comfortable with them.
* RMT treatments should be customized to your needs through assessment, consultation, and feedback.
* A good RMT will provide aftercare instructions as well.

Regular massage therapy from a *qualified RMT* can be highly beneficial for overall health and
comfort.

## Why choose our registered massage therapist in Langley?

Here’s why you should choose our Langley massage therapy:
* **Expertise:** Our **registered massage therapists are *highly trained professionals* **with
expertise in various wellness areas.
* **Personalized Approach:** Each session is customized to address your specific needs, ensuring a
targeted and effective treatment plan.
* **Collaborative Care:** Our massage therapists work in tandem with our other healthcare team to
provide integrated care for your overall well-being.
* **Comfortable Environment:** Immerse yourself in our serene and inviting atmosphere, designed to
enhance your therapeutic experience.

Embark on a journey of healing and rejuvenation with our service for **RMT in Langley**. Please
contact us to schedule your appointment or learn more about our Langley massage and physio services.

Invest in your well-being today with our Langley RMT, and let our registered massage therapist be

# Dry Needling In Langley | IMS | Intramuscular Stimulation

Discover the power of precision healing with our **dry needling and Intramuscular Stimulation
(IMS)** treatments in Langley!

At Opal Physio, we’re revolutionizing pain **relief and muscle recovery** using these cutting-edge
techniques. Imagine melting away tension, easing chronic pain, and unlocking your body’s natural
healing potential – all with the gentle insertion of ultra-thin needles.

Whether you’re an athlete looking to **enhance performance** or someone seeking **relief from
stubborn aches**, our expert physiotherapists are ready to tailor this innovative treatment to your
unique needs.

Say goodbye to persistent discomfort and hello to a new level of wellness. It’s time to experience
the transformative effects of dry needling and IMS for yourself!

# Dry needling / intramuscular stimulation (IMS) at Opal

At Opal Physio, we proudly offer dry needling in Langley as part of our comprehensive physiotherapy
services. These specialized techniques can provide significant pain relief and improved function for
many of our patients dealing with chronic muscle pain, tension, and dysfunction.

Contact Us

## What is dry needling / IMS?

Dry needling, also known as intramuscular stimulation (IMS), is an evidence-based treatment
technique used by specially trained physiotherapists to **treat myofascial pain and muscle
tension**. It involves inserting thin, sterile acupuncture needles into specific trigger points or
tight bands within muscles to elicit a therapeutic response.

While IMS **uses similar needles to acupuncture**, it is based on Western medicine principles and
scientific research rather than traditional Chinese medicine. The goal is to target neuromuscular
dysfunction and stimulate a healing response in the affected tissues.

## How does dry needling work?

When a needle is inserted into a trigger point or tight band of muscle tissue, it can elicit a local
twitch response – a brief, involuntary contraction of the muscle fibres. This twitch response is
associated with various therapeutic effects:
* Increased blood flow to the area
* Release of endogenous opioids and other pain-relieving chemicals
* Decreased muscle tension and knots
* Improved nerve function and communication
* Stimulation of the body’s natural healing processes

The needle insertion creates a small, controlled lesion that triggers the body to increase
circulation and initiate tissue repair. This can help reset dysfunctional muscle tissue and restore
normal function.

## Conditions treated with dry needling / Intramuscular Stimulation

Dry needling and IMS can be effective for treating a wide range of musculoskeletal conditions,
including:
* Chronic [neck pain][62] and [back pain][63]
* [Shoulder impingement][64] and rotator cuff issues
* [Hip pain][65] and [knee pain][66]
* [Plantar fasciitis][67]
* Tension [headaches][68]
* [Muscle strains and spasms][69]
* [Myofascial pain syndrome][70]
* [Fibromyalgia][71]
* [Tendinopathies][72]

It can also be beneficial for improving overall muscle function, flexibility, and range of motion.

## What to expect during treatment?

**Initial assessment:** Before beginning dry needling treatment, your physiotherapist will
thoroughly assess whether this technique is appropriate for your condition. They will review your
medical history and evaluate your muscle function, movement patterns, and areas of pain or
dysfunction.

**Treatment session:** During the dry needling session, you will be positioned comfortably on a
treatment table. Your physiotherapist will use palpation skills to locate the specific trigger
points or tight muscle bands to be treated. They will then insert thin, sterile needles into these
areas.

You may feel a slight prick as the needle penetrates the skin, followed by a deep ache, muscle
twitch, or cramping sensation as it reaches the trigger point. These sensations are normal and
indicate that the treatment is targeting the correct areas.

The needles may be left in place for a short time (30 seconds to a few minutes) or manipulated
gently to elicit the desired response. Depending on your condition, your physiotherapist may treat
multiple points during a single session.

**Post-treatment:** After the needles are removed, your physiotherapist may perform additional
manual therapy techniques or prescribe exercises to complement the dry needling treatment. You may
experience some muscle soreness for 24-48 hours following treatment, similar to the feeling after an
intense workout. This is a normal response and usually resolves quickly.

## Benefits of dry needling / IMS

Dry needling and IMS treatment offer several potential benefits for patients:
* Rapid pain relief
* Improved muscle function and flexibility
* Increased range of motion
* Decreased muscle tension and knots
* Enhanced blood flow and tissue healing
* Reduced chronic inflammation
* Improved nerve function
* Complementary to other physiotherapy treatments

Many patients experience improvements in pain and mobility following dry needling treatment.
However, depending on the chronicity and severity of the condition, the full effects may take
several sessions to achieve.

## Safety and side effects

Dry needling is generally considered a safe treatment when performed by a qualified practitioner.
Our physiotherapists have undergone extensive training in IMS techniques and anatomy to ensure safe
and effective treatment.

Common side effects may include:
* Temporary soreness or bruising at the needle insertion sites
* Fatigue or lightheadedness
* Minor bleeding or bruising

Serious complications, including infection or injury to blood vessels or nerves, are rare. Our
therapists take all necessary precautions to minimize these risks.

## Is dry needling / IMS right for you?

Dry needling can be an excellent treatment option for many patients, but it may not be appropriate
for everyone. It is contraindicated in certain conditions, including:
* Acute inflammation
* Bleeding disorders or use of blood thinners
* Compromised immune system
* Local skin infections or lesions
* Lymphedema
* Needle phobia
* Pregnancy
* Vascular disease

During your initial assessment, your physiotherapist will determine if IMS is a suitable treatment
option based on your condition and medical history.

## Combining dry needling with other treatments

At Opal Physio, we believe in providing comprehensive, individualized care to our patients. Dry
needling is often most effective when combined with other physiotherapy treatments and modalities,
such as:
* [Manual therapy techniques][73]
* [Therapeutic exercise][74]
* Joint mobilization or manipulation
* [Postural education and ergonomic advice][75]
* Taping or bracing
* [Shockwave][76], [low-level laser therapy][77] or ultrasound therapy

Your physiotherapist will develop a personalized treatment plan that may incorporate IMS and other
appropriate interventions to address your specific needs and goals.

## Our expertise in dry needling

Our physiotherapists have received specialized training in dry needling techniques, allowing us to
offer this advanced treatment option to our patients. We stay up-to-date with the latest research
and best practices in dry needling to ensure we provide the highest quality care.

## Getting started with IMS In Langley

If you’re looking for dry needling near me and are interested in exploring whether dry needling or
IMS treatment could benefit your condition, we encourage you to schedule an initial assessment with
one of our experienced physiotherapists. During this appointment, we’ll evaluate your condition,
discuss your treatment options, and determine if [dry needling][78] is appropriate for your
rehabilitation plan.

Don’t let chronic pain or muscle dysfunction hold you back any longer. Contact Opal Physio today to
learn more about how dry needling in Langley can help you achieve your health and wellness goals.
