# Sports Injury Clinic

[spcli 1][spcli 1]

**At Somerton Physiotherapy Clinic, **our Sports and Exercise medicine department is focused and
dedicated towards the prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and rehabilitation of sports injuries.

We treat all sports injuries from high level athletes who are competing competitively to individuals
playing 5 a-side with their friends to recreational runners. Every patient that visits our Dublin
Physio clinic is treated with empathy and a guarantee of 100% commitment from your therapist.

At our Blanchardstown Physio, Castleknock Physio and Tallaght Physio locations our fully equipped
sports injury clinics allow us to use several different techniques to treat sports injuries
effectively and efficiently. Our promise is to rehabilitate you back to your full pre-injury
potential. This can be achieved solely with the patient, or if applicable, in unison with the input
from other members of the sports medicine team i.e., surgeon or sports medicine consultant.

Using our state-of-the-art facilities and high-tech equipment, we aim to empower you to rebuild both
your physical and mental fortitude to enable a full and swift return to your sport!

## **Some of the most common Sports Injuries we treat include:**
* Shoulder: Dislocation, Frozen Shoulder, Rotator cuff tear, AC joint injury
* Elbow: Tennis and Golfers elbow
* Wrist fractures, tendinitis and repetitive strain
* Sports related back and neck pain
* Hip pain
* Hamstring, quad, gluteal, calf, groin muscle strain
* ITB tendinitis
* Running related injuries
* Cycling related injuries
* Gym related injuries
* Achilles tendon injury
* Knee Ligament injury
* Meniscal tears
* Patellofemoral joint pain
* Ankle sprains
* Post ACL reconstruction
* Shin splints
* Stress fractures

** **

#### **Returning to your chosen sport after injury:**

Our sports and injury clinics in Dublin boast the best equipment needed to guide you back to your
sport. You can rest assured that your therapist will guide you through every aspect of your rehab
journey. The use of any gym equipment will be fully demonstrated and you will be coached through
each component of your rehab programme.

**At Somerton Physio we have implemented a 4-step treatment pathway to ensure a swift return to your
sport in a timely and safe manner. Pathway components include:**
* ** Functional testing:**

This is an aspect of sports and exercise medicine that is crucial in allowing your therapist to
assess your current ability. Functional testing is where we look at specific tasks and compare your
injured side to your unaffected side. Most up to date research and evidence tells us that passing
functional testing can reduce your risk of re-injury when you return to your chose sport.
* ** Digital Dynamometry:**

This is how we compare the strength of one joint/muscle to another. Our state-of-the-art digital
dynamometer accurately records your strength in kilograms, thus showing any deficits in muscle
strength.

By providing the ability to make precise measurements of muscle strength, the digital dynamometer
allows us to assess and monitor ongoing progress. It allows us to give more accurate feedback,
enabling us to provide more scientific and meticulous patient care and tailored rehab.

Extensive research into injury prevention and recovery from injuries such as ACL rupture and
tendinopathy has shown the importance of limb symmetry. This is yet another expert toul we can offer
you in your journey towards full recovery.
* ** Plyometric testing:**

Plyometrics is the development of power through muscles relaxing and contracting at a rapid pace.
Plyometric training builds your muscles ability to generate force and power. When testing
plyometrics we use a series of well documented tests, these give your therapist reliable data on
your readiness to return to your sport.
* ** Sport simulation:**

As simple as it sounds, sports simulation is based on your specific sport. Your therapist will use
various techniques to emulate the rigors and demands of your sport. High speed running, twisting and
turning, cutting, hopping, jumping for a high ball while being opposed, the list is endless. This is
the final stage of your rehabilitation and you will start to feel ever closer to your goal of
getting back to your sport or activity.

Throughout the 4-step treatment pathway your therapist may use manual therapy techniques to enhance
your recovery and return to play. These techniques can include massage, joint mobilisations, joint
manipulation, stretching, trigger point therapy and dry needling.

# Running Performance Lab

*“If you are suffering from running related pain or just want to improve your running times and
technique, our detailed assessment and treatment plans and packages will help you to take your
training to the next level”*

Our aim at Somerton Physiotherapy is to help our clients improve their performance and achieve their
rehabilitation goals. Our **Running Performance Lab** service provides a platform for recovering
athletes to regain their full potential. It also affords healthy athletes the opportunity to improve
running performance variables which can contribute to the prevention of future injury and improve
overall running performance.

We review your running technique from multiple angles in our state of the art facility. We then
analyse your run using world leading movement capturing software (Dartfish) in order to construct a
plan tailored to your running needs.

We specialise in Long distance and Juvenile runners looking to improve their running technique and
speed. However, we treat runners of all backgrounds, whether you are a beginner, recreational runner
or an elite athlete. If you are suffering from running related pain or just want to improve your
running times, our detailed assessment and treatment plans and packages will help you to take your
training to the next level.

#### Running Performance Packages
* [
1. Running Assessment / Gait Analysis][32]
* [
2. Run For Fun Package][33]
* [
3. Run Long and Strong Package][34]
* [
4. Runners Performance Package][35]
* [
5. Juvenile Running Package ][36]

What does a Running Assessment at Somerton Physio entail:

#### Running Assessment / Gait Analysis
1. **Initial Consultation**
* You will meet with one of our Chartered Physiotherapists who will discuss your injury history with
you, your training background and future goals.
2. **Movement & Functional Testing**

At our Dublin Sports Clinic your Physiotherapist will get you to perform a series of movements and
strength tests. This will measure your range of movements, lower limb stability and any strength
deficits which may be affecting your running Kinematics.
3. **Running Technique Assessment**
* Our experienced Physiotherapist will carry out a video analysis of your running technique using
world leading movement tracking software (Dartfish).

#### What we look for:
* Stride length
* Cadence
* Posture and positioning
* Contact type and time
* Loading patterns
4. **Solution**

We will provide you with:
* Individualised instructions on technique alteration
* A comprehensive strengthening plan, targeting the areas identified in the running assessment
(Please see our running packages)
* Detailed plan of what you will need to do to overcome your running issue.
5. **Running Performance Lab Report**

After your final consultation you will receive a comprehensive report detailing the following:
1. Top Down assessment of running kinematics
2. Specific factors influencing your run
3. Main findings related to your pain and pathology
4. Goals for gait re-education
5. Cues/solutions given
6. Future areas to work on
7. Overall impression
8. Plan

#### Running Performance Lab objective:
1. Improve running efficiency and kinematics
2. Identify current issues and how they impact on your run
3. Identify potential future injuries and reduce their impact on your goals
4. Increase speed and running performance

#### Common Running Injuries We See In The Clinic:
* Achilles tendon pain
* Hamstring strain / hamstring tendinopath
* ITB syndrome
* Calf pain – recurring calf tear
* Knee ligaments injuries
* Lower back pain – bulging disc
* Hip Pain
* Osgood Schlatters
* Knee pain – bursitis, meniscus
* Ankle pain – anterior impingement
* Severs
* Patellar tendinopathy
* Shin splints
* Patellofemoral pain
* Gluteal tendinopathy
* Plantar fasciitis

click here to book in to see one of our experienced Chartered physiotherapists. Select our

# SPORTS MASSAGE DUBLIN 15 / SPORTS MASSAGE DUBLIN 24

***Exciting news for sports massage clients! We are introducing a sports massage loyalty card.***

***Purchase 5 Sports Massages and your 6th is free! Offer is valid in our Blanchardstown,
Castleknock and Tallaght clinics.***

**Sports massage is a type of massage that can alleviate pain and tension occurring in certain areas
of the body. ** These symptoms can be as a result of too much physical activity or often as a result
of increased stress in daily life. This type of massage was originally developed to help athletes as
a way to prevent and relieve [sports injuries][32].

Both athletes and non-athletes can achieve physiological and psychological benefits from receiving
sports massage. At our Sports Massage clinics in Blanchardstown, Castleknock and Tallaght, we use a
variety of different massage techniques to restore normal muscle function as well as relieve pain.

Sports Massage is an effective treatment for easing stiffness, tension or knots in the [neck][33],
[shoulder][34], [lower back][35] and leg muscles. For athletes it can be beneficial pre or post any
sporting event.

Treatment is not a painful or uncomfortable technique. Prior to your massage your
[physiotherapist][36] will discuss your preferred depth of massage. After your treatment your
physiotherapist will prescribe a home exercise programme to help maintain or improve the increase in
flexibility the sports massage will achieve.

# Back and Neck Pain

Back and neck pain is one of the most common complaints we treat at Somerton Physiotherapy Clinic.
At our Blanchardstown, Castleknock and Tallaght facilities we successfully treat back and neck pain
on a daily basis. According to the World Health Organisation (WHO) low back pain is the leading
cause of disability in the general public and a leading reason for work absenteeism. Latest research
estimates that up to 80% of the world’s population will suffer from back and/or neck pain at some
point in their lifetime, with a large portion of these going on to develop long term issues.

The implementation of a physiotherapy treatment programme has been shown to be an effective strategy
at managing both acute and long term back and neck pain, by promoting and empowering the patient to
move and get active again.

## **What is the Back and Neck Clinic at Somerton Physiotherapy Clinic?**

Our Chartered Physiotherapists are experts in treating back and neck pain in clients of all ages. At
the Back and Neck Clinic you will undergo a specific assessment of your spine, so that we can
ascertain your starting point. This will help your physiotherapist to develop a tailored treatment
protocol that will help you reach your goals and get you back doing the activities you love doing.

At your first appointment we will take you through a comprehensive initial assessment, which gives
us a definitive picture of your back or neck condition. We use a selection of key objective measures
(range of movement, strength, endurance, orthopaedic testing etc.) which gives us the information to
design an individual blueprint to help return you to your normal function.

Following this in-depth assessment, our treatment phase consists of hands on treatment, exercise
therapy and education. Our focus is on regaining your capacity for movement and to reclaim
positivity and trust in your body. We will then introduce you to some progressive movement and
strengthening exercises in line with your goals and put a plan in place to address long term
management and prevention.

Common back and neck complaints that we successfully treat at our Castleknock, Blanchardstown and
Tallaght physio clinics:
* Osteoarthritis
* Cervical and Lumbar disc bulges (herniations)
* Cervical and Lumbar muscle pain
* Degenerative disc
* Osteoporosis
* Headaches or dizziness originating from the neck (cervicogenic headaches)
* Arm or leg pain referred from the back
* Spinal stenosis (narrowing of spinal canal)
* Post back or neck surgery rehabilitation
* Cervical and Lumbar whiplash
* Facet joint pain (joint between two spinal bones)
* Scoliosis

If you feel we can help you on your journey to a pain free back or neck please click below to book
in to see one of our experienced chartered physiotherapists.

# Children’s Physiotherapy

[Somerton 14 600x429 1][Somerton 14 600x429 1]

Adolescent or Children’s physiotherapy is an area we highly specialise in at Somerton Physiotherapy
Clinic. We have been successfully treating children and adolescents with various injuries for almost
20 years. Every child is different, so our unique level of experience in this area of physiotherapy
has allowed us to rehabilitate adolescents from all over Dublin and Ireland.

As their bodies develop and grow, children and adolescents can be particularly vulnerable to overuse
injuries. As your child matures, their body can experience a huge amount of physical change with
boys growing on average 10-30cm, while girls grow 5-20cm on average.

[Children's Physiotherapy - Adolescents - Somerton Physio ][Children's Physiotherapy - Adolescents -
Somerton Physio ]

Growth spurts during this time can cause temporary problems in strength, co-ordination, balance and
speed. These changes can result in physical discomfort/pain in muscles and joints as the child’s
body struggles to adapt to the demands of daily life or playing sport. If the underlying cause of
the pain remains untreated, the condition can progress to affecting a child during day-to-day
activities, such as walking or climbing up and down stairs.

Here at Somerton Physiotherapy your treatment plan will consist of an accurate diagnosis of the
problem and we will prescribe a specific tailored exercise programme to help your child return to
their pre injury state. This ensures that they continue to enjoy the benefits of sport and physical
activity.

Common child and adolescent conditions treated at Somerton Physiotherapy Clinic:
* **Knee pain** (Osgood Schlatter’s, bipartite patella, ligament injury, Sinding-Larsen-Johansson
syndrome)
* **Ankle/Heel pain** (Severs, ankle ligament sprain, Achilles tendon irritation, stress fracture)
* **Back Pain** (scoliosis, stress fracture, facet joint irritation)
* **Hip pain** (SUFE, hip impingement, avulsion fracture, hip dysplasia)
* **Muscle strains / aches**
* **Shin splints / Tibial stress syndrome**

If your child is a keen runner, you may be interested in our [Juvenile Runners Package (Castleknock
clinic ONLY)][32]. This package includes 4 physiotherapy led strength and conditioning sessions for
young athletes. This package will help to improve arm and leg co-ordination and balance, it will
also help increase speed and endurance which will translate into your chosen sport. Click here for
further details.

# About Therapia

## Therapia’s mission is to enable a personalized circle of care for patients—at home, virtually, or
## in person.

We bring expert, licensed physiotherapists directly to patients’ doors, offering convenient and
affordable treatment without the need to travel or wait in clinics. Our tech-enabled platform and
carefully selected therapist network ensure each patient receives high-quality, one-on-one care
tailored to their recovery needs.

[Book an Appointment][53]
[416-526-6933][54]

### Who we are

### Our mission

Our mission is to deliver high-quality, personalized healthcare that meets you where you are. We
offer flexible, convenient, and compassionate care across a range of services to support recovery,
wellness, and long-term health.

### Our vision

To be a globally recognized and trusted partner across the healthcare spectrum promoting recovery,
wellness, and long-term health at every stage. We aim to improve accessibility, connect the system,
and shift the focus from sick care to true health care through prevention, healthy lifestyles, and
compassionate support.

### Our future

RhynoCare acquired Therapia to carry forward this mission. With decades of healthcare experience and
a commitment to innovation, we are expanding Therapia’s reach so more patients and providers can
benefit from a truly patient-centered approach to care.

# About Therapia

## Therapia’s mission is to enable a personalized circle of care for patients—at home, virtually, or
## in person.

We bring expert, licensed physiotherapists directly to patients’ doors, offering convenient and
affordable treatment without the need to travel or wait in clinics. Our tech-enabled platform and
carefully selected therapist network ensure each patient receives high-quality, one-on-one care
tailored to their recovery needs.

[Book an Appointment][53]
[416-526-6933][54]

### Who we are

### Our mission

Our mission is to deliver high-quality, personalized healthcare that meets you where you are. We
offer flexible, convenient, and compassionate care across a range of services to support recovery,
wellness, and long-term health.

### Our vision

To be a globally recognized and trusted partner across the healthcare spectrum promoting recovery,
wellness, and long-term health at every stage. We aim to improve accessibility, connect the system,
and shift the focus from sick care to true health care through prevention, healthy lifestyles, and
compassionate support.

### Our future

RhynoCare acquired Therapia to carry forward this mission. With decades of healthcare experience and
a commitment to innovation, we are expanding Therapia’s reach so more patients and providers can
benefit from a truly patient-centered approach to care.

# Mackenzie Rhodes PT, FRCms, MPT, Hons. BSc

Mackenzie is a physiotherapist that works to empower his patients by taking an evidence-based,
patient-centered approach to rehabilitation. This involves a combination of manual therapy
techniques, acupuncture/dry needling, therapeutic exercise and providing recommendations regarding
activity modification.

[Mackenzie Rhodes PT, FRCms, MPT, Hons. BSc]
[Book an Appointment][55]
[Call 416-526-6933][56]

## Education

Queen's University - Bachelor of Science with Specialization in Life Science Western University -
Master of Physical Therapy

## Certifications

Registered Physiotherapist, Level II Advanced Orthopaedic Manual & Manipulative Therapist, Certified
Acupuncture and Dry Needling Practitioner, and Functional Range Conditioning Specialist (FRCms)

## Special Interests

Special interests in musculoskeletal conditions, post surgical rehab, weightlifting injuries, and
concussion rehabilitation.

## Neighborhoods Near Me

Leaside, East York, The Beaches, and North York

## Interesting Facts

In my spare time I like to lift weights as well as play guitar/bass.

## Availability

Call us at [416-526-6933][57] to request Mackenzie's availability.

# Nirvan Maharjan, BScPT

I greatly value my patients, particularly my senior patients. Their wealth of memories is truly
remarkable, and I consider myself fortunate to be a part of those exchanges. Furthermore, I
consistently find their wisdom to be a source of invaluable learning.

[Nirvan Maharjan, BScPT]
[Book an Appointment][55]

## Education

RGUHS, BPT

## Certifications

Certified in (MDT) Mckenzie technique.

Certified GLA:D Canada.

Certified AIB-VRC (Vestibular Rehabilitation and Concussion)

Dry Needling

## Special Interests

Osteoarthritis, Balance Disorders, Vertigo, Dizziness, Post Surgical Rehab (THR, TKR), Low back
pain, Sports Injury, Geriatrics, Neurological conditions (Parkinson, Stroke, MS), Headache
Management.

## Neighborhoods Near Me

Scarborough, Pickering, East York, North York, Toronto.

## Interesting Facts

Our body is like a sea-saw. The more we keep it in balance the more pain free we get.

A strategic leader, Jeevetha is committed to building innovative, scalable solutions that enhance
access to care.

# About Therapia

## Therapia’s mission is to enable a personalized circle of care for patients—at home, virtually, or
## in person.

We bring expert, licensed physiotherapists directly to patients’ doors, offering convenient and
affordable treatment without the need to travel or wait in clinics. Our tech-enabled platform and
carefully selected therapist network ensure each patient receives high-quality, one-on-one care
tailored to their recovery needs.

[Book an Appointment][53]
[416-526-6933][54]

### Who we are

### Our mission

Our mission is to deliver high-quality, personalized healthcare that meets you where you are. We
offer flexible, convenient, and compassionate care across a range of services to support recovery,
wellness, and long-term health.

### Our vision

To be a globally recognized and trusted partner across the healthcare spectrum promoting recovery,
wellness, and long-term health at every stage. We aim to improve accessibility, connect the system,
and shift the focus from sick care to true health care through prevention, healthy lifestyles, and
compassionate support.

### Our future

RhynoCare acquired Therapia to carry forward this mission. With decades of healthcare experience and
a commitment to innovation, we are expanding Therapia’s reach so more patients and providers can
benefit from a truly patient-centered approach to care.

## We have exciting news to share...

We’re thrilled to announce that Therapia has been acquired by RhynoCare, a partner that shares our
mission of delivering accessible, high-quality at-home care. This acquisition means an even better
experience for clients through enhanced services, streamlined support, and exciting new initiatives.
With RhynoCare’s backing, we’re poised for growth, and we can’t wait to show you what’s next!

[RhynoCare + Therapia combined logos]

Hear from Dr. Andrew Park, CEO of RhynoCare, about what this acquisition means for Therapia. Press
play to learn more!

[Patient using resistance band]

## Seamless care, from booking to recovery

### Getting started is simple:

Just tell us where it hurts and choose a time that works for you. Therapia takes care of the
rest—matching you with a physiotherapist in your community who’s best suited to treat your
condition.

With appointments available 7 days a week, 365 days a year, and pricing comparable or better than
clinics, Therapia is the preferred choice for physiotherapy at home.

### Ready to book?

Schedule your [appointment online][60] or call [416-526-6933][61]. Have questions? Read our
[FAQs][62].

## Our services

Here are some of the areas in which our home physical therapists provide highly specialized care:

Seniors Care & Geriatric Rehabilitation

For seniors focused on fall prevention, injury recovery, and regaining strength after deconditioning
or weakness.

Post-Surgical Rehabilitation

After ACL reconstruction, joint replacement, arthroscopy, or fracture repair to speed recovery
safely.

Bone & Joint Disorders

Treatment for arthritis, back pain, and joint pain to reduce discomfort, improve mobility, and
restore daily function.

Musculoskeletal Injuries

Treatment for sprains, strains, and soft tissue injuries including muscle, tendon, and ligament
tears.

Fractures & Dislocations

For hip fractures, patella injuries, and shoulder dislocations to rebuild strength and restore safe
movement.

Neurological Conditions

After stroke or spinal cord injury to improve mobility, coordination, and independence in daily
living.

Cardiac Rehabilitation

Designed to support recovery, improve stamina, and rebuild confidence following a heart attack.

Pediatric Conditions

For children addressing developmental delays, posture concerns, and recovery from injuries to
support healthy growth.

Dizziness & Imbalance Disorders

For vertigo, dizziness, and balance issues to restore stability, reduce falls, and increase
independence.

Sports Injuries

Sports physiotherapy for athletes recovering from injuries to restore strength, prevent setbacks,
and return to play.

## FAQs

### What is FlexifyMe?
* FlexifyMe is a digital healthcare platform focused on managing pain and movement-related
  conditions through a combination of online physiotherapy, guided therapy sessions, and
  technology-assisted assessment. The platform supports individuals dealing with recurring pain by
  offering structured care plans supervised by qualified physiotherapists and healthcare
  professionals.
* FlexifyMe works with a multidisciplinary team that includes physiotherapists, yoga therapists, and
  orthopedic specialists, helping users receive expert guidance remotely and consistently.

### What is online physiotherapy?
* Online physiotherapy, also known as tele-physiotherapy, allows you to consult with a licensed
  physiotherapist through secure video sessions. During these sessions, the therapist assesses your
  movement, posture, and symptoms, then guides you through personalised exercises and recovery
  strategies.
* It enables professional physiotherapy care without visiting a clinic, making it suitable for
  home-based treatment and ongoing recovery support.

### Why choose online physiotherapy?
* Online physiotherapy offers flexibility, accessibility, and continuity of care. It is particularly
  helpful for individuals with busy schedules, mobility limitations, or those who prefer structured
  recovery at home.
* With expert supervision and personalised treatment plans, online physiotherapy allows you to
  receive consistent guidance while avoiding travel time and clinic dependency.

Operating in major cities like Pune, Mumbai, Delhi, and Noida, FlexifyMe aims to deliver expert-guided care that promotes long-term health and well-being.

relevant_companies.company_summary: Graceline Physiotherapy Services specializes in delivering personalized care through both online and in-person treatments, aimed at enhancing mobility, reducing pain, and improving overall well-being. The company offers a range of services, including online physiotherapy consultations, in-person sessions, and specialized rehabilitation programs for joint replacement and stroke recovery, catering to diverse clients such as older adults, athletes, and individuals seeking remote physiotherapy solutions. With a focus on healthcare, rehabilitation, and sports medicine, Graceline is dedicated to empowering recovery for individuals wherever they are.

dedicated team of experienced physiotherapists committed to providing individualized care that

## We Offer Online Physiotheraphy

Welcome to Graceline Physiotherapy, where your health and well-being are our priority. We are a
dedicated team of experienced physiotherapists committed to providing individualized care that
empowers you to achieve your health goals.

At Graceline Physiotherapy, we believe that everyone deserves access to high-quality physiotherapy
services, no matter where they are. That’s why we offer both **online consultations** and
**hands-on, in-person treatments**, making our services convenient, flexible, and accessible.

Our approach is built on a foundation of compassion, expertise, and innovation. Whether you’re
recovering from an injury, managing chronic pain, or regaining strength after surgery, we create
treatment plans tailored to your specific needs. Using evidence-based practices, we guide you every
step of the way toward improved mobility, reduced pain, and a better quality of life.

### Our Mission

To deliver accessible, personalized physiotherapy solutions that empower our clients to take control
of their health and recovery.

### Our Vision

To be the trusted partner in physiotherapy care, inspiring healthier, stronger communities.

## Why Choosen Us

### Personalized Care

We create tailored treatment plans to meet your unique needs and goals.

### Expert Team

Our physiotherapists are highly trained and experienced in various conditions and treatments.

### Convenient Options

Access our services both online and in-person for flexibility and comfort.

### Comprehensive Support

From injury management to post-surgery rehabilitation, we’re with you every step of the way.

### Affordable Services

Enjoy competitive pricing with discounts on your first online consultation.

## ABOUT HEALYOS

Healyos is a healthcare company that aims to provide high-quality treatment and recovery services to
its patients. It was established in 2015 under the guidance of Padma Vibhushan Dr. KH Sancheti. With
a team of skilled professionals including physiotherapists and physicians, our services have won the
trust of leading orthopaedic surgeons across Pune. The commitment to deliver exceptional
physiotherapy treatment strengthens as we continue expanding our services.

Our vision is to deliver effective and customized home-based patient recovery through the
integration of quality care and rehabilitation services.

that empower patients to lead healthier lives. Guided by the expertise of Padma Vibhushan Dr. KH

continuous improvement, fostering innovation, and delivering compassionate services that meet the
unique needs of each patient.

Our vision is to revolutionize patient recovery through effective, customized, and home-based care.
By integrating quality treatment and advanced rehabilitation services, we strive to enhance recovery
outcomes and improve overall patient well-being.

## Our Presence

We provide physiotherapy services across all of Pune, ensuring accessible, high-quality care for our
patients.

## ABOUT HEALYOS

Healyos is a healthcare company that aims to provide high-quality treatment and recovery services to
its patients. It was established in 2015 under the guidance of Padma Vibhushan Dr. KH Sancheti. With
a team of skilled professionals including physiotherapists and physicians, our services have won the
trust of leading orthopaedic surgeons across Pune. The commitment to deliver exceptional
physiotherapy treatment strengthens as we continue expanding our services.

Our vision is to deliver effective and customized home-based patient recovery through the
integration of quality care and rehabilitation services.

## Our Mission

At Healyos, our mission is to provide high-quality, personalized treatment and recovery services
that empower patients to lead healthier lives. Guided by the expertise of Padma Vibhushan Dr. KH
Sancheti, we aim to set new standards in physiotherapy and healthcare excellence.

## Our Values

Quality, trust, and patient-centered care are at the core of everything we do. We are committed to
continuous improvement, fostering innovation, and delivering compassionate services that meet the
unique needs of each patient.

## Our Vision

Our vision is to revolutionize patient recovery through effective, customized, and home-based care.
By integrating quality treatment and advanced rehabilitation services, we strive to enhance recovery
outcomes and improve overall patient well-being.

## Our Presence

We provide physiotherapy services across all of Pune, ensuring accessible, high-quality care for our
patients.

[iso123 About Us][iso123 About Us]

## WE ARE ISO CERTIFIED

We take immense pride in announcing that we are ISO 9001:2005 certified.

Throughout the accreditation process we have developed and implemented a robust quality management
system which has enabled us to improve our overall performance and maintain a high level of quality
in the services we provide…

To become ISO 9001 compliant, we underwent an evaluation process that included quality management
system development.

Quality is at the heart of everything we do, and we continue to challenge ourselves to improve our
services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of patients, while always complying with
regulations and specifications.

# In-Home Physiotherapy Services

[ Start now ][158]
[ Call us ][159]
Do you want personalized treatment without travelling to a physiotherapy clinic? In-Home
Therapeutics can improve physical health in your chosen home environment, making it a comfortable
and cost-effective experience. Whether you seek to [regain muscle strength][160] or reduce chronic
pain, our services are here to help.

Find out more about our in-home physiotherapy services below!

## Private Physiotherapy Services Available In Your Area

In the Greater Toronto area, we have experienced physiotherapists who can offer personalized
physiotherapy at home.

These private physical therapy services are also suitable for anyone living in cities such as [North
York][161], [Cornwall][162], [Ottawa][163], [Brockville][164], [Kingston][165], [Napanee][166],
[Toronto][167], [Mississauga][168], [Oakville][169], [Etobicoke][170], [Vaughan][171], and
[Brampton][172].

Don’t see your city on the list? Call us to determine whether remote physiotherapy is available in
your location, whether that’s Richmond Hill or Windsor. Our team wants to provide as much care as
possible, so don’t hesitate to reach out about at-home physical therapy services. For more
information on remote physiotherapy, keep reading.

## Neurological Physiotherapy For Strength and Mobility

Neurological physiotherapy is the best option for those who have neurological disorders that impact
their brain, spinal cord, and nerves. Some of these might be spinal cord injuries or strokes.
We offer therapeutic exercises like stretching to improve coordination and increase muscle strength,
leading to better mobility overall. With a personalized treatment plan, you can also use adaptive
equipment that caters to your physical well-being. If you or a loved one needs that extra support,
choose [neurological physiotherapy][173] today.

## Musculoskeletal Physiotherapy For Chronic Pain Management

If you have an injury that limits your movement and strength, choose [musculoskeletal
physiotherapy][174] as your subsequent treatment. Our team specializes in aches and pains, along
with post-fractures and discolorations that haven’t been kind to your body. Through home exercises
and professional guidance, we can help eliminate stubborn pain.

## Balance and Falls Prevention to Prevent Future Accidents

Chronic pain, neurological conditions, and ageing can disrupt your balance and increase the risk of
falling over. We understand that this risk can be scary for seniors. Therefore, our team has put
together balance programs to protect your health.
Book an appointment for [balance and falls prevention][175] to complete a falls risk assessment.

## Post-Operative Home Rehabilitation Services

Choose [post-operative physiotherapy][176] if you want support in your recovery process. At In-Home
Therapeutics, we can arrange a one-to-one session to ban the pain, swelling, and lack of mobility
from your life. Our structured physiotherapy program has everything you need after surgery,
including strength-based home exercises and physical techniques to manage your pain.
One of our physiotherapists will guide you through rehabilitation to help you get back on your feet.

## Physiotherapy For Seniors to Address Physical Challenges

Seniors may need [extra home care][177] because they can’t travel. This is an issue we understand,
making our in-home therapy services perfect for older adults who have limited physical movement.
Do you have family members who are in desperate need of physiotherapy? Choose our [physiotherapy for
seniors][178] treatment now.

## Acupuncture and Dry Needling Treatments

In-Home Therapeutics also provides more relaxing therapy techniques that revolve around acupuncture
and dry needling. The insertion of fine needles is supposed to treat pain, muscle tension, and
inflammation. Whether you want to relax or achieve a natural energy flow through your body, our
private physical therapy services can help you feel physically stronger.
You can learn more about acupuncture and dry needling [here][179].

## Additional At-home Physical Therapy Services In Greater Toronto Area

We also provide other in-home physiotherapy services for specific individuals. Those who have
experienced long-term [pain from car accidents][180] can choose [motor vehicle accident
physiotherapy][181] to feel good again. You need a referral from a physician or chiropractor before
starting this treatment, and you must live in Cornwall, Ottawa, Kingston, Brockville, or Russell.

[Physiotherapy for veterans affairs][182] is another service beneficial for veterans with movement
disorders. Our team suggests exercise programs, manual therapy like massages, and educational tips
for injury prevention. Anyone living in Cornwall, Ottawa, Kingston, Brockville, and Russell can
access these special services.

Lastly, our [corporate physiotherapy][183] package is designed to help employees manage their
physical well-being when working remotely. Our ergonomic assessment evaluates workstations and tasks
to determine whether they’re safe or causing physical injury. Choose this package to implement more
home care for your team.

## ABOUT

[Screenshot 2022-06-06 at 8.35.07 AM.png]

We are a team of like-minded physiotherapist from diverse backgrounds and trainings.

What matters to us most is help people achieve optimal health, that’s is good sleep, clean stomach
and healthy muscles and joints.

We educate our clients about the inbuilt capacity of body to heal through simple monitored exercise.

One on one monitored exercise sessions with natural pain relieving modalities helps us address these
issues to your satisfaction.

Hence, give us an opportunity to help you experience stress free health care.

## Agende facilmente online ou se preferir entre em contacto!

### We work with english or spanish speaking clients! 

## O Que Oferecemos

Oferecemos uma variedade de serviços de fisioterapia para atender às necessidades de nossos
pacientes. Desde massagens terapeuticas/relaxantes/desportivas até treino especializado com
fisioterapeutas experientes, estamos comprometidos em fornecer um cuidado abrangente e personalizado
para permitir a melhor reabilitação qualquer seja a lesão.

[Conheça-nos melhor ][9]
[Academia - LSFISIO]

## Nossos Serviços

[[Massagem - LSFISIO]][10]

##### [Massagens][11]

###### Relaxamento e Bem-Estar

[Ver mais ][12]

As nossas massagens são projetadas para aliviar o stress, reduzir a tensão muscular e promover o
bem-estar geral. Com terapeutas qualificados, garantimos uma experiência relaxante e
rejuvenescedora.

[[FISIO]][13]

##### [Fisioterapia][14]

###### Reabilitação Física

[Ver mais ][15]

Nossas sessões de fisioterapia são personalizadas para ajudar na recuperação de lesões, aumentar a
mobilidade e melhorar a qualidade de vida. Contamos com profissionais dedicados que cuidam da sua
saúde e bem-estar.

[[PERSONAL]][16]

##### [Treino Personalizado][17]

###### Com Fisioterapeutas

[Ver mais ][18]

Oferecemos treino personalizado com fisioterapeutas especializados para melhorar a força,
flexibilidade e condicionamento físico. Nosso foco é garantir que atinja seus objetivos de forma
segura e eficaz.

[[FISIOTERAPIA]][19]

##### [Fisioterapia Domiciliar][20]

###### Conforto e Comodidade

[Ver mais ][21]

Para aqueles que precisam de tratamento em casa, disponibilizamos sessões de fisioterapia
domiciliar. Os nossos profissionais qualificados levam o cuidado terapêutico diretamente até si,
garantindo sua recuperação no conforto do seu lar.

[[PILATES]][22]

##### [Pilates Clinico][23]

###### Saúde é movimento

[Ver mais ][24]

Exercícios terapêuticos guiados por fisioterapeutas para reabilitação, fortalecimento e alívio de
dores. Melhore a postura, a mobilidade e a estabilidade com sessões personalizadas sobre atenção do
fisioterapeuta.

## Como podemos ajudar?

Nome
Telefone
Email
Em que podemos ajudar?
Enviar

Agradecemos o envio. Entraremos em contato em breve.

###### Quais são os horários de funcionamento?

A LS Fisio funciona de segunda a sexta-feira, das 7h00 às 22h00 conforme marcação e a sua
confirmação, oferecendo flexibilidade para agendar sessões de fisioterapia, pilates clínico e
massagens ao domicílio. Aos sábados, atendemos das 9h00 às 14h00, proporcionando conveniência para
quem tem agenda movimentada durante a semana.

###### É possível visitar as instalações sem agendar?

Sim, mas é necessário agendar antes, pois podemos estar fora das instalações durante o horário de
funcionamento. 😉

###### Que tipos de tratamentos oferecem?

Na LS Fisio, oferecemos uma variedade de tratamentos especializados focados na reabilitação e
bem-estar, incluindo fisioterapia para dores nas costas, lesões musculoesqueléticas e reabilitação
pós cirúrgica. Além da fisioterapia tradicional, dispomos de Pilates Clínico, que ajuda a fortalecer
o corpo de forma segura e personalizada, promovendo a prevenção de lesões e a melhoria da postura.
Também oferecemos massagem domiciliar para maior conveniência e cuidado contínuo. Nosso atendimento
é direcionado tanto a pacientes locais quanto a falantes de inglês em Cascais, garantindo um
acompanhamento profissional e humanizado em todas as etapas do tratamento.

###### Quais são os horários de funcionamento?

A LS Fisio funciona de segunda a sexta-feira, das 7h00 às 22h00 conforme marcação e a sua
confirmação, oferecendo flexibilidade para agendar sessões de fisioterapia, pilates clínico e
massagens ao domicílio. Aos sábados, atendemos das 9h00 às 14h00, proporcionando conveniência para
quem tem agenda movimentada durante a semana.

###### É possível visitar as instalações sem agendar?

Sim, mas é necessário agendar antes, pois podemos estar fora das instalações durante o horário de
funcionamento. 😉

###### Que tipos de tratamentos oferecem?

Na LS Fisio, oferecemos uma variedade de tratamentos especializados focados na reabilitação e
bem-estar, incluindo fisioterapia para dores nas costas, lesões musculoesqueléticas e reabilitação
pós cirúrgica. Além da fisioterapia tradicional, dispomos de Pilates Clínico, que ajuda a fortalecer
o corpo de forma segura e personalizada, promovendo a prevenção de lesões e a melhoria da postura.
Também oferecemos massagem domiciliar para maior conveniência e cuidado contínuo. Nosso atendimento
é direcionado tanto a pacientes locais quanto a falantes de inglês em Cascais, garantindo um
acompanhamento profissional e humanizado em todas as etapas do tratamento.

# Nursing and Rehabilitation Center

Morningside Nursing and Rehabilitation Center provides skilled rehabilitation and nursing that
supports the whole patient—restoring independence, reducing readmissions, and promoting the best
health outcomes.

### Services

### Assisted Living Program

Morningside Assisted Living is a licensed 40-bed residence in the Bronx, NY, designed for
individuals who want to maintain independence while receiving minimal assistance. The program offers
private living units, 24-hour supervision, personal care support, meals, transportation, activities,
and therapy services to help residents thrive. With a focus on “Renew, Restore, Rehabilitate,” the
staff develops personalized care plans and provides a supportive community environment.

[ Contact us ][28]

### Dialysis

Morningside offers on-site dialysis services within its skilled nursing setting, allowing residents
to receive life-sustaining treatments without the stress of traveling to outside centers. By having
dialysis in the same place where patients live and receive other medical care, it ensures seamless
coordination, greater comfort, and improved safety. This integrated approach means all medical needs
are addressed under one roof, supporting better outcomes and peace of mind for patients and their
families.

**Services**

# Nursing and Rehabilitation Center

Morningside Nursing and Rehabilitation Center provides skilled rehabilitation and nursing that
supports the whole patient—restoring independence, reducing readmissions, and promoting the best
health outcomes.

### Services

### Assisted Living Program

Morningside Assisted Living is a licensed 40-bed residence in the Bronx, NY, designed for
individuals who want to maintain independence while receiving minimal assistance. The program offers
private living units, 24-hour supervision, personal care support, meals, transportation, activities,
and therapy services to help residents thrive. With a focus on “Renew, Restore, Rehabilitate,” the
staff develops personalized care plans and provides a supportive community environment.

[ Contact us ][28]

### Dialysis

Morningside offers on-site dialysis services within its skilled nursing setting, allowing residents
to receive life-sustaining treatments without the stress of traveling to outside centers. By having
dialysis in the same place where patients live and receive other medical care, it ensures seamless
coordination, greater comfort, and improved safety. This integrated approach means all medical needs
are addressed under one roof, supporting better outcomes and peace of mind for patients and their
families.

[ Contact us ][29]

### 24/7 Skilled Nursing Care

Our skilled nursing team provides 24/7 expert medical care and support, ensuring residents receive
personalized attention, medication management, and specialized treatments whenever needed. With a
focus on safety, comfort, and well-being, we are always here to meet the evolving health needs of
those in our care.

[ Contact us ][30]

### Short-Term / Sub-Acute Rehabilitation

Our short-term rehabilitation program provides personalized therapy and medical support to help
residents regain strength, mobility, and independence. With a team of skilled professionals, we
focus on rapid recovery and seamless transitions, ensuring each individual reaches their highest
level of function and returns home with confidence.

[ Contact us ][31]

### Intravenous Therapy

We offer intravenous therapy services to administer medications, fluids, and nutrients directly into
the bloodstream, ensuring efficient and effective treatment for various medical conditions.

[ Contact us ][32]

### Wound Care

Our wound care specialists provide attentive treatment for various types of wounds, utilizing
appropriate dressings and medications to promote healing and prevent infection.

[ Contact us ][33]

### Medical Oversight & Specialty Services

Our experienced in-house physicians provide continuous medical oversight, collaborating closely with
our clinical team to deliver personalized diagnostic and treatment plans. Residents also benefit
from access to a trusted network of specialists ensuring expert consultations and comprehensive care
for complex medical needs. This integrated approach maintains the highest standard of care
throughout each resident’s stay.

[ Contact us ][34]

### Pain Management

Utilizing an interdisciplinary approach, we develop individualized pain management plans aimed at
enhancing quality of life. Treatment options may include medications, massage therapy, mental health
support, and other modalities tailored to each patient’s needs.

[ Contact us ][35]

### Palliative and Hospice Care

We provide compassionate palliative and hospice care for patients with chronic illnesses, focusing
on comfort, stress relief, and quality of life. Our team collaborates with experienced hospice
organizations to offer comprehensive support.

[ Contact us ][36]

### Enteral Nutrition

We offer enteral nutrition therapy for patients unable to consume food orally, ensuring proper
nourishment through carefully administered feeding tubes tailored to individual nutritional needs.

[ Contact us ][37]

### Cardiac Rehabilitation

For patients recovering from cardiac events or managing heart disease, our program includes exercise
therapy and education aimed at preventing future cardiac issues and promoting heart health.

[ Contact us ][38]

### Respiratory Care

Our team provides care for patients with breathing disorders, offering treatments and education to
improve respiratory function and enhance overall well-being.

[ Contact us ][39]

### Physical Therapy

Our physical therapy program focuses on restoring mobility, strength, and function through
personalized exercise regimens and therapeutic techniques, aiding patients in achieving their
rehabilitation goals.

[ Contact us ][40]

### Occupational Therapy

Our culinary team prepares nutritious and delicious meals tailored to individual dietary needs and
preferences, creating an enjoyable dining experience that supports overall health and satisfaction.

[ Contact us ][41]

### Speech Pathology

Our speech therapy services address communication and swallowing disorders, employing individualized
treatment plans to enhance speech, language, swallowing abilities, and cognition.

[ Contact us ][42]

### Post Operative Care

We offer personalized pre- and post-operative care plans, ensuring a smooth surgical experience. Our
comprehensive approach includes pre-op education, pain management, and recovery planning to
facilitate optimal healing.

[ Contact us ][43]

### Social Work

Our qualified social workers assist patients and their families in navigating the healthcare system,
providing counseling, education, and resources to support emotional well-being and effective care
planning.

[ Contact us ][44]

## Dedicated to the highest quality nursing care

Our registered and licensed nurse teams are highly skilled at assessing patient needs and
implementing individualized care plans.

Our nurses collaborate with patients, family members, doctors and our own experience leadership to
understand care goals, assess care needs, develop individualized plan and coordinate other essential
services.

###### Overview

## We tailor our expert nursing services to address each patient’s health care needs

Our nurses collaborate with patients, family members, doctors and our own experience leadership to
understand care goals, assess care needs, develop individualized plan and coordinate other essential
services. You will be assigned to a registered nurse as your primary care manager who is responsible
for overseeing all your care needs. Our nurse will collaborate with you and your doctor to develop a
personalized plan of care and will coordinate any other home-based services that you may need.

relevant_companies.polished_summary: Guys and St Thomas NHS Foundation Trust is a leading healthcare provider in London, offering a wide range of medical services across its hospitals, including Guy's Hospital, St Thomas' Hospital, and the Royal Brompton Hospital. The Trust is dedicated to delivering high-quality patient care, with specialties in areas such as cardiovascular health, maternity, cancer treatment, and emergency services, while also engaging in research and education to enhance healthcare outcomes. Its commitment to patient-centered care is reflected in its initiatives to involve patients and their families in the healthcare process.

relevant_companies.company_summary: Inova is a leading nonprofit healthcare provider in Northern Virginia, dedicated to delivering world-class and compassionate healthcare services to diverse communities. With over 26,000 team members, Inova offers a comprehensive range of integrated healthcare services, including primary care, emergency care, cancer treatment, and specialized services in heart and vascular health, pediatrics, and behavioral health, facilitating over 4 million patient visits annually. Recognized for excellence in patient care and clinical outcomes, Inova is committed to advancing healthcare through innovation and community engagement.

# About Us

We are a modern Medical Clinic

Velocity Fitness Clinic working since 1999 in this field. Daily handling patient strength of around
100 per day. From acute to subacute to chronic problems we are dealing in OPD every day from all
departments ie orthopaedic, neurology, pediatric, gynogenetic, geriatric, surgery e.t.c.

where there is a number of therapy centres providing treatment through electronic machines only we
understand that treatment cannot be complete until you spend some time exercising for the weak
muscles. At velocity, we guide you the right way to exercise

#### We improve your quality of Life..

We understand the value of your time so we try not to keep you waiting for long for your turn of
therapy. For this, we have multiple sets of latest machines and good strength of staff. Also, we do
not keep you waiting in between one and second machine application as it waves off the effect of the
preceding machine and makes a slow recovery.

# About Us

We are a modern Medical Clinic

Velocity Fitness Clinic working since 1999 in this field. Daily handling patient strength of around
100 per day. From acute to subacute to chronic problems we are dealing in OPD every day from all
departments ie orthopaedic, neurology, pediatric, gynogenetic, geriatric, surgery e.t.c.

where there is a number of therapy centres providing treatment through electronic machines only we
understand that treatment cannot be complete until you spend some time exercising for the weak
muscles. At velocity, we guide you the right way to exercise

#### We improve your quality of Life..

We understand the value of your time so we try not to keep you waiting for long for your turn of
therapy. For this, we have multiple sets of latest machines and good strength of staff. Also, we do
not keep you waiting in between one and second machine application as it waves off the effect of the
preceding machine and makes a slow recovery.

We regularly keep in touch through SMS with our clients for motivating them for their home exercises
and review their recovery from the therapist.

## Facilities

We constantly invest in high-end services.

Our therapists are professional and Postgraduate in qualification provide us with the expertise to
reach the finest point of your problem and treat it accordingly. Short courses are done from
professionals of Australia and New Zealand make us work in international standards for your speedy
and safe recovery.

One of the main objectives of Velocity clinic is none other than to offer the maximum quality from
the first contact, making a complete amnesics that allows physiotherapy develop a diagnostic target,
with subsequent monitoring of the patient’s progress.

Each person has a unique evolution, despite presenting the same pathology. Getting a proper
diagnosis is key to the treatment is effective.

Our treatment sessions are exclusively manual therapy, carried out by our team of qualified
physiotherapists. The approximate duration of each session is 45** **minutes, to provide quality
treatment and most timely manner possible.

# About Us

We are a modern Medical Clinic

Velocity Fitness Clinic working since 1999 in this field. Daily handling patient strength of around
100 per day. From acute to subacute to chronic problems we are dealing in OPD every day from all
departments ie orthopaedic, neurology, pediatric, gynogenetic, geriatric, surgery e.t.c.

where there is a number of therapy centres providing treatment through electronic machines only we
understand that treatment cannot be complete until you spend some time exercising for the weak
muscles. At velocity, we guide you the right way to exercise

#### We improve your quality of Life..

We understand the value of your time so we try not to keep you waiting for long for your turn of
therapy. For this, we have multiple sets of latest machines and good strength of staff. Also, we do
not keep you waiting in between one and second machine application as it waves off the effect of the
preceding machine and makes a slow recovery.

We regularly keep in touch through SMS with our clients for motivating them for their home exercises
and review their recovery from the therapist.

## Facilities

We constantly invest in high-end services.

Our therapists are professional and Postgraduate in qualification provide us with the expertise to
reach the finest point of your problem and treat it accordingly. Short courses are done from
professionals of Australia and New Zealand make us work in international standards for your speedy
and safe recovery.

One of the main objectives of Velocity clinic is none other than to offer the maximum quality from
the first contact, making a complete amnesics that allows physiotherapy develop a diagnostic target,
with subsequent monitoring of the patient’s progress.

Each person has a unique evolution, despite presenting the same pathology. Getting a proper
diagnosis is key to the treatment is effective.

Our treatment sessions are exclusively manual therapy, carried out by our team of qualified
physiotherapists. The approximate duration of each session is 45** **minutes, to provide quality
treatment and most timely manner possible.

## SMS Communication Disclosure

NLH Physical Therapy (Athletic Edge Physical Therapy) may send SMS text messages related to
scheduling coordination, appointment communication, and care follow-up.

Message frequency varies (approximately 1–4 messages per month). Message & data rates may apply.
Reply STOP to opt out. Reply HELP for assistance. SMS consent is not required to receive services.

$28.00
This 17-ounce, double-walled stainless steel water bottle is perfect for your daily outings. It will
keep your drink of choice hot or cold for hours. It also features an odor- and leak-proof cap. Throw
it in your car's cup holder on your way to work, take it with you on hikes, or toss it in your bag
for any time you get thirsty.

• High-grade stainless steel
• 17 oz (500 ml)
• Dimensions: 10.5″ × 2.85″ (27 × 7 cm)
• Vacuum flask
• Double-wall construction
• Bowling pin shape
• Glossy finish
• Odorless and leak-proof cap
• Insulated for hot and cold liquids (keeps the liquid hot or cold for 6 h)
• Patented ORCA coating for vibrant colors
• Hand-wash only
• Blank product sourced from China

Disclaimer: Keeping water in the bottle for over 24 hours is unhygienic and can result in an
unpleasant smell.

## Athletico’s Toll-Free Injury Hotline

Athletico has created an Injury Hotline available to anyone who sustains an injury or has questions
about chronic pain, strains or injuries. A certified and licensed athletic trainer (AT) will answer
your questions regarding your injury and direct you appropriately for care. ATs are highly skilled
allied health professionals who are trained to assess injuries sustained during athletic events.
Through Athletico’s Injury Hotline, an AT will discuss the injury and educate the caller on how to
safely care for their injury until they can be seen by a doctor. They can also determine if an
individual’s injury is significant enough to seek immediate medical attention. Callers may access
the Injury Hotline by calling toll-free: 1-877-ATHLETICO (877-284-5384)

## Insurance/Billing

Athletico’s business staff will assist you on an individual basis filing all insurance claims. In
addition to accepting numerous insurance plans, Athletico is also Medicare certified. We will do
everything in our power to accommodate each individual. Please feel free to contact our Billing
Center associates at 630-575-6250 for assistance.

## Athletico’s Toll-Free Injury Hotline

Athletico has created an Injury Hotline available to anyone who sustains an injury or has questions
about chronic pain, strains or injuries. A certified and licensed athletic trainer (AT) will answer
your questions regarding your injury and direct you appropriately for care. ATs are highly skilled
allied health professionals who are trained to assess injuries sustained during athletic events.
Through Athletico’s Injury Hotline, an AT will discuss the injury and educate the caller on how to
safely care for their injury until they can be seen by a doctor. They can also determine if an
individual’s injury is significant enough to seek immediate medical attention. Callers may access
the Injury Hotline by calling toll-free: 1-877-ATHLETICO (877-284-5384)

## Insurance/Billing

Athletico’s business staff will assist you on an individual basis filing all insurance claims. In
addition to accepting numerous insurance plans, Athletico is also Medicare certified. We will do
everything in our power to accommodate each individual. Please feel free to contact our Billing
Center associates at 630-575-6250 for assistance.

#### Leadership Development

We fully recognize that people are our most important asset. Our success depends entirely on the
strength of our talented employees and leaders, which we build from within and manage through a
disciplined process.

Our approach to developing leaders at Athletico is simple—we see every employee as having leadership
potential, and we incorporate the best evidence-based training and strategies to help our leaders at
every level grow.

##### Athletico’s Purpose and Values

Our purpose and values are the foundation on which we develop leaders. Our shared purpose—to help
people enhance their health and quality of life—unifies us as we collaborate internally and sustains
us as we engage externally. Taken together, our purpose and values are the foundation for our unique
culture and leadership approach.

##### We Hire the Best

Through a strategic, quality-driven hiring experience that establishes first the alignment of the
candidate with the company’s core values, followed by a “best fit” process, Athletico consistently
attracts top talent from across the nation because of our reputation for clinical excellence.
Subsequently, our future leaders are able to be prepared from the early stages of their career and
developed throughout their professional life.

##### We Develop and Engage Our Team

We believe there’s no substitute for hands-on experience when it comes to leadership development.
That’s why we create early, meaningful responsibilities for every employee. Typical assignments
require collaboration inside and outside the organization, fostering strong project management
skills and keeping our team connected to current healthcare trends and operations.

##### Our Signature Leadership Development Programs

###### Toolbox Topics

**Audience:** All Athletico employees seeking to grow their professional and leadership skills.

**Leadership Pathway:** Foundational Skills for Leading Self and Others

###### Emerging Leaders Program

**Audience:** Individual contributors aspiring to be people leaders.

**Leadership Pathway:** Leading Self

###### LEAD – Learn. Engage. Achieve. Develop.

**Audience:** Clinic Managers
Gain tactical leadership skills to succeed in your operational role.

**Leadership Pathway:** Leading Teams

###### Advanced Leadership Development Program

**Audience:** Senior leaders aspiring to move into an executive level role.

**Leadership Pathway:** Leading Leaders and Leading Athletico

In alignment with our mission and values, our STRONG leadership competencies provide a common
language for defining leadership at every level and are embedded in all of our leadership
development programs and initiatives. Each program focuses on the behaviors and actions outlined in
this framework, and employees enrolled can expect to learn through on-the-job application
activities, group coaching, eLearning, and self-assessments. This reflects our commitment to setting
employees up for success early in their careers and preparing new and seasoned leaders to
confidently step into any leadership role.

# Outpatient Physical Therapy

We’re part of the largest physical therapy network in the U.S. With almost 2,000 outpatient physical
therapy centers and 7,000-plus licensed therapists, we’re a leader in physical therapy excellence.

We’re also your partner in wellness. We offer occupational and hand therapy, sports medicine,
workplace injury treatment and prevention, and specialized rehabilitation services.

Our focus every day is on exceptional patient care. Your health and wellness goals are our goals. We
help you maintain your health or recover your health to get back to the activities and life that you
love.

[Action shot of Tom outside cross-country skiing in a black outfit]
Clinician Spotlight: Tom Videtich Bye
He may not immediately tell patients about his previous life as an elite athlete, but when it fits
into conversation and instruction, Physical Therapist Tom Videtich Bye opens up. He was a Division I
cross-country skier who competed on the national and international stages as a junior and was once
in the pool for the U.S. national team. Ultimately, Tom switched gears; his focus now is helping
patients attain their goals.
[Read his story here][70]

Augmentative and alternative communication - helping kids connect through pediatric speech therapy
When it comes to kids with communication difficulties, high-tech and screen time often tip the scale
toward good rather than bad for many reasons. Learn how high-tech communication tools enhance work
done with pediatric speech therapists to help kids understand and communicate with the world around
them.

# Outpatient Physical Therapy

We’re part of the largest physical therapy network in the U.S. With almost 2,000 outpatient physical
therapy centers and 7,000-plus licensed therapists, we’re a leader in physical therapy excellence.

We’re also your partner in wellness. We offer occupational and hand therapy, sports medicine,
workplace injury treatment and prevention, and specialized rehabilitation services.

Our focus every day is on exceptional patient care. Your health and wellness goals are our goals. We
help you maintain your health or recover your health to get back to the activities and life that you
love.

[Action shot of Tom outside cross-country skiing in a black outfit]
Clinician Spotlight: Tom Videtich Bye
He may not immediately tell patients about his previous life as an elite athlete, but when it fits
into conversation and instruction, Physical Therapist Tom Videtich Bye opens up. He was a Division I
cross-country skier who competed on the national and international stages as a junior and was once
in the pool for the U.S. national team. Ultimately, Tom switched gears; his focus now is helping
patients attain their goals.
[Read his story here][70]
[A child with glasses sits on her mother's lap while the daughter is using her tablet]
Augmentative and alternative communication - helping kids connect through pediatric speech therapy
When it comes to kids with communication difficulties, high-tech and screen time often tip the scale
toward good rather than bad for many reasons. Learn how high-tech communication tools enhance work
done with pediatric speech therapists to help kids understand and communicate with the world around
them.
[Click here to learn more][71]

“I had lower back pain and could barely walk. I was only able to stand for about one minute. After 11 sessions, I can stand, walk, and am getting back to running. Ariana, Arav, and Priya were phenomenal, and Elizabeth was wonderful. This place truly helped me get my life back.”

Twin Boro Physical Therapy – Martinsville, NJ

“I went to PT Solutions in Souderton for rehab after back surgery. I cannot express how great the experience was. Every time I went for PT I was greeted with a smile and genuine inquiry on how I was feeling from Faith and Danielle. Danielle would make sure I was always challenged even if she had to make a simple exercise more difficult so I would get the most out of it. If I ever need PT again there is no doubt that I will be going back here. Thank you for my speedy recovery and support.”

PT Solutions of Souderton – Souderton, PA

“I recently started PT and I didn’t have high hopes for any relief. I was injured during my service overseas and the VA sent me here for help. Kale is my Physical Therapist and he is truly one of a kind. He explains the process slowly and understandably and listens to my questions and needs. The facility is very nice and clean. After starting therapy here, I finally feel hopeful about my recovery.”

PT Solutions of Somerset – Somerset, KY

“I hate going to PT however going to PT Solutions makes it so much better. Everyone is so nice there and makes your PT go by so much easier. Don’t get me wrong they work you but they make you feel like they have known you for years. James is excellent!! This is my second time having him. He is so nice and so knowledgeable. Answers all my questions and makes sure I understand what he is telling me. I have MS so my brain sometimes just doesn’t wanna cooperate and he explains it so I get it. I definitely recommend PT Solutions to anyone looking for PT.”

PT Solutions of Fort Oglethorpe – Fort Oglethorpe, GA

“I have gone to PT Solutions on two different occasions. This most recent was the longest for a lower back and hip issue. Omar was incredible! His knowledge in answering my questions were thorough and professional. He is very kind and after 14 visits at 3x a week, both my back and hip has improved greatly! I will now go once a week for 6 weeks to ensure I follow Omar’s plan at home and continue to improve. The environment is very positive between the PT therapists too. I highly recommend PT Solutions!”

PT Solutions of Lenexa – Prairie Star, KS

“I love all of the people at PT Solutions. I work with Emily, who keeps me in check and reminds me that recovery takes time. She knows when to slow me down and when to push me. All of the therapists are great, and you can see how they truly care about each patient and support one another.”

# Our Story

From our humble beginnings with just a few employees to our nationwide expansion, we remain grateful
for the countless opportunities to impact people’s lives every day.

## Our Story Overview

Founded in 2003 by our CEO Dale Yake, PT Solutions Physical Therapy is a privately held physical
therapy practice based in Atlanta, Georgia, with more than 550 points of service across 25 states.
PT Solutions provides physical and occupational therapy, speech-language pathology, athletic
training, and sports medicine services in outpatient, inpatient rehabilitation, and acute care
settings.

Earning a spot on Inc. 5000’s list of fastest-growing private companies for nine consecutive years,
PT Solutions continues to expand its national footprint through its unique model of hospital
partnerships, private acquisitions, and de novo clinics. Through its APTA-accredited residency
program, PT Solutions educates, trains, and trusts its professionals to provide research-supported
care in hospitality-driven and service-oriented environments.

## PT Solutions Timeline

We care about our patients, our people, and our communities. Our goal is to provide transformative
care to our communities through evidence, experience, and exceptional customer service because
everyone deserves the chance to be unstoppable.
* #### 2003

Founded by Dale Yake in Eufaula, AL
* #### 2004

Established first hospital relationship and expanded into Georgia and Florida
* #### 2005

Launched first of its kind APTA accredited residency program to establish rigor in teaching and
quality
* #### 2016

Geographic expansion into IL, KS, KY, LA, MO, NC, SC, TN, VA
* #### 2017

Hit 100-clinic milestone and expanded partnership model, working with 25+ hospital partners
* #### 2022

4,000+ employees
* #### 2023

Hit 500-clinic and 70-hospital milestones and entered 25th state; 200+ Residency program graduates
* #### 2024+

National recruiting platform, affiliated with 30 universities and recruiting from 150+

# Team Up Speak Up with Concussion Legacy Foundation

The word concussion often conjures up the image of a large blow to the head with loss of
consciousness, amnesia or other major on-field event. However, a concussion is often much more
subtle. The severity of a hit or collision is not a reliable predictor of concussion or concussion
severity^{1,2}. In fact, in a study done with nearly 450 collegiate football and hockey athletes,
half of the 48 concussions identified had no specific large impact event associated with the
injury³.

So how do we detect [concussion][61] if it is often times difficulty to acutely identify from the
sidelines? Many current models rely on an athlete to self-report symptoms to a coach, trainer or
parent. However, one must ask if we can safely rely on an individual who has suffered a mild
[traumatic brain injury][62] to accurately report his or her symptoms? A person suffering from
common acute symptoms including dizziness, confusion, mental fogginess or other cognitive complaints
may not be the most reliable source of information during this critical time.

[Team Up Speak Up][63] Day, an initiative from the [Concussion Legacy Foundation][64], encourages
teammates to look out for one another and speak up if they see signs and symptoms of a concussion.
During a given season, one in five high school athletes in [Georgia][65] will sustain a concussion
and, of those, one-third will report suffering from two or more concussions in a given year⁴. We
encourage you to [take the pledge][66] and talk to your team about the importance of protecting each
other from this often silent injury.

**Sources**:
1. McCrory P, Meeuisse W, Dvorak J, et al. Consensus statement on concussion in sport- the 5^{th}
international conference on concussion in sport held in Berlin, October 2016. Br J Sports Med.
2017;51: 838-847.
2. Iverson GL, Gerdner AJ, Terry DP, et al. Predictors of clinical recovery from a concussion: a
systematic review. Br J Sports Med 2017;51:941-948.
3. Duhaime AC, Beckwith JG, Maerlender AC et al. Spectrum of acute clinical characteristics of
diagnosed concussions in college athletes wearing instrumented helmets. J Neurosurg. 2012 Dec;
117(6): 1092-1099.
4. Marar M, Mcilvain NM, Fields SK et al. Epidemiology of concussions among United States high
school athletes in 20 sports. Am J Sports Med. 2012;40(4):747-755.

**Author:** Lindsay Walston, PT, DPT, NCS

Why Choose Us

## How Our Values Prioritize You

These are our Core Values and what they mean for you:

**People first.** Our patient needs are our #1 priority.

**Results that are meaningful.** We partner with you to set, measure, and achieve the goals that are
most important to you.

**Openness and Transparency.** We believe an educated consumer is our best patient and we encourage
open communication between patient and therapist. Each plan of care is developed through a
combination of proven best-practices and the unique needs expressed by the patient.

**Positivity and Optimism.** We only hire positive and optimistic people. Work and therapy should be
enjoyable and supportive.

**Treat people like family. **Our team supports and encourages each other. We have long-term patient
relationships going back decades, with care of grandparents, parents, and children. We genuinely
care about our patients, their families, each other, and our community.

[Learn More][67]

We Offer

## Treatments For Active Individuals Of All Ages

Our physical therapists design treatment plans specific to each person’s needs, challenges, and
goals, regardless of age. While we offer many treatment options, post-operative therapy is a strong
focus. After surgery, your tissues, muscles and bones go through a period of healing. Often,
limiting mobility during recovery can reduce range of motion, flexibility and functionality.
Post-operative physical therapy encourages your body to heal through specific exercises ideal for
each phase of your recovery.

[Learn More][68]

Chadwick Jones

I have nothing but great things to say about Christine and her staff at SEPT-Biltmore! They are kind

seen. They work very closely to achieving your goals without being over-bearing and keep you
informed each step of the way of that progress. Anyone actively looking for PT should definitely
give SEPT-Biltomore a try!

Ingrid Ringler

all_classified.polished_summary: Southeast Physical Therapy is a locally-owned outpatient practice established in 1999, specializing in orthopedic and sports rehabilitation. With a team of over 20 experienced physical therapists, the clinic offers a comprehensive range of services, including treatment for various pain conditions, pre/post-surgical rehabilitation, and specialized therapies, all while accepting major insurances, including Medicare and Medicaid. Committed to serving the communities of Buncombe, Haywood, and Henderson Counties, Southeast Physical Therapy prioritizes personalized care and convenience with multiple locations for its patients.

all_classified.company_summary: Therapy Brands is a leading provider of electronic health record (EHR) solutions, specializing in the mental health and rehabilitation therapy sectors. Their core products, including TheraNest and Fusion, offer comprehensive practice management tools tailored for mental health solo and group practices, as well as physical, occupational, and speech therapy providers. In addition to their EHR offerings, Therapy Brands provides essential services such as revenue cycle management, telehealth solutions, and customer education to enhance the operational efficiency of healthcare practices.

# Practice Success

Ensora Health builds EHR and practice management software for mental, behavioral, and rehabilitative
therapy – designed to help your practice and clients thrive.
[Request a demo][135]

## TheraNest

### Mental Health

TheraNest is a mental health EHR and practice management solution built to help you save time,
reduce admin, and run a successful practice.
[Start a free trial][136]

## Fusion

### Rehab Therapy

Fusion’s EHR simplifies documentation, scheduling, and billing – so physical, occupational, and
speech therapy teams can work through the day with ease.
[Request a demo][137]

## Lightening the load for every part of your practice

Whether you’re a solo therapist, part of a large group, or a member of the admin support staff,
we’re here to help you deliver exceptional care.

Mental health solo practices
When you’re a solo therapist, you carry the full weight of your practice. You need fewer systems to
manage, fewer fires to chase, and more space for meaningful moments. TheraNest helps you stay
organized and sustainable without extra effort.
[[Resources] Learn More][138]
Mental health group practices
Group practices juggle shifting schedules, tight cash flow, and costly no-shows. Supporting
clinicians and clients is key, but admin tasks feel overwhelming. You deserve a simpler path
forward.
[[Resources] Learn More][139]
Rehab therapy
Documentation, authorizations, and shifting schedules can push admin work late into the night. Built
by therapists who understand, Fusion streamlines your workflow in one EHR — so your PT/ OT/ SLP team
can avoid burnout and focus on clients.
[[Resources] Learn More][140]

## Practice success with Ensora Health

We build and fine-tune our solutions with input from clinicians, their clients, and practice owners
and administrators. That’s why they are designed to solve real problems, not just check boxes.

### TheraNest

Automate and simplify admin work with an all-in-one mental health EHR and PMS.

[Explore TheraNest][141]

### Fusion

Improve workflows and patient outcomes with the trusted EHR for physical, occupational, and speech
therapy.

[Explore Fusion][142]
