## Latest Bango News

[Auditoria de assinaturas: como descobrir e cortar serviços que drenam a sua conta][66]

Jul 1, 2026

Última atualização em 1 de julho de 2026 às 14h15. Os brasileiros gastam, em média, R$ 1.416 por ano
com assinaturas digitais — cerca de R$ 118 por mês — distribuídos entre streaming de vídeo, música,
delivery e varejo, segundo a pesquisa "A Guerra das Assinaturas", da Bango. O problema é que quase
um terço desse dinheiro (32%) vai para serviços que o assinante sequer usa. São cobranças de R$ 9,90
ou R$ 19,90 que passam despercebidas na fatura do cartão, mas que, somadas ao longo de doze meses,
comprometem bem o orçamento. O fenômeno não é exclusivo do Brasil. Nos Estados Unidos, por exemplo,
a pesquisa anual da CNET com a YouGov aponta que o americano médio desperdiça cerca de US$ 205 por
ano em assinaturas não utilizadas. É por isso que uma auditoria periódica de assinaturas pode ser o
melhor caminho para identificar essas cobranças e decidir o que manter e o que cancelar. Quais apps
ajudam a auditar assinaturas? Existem aplicativos dedicados a catalogar contratos recorrentes,
emitir alertas antes das renovações e calcular o impacto anual dos gastos. Subby (Android e iOS)
Funciona como um rastreador de assinaturas com entrada manual. O usuário registra cada serviço com
valor, ciclo de cobrança e data de renovação e o app gera gráficos do gasto acumulado e envia
lembretes antes de cada renovação. Não exige acesso à conta bancária, o que o torna uma opção para
quem prefere manter dados financeiros fora de apps de terceiros. A versão gratuita inclui anúncios;
a remoção custa US$ 2,99 em compra única. Bobby (iOS) O usuário adiciona seus contratos — streaming,
academia, aluguel, apps — e a tela inicial exibe a soma exata do que está comprometido no mês. Não
se conecta ao banco e opera com uma lógica de lista simples, sem gráficos avançados ou categorias
complexas. Rocket Money (iOS, Android e web) Se conecta à conta bancária, detecta cobranças
recorrentes de forma automatizada e, na versão Premium (US$ 6 a US$ 12/mês), oferece um serviço de
concierge que entra em contato com os fornecedores para cancelar assinaturas em nome do usuário. É a
opção mais completa, mas exige compartilhamento de dados bancários e opera com foco no mercado
americano — integrações com bancos brasileiros podem ser limitadas. Apps de controle financeiro
servem para auditar assinaturas? Quem já usa um gerenciador financeiro pode integrá-lo ao processo
sem instalar um app novo. A vantagem dos gerenciadores financeiros é que o rastreamento de
assinaturas fica dentro do mesmo painel de controle do orçamento doméstico. No entanto, nenhum deles
oferece cancelamento automatizado ou alertas específicos de renovação como os apps dedicados.No
Brasil, duas opções se destacam: o Mobills e o Organizze. O Mobills tem uma categoria nativa para
despesas recorrentes e assinaturas. O app permite registrar cada serviço de forma manual ou conectar
cartões de crédito para importação automática. Relatórios mensais mostram o peso das assinaturas no
orçamento geral. Já o Organizze permite marcar gastos fixos como assinaturas e gera relatórios
visuais de saídas mensais. A interface ajuda a identificar, mês a mês, quanto dos gastos totais está
comprometido com cobranças recorrentes. Como fazer uma auditoria manual de assinaturas? Apps de
rastreamento não encontram assinaturas feitas fora das lojas oficiais — portais de notícias, clubes
de assinatura físicos, plataformas contratadas pelo site. O pente-fino manual cobre essas lacunas, e
fazer uma auditoria manual bem feita não é tão difícil quanto parece: 1. Verifique as lojas de
aplicativos No iPhone, abra Ajustes, toque no seu nome (ID Apple) e selecione Assinaturas. No
Android, abra a Google Play Store, toque na foto do perfil, acesse Pagamentos e Assinaturas e depois
Assinaturas. Essas telas listam todos os serviços contratados via loja de apps — inclusive períodos
de teste que viraram cobrança automática. 2. Revise os extratos dos últimos 90 dias Baixe as faturas
de cartão de crédito e os extratos bancários dos três meses anteriores. Procure por valores
idênticos repetidos ou pelo filtro "recorrente", quando o banco oferecer essa opção. Cobranças
pequenas com nomes abreviados (como "GOOGYOUTUBEPR" ou "APLITUNES") costumam passar despercebidas.
3. Faça uma varredura na caixa de e-mail Na barra de busca do e-mail, pesquise por termos como
"assinatura", "renovação", "recibo", "fatura", "billing" ou "obrigado por assinar". Essa busca
resgata cadastros feitos em sites que não passam pelas lojas de apps. 4. Confira logins salvos no
navegador e no gerenciador de senhas Abra o cofre de senhas do celular ou do navegador. Se há uma
conta salva em um serviço de conteúdo, e-commerce ou app de produtividade, há chance de existir um
cartão vinculado a ela com cobrança ativa. 5. Monte uma planilha de controle Liste cada assinatura
encontrada com quatro colunas: nome do serviço, valor mensal, forma de pagamento e data de
renovação. A soma final mostra o custo anual real. A partir dela, o usuário decide o que cortar e o
que vale renegociar para um plano mais barato. Com que frequência fazer a auditoria de assinaturas?
A pesquisa da Bango mostra que a média de assinaturas por pessoa no Brasil é de 3,8 — número que
tende a crescer com a entrada de novos serviços de IA, fitness e produtividade no mercado. A
recomendação de especialistas em finanças pessoais, geralmente, é repetir o processo a cada 90 dias,
ou ao menos duas vezes por ano, para capturar períodos de teste esquecidos e reajustes de preço que
passam sem aviso. Programar lembretes no calendário para os dias anteriores à renovação de cada
serviço reduz a chance de uma cobrança indesejada se repetir por mais um ciclo. Quem usa um app de
rastreamento pode automatizar esses alertas; quem prefere o método manual precisa manter a planilha
atualizada a cada nova contratação.

and rehabilitation. Our experienced physiotherapists deliver evidence-based treatment plans in a

## Our Services

We provide expert physiotherapy care across a range of conditions and needs. Our services are
designed to help you recover, move confidently, and regain control of your physical health.

## Stroke and Neurological Physiotherapy

We support individuals recovering from strokes, Parkinson’s, multiple sclerosis, and other
neurological conditions by improving movement, coordination, and independence.

## Musculoskeletal Physiotherapy

Our treatments aim to restore comfort and alignment by addressing joint pain, spinal issues,
arthritis, and posture through guided movement and hands-on care.

## Sports Injuries Physiotherapy

We help athletes and active individuals recover from sprains, strains, and other sports-related
injuries with tailored treatment plans focused on safe and effective healing.

## Paediatric Physiotherapy

Our physiotherapists provide gentle, age-appropriate care to children facing developmental delays,
injuries, or neurological challenges to support their growth and mobility.

## Elderly Physiocare and Rehabilitation

We promote strength, balance, and confidence in older adults through personalised programs that
enhance mobility and reduce fall risks.

## Home Visit / Mobile Physiotherapy

Our mobile service brings expert physiotherapy to your home, offering convenience and privacy for
individuals with limited mobility or busy schedules.

## Ultrasound-Guided Injections

We provide precise, ultrasound-guided joint and soft tissue injections to reduce pain and
inflammation, ensuring targeted treatment and faster relief.

# Trusted Physiotherapy Clinic in London

We provide expert physiotherapy services in London, with a focus on pain relief, injury recovery,
and rehabilitation. Our experienced physiotherapists deliver evidence-based treatment plans in a
supportive and professional environment.

## Our Services

We provide expert physiotherapy care across a range of conditions and needs. Our services are
designed to help you recover, move confidently, and regain control of your physical health.

## Stroke and Neurological Physiotherapy

We support individuals recovering from strokes, Parkinson’s, multiple sclerosis, and other
neurological conditions by improving movement, coordination, and independence.

## Musculoskeletal Physiotherapy

Our treatments aim to restore comfort and alignment by addressing joint pain, spinal issues,
arthritis, and posture through guided movement and hands-on care.

## Sports Injuries Physiotherapy

We help athletes and active individuals recover from sprains, strains, and other sports-related
injuries with tailored treatment plans focused on safe and effective healing.

## Paediatric Physiotherapy

Our physiotherapists provide gentle, age-appropriate care to children facing developmental delays,
injuries, or neurological challenges to support their growth and mobility.

## Elderly Physiocare and Rehabilitation

We promote strength, balance, and confidence in older adults through personalised programs that
enhance mobility and reduce fall risks.

## Home Visit / Mobile Physiotherapy

Our mobile service brings expert physiotherapy to your home, offering convenience and privacy for
individuals with limited mobility or busy schedules.

## Ultrasound-Guided Injections

We provide precise, ultrasound-guided joint and soft tissue injections to reduce pain and
inflammation, ensuring targeted treatment and faster relief.

## Bringing Expert Care to Your Home

Our physiotherapists specialise in rehabilitation and provide home-based physiotherapy services for
patients with neurological conditions such as stroke, spinal cord injuries, and multiple sclerosis.
We also support individuals recovering from surgery or prolonged hospital stays who require
assistance in restoring mobility and functional independence. Services are available across the
Croydon, Greenwich, Wandsworth, and Hammersmith and Fulham boroughs.

## Referanslarımız

Görsel, videolu ve diğer referanslarımızı sayfada inceleyebilirsiniz.

17 ay önce kızımıza bakıcı bulmak için size başvurdum. Çok kısa bir süre içerisinde,
beklentilerimizi en iyi şekilde karşılayan, kızımızı kendi çocuğu gibi benimseyen Emine Yılmaz hanım
ile sayenizde tanıştık. Güler yüzlü ve güven verici yaklaşımınız için teşekkür ederim.

[Reviewer]

### Aşina Bayram

#### Laboratuar Sorumlusu

Tarafınız aracılığı ile çalışmaya başladığımız ve şu anda beş aylık kızımın bakıcılığını yapmakta
olan bakıcımızın bize vermiş olduğu hizmetten çok memnun kaldığımızı tarafınıza belirtmek isteriz.
Bebeğimizin gelişimindeki katkısını göz ardı etmemek mümkün değil. Bize kızımızı gözümüz arkada
kalmadan güvenle emanet edecek bir bakıcı sağladığınız için teşekkür ederiz.

[Reviewer]

### Banu Fora

#### Avukat

Mart 2014 tarihinden itibaren Damla İnsan Kaynakları firmasının bulmuş olduğu bebek bakıcısı Fatma
Aslankarayiğit ile çalışmış bulunmaktayız. Gerek personel seçimindeki göstermiş olduğu hassasiyet
gerek hızlı aday bulunması konusunda Damla İnsan Kaynaklarına Engin Ailesi olarak teşekkür ederiz.

#### İdari İşler ve Yöneticisi Asistanı

Damla Danışmanlık ekibine, göstermiş oldukları ilgi ve titizlikten dolayı çok teşekkür ederim.
Başarılarınızın devamını diliyorum. İyi çalışmalar.

[Reviewer]

### Defne Samman Işık

#### Yönetmen

Çok bunaldığım o gün bana sadece konuşmak için ayırdığınız saatler için minnettarım. Sizin de bir
anne olmanız, empati yeteneğiniz, sizin ve şirketinizin profesyonel duruşu ile sektörünüzdeki diğer
ajanslardan benim için çok farklı bir yerdesiniz. İlk defa bir ajansın “anne”nin de manevi
çıkarlarını gözettiğini hissediyorum. Yardımlarınız için çok teşekkür eder, tüm yeni annelere sizi
ve ajansınızı tavsiye ettiğimi ve edeceğimi belirtirim.

tüm Damla Danışmanlık hizmetlerine çalışanlarına teşekkürlerimi borç biliyorum.

smoother recovery and minimizing long-term complications or disabilities.

strengthening muscles, improving balance, and teaching proper movement techniques.

and joints to reduce strain, discomfort, and the risk of chronic pain issues.

Our Story

Dribbble began in 2009 as a small, invite-only space for designers to share work and feedback. It
quickly became known as the design world’s “cool kids’ table,” where creativity, community, and
craft came together.

**In 2021, we opened our doors to all designers.** Dropping the invite-only model brought in fresh
talent while keeping the trusted vibe that made Dribbble special.

**Then in 2024, we launched the Dribbble Marketplace.** It was a game-changer. Designers could now
sell work, land clients, and grow their income, all in one place.

Now, we’re focused on helping designers do work they’re proud of and get paid for it. We’ve shifted
from ad-based to revenue-sharing, putting our mission at the core: helping creatives thrive
creatively and financially. Supporting creativity isn’t just our motto. It’s the future we’re
building together.

company better. Integrity, courage, and high standards aren’t optional; they’re what we owe to each
other. We’re always learning, innovating, and growing together.

#Help Customers Succeed

Our success starts with our customers. We’re here to solve real problems and create value with
meaningful solutions. Challenges don’t stop us; we find creative solutions, overcome obstacles, and
deliver exceptional results. When our customers win, we win.

#Take Action, Deliver Results

We focus on solving the most important problems and measuring our impact. Every step forward helps
us improve, innovate, and push for bigger wins. We stay relentless in our pursuits and humble in our
successes.

#Bring Good Vibes

Relationships fuel our success. We create an environment of trust and authenticity, where everyone
can bring their full selves to work. Respecting different ideas, opinions, and perspectives makes us
stronger and keeps our culture inclusive, creative, and fun.

## FAQs

### What is FlexifyMe?
* FlexifyMe is a digital healthcare platform focused on managing pain and movement-related
  conditions through a combination of online physiotherapy, guided therapy sessions, and
  technology-assisted assessment. The platform supports individuals dealing with recurring pain by
  offering structured care plans supervised by qualified physiotherapists and healthcare
  professionals.
* FlexifyMe works with a multidisciplinary team that includes physiotherapists, yoga therapists, and
  orthopedic specialists, helping users receive expert guidance remotely and consistently.

### What is online physiotherapy?
* Online physiotherapy, also known as tele-physiotherapy, allows you to consult with a licensed
  physiotherapist through secure video sessions. During these sessions, the therapist assesses your
  movement, posture, and symptoms, then guides you through personalised exercises and recovery

Our Unique Approach to Physiotherapy in Singapore

Our approach to physiotherapy focuses on addressing imbalances and restoring movement through personalised care tailored to individual needs.

▸
1. Integrative Hands-On Techniques

We combine manual therapy with modern physiotherapy techniques to address muscle imbalances and restore balance in the body. These hands-on methods help alleviate pain and improve mobility.
▸
2. Cultural Sensitivity in Care

We tailor treatments to the unique physical challenges influenced by Singapore’s lifestyle, such as long hours of desk work or the demands of caregiving. For office workers, prolonged sitting and poor ergonomics often contribute to back discomfort. In such cases, we may recommend physio treatment for lower back pain that addresses both posture-related strain and long-term mobility. This ensures therapy remains relevant, practical, and aligned with each individual’s daily routines.
▸
3. Personalised Treatment Plans

Every physiotherapy plan is customised based on individual needs, taking into account the patient’s specific lifestyle, goals, and health history to support recovery and long-term well-being. Our musculoskeletal physio services cover all major pain points of the body, from the neck and shoulders to the back, hips, and knees, allowing treatment to be tailored to each condition.

Why More Singaporeans Are Turning to Physiotherapy to Relieve Pain

In Singapore, physiotherapy addresses a wide range of issues, from postural pain to recovery, helping individuals stay active and manage discomfort.

▸
1. Increasing Sedentary Lifestyles

With long hours spent at desks and on screens, many Singaporeans are experiencing desk-related pain, making physiotherapy an essential solution for managing posture and alleviating tension. Over time, prolonged sitting without proper ergonomics can contribute to stiffness in the neck , shoulders , and lower back , as well as reduced flexibility. Physiotherapy not only helps to ease this discomfort but also equips individuals with corrective exercises and movement strategies that prevent recurring pain. By addressing these issues early, patients can improve their posture, maintain mobility, and reduce the risk of chronic musculoskeletal conditions developing later in life.
▸
2. Aging Population Seeking Active Lifestyles

As the senior population grows, many older individuals turn to physiotherapy to maintain mobility, reduce pain, and support recovery, allowing them to stay active and independent in their later years. For those who find it inconvenient to travel, opting for physio at home provides the flexibility of receiving care in a familiar environment, making sessions more accessible and comfortable.
▸
3. Proactive Health Management Across All Ages

Physiotherapy is becoming a proactive approach to health, not just for injury recovery, but for preventing chronic pain and maintaining flexibility for people of all ages. Younger adults are increasingly seeking physiotherapy to counteract the effects of long working hours and stress, while older adults benefit from tailored programmes that preserve mobility and independence. Even athletes and active individuals turn to physiotherapy for preventive care, ensuring their bodies remain strong and resilient against strain. This shift reflects a growing awareness in Singapore that investing in physiotherapy early can help avoid long-term health complications, reduce the likelihood of surgery, and support overall quality of life.

# About Us

Rehab and Beyond was founded in early 2018 by Jaden with the objective of providing high quality and
affordable rehabilitation and allied health services beyond the four walls of the hospital and into
the community.

Read More About Our Story

Jaden saw how the high quality allied health services in the hospital benefited those who were
admitted for inpatient care. A person with a new stroke may receive physiotherapy, occupational
therapy, speech therapy and other services such as stroke education and dietary counseling to manage
his recovery and minimise the risk of getting another stroke in the future. However, these cares
were not easily accessible for patients who have been discharged and are transitioning back into
their homes and community.

Seeing these significant needs unaddressed, Jaden decided to make all these services available, with
intention that patients will now have access to a skilled and coordinated care to assist their
rehabilitation and prevention measure. While the health ministry and its agencies are already
working hard to address these issues, Rehab and Beyond was born to fill up this gap.

## Our Team

[Image]

### Jaden

Jaden holds a Master’s degree from Australia and has a decade of experience in public and private
hospitals. He is well-versed in sports injury management, post-surgery physiotherapy, and
rehabilitation for people with medical conditions such as stroke and Parkinson's disease. Jaden is
passionate about providing physiotherapy treatment that is backed by science and research. He was
even invited to present some of his own award-winning research papers in local and international
conferences.

Recently, he partnered prominent orthopaedic specialists to give talks to Netball club players (on
knee & ankle injuries) and GP doctors (on common shoulder injuries). He has also conducted workshops
for other physios on the post-surgery management of hip & knee conditions. Jaden believes that
"people do not care how much you know until they know how much you care". He strives to understand
his clients’ needs, goals and priorities before selecting the most appropriate treatment approach.
For his dedication and professionalism, he has earned many positive reviews as well as three Service
Excellence Awards in as many years.

Full registration (Physiotherapy) with Allied Health Professions Council (AHPC), Ministry of Health,
Singapore
AHPC certified Clinical Supervisor (Physiotherapy)
Master of Clinical Rehabilitation (Australia)
American College of Sports Medicine (ACSM) Certified Clinical Exercise Physiologist (CEP)
ACSM / American Cancer Society Certified Cancer Exercise Trainer (CET)
[Image]

### Debra

Debra Ow Pei Li is a physiotherapist with a strong passion in the management of musculoskeletal /
orthopaedic rehabilitation and geriatric care. She worked in Tan Tock Seng Hospital (TTSH) for 7
years as a senior physiotherapist, and has extensive experience in the acute, outpatient as well as
community setting. She has rich experience working with patients in the home, seeing an array of
musculoskeletal, neurological and orthopaedic conditions. She has a keen interest in promoting
healthy living,and is an advocate of the phrase – Live Well, Age Well.

In the community scene, she worked closely with community partners to co-curate exercise programmes
and conducted public talks on frailty as well as healthy ageing.

Debra is also a certified AHPC supervisor and clinical educator, who has supervised students from
Singapore Institute of Technology (SIT) during their clinical placements.

# Why Us

# Well equiped clinics

All our clinic locations are well-equipped with gyms and a wide range of equipment specific for
therapy.

# Strategic Locations

We have 3 locations for clinics for you to choose from, including one right in the CBD if you are
working there!

# We Speak Your Language

We have a team of qualified local therapists who can manage most conditions and speak your language
and/or dialect.

# Affordable Home Therapy

We provide dedicated home therapy with specialised and portable equipment at a reasonable rate.

# Tailored to your environment

Home therapy sessions are designed with your home environment in mind. You won't have a situation
where you cannot do the treatment because you don’t have the machines needed.

# Diverse range of qualifications

Our therapists have a diverse range of qualifications and certifications from Australia, Ireland,
New Zealand, UK and USA.

# Convenient time and place

Too busy? Most clinics closed by the time you end work? Our therapist can see you at your own home
after your work, there is no need to make a separate trip out to have therapy.

> While we provide wide-ranging rehabilitation services in our acute hospitals, we need to do more
> to shift the gravity of care into the community so that patients can be cared for in an
> environment that they are familiar with
> - Lam Pin Min, Senior Minister of State for Health (2017)

## Go beyond rehab

BEYOND THE DIAGNOSIS
Client Centered Philosophy of Care
Learn More

We see you as who you are - the athlete, the parent, the achiever, the overcomer, and not just
another patient with an injury or a diagnosis. We tailor made your treatment care based on YOU

We do this through a systematic approach of:
1. Treating you as a unique individual and seeking to understand your needs, priorities, and goals
2. Assessing your condition thoroughly and identifying the root cause of the problem and other
contributing factors
3. Helping you understand your condition and available treatment options to enable you to make
informed decisions on the therapy plan
4. Encouraging you (and your caregiver) to participate in the process of setting your rehab goals
5. Enabling you to take control of your own health by participating actively in rehab and taking
practical steps to achieve your health goals
6. Tailoring a custom-made treatment plan for you, and conducting regular reviews to help you
progress to the next stage of rehab
7. Initiating prompt referral(s) to other medical & health professionals for additional attention
when appropriate

BEYOND THE CURRENT PHYSICAL INJURY
Strong Network of Medical, Health and Fitness Collaborators
Learn More

We collaborate and work closely with a community of sports physiologist and fitness trainers to
reduce future risks of health problems and enhance your fitness performance. Here are some of the
professionals that we work together with:
* Medical Specialists
* MLD Therapist
* Podiatrist
* Exercise Physiologist
* Dieticians and Nutritionists
* Allied Health & Wellness Professionals
* Fitness Trainers
* Orthotist

BEYOND THE FACILITIES
Multiple Locations
Learn More

“The best gym is the one that you actually go to”

We are always looking to improve your experience and bring convenience and accessibility to you.
Check out our clinics in Tanjong Pagar and Novena.

Live or work in the East or West? Call us to enquire about the clinic that is closest to you.

Not comfortable with gyms? Difficulty leaving the house? We can bring the clinic to you.

[**Find our location nearest to yours**][29]

BEYOND 6PM
Extended Clinic Hours
Learn More

Frustrated that most clinics are closed by the time you get off work? We open extra longer just for
you!
* Core Collective open until 8pm
* Open during selected public holidays
* All clinics open during lunch
* Options for Home Therapy

BEYOND THE CLINIC
Dedicated Home Therapy Service
Learn More

Your body is your greatest equipment and the best program is the one the you actually do regularly.
Learn how to lead an active self management program utilizing your home environment and facilities.
Fancy doing some agility training in the local park? In Rehab & Beyond, home therapy doesn’t mean
exercising in the bed

Why Home Therapy?
* Save time & travelling
* No need to take time off work
* We bring the equipment to you
* Practical for long term self management (utilizing home environment and facilities such as gym &
swimming pool)

BEYOND STANDARD CARE
Experienced Therapist & Best Practices
Learn More

Our therapist underwent further training in reputable institutions from Singapore, Australia, New
Zealand, USA, UK and Ireland.

Why our therapist is awesome and why you would love them:
* They are certified in the following disciplines: Clinical Pilates, Rock Taping, PNF, Kinetic Link
Training
* They are also able to connect with clients who speak: Cantonese, Hokkien, Teochew, Bahasa
Indonesia?
* Sensitive to local culture
* Sessions can last up to an hour and are individualised for your unique needs
* Speakers at local and international health and medical conferences
* Therapist are regularly invited to share in public forums and peer conferences

# About Us

Rehab and Beyond was founded in early 2018 by Jaden with the objective of providing high quality and
affordable rehabilitation and allied health services beyond the four walls of the hospital and into
the community.

Read More About Our Story

Jaden saw how the high quality allied health services in the hospital benefited those who were
admitted for inpatient care. A person with a new stroke may receive physiotherapy, occupational
therapy, speech therapy and other services such as stroke education and dietary counseling to manage
his recovery and minimise the risk of getting another stroke in the future. However, these cares
were not easily accessible for patients who have been discharged and are transitioning back into
their homes and community.

Seeing these significant needs unaddressed, Jaden decided to make all these services available, with
intention that patients will now have access to a skilled and coordinated care to assist their
rehabilitation and prevention measure. While the health ministry and its agencies are already
working hard to address these issues, Rehab and Beyond was born to fill up this gap.

> A person with a new stroke may receive physiotherapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy and
> other services such as stroke education and dietary counseling to manage his recovery and minimise
> the risk of getting another stroke in the future.
> - Whoever said this on the our story section

## Our Team

[Image]

### Jaden

Jaden holds a Master’s degree from Australia and has a decade of experience in public and private
hospitals. He is well-versed in sports injury management, post-surgery physiotherapy, and
rehabilitation for people with medical conditions such as stroke and Parkinson's disease. Jaden is
passionate about providing physiotherapy treatment that is backed by science and research. He was
even invited to present some of his own award-winning research papers in local and international
conferences.

Recently, he partnered prominent orthopaedic specialists to give talks to Netball club players (on
knee & ankle injuries) and GP doctors (on common shoulder injuries). He has also conducted workshops
for other physios on the post-surgery management of hip & knee conditions. Jaden believes that
"people do not care how much you know until they know how much you care". He strives to understand
his clients’ needs, goals and priorities before selecting the most appropriate treatment approach.
For his dedication and professionalism, he has earned many positive reviews as well as three Service
Excellence Awards in as many years.

Full registration (Physiotherapy) with Allied Health Professions Council (AHPC), Ministry of Health,
Singapore
AHPC certified Clinical Supervisor (Physiotherapy)
Master of Clinical Rehabilitation (Australia)
American College of Sports Medicine (ACSM) Certified Clinical Exercise Physiologist (CEP)
ACSM / American Cancer Society Certified Cancer Exercise Trainer (CET)
[Image]

### Debra

Debra Ow Pei Li is a physiotherapist with a strong passion in the management of musculoskeletal /
orthopaedic rehabilitation and geriatric care. She worked in Tan Tock Seng Hospital (TTSH) for 7
years as a senior physiotherapist, and has extensive experience in the acute, outpatient as well as
community setting. She has rich experience working with patients in the home, seeing an array of
musculoskeletal, neurological and orthopaedic conditions. She has a keen interest in promoting
healthy living,and is an advocate of the phrase – Live Well, Age Well.

In the community scene, she worked closely with community partners to co-curate exercise programmes
and conducted public talks on frailty as well as healthy ageing.

Debra is also a certified AHPC supervisor and clinical educator, who has supervised students from
Singapore Institute of Technology (SIT) during their clinical placements.

AHPC Clinical Supervisor
Clinical Educator (SIT)
Otago Exercise Leader
ACE Certified Personal Trainer

company.name: Graceline Physiotherapy Services
company.description: Graceline Physiotherapy Services offers personalized, expert care through online and in-person treatments to help you achieve better mobility, reduced pain, and improved well-being.
company.tagline: Empowering Recovery, Anywhere You Are.

services.name: Online Physiotherapy Consultation
services.description: Personalized physiotherapy sessions conducted online via video conferencing.

services.name: In-Person Physiotherapy
services.description: Hands-on treatment sessions for various physical conditions.

services.name: Joint Replacement Rehabilitation
services.description: Comprehensive rehabilitation programs designed to restore strength and mobility after joint replacement surgery.
services.target_customers: Patients recovering from joint replacement surgery.

services.name: Stroke Rehabilitation
services.description: Specialized rehabilitation programs focusing on enhancing motor skills and daily function after a stroke.

services.name: Geriatric Care
services.description: Physiotherapy services tailored for older adults to manage age-related conditions and improve mobility.

services.name: Sports Medicine
services.description: Expert care for sports-related injuries, including injury prevention and rehabilitation.

all_classified.polished_summary: Graceline Physiotherapy Services specializes in delivering personalized care through both online and in-person treatments, aimed at enhancing mobility, reducing pain, and improving overall well-being. The company offers a range of services, including online physiotherapy consultations, in-person sessions, and specialized rehabilitation programs for joint replacement and stroke recovery, catering to diverse clients such as older adults, athletes, and individuals seeking remote physiotherapy solutions. With a focus on healthcare, rehabilitation, and sports medicine, Graceline is dedicated to empowering recovery for individuals wherever they are.

all_classified.company: Guys and St Thomas NHS Foundation Trust
all_classified.company_summary: Guys and St Thomas NHS Foundation Trust is a leading healthcare provider in London, offering a wide range of medical services across its hospitals, including Guy's Hospital, St Thomas' Hospital, and the Royal Brompton Hospital. The Trust is dedicated to delivering high-quality patient care, with specialties in areas such as cardiovascular health, maternity, cancer treatment, and emergency services, while also engaging in research and education to enhance healthcare outcomes. Its commitment to patient-centered care is reflected in its initiatives to involve patients and their families in the healthcare process.

all_classified.polished_summary: Guys and St Thomas NHS Foundation Trust is a leading healthcare provider in London, offering a wide range of medical services across its hospitals, including Guy's Hospital, St Thomas' Hospital, and the Royal Brompton Hospital. The Trust is dedicated to delivering high-quality patient care, with specialties in areas such as cardiovascular health, maternity, cancer treatment, and emergency services, while also engaging in research and education to enhance healthcare outcomes. Its commitment to patient-centered care is reflected in its initiatives to involve patients and their families in the healthcare process.

With over 25 years of experience, the clinic focuses on helping clients in the Los Angeles area manage chronic pain and avoid surgery through customized treatment plans. Their services include free phone consultations and hands-on therapy designed to restore joint function and improve overall well-being.

# Los Angeles Pain Relief

## Pain Relief Through Hendrickson Method® Manual Therapy

Are you in the Los Angeles area and looking for a professional, trustworthy, and experienced
orthopedic manual therapist? Look no further than Harris Manual Therapy! With **more than 25 years
of practice in therapy**, Craig Harris, LCMT, COMT has a high level of experience and knowledge of
the best manual techniques.

At Harris Manual Therapy, we use the Hendrickson Method® (HM), a highly effective method of manual
therapy that provides pain relief and physical restoration. Call our office today at (818) 454-1136
for a free phone consultation!

**Browse our website for more information about the following topics:**
* [Orthopedic manual therapy][25]
* [Avoiding surgery][26]
* [Treating chronic pain][27]

### Alleviate your pain and get back to your normal life!

We provide therapy to those who do not want drugs or surgery. Our certified manual therapists
understand that chronic pain can be absolutely crippling. This type of pain can prevent you from
properly performing everyday activities in your life. While surgery may be a treatment option, this
can bring about numerous complications, a lengthy recovery period, and possibly even additional
pain.

### Avoid Surgery, Find Pain Relief

Manual therapy through the Hendrickson Method may serve as an easier, more effective way to treat
your painful condition in comparison to ordinary massages. If you have been struggling with pain and
have not been able to find treatment that provides long-term relief, our Los Angeles pain relief
therapy may be the perfect option for you!

**At Harris Manual Therapy, we offer:**
* More than two decades of experience in the manual therapy field
* The first Hendrickson Method instructor outside the Bay Area
* Treatment that is customized to your unique needs
* Free phone consultations

Are you in pain and in need of effective, long-term relief? If so, come to Harris Manual Therapy and
let us help you get back to your normal routine as soon as possible. Please note that Flexible
Reimbursement Plans can be used, but insurance may not cover the costs of our services. To learn
more about our innovative method of manual therapy, [contact our office][28] now at (818) 454-1136!

## How Physiotherapy Works

What to Expect From Physiotherapy at HealX Physio & Rehab

When you step into our Woodbridge Rehabilitation Centre, our expert physiotherapists study your
medical history and conduct a thorough evaluation of your condition, including physical examination,
and movement analysis. This comprehensive assessment allows us to identify the root cause of your
pain or dysfunction and establishes a baseline for your treatment journey.

Based on the findings from the initial assessment, we at HealX Physio & Rehab develop a clear
diagnosis and set realistic and achievable goals for your welfare. We discuss treatment options
specific to your condition, expected timeline, and create a personalised care plan tailored to your
needs and lifestyle.

Our experts provide hands-on Physiotherapy Treatment in Woodbridge such as joint mobilisation, soft
tissue massages, and targeted stretching. We also provide guidance for various specific therapeutic
exercises designed to improve strength, flexibility, and function, ensuring you perform them
correctly for maximum benefit.

We keep monitoring your progress through objective measurements and subjective feedback. Based on
your response to the treatment, our professionals adjust the treatment, modify exercises, and refine
techniques to ensure you are on the optimal path to recovery.

At our Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation Centre in Woodbridge, we not only treat your condition but
also provide valuable education about the ailment, proper body mechanics, and injury prevention
strategies. This knowledge will help you to maintain your improvements independently and prevent
future issues, ensuring long-term success.

Even after you have achieved your recovery goals, we continue to support your long-term wellbeing.
Whether through maintenance sessions, updated exercise programs, or periodic reassessments, our team
ensures you stay strong, active, and confident in your daily activities.

## How Physiotherapy Works

What to Expect From Physiotherapy at HealX Physio & Rehab

When you step into our Woodbridge Rehabilitation Centre, our expert physiotherapists study your
medical history and conduct a thorough evaluation of your condition, including physical examination,
and movement analysis. This comprehensive assessment allows us to identify the root cause of your
pain or dysfunction and establishes a baseline for your treatment journey.

Based on the findings from the initial assessment, we at HealX Physio & Rehab develop a clear
diagnosis and set realistic and achievable goals for your welfare. We discuss treatment options
specific to your condition, expected timeline, and create a personalised care plan tailored to your
needs and lifestyle.

Our experts provide hands-on Physiotherapy Treatment in Woodbridge such as joint mobilisation, soft
tissue massages, and targeted stretching. We also provide guidance for various specific therapeutic
exercises designed to improve strength, flexibility, and function, ensuring you perform them
correctly for maximum benefit.

We keep monitoring your progress through objective measurements and subjective feedback. Based on
your response to the treatment, our professionals adjust the treatment, modify exercises, and refine
techniques to ensure you are on the optimal path to recovery.

At our Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation Centre in Woodbridge, we not only treat your condition but
also provide valuable education about the ailment, proper body mechanics, and injury prevention
strategies. This knowledge will help you to maintain your improvements independently and prevent
future issues, ensuring long-term success.

Even after you have achieved your recovery goals, we continue to support your long-term wellbeing.
Whether through maintenance sessions, updated exercise programs, or periodic reassessments, our team
ensures you stay strong, active, and confident in your daily activities.

BENEFITS & OUTCOMES

## Benefits of Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation

Experience the transformative benefits of professional physiotherapy services - designed to restore
your flexibility and improve your quality of life.

### Reduced Pain and Inflammation

At HealX Physio & Rehab, we use evidence-based treatment techniques to target the root cause of your
pain and not just the symptoms. Through manual therapy, therapeutic exercises, and personalised
sessions with our experts, we help reduce inflammation and the discomfort naturally. With our
services you will experience lasting relief without having to rely solely on pain medications.

### Improvement in Mobility and Flexibility

With our personalised strengthening and stretching exercises, you will be able to freely move again.
Our experts will work with you to restore your range of motion, improve muscle flexibility, and
enhance overall functional mobility. Visit our Woodbridge Rehabilitation Centre to get back to doing
the activities you love with confidence and ease.

### Faster Recovery after an Injury or Surgery

Through our comprehensive rehabilitation programs, we will accelerate your healing process. By
combining hands-on therapy with progressive exercise protocols and providing education to optimise
tissue healing, we will restore movement and improve your recovery timeline. Return to your daily
life sooner with our expert-guided recovery approach.

### Reduced Dependency on Medication

Visit our clinic in Woodbridge to experience natural, drug-free solutions that will help manage your
pain and improve your health. Our Physiotherapy Treatments are tailored to address the underlying
causes of your condition, reducing the need for long-term medication. Achieve better outcomes
through movement, manual therapy, and lifestyle modifications that support your body's natural
healing abilities.

### Prevention of Injuries in the Long Run

At HealX Physio & Rehab, we help you understand your body's mechanics, movement patterns and train
you in strengthening strategies to protect yourself from future injuries. Our physiotherapists
provide the education you need to maintain optimal physical health and prevent recurring problems.
We will enable you to build resilience and stay active for years to come with our preventive care
approach.

### Improves Overall Physical Performance

Visit our Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation Centre in Woodbridge to enhance your day-to-day physical
performance. Through targeted exercises and guided training, we strengthen your key muscle groups,
improve joint stability, correct movement patterns, and refine balance and coordination. You will be
able to walk, lift, and climb stairs easily, while also improving agility, endurance, and control in
sports related activities.

FAQs

How do I know if my insurance will cover HomePhysio.com.my?

We have many patients under insurance and have successfully completed their treatment sessions. We
do recommend our customers to always check with their respective [agency][25] first.

What do I need to have prepared for my Tele-Consultation?

In order to get the most from your Tele-consultation service, please come prepared with the
following:
1. Loose, appropriate clothing to assist examination e.g. sports attire
2. A spacious environment so that you could perform tests and movements
3. Any necessary [medical scans][26] or documents for reference

Do I need a referral to have an online Physical Therapy consultation?

No, you do not require a referral to have Tele-Consultation.

What is Home Physiotherapy?

Home physiotherapy provides basically the same physiotherapy services that you can find in
hospitals, but in the comfort of your own home. So you don’t have to suffer the hassle and pain when
travelling out of the house.

FAQs

How do I know if my insurance will cover HomePhysio.com.my?

We have many patients under insurance and have successfully completed their treatment sessions. We
do recommend our customers to always check with their respective [agency][25] first.

What do I need to have prepared for my Tele-Consultation?

In order to get the most from your Tele-consultation service, please come prepared with the
following:
1. Loose, appropriate clothing to assist examination e.g. sports attire
2. A spacious environment so that you could perform tests and movements
3. Any necessary [medical scans][26] or documents for reference

Do I need a referral to have an online Physical Therapy consultation?

No, you do not require a referral to have Tele-Consultation.

What is Home Physiotherapy?

Home physiotherapy provides basically the same physiotherapy services that you can find in
hospitals, but in the comfort of your own home. So you don’t have to suffer the hassle and pain when
travelling out of the house.

In-Home Therapeutics is proud to offer professional in-home physiotherapy services. Whether you or a loved one need home exercises for post-operative rehabilitation or personalized treatment for a neurological disorder, our dedicated home physiotherapists bring expert, one-on-one care to your doorstep. Call us today for a free phone consultation and start your recovery journey!

Award-Winning Home Care Physiotherapy

Discover the exceptional quality and personalized care offered by our expert home physiotherapists. Home care physiotherapy is about restoring your physical health in the comfort of a home environment, making you feel comfortable and looked after. We understand that travelling can be a common barrier for those with physical conditions, so we’re here to provide you with care remotely.

Our mobile physiotherapy clinic also stores high-quality equipment that will help you on your recovery journey, no matter where you are in the house. Here at In-Home Therapeutics, we will always put you or a family member first.

Mobile Physiotherapy

Our mobile physiotherapy brings high-quality equipment and expert care directly to you for a professional treatment experience no matter where you are in your home. In-Home Therapeutics is proud to provide personalized treatment that puts you or your loved one first – all in the place where you feel most comfortable.

Book an Appointment

Home Physiotherapy Services

Whether you’re recovering from surgery, managing pain, or improving mobility, we offer personalized home physiotherapy services to help you move better and feel better. 

High-Quality Home Physio Care

Manage pain, stiffness, and mobility issues from injuries, arthritis, or fractures. Our treatments help restore movement and prevent future discomfort.
Learn More

Neurological Physiotherapy

Improve coordination, strength, and daily function with specialized care for strokes, Parkinson’s, MS, and spinal cord injuries.
Learn More

Post-Operative Rehabilitation

Regain mobility and strength after surgery with rehabilitation services that help manage pain, reduce swelling, and aid recovery.
Learn More

At-Home Sports Physiotherapy

Recover from sports injuries and get back to doing what you love with custom physical rehabilitation plans for athletes at all levels.
Learn More

Physiotherapy for Seniors

We all want to stay active and independent. An in-home physiotherapist Toronto can help improve mobility, prevent falls, and manage pain.
Learn More

Balance & Falls Prevention

Strengthen muscles and improve stability with exercises designed to reduce the risk of falls and boost your confidence.
Learn More

Acupuncture & Dry Needling

Relieve muscle tension, inflammation, and chronic pain with acupuncture and dry needling, a natural treatment that supports mobility and recovery.
Learn More

High-Quality Home Physio Care

We promise to provide top-notch home physio treatments tailored to your unique needs and preferences. Our registered physiotherapists have specialized knowledge and skills to offer in-home physiotherapy for seniors or anyone who wants to get back on their feet and live pain-free.
We understand that mobility challenges can make it difficult to attend in-clinic appointments. That’s why we bring expert home physio directly to you, ensuring you receive the specialized treatment and support you need – without the stress of travel.

Our Team

Revolutionary In-Home Physiotherapy
Discover a new era of in-home home physiotherapy in Toronto with our innovative, fully-mobile physiotherapy clinic. We specialize in personalized, home-based physiotherapy, equipped with the latest technology and research to offer top-quality care. All you need to do is stay in your preferred home while we bring the care to you.

Our services range from musculoskeletal physiotherapy and pain management to acupuncture and dry needling for relieving inflammation. With these options, you can choose an in-home physical therapy technique that works for your health goals.

Tailored Patient Experience
Our registered physiotherapists are dedicated to providing a patient-focused approach. Every hour-long session of at-home physiotherapy is one-on-one to ensure personalized attention and unhurried treatment.

You can also discuss future improvements, and your physiotherapist Toronto can change exercise therapy to cater to your needs. We want optimal outcomes for your recovery, so don’t be afraid to be honest or ask questions regarding our services.

Prompt and Convenient Service
We value your time and prioritize quick and easy scheduling for smooth in-home physiotherapy. With a free phone consultation, we can eliminate long wait times and start physiotherapy in your home within days.

Many physiotherapy clinics have limited appointments and long wait lists, which we want to avoid when caring for your health. We exclusively work remotely using portable, high-end equipment to offer better care in less time!

Accessible and Affordable Care
We believe in providing accessible care without sacrificing quality. Our fully mobile physiotherapy model offers competitive pricing comparable to local clinics – we don’t operate with an overhead, meaning you don’t have to pay costs for our storefront, scheduling rates, or utilities.

In-Home Therapeutics also accepts private health insurance for added convenience. WSIB, BlueCross, and Veterans Affairs can also cover your treatment.

# In-Home Physiotherapy Services

[ Start now ][158]
[ Call us ][159]
Do you want personalized treatment without travelling to a physiotherapy clinic? In-Home
Therapeutics can improve physical health in your chosen home environment, making it a comfortable
and cost-effective experience. Whether you seek to [regain muscle strength][160] or reduce chronic
pain, our services are here to help.

Find out more about our in-home physiotherapy services below!

## Private Physiotherapy Services Available In Your Area

In the Greater Toronto area, we have experienced physiotherapists who can offer personalized
physiotherapy at home.

These private physical therapy services are also suitable for anyone living in cities such as [North
York][161], [Cornwall][162], [Ottawa][163], [Brockville][164], [Kingston][165], [Napanee][166],
[Toronto][167], [Mississauga][168], [Oakville][169], [Etobicoke][170], [Vaughan][171], and
[Brampton][172].

Don’t see your city on the list? Call us to determine whether remote physiotherapy is available in
your location, whether that’s Richmond Hill or Windsor. Our team wants to provide as much care as
possible, so don’t hesitate to reach out about at-home physical therapy services. For more
information on remote physiotherapy, keep reading.

## Neurological Physiotherapy For Strength and Mobility

Neurological physiotherapy is the best option for those who have neurological disorders that impact
their brain, spinal cord, and nerves. Some of these might be spinal cord injuries or strokes.
We offer therapeutic exercises like stretching to improve coordination and increase muscle strength,
leading to better mobility overall. With a personalized treatment plan, you can also use adaptive
equipment that caters to your physical well-being. If you or a loved one needs that extra support,
choose [neurological physiotherapy][173] today.

## Musculoskeletal Physiotherapy For Chronic Pain Management

If you have an injury that limits your movement and strength, choose [musculoskeletal
physiotherapy][174] as your subsequent treatment. Our team specializes in aches and pains, along
with post-fractures and discolorations that haven’t been kind to your body. Through home exercises
and professional guidance, we can help eliminate stubborn pain.

## Balance and Falls Prevention to Prevent Future Accidents

Chronic pain, neurological conditions, and ageing can disrupt your balance and increase the risk of
falling over. We understand that this risk can be scary for seniors. Therefore, our team has put
together balance programs to protect your health.
Book an appointment for [balance and falls prevention][175] to complete a falls risk assessment.

## Post-Operative Home Rehabilitation Services

Choose [post-operative physiotherapy][176] if you want support in your recovery process. At In-Home
Therapeutics, we can arrange a one-to-one session to ban the pain, swelling, and lack of mobility
from your life. Our structured physiotherapy program has everything you need after surgery,
including strength-based home exercises and physical techniques to manage your pain.
One of our physiotherapists will guide you through rehabilitation to help you get back on your feet.

## Physiotherapy For Seniors to Address Physical Challenges

Seniors may need [extra home care][177] because they can’t travel. This is an issue we understand,
making our in-home therapy services perfect for older adults who have limited physical movement.
Do you have family members who are in desperate need of physiotherapy? Choose our [physiotherapy for
seniors][178] treatment now.

## Acupuncture and Dry Needling Treatments

In-Home Therapeutics also provides more relaxing therapy techniques that revolve around acupuncture
and dry needling. The insertion of fine needles is supposed to treat pain, muscle tension, and
inflammation. Whether you want to relax or achieve a natural energy flow through your body, our
private physical therapy services can help you feel physically stronger.
You can learn more about acupuncture and dry needling [here][179].

## Additional At-home Physical Therapy Services In Greater Toronto Area

We also provide other in-home physiotherapy services for specific individuals. Those who have
experienced long-term [pain from car accidents][180] can choose [motor vehicle accident
physiotherapy][181] to feel good again. You need a referral from a physician or chiropractor before
starting this treatment, and you must live in Cornwall, Ottawa, Kingston, Brockville, or Russell.

[Physiotherapy for veterans affairs][182] is another service beneficial for veterans with movement
disorders. Our team suggests exercise programs, manual therapy like massages, and educational tips
for injury prevention. Anyone living in Cornwall, Ottawa, Kingston, Brockville, and Russell can
access these special services.

Lastly, our [corporate physiotherapy][183] package is designed to help employees manage their
physical well-being when working remotely. Our ergonomic assessment evaluates workstations and tasks
to determine whether they’re safe or causing physical injury. Choose this package to implement more
home care for your team.

## Contact Us to Book Your Next In-Home Physiotherapy Appointment

If you have further questions about these at-home physiotherapy services, [contact us][184]. One of
our experts will get back to you and discuss the best program for achieving your physical goals. You
don’t have to sit at home in pain anymore, so reach out now to receive high-quality care from a
dedicated physiotherapist. We will bring the treatment to your door!

Recognized for excellence in patient care and clinical outcomes, Inova is committed to advancing healthcare through innovation and community engagement.

## ABOUT

[Screenshot 2022-06-06 at 8.35.07 AM.png]

We are a team of like-minded physiotherapist from diverse backgrounds and trainings.

What matters to us most is help people achieve optimal health, that’s is good sleep, clean stomach
and healthy muscles and joints.

We educate our clients about the inbuilt capacity of body to heal through simple monitored exercise.

One on one monitored exercise sessions with natural pain relieving modalities helps us address these
issues to your satisfaction.

Hence, give us an opportunity to help you experience stress free health care.

Mobile Physiotherapy in Melbourne

Mobile Physiotherapy Experts for Physical Challenges

Khy Physio brings mobile physiotherapy directly to your home across Melbourne. We support seniors, people with disabilities, and those managing falls and balance issues, mobility difficulties, and muscle and joint pain.

Our physiotherapists deliver personalised, in-home care to help you move safely, build strength, and regain confidence – whether you’re recovering from surgery, managing age-related changes, or living with a physical condition.

Whom We Help

Seniors with frailty who have falls and balance difficulties

Individuals after joint replacements or hip and knee procedures

NDIS participants with mobility, balance challenges and muscle pain

Anyone experiencing muscle weakness, reduced physical function or chronic pain

Book an appointment

Our Services at Khy Physio

Our Services
at Khy Physio.

/ 01

Mobile Physiotherapy for Seniors

Khy Physio specialises in in-home physiotherapy for seniors managing age-related muscle weakness, balance and mobility problems, muscle and joint pain, osteoporosis, and post-surgery recovery, all delivered in the comfort of your own home.

/ 02

Mobile Physiotherapy for NDIS participants

Khy Physio is a registered NDIS provider delivering mobile physiotherapy for people living with physical disability. Our NDIS physiotherapists support those with Strokes, Parkinson’s disease, MND, FND, and other neurological and physical conditions.

/ 03

Hydrotherapy in Melbourne

Khy Physio hydrotherapy physiotherapists use water buoyancy to improve strength, function, and pain management in a safe, low-impact environment. Ideal for chronic pain, joint replacements, arthritis, and significant muscle weakness, we offer NDIS, Support at Home, and private hydrotherapy options.

/ 04

Mobile Physiotherapy in Melbourne

Khy Physio brings expert physiotherapy directly to your home across Melbourne — no clinic, no waiting rooms. We help you recover from injury, manage pain, and stay mobile and independent, with focused one-on-one care built around your goals.

/ 05

Mobile Physiotherapy for DVA clients

Khy Physio provides gap-free mobile physiotherapy for eligible Department of Veterans’ Affairs (DVA) clients. We support veterans managing mobility challenges, pain, and functional limitations – helping you stay active and independent.

/ 06

Mobile Physiotherapy for TAC clients

For those who were unfortunately in transport related accident, Khy Physio is here to help. We aim to reduce the stresses of receiving quality care by delivering physiotherapy to your home. We support TAC clients who have been approved for provider travel due to a clinical need, ensuring you receive high-quality care when attending a clinic isn’t safe or practical.

/ 07

Mobile Physiotherapy for Support at home clients

At Khy Physio, we support older Australians under the Support at Home program (formerly Home Care Packages), delivering in-home physiotherapy that helps you stay strong, mobile and independent in the comfort of your own home.

/ 08

Mobile Physiotherapy for WorkCover clients

Khy Physio’s WorkCover mobile physiotherapists support you after a work-related injury. We understand the pressure of juggling medical reviews, insurer requirements, and employer updates while trying to recover – delivering quality in-home care so getting better is one less stress.

Not sure where to start?

Reach out and we’ll guide you through the next steps toward in-home physiotherapy.

Get started

Mobile Physio Excellence

Driven by Purpose.
Guided by Evidence.

/ 01

Genuine Care – Real Connections

We see you, and we hear you. At Khy Physio, we take the time to understand each and every individual, and to put ourselves in their shoe. That’s why our clients often say they can feel how much we care.

/ 02

Experienced Evidence Based Practice

Our experienced physiotherapists use current evidence-informed practice to guide treatment aimed at supporting balance, mobility, and participation in everyday activities. Your progress is reviewed regularly so your care can be adapted to suit your individual needs and goals.

/ 03

Trusted Quality – Mobile Physio

We’ve supported hundreds of clients to maintain mobility, independence, and confidence at home. As trusted mobile physiotherapists across Melbourne, we provide personalised, evidence-based care tailored to each person’s needs.

/ 04

Personalised Care – Designed For You

Your goals, Our plan. Every treatment plan is developed specific to your situation, goals, condition, and home environment. We ensure a thorough assessment, expert guidance, and continuous monitoring for meaningful results.

/ 05

Advanced Progress Tracking

Using Clinical-Grade equipments such as handheld dynamometers and evidence-based outcome measures, we monitor your strength, function, and key points that matter to you, so every milestone is celebrated, and we achieve real progress through evidence, not luck.

/ 06

Comprehensive Support

Behind every visit is a whole team of physiotherapists with diverse clinical backgrounds and specialties. Whether you need neurological rehab, aged care support, post-surgery recovery, or NDIS goal-focused therapy, we match you with the right expertise and that expertise is always close by if your needs change.

Our Services

## Our Mobile Physiotherapy
## Service in Melbourne.

We are proudly serving all suburbs of Melbourne, bringing our highly experienced physiotherapists to
you.

/ 01

### Mobile Physiotherapy for Seniors

At Khy Physio, we are highly experienced in providing in-home physiotherapy for seniors who are
experiencing ageing related muscle weakness, balance and mobility problems. Whether you are
recovering from a surgery or manage age related changes such as muscle and joint pain, osteoporosis
or other conditions, we are confident in helping you.

[Visit Service ][34]
/ 02

### Mobile Physiotherapy for NDIS participants

Khy Physio is a registered NDIS provider. Our NDIS physiotherapists are well equipped in managing
physical-related disability, and providing mobile physiotherapy those who face physical challenges
due to their disabilities. Some of the conditions we are experienced in include Strokes, Parkinson’s
disease, MND, FND and others.

[Visit Service ][35]
/ 03

### Hydrotherapy in Melbourne

At Khy Physio, our hydrotherapy physiotherapists are highly experienced in using the power of water
buoyancy to improve strength, function and manage pain in a safe, low-impact environment. Ideal for
individuals with chronic pain, joint replacements, arthritis, or significant muscle weakness. We
provide NDIS, Support at Home program, and private hydrotherapy options for all abilities.

[Visit Service ][36]
/ 04

### Mobile Physiotherapy in Melbourne

Khy Physio brings expert physiotherapy directly to your home across Melbourne. We help you recover
from injury, manage pain, and stay mobile and independent — no clinic, no waiting rooms, just
focused one-on-one care that fits around your life.

[Visit Service ][37]
/ 05

### Mobile Physiotherapy for DVA clients

Khy Physio provides gap-free mobile physiotherapy for eligible Department of Veterans’ Affairs (DVA)
clients. We support veterans managing mobility challenges, pain, and functional limitations —
helping you stay active and independent.

[Visit Service ][38]
/ 06

### Mobile Physiotherapy for TAC clients

For those who were unfortunately in transport related accident, Khy Physio is here to help. We aim
to reduce the stresses of receiving quality care by delivering physiotherapy to your home. We
support TAC clients who have been approved for provider travel due to a clinical need, ensuring you
receive high-quality care when attending a clinic isn’t safe or practical.

[Visit Service ][39]
/ 07

### Mobile Physiotherapy for Support@home clients

At Khy Physio, our mobile physiotherapists have been proudly support our Australian older adults
under the support@home program, or previously known as Home Care Package. We are experts in
evidenced approach to improving strength, function and manage pain, and have helped hundreds of
older Australians improve and maintain their health and wellbeing.

[Visit Service ][40]
/ 08

### Mobile Physiotherapy for WorkCover clients

For those who faced work related accident, our WorkCover mobile physiotherapists are to help you. We
understand the stress of navigating through medical reviews, insurer requirements, employer updates,
all while trying to get better and eventually back to work. We strive to provide you with quality
care to guide you back to work without adding the stresses.

[Visit Service ][41]

### Not sure which service fits?

Get in touch and our team will help you find the right mobile physiotherapy support for your needs.

[Book An Appointment ][42]

Mobile Physiotherapy Excellence driven by Purpose

## Mobile Physio Excellence

/ 01

### Genuine Care Real Connections

We see you, and we hear you. At Khy Physio, we take the time to understand each and every
individual, and to put ourselves in their shoe. That’s why our clients often say they can feel how
much we care.

/ 02

### Experienced Evidence Based Practice

Our experienced physiotherapists use up-to-date evidence-based practice to help you improve balance,
mobility and to build confidence and independence. Your progress is monitored regularly to ensure
treatment is most effective for you specifically.

/ 03

### Trusted Quality Mobile Physio

We’ve supported hundreds of clients to maintain mobility, independence, and confidence at home. As
trusted mobile physiotherapists across Melbourne, we provide personalised, evidence-based care
tailored to each person’s needs.

/ 04

### Personalised Care Designed For You

Your goals, Our plan. Every treatment plan is developed specific to your situation, goals,
condition, and home environment. We ensure a thorough assessment, expert guidance, and continuous
monitoring for meaningful results.

/ 05

### Advanced Progress Tracking

Using Clinical-Grade equipments such as handheld dynamometers and evidence-based outcome measures,
we monitor your strength, function, and key points that matter to you, so every milestone is
celebrated, and we achieve real progress through evidence, not luck.

/ 06

### Comprehensive Support

Behind every visit is a whole team of physiotherapists with diverse clinical backgrounds and
specialties. Whether you need neurological rehab, aged care support, post-surgery recovery, or NDIS
goal-focused therapy, we match you with the right expertise and that expertise is always close by if
your needs change.

Pricing & Funding

# Pricing & Funding

Most of our clients pay little or nothing out of pocket — mobile physiotherapy is covered by a range
of funding programs. Here’s how it works.

[Ask for a quote ][32] [03 8824 0712][33]

How it’s funded

## Ways to fund your physiotherapy.

We work with all the major funding streams for in-home physiotherapy across Melbourne. Tell us your
situation and we’ll confirm your options and any costs up front — no surprises.

/ 01

### NDIS

We’re a registered NDIS provider. We deliver mobile physiotherapy for self-managed, plan-managed and
NDIA-managed participants, billed to your plan in line with the NDIS Price Guide.

/ 02

### Home Care Package

If you have a Home Care Package, physiotherapy can be funded from your package budget. We work with
your provider and case manager to arrange regular visits.

/ 03

### Support at Home

Under the Support at Home program, in-home physiotherapy is funded as part of your allied health
supports. We’ll liaise with your provider to get you started.

/ 04

### DVA

Gap-free mobile physiotherapy for eligible Department of Veterans’ Affairs (DVA) clients with a
valid referral — no out-of-pocket cost to you.

/ 05

### TAC

Recovering from a transport accident? For approved TAC clients we bill TAC directly, so you can
focus on getting better in the comfort of home.

/ 06

### WorkCover

Injured at work? With an accepted WorkCover claim we bill your insurer directly for approved
physiotherapy — no upfront cost while your claim is active.

/ 07

### Medicare (CDM/EPC)

With a GP Chronic Disease Management (CDM/EPC) plan, Medicare covers a set number of allied health
visits each calendar year. A small gap fee may apply.

/ 08

### Private / self-funded

No funding? No problem — and no referral needed. Private session rates are quoted on enquiry, based
on your location and care needs.

/ 09

### Private health insurance

If your “extras” cover includes physiotherapy, you can claim part of each session through your
private health fund. We provide an itemised receipt so you can claim straight back from your
insurer.

/ 10

### My Aged Care (CHSP)

Through My Aged Care and the Commonwealth Home Support Programme (CHSP), eligible older Australians
can access subsidised in-home physiotherapy. We’ll help you understand your referral and
entitlements.

Fees are charged in line with each program’s schedule (for example, the NDIS Price Guide). Private
and self-funded rates are quoted on enquiry, as they depend on your location and care needs.
[Contact us for a quote][34].

## We don’t just help you feel better — we help you stay mobile and independent, at home, with Khy
## Physio.

FAQ

## Pricing & funding questions.

Still unsure? Call us on [03 8824 0712][35] and we’ll talk it through.

Do I need a referral to see a physiotherapist?
No — you can book directly with us for private physiotherapy. A GP referral or care plan is only
needed for certain funding (for example Medicare CDM/EPC or DVA), and we’re happy to help you
arrange one.
How much does a home visit cost?
It depends on your funding. NDIS, Home Care Package, Support at Home, DVA, TAC and WorkCover clients
usually pay little or nothing out of pocket. Private session rates are quoted on enquiry based on
your area and needs — just ask.
Which funding programs do you work with?
NDIS, Home Care Packages, the Support at Home program, DVA, TAC, WorkCover, Medicare (CDM/EPC) and
private/self-funded. We’ll confirm what you’re eligible for before your first visit.
Is there a travel or call-out fee?
We come to you across Melbourne. Any travel component is built into your program’s billing or
included in your quote — we’ll always make the costs clear up front.
Can you bill my plan or insurer directly?
Yes. For NDIS (plan- and NDIA-managed), Home Care Packages, DVA, TAC and WorkCover we bill your
plan, provider or insurer directly wherever your approval allows.
How do I get started?
Complete our [new-patient form][36] or call us on 03 8824 0712. We’ll confirm your funding and book
your first in-home visit — often within the same week.

representatives to get back to you. Thank you for your patience!

### We work with english or spanish speaking clients! 

## O Que Oferecemos

Oferecemos uma variedade de serviços de fisioterapia para atender às necessidades de nossos
pacientes. Desde massagens terapeuticas/relaxantes/desportivas até treino especializado com
fisioterapeutas experientes, estamos comprometidos em fornecer um cuidado abrangente e personalizado
para permitir a melhor reabilitação qualquer seja a lesão.

[Conheça-nos melhor ][9]
[Academia - LSFISIO]

## Nossos Serviços

[[Massagem - LSFISIO]][10]

##### [Massagens][11]

###### Relaxamento e Bem-Estar

[Ver mais ][12]

As nossas massagens são projetadas para aliviar o stress, reduzir a tensão muscular e promover o
bem-estar geral. Com terapeutas qualificados, garantimos uma experiência relaxante e
rejuvenescedora.

[[FISIO]][13]

##### [Fisioterapia][14]

###### Reabilitação Física

[Ver mais ][15]

Nossas sessões de fisioterapia são personalizadas para ajudar na recuperação de lesões, aumentar a
mobilidade e melhorar a qualidade de vida. Contamos com profissionais dedicados que cuidam da sua
saúde e bem-estar.

[[PERSONAL]][16]

##### [Treino Personalizado][17]

###### Com Fisioterapeutas

[Ver mais ][18]

Oferecemos treino personalizado com fisioterapeutas especializados para melhorar a força,
flexibilidade e condicionamento físico. Nosso foco é garantir que atinja seus objetivos de forma
segura e eficaz.

[[FISIOTERAPIA]][19]

##### [Fisioterapia Domiciliar][20]

###### Conforto e Comodidade

[Ver mais ][21]

Para aqueles que precisam de tratamento em casa, disponibilizamos sessões de fisioterapia
domiciliar. Os nossos profissionais qualificados levam o cuidado terapêutico diretamente até si,
garantindo sua recuperação no conforto do seu lar.

[[PILATES]][22]

##### [Pilates Clinico][23]

###### Saúde é movimento

[Ver mais ][24]

Exercícios terapêuticos guiados por fisioterapeutas para reabilitação, fortalecimento e alívio de
dores. Melhore a postura, a mobilidade e a estabilidade com sessões personalizadas sobre atenção do
fisioterapeuta.

###### Saúde é movimento

[Ver mais ][24]

Our Services

Families across New York City trust Morningside Nursing and Rehabilitation Center for expert nursing care, rehabilitation, and long-term support in a safe, caring environment.

24/7 Skilled Nursing Care
Our skilled nursing team provides 24/7 expert medical care and support, ensuring residents receive personalized attention, medication management, and specialized treatments whenever needed. With a focus on safety, comfort, and well-being, we are always here to meet the evolving health needs of those in our care. View All Services

Short-Term / Sub-Acute Rehabilitation
Our short-term rehabilitation program provides personalized therapy and medical support to help residents regain strength, mobility, and independence. With a team of skilled professionals, we focus on rapid recovery and seamless transitions, ensuring each individual reaches their highest level of function and returns home with confidence. View All Services

Post-Operative Care
We offer personalized pre- and post-operative care plans, ensuring a smooth surgical experience. Our comprehensive approach includes pre-op education, pain management, and recovery planning to facilitate optimal healing. View All Services

Assisted Living Program
Morningside Assisted Living is a licensed 40-bed residence in the Bronx, NY, designed for individuals who want to maintain independence while receiving minimal assistance. View All Services

Dialysis

# Nursing and Rehabilitation Center

Morningside Nursing and Rehabilitation Center provides skilled rehabilitation and nursing that
supports the whole patient—restoring independence, reducing readmissions, and promoting the best
health outcomes.

### Services

### Assisted Living Program

Morningside Assisted Living is a licensed 40-bed residence in the Bronx, NY, designed for
individuals who want to maintain independence while receiving minimal assistance. The program offers
private living units, 24-hour supervision, personal care support, meals, transportation, activities,
and therapy services to help residents thrive. With a focus on “Renew, Restore, Rehabilitate,” the
staff develops personalized care plans and provides a supportive community environment.

[ Contact us ][28]

### Dialysis

Morningside offers on-site dialysis services within its skilled nursing setting, allowing residents
to receive life-sustaining treatments without the stress of traveling to outside centers. By having
dialysis in the same place where patients live and receive other medical care, it ensures seamless
coordination, greater comfort, and improved safety. This integrated approach means all medical needs
are addressed under one roof, supporting better outcomes and peace of mind for patients and their
families.
