**Services**

# Nursing and Rehabilitation Center

Morningside Nursing and Rehabilitation Center provides skilled rehabilitation and nursing that
supports the whole patient—restoring independence, reducing readmissions, and promoting the best
health outcomes.

### Services

### Assisted Living Program

Morningside Assisted Living is a licensed 40-bed residence in the Bronx, NY, designed for
individuals who want to maintain independence while receiving minimal assistance. The program offers
private living units, 24-hour supervision, personal care support, meals, transportation, activities,
and therapy services to help residents thrive. With a focus on “Renew, Restore, Rehabilitate,” the
staff develops personalized care plans and provides a supportive community environment.

[ Contact us ][28]

### Dialysis

Morningside offers on-site dialysis services within its skilled nursing setting, allowing residents
to receive life-sustaining treatments without the stress of traveling to outside centers. By having
dialysis in the same place where patients live and receive other medical care, it ensures seamless
coordination, greater comfort, and improved safety. This integrated approach means all medical needs
are addressed under one roof, supporting better outcomes and peace of mind for patients and their
families.

[ Contact us ][29]

### 24/7 Skilled Nursing Care

Our skilled nursing team provides 24/7 expert medical care and support, ensuring residents receive
personalized attention, medication management, and specialized treatments whenever needed. With a
focus on safety, comfort, and well-being, we are always here to meet the evolving health needs of
those in our care.

[ Contact us ][30]

### Short-Term / Sub-Acute Rehabilitation

Our short-term rehabilitation program provides personalized therapy and medical support to help
residents regain strength, mobility, and independence. With a team of skilled professionals, we
focus on rapid recovery and seamless transitions, ensuring each individual reaches their highest
level of function and returns home with confidence.

[ Contact us ][31]

### Intravenous Therapy

We offer intravenous therapy services to administer medications, fluids, and nutrients directly into
the bloodstream, ensuring efficient and effective treatment for various medical conditions.

[ Contact us ][32]

### Wound Care

Our wound care specialists provide attentive treatment for various types of wounds, utilizing
appropriate dressings and medications to promote healing and prevent infection.

[ Contact us ][33]

### Medical Oversight & Specialty Services

Our experienced in-house physicians provide continuous medical oversight, collaborating closely with
our clinical team to deliver personalized diagnostic and treatment plans. Residents also benefit
from access to a trusted network of specialists ensuring expert consultations and comprehensive care
for complex medical needs. This integrated approach maintains the highest standard of care
throughout each resident’s stay.

[ Contact us ][34]

### Pain Management

Utilizing an interdisciplinary approach, we develop individualized pain management plans aimed at
enhancing quality of life. Treatment options may include medications, massage therapy, mental health
support, and other modalities tailored to each patient’s needs.

[ Contact us ][35]

### Palliative and Hospice Care

We provide compassionate palliative and hospice care for patients with chronic illnesses, focusing
on comfort, stress relief, and quality of life. Our team collaborates with experienced hospice
organizations to offer comprehensive support.

[ Contact us ][36]

### Enteral Nutrition

We offer enteral nutrition therapy for patients unable to consume food orally, ensuring proper
nourishment through carefully administered feeding tubes tailored to individual nutritional needs.

[ Contact us ][37]

### Cardiac Rehabilitation

For patients recovering from cardiac events or managing heart disease, our program includes exercise
therapy and education aimed at preventing future cardiac issues and promoting heart health.

[ Contact us ][38]

### Respiratory Care

Our team provides care for patients with breathing disorders, offering treatments and education to
improve respiratory function and enhance overall well-being.

[ Contact us ][39]

### Physical Therapy

Our physical therapy program focuses on restoring mobility, strength, and function through
personalized exercise regimens and therapeutic techniques, aiding patients in achieving their
rehabilitation goals.

[ Contact us ][40]

### Occupational Therapy

Our culinary team prepares nutritious and delicious meals tailored to individual dietary needs and
preferences, creating an enjoyable dining experience that supports overall health and satisfaction.

[ Contact us ][41]

### Speech Pathology

Our speech therapy services address communication and swallowing disorders, employing individualized
treatment plans to enhance speech, language, swallowing abilities, and cognition.

[ Contact us ][42]

### Post Operative Care

We offer personalized pre- and post-operative care plans, ensuring a smooth surgical experience. Our
comprehensive approach includes pre-op education, pain management, and recovery planning to
facilitate optimal healing.

[ Contact us ][43]

### Social Work

Our qualified social workers assist patients and their families in navigating the healthcare system,
providing counseling, education, and resources to support emotional well-being and effective care
planning.

[ Contact us ][44]

Our registered and licensed nurse teams are highly skilled at assessing patient needs and
implementing individualized care plans.

Our nurses collaborate with patients, family members, doctors and our own experience leadership to
understand care goals, assess care needs, develop individualized plan and coordinate other essential
services.

###### Overview

## We tailor our expert nursing services to address each patient’s health care needs

Our nurses collaborate with patients, family members, doctors and our own experience leadership to
understand care goals, assess care needs, develop individualized plan and coordinate other essential
services. You will be assigned to a registered nurse as your primary care manager who is responsible
for overseeing all your care needs. Our nurse will collaborate with you and your doctor to develop a
personalized plan of care and will coordinate any other home-based services that you may need.

# Kinesiology Services | Kinesiologist in Langley BC

## Kinesiology Services In Langley

We’re excited to offer you a complete range of kinesiology services that can help you achieve your
health and fitness goals. Our team of skilled kinesiologists will work closely with you to create
customized exercise plans that are tailored specifically to your individual needs and fitness
levels. Whether you’re looking to recover from an injury, improve your overall health, or boost your
athletic performance, our kinesiologists are here to guide and support you every step of the way.
We’re committed to helping you become your best self.

With their extensive knowledge of human movement and biomechanics, our kinesiologists can help you
improve your strength, flexibility, endurance, balance, and coordination. So, if you are looking for
professional guidance and support to help you reach your fitness goals, our kinesiologists are here
to help.

At our Langley clinic, we offer kinesiology services that typically include an initial assessment to
understand your physical condition, followed by an individualized exercise program designed to
improve your functional capabilities.

Kinesiology services can be used for injury rehabilitation, sports performance training, improving
activities of daily life, [strength training][62], education, and lifestyle modifications to prevent
injury and maintain physical health. Kinesiology services are focused on improving physical function
and helping you achieve your health and wellness goals through personalized exercise programs and
rehabilitation plans.

With our approach, you won’t have to worry about a one-size-fits-all solution. Instead, our
Kinesiologist will work with you to design a program that considers your unique abilities and
limitations. Personalized rehabilitation puts you on the fast track to recovery.

So if you’re ready to take control of your health and wellness, contact us today to learn more about
our kinesiology services in Langley. Let’s work together to help you achieve your best self!

At Opal Physiotherapy, we also offer [active rehabilitation][63] services after an [ICBC-related
Motor vehicle accident][64]. Our Kinesiologist will provide a customized [MVA active rehab
program][65] to help you after the injury to re-establishing mobility and function.

## Did you know?
* > We offer a one-on-one 15-minute free consultation with our registered kinesiologist to discuss
> your issue and offer honest advice about rehabilitation/treatment options.

[Ben Unsworth][66]
Kinesiologist At Opal Physio

Contact Us

## Benefits of working with our kinesiologist in Langley
* Our Kinesiologist is an accredited member of the British Columbia Association of Kinesiologists or
BCAK.
* They are qualified, with a degree in kinesiology and have the training to treat physical
conditions.
* They identify and treat the cause of a person’s pain rather than just treating the symptoms.
* They are a great resource to improve your overall health and physical outcomes.
* Our clinic’s experienced Kieisologist can complement your existing treatment, which can include
physiotherapy, occupational therapy, chiropractic and massage therapy.
* They can also provide support and encouragement while you are going through your rehabilitation
process.
* They can help understand your body’s needs and help explore different avenues in order to improve
your health.

## Frequently asked questions on kinesiology

## What is Kinesiology?

Kinesiology is a science that studies the body in motion. It is the study of how the body moves and
how it reacts to different stimuli. [Kinesiology][67] is an interdisciplinary field that includes
biomechanics, physiology, anatomy, neurology and psychology.

[Kinesiology has many applications][68] in rehabilitation medicine, sports medicine and physical
education. This field aims to understand human movement and use this knowledge to help people reach
their maximum potential for health and performance.

The word “kinesiology” comes from the Greek words kinesis(“to move”) and logia (“to study”). This
refers to a kinesiologist investigating the cause of movement disorders.

## Who is a kinesiologist?

Kinesiologists are health professionals and experts in human movement, studying the body’s movements
and their relation to the brain. They use applied anatomy and physiology that uses muscle testing to
evaluate how people are physically functioning and use various skills to help people move more
freely and with less pain.

## What does a kinesiologist do?

A kinesiologist studies the factors that influence human motion and identifies ways to improve their
clients’ health and well-being. They evaluate how we move our bodies, whether during exercises or
everyday activities such as walking, running, playing sports, dancing, gardening, cooking, cleaning,
working, shopping, etc., looking for signs of injury, disease, or dysfunction.

## Who can kinesiologists help?

Kinesiologists can help a wide range of individuals, including those recovering from injuries,
looking to improve their overall health, seeking to enhance athletic performance, and anyone who
wants to prevent injury and maintain physical health. They can help with injury prevention or
recovery from an injury and improve your performance whether it is a leisure activity, work or
sports.

## How can a kinesiologist help me?

Kinesiologist services can include a wide range of assessments, treatments, and exercise programs
designed to improve physical function and prevent injury. Our Kinesiologist will work with you to
identify the cause of the problem and offer customized treatment plans to help you move and feel
better.

## What is active rehabilitation treatment?

The Active Rehabilitation treatment session is a treatment that is provided by a physical therapist
or a kinesiologist. It is done to help the patient recover from an injury. It works by restoring the
normal range of motion and strength of muscles, ligaments, and joints.

Kinesiologists can help a wide range of individuals, including those recovering from injuries,
looking to improve their overall health, seeking to enhance athletic performance, and anyone who
wants to prevent injury and maintain physical health. They can help with injury prevention or
recovery from an injury and improve your performance whether it is a leisure activity, work or
sports.

## How can a kinesiologist help me?

Kinesiologist services can include a wide range of assessments, treatments, and exercise programs
designed to improve physical function and prevent injury. Our Kinesiologist will work with you to
identify the cause of the problem and offer customized treatment plans to help you move and feel
better.

## What is active rehabilitation treatment?

The Active Rehabilitation treatment session is a treatment that is provided by a physical therapist
or a kinesiologist. It is done to help the patient recover from an injury. It works by restoring the
normal range of motion and strength of muscles, ligaments, and joints.

Active rehabilitation treatments are designed for patients after a recent injury or recovering from
an injury. They also help patients recover from muscle fatigue, joint stiffness, and other symptoms
of overuse or repetitive use injuries.

Kin can also help provide active rehabilitation to athletes with health and general fitness, sports
activity performance, athletic training, and wellness to help them succeed in their sport.

## Do kinesiologists provide active rehabilitation treatment?

Yes, Kinesiologists provide active rehabilitation treatment, which involves personalized exercise
programs to help patients recover from injury or other conditions that have impaired their movement
and function.

## Do kinesiologists provide strength training?

Yes, kinesiologists provide strength training that targets muscle strength, power, and endurance.
They can design tailored programs to meet individual goals, fitness levels, and physical conditions,
incorporating exercises like weightlifting, resistance band workouts, and bodyweight exercises.
Other exercise modalities, such as cardiovascular training or flexibility work, may also be
included.

## How can kinesiologist help me recover from an injury?

Kinesiologists can help patients recover from injury by designing exercise programs tailored to
their specific needs and abilities. They can also help patients improve their range of motion,
strength, and flexibility, which are important factors in recovery. They offer an initial
assessment, exercise prescription, injury rehabilitation, sports performance training, education and
lifestyle modifications to help you maintain your physical health and prevent injury

## Can kinesiologist help me manage chronic pain?

Yes, kinesiologists can help manage chronic pain by designing exercise programs that help alleviate
pain and improve functionality. They devise a conditioning program to help manage your symptoms and
reduce pain on a day-to-day basis.

## What exercises are best for my specific injury or condition?

The best exercises for a specific injury or condition will depend on the individual and the nature
of the injury or condition. Rehabilitation specialists can assess your needs and develop an exercise
program that is safe and effective for you.

## What is the role of kinesiology in post-surgical rehabilitation?

The role of kinesiology in post-surgical rehabilitation is to design exercise programs that help
patients regain strength, range of motion, and functionality and recover post-operatively. The
physical activity experts work closely with other healthcare providers to ensure that patients are
progressing appropriately.

## What is the importance of proper body mechanics in preventing injury?

Proper body mechanics are crucial in preventing injury and maintaining physical health. They help
you maintain proper alignment, distribute forces effectively, and reduce any strain on muscles,
bones, and joints. Poor body mechanics can lead to injuries, chronic conditions, and muscle
imbalances. By practicing good body mechanics, you can reduce the risk of developing future injuries
and chronic conditions, improve your physical health, and enhance your overall well-being.

## How can kinesiologist help me improve my athletic performance?

Kinesiologists can help improve athletic performance by designing exercise programs that target
specific areas of fitness such as strength, power, endurance, and agility. They can also analyze
movement patterns and provide feedback to improve techniques during sports.

## What is the role of kinesiology in treating movement disorders?

Kinesiology plays a crucial role in treating movement disorders by assessing movement patterns and
designing personalized exercise programs to improve physical function and enhance the quality of
life in individuals with movement disorders.

# Services Provided At Opal Physio

## Services Provided at Opal Physiotherapy and Health Clinic

We are the first and only combined physiotherapy and physiatry clinic in Langley, BC. We provide
services to patients with a wide range of injuries and conditions in and Around the Lower Mainland
and Fraser Valley Region. Our team of physiotherapists and physiatrists are experts in their field,
and we offer a variety of treatments to help you recover from your injury or condition. Our highly
qualified professionals are committed to providing the best care possible. Our goal is to empower
patients with proven treatments to help them feel better and improve their lives.

Contact Us

**Our Services Include**

## PHYSIOTHERAPY

### Our Cutting-Edge Physiotherapy Services Combined With Post-Graduate Specialization Credentials

Our physiotherapy services include the management and treatment of various injuries and conditions.
All our consultations are one on one and can involve various specialized techniques including manual
hands-on therapy, active rehab, exercise therapy, education, soft tissue and joint mobilization.

Our Physio uses treatment programs to assist you in getting back to activities that you enjoy and
improving your quality of life.

## PHYSIATRY

A Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation practice involves the assessment and treatment of various
chronic pain issues and musculoskeletal diseases. Also, provide assessment and management of
neurological conditions such as spinal cord injuries, multiple sclerosis, traumatic brain injuries
or stroke.

Our physiatrist uses treatment programs to help our patients get back to what they enjoy doing and
improve one’s quality of life.

[Learn More About Physiatry Services][81]

## MASSAGE THERAPY

### Indulge in the rejuvenating experience of massage therapy at our clinic.

Our registered massage therapists specialize in a range of services, from senior preventative and
rehab care to prenatal and postnatal support, addressing women’s health, migraines, recurring daily
issues, postural concerns, relaxation, chronic pain, sports injuries, and mental well-being.

Our team’s expertise ensures a personalized approach to meet your unique needs, offering targeted
and effective treatments. Experience the healing touch of our therapists in a comfortable and serene
environment.

Embark on a journey to enhanced well-being by scheduling your appointment today. Contact us at now
and discover the path to a healthier, more relaxed you.

[Learn More About Massage Therapy][82]

## KINESIOLOGY

At Opal, we offer active rehabilitation services for those who have been in a motor vehicle accident
that is [ICBC-related][83]. Our kinesiologist will provide a customized active rehab program to help
you regain mobility and function after your injury. They will also provide you with exercises that
are tailored to your specific injury needs.

Our Kinesiology Services Include:
* [ICBC Active Rehab][84]
* [Strength Training][85]

[Learn More About Kinesiology Services][86]

## ACTIVE REHAB

Physiotherapists and kinesiologists provide active rehabilitation services to help individuals
recover from injuries or conditions affecting their physical abilities. Physiotherapists use
exercise therapy and manual therapy, while kinesiologists focus on fitness and wellness goals. Both
professionals develop individualized treatment plans to improve strength, mobility, and function.

# Antima Jain – Registered Physiotherapist

**Antima Jain**

## About Antima Jain – PT

Licensed Physiotherapist since 2018, Antima Jain brings over 12 years of hands-on clinical
experience in musculoskeletal care. A graduate of the Master of Physiotherapy (MSc PT) program with
a musculoskeletal (MSK) specialization (2012), she has built a reputation for thorough assessments
and individualized treatment plans that address not only symptoms but also the root causes of
chronic and non-traumatic musculoskeletal pain.

### Education and Credentials
* **Master of Physiotherapy (MSc PT)**, Musculoskeletal Specialization. 2012.
* **Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT)**, 2009.

### Clinical Experience

> **Total Practice**: 12+ years
> **Licensed Physiotherapist**: Since 2018

Throughout her career, Antima has successfully managed a diverse caseload, including:
1. **Orthopedic Injuries**
* Post-operative rehabilitation (ACL reconstruction, joint replacements)
* Fracture management and return-to-function protocols
2. **Sports-Related Conditions**
* Acute sprains, strains, and tendonopathies
* Performance enhancement and injury prevention programs
3. **Chronic Musculoskeletal Pain**
* Complex regional pain syndrome and myofascial dysfunction
* Low back and neck pain of non-traumatic origin

### Treatment Philosophy

Antima believes in a patient-centred, evidence-based [physiotherapy treatment][62] approach. Her
goals are to:

**1. Identify Underlying Drivers**

Delve beyond presenting symptoms to uncover biomechanical imbalances, postural habits, and lifestyle
factors that contribute to chronic pain.

**2. Empower Through Education**

Teach self-management strategies—ranging from therapeutic exercises to ergonomic adjustments so that
patients can sustain progress independently.

**3. Apply Manual & Therapeutic Techniques**

Blend hands-on interventions with active rehabilitation to restore mobility, strength, and
functional performance.

### Certifications & Special Skills
* **Mulligan Concept® Manual Therapy**
* **Certified Dry Needling Practitioner**
* Continuing professional development in sports taping, kinetic control, and advanced therapeutic
exercise modalities

### Outside the Clinic

When she’s not helping patients reclaim their pain-free lives, Antima loves to:
* **Explore New Destinations **– From coastal hikes to cultural city tours
* **Quality Family Time** – Weekend brunches, board games, and beach outings

# Physiotherapy Services in Langley

## Physiotherapy clinic and injury recovery centre in Langley, BC

##### Our Physiotherapy center provides the highest quality of physical therapy services to all our
##### clients with various treatment options that apply to your specific needs.

[Contact Us][62]

We direct bill physical therapy services to [ICBC][63], WorkSafeBC ( [Work Injury
Rehabilitation][64] ) and many other [Private Health Insurance Companies][65].

## Best Physiotherapy services in Langley, Lower Mainland

If you’re looking for top-notch physiotherapy services, you’ve come to the right place! Here at our
clinic, we pride ourselves on **providing our patients with the highest quality of care possible**.

Whether you’re recovering from an injury or dealing with a chronic condition, our team of
experienced professionals will work with you to create a **treatment plan that is tailored to your
individual needs**.

We offer a wide range of services, including manual therapy, exercise prescription, active rehab and
education. Contact us today to schedule an appointment.

[Contact Us][66]

### Get your strength and mobility back with physiotherapy treatment!

Our clinic offers physiotherapy treatment for musculoskeletal conditions, including pain and injury.
Though each person’s condition is different, our physical therapy rehabilitation addresses their
symptoms using several effective methods tailored to their particular problem.

We provide treatment techniques to get you back on your feet using **evidence-based approaches like
exercise therapy and manual therapy. **We also utilize technologies to help assist with your
recovery, including ultrasound and laser-assisted pain relief to help speed the healing process as
required.

Our [physical therapist][67] will design a recovery program with you to help target your issues and
achieve your goal. All of our physios hold a graduate degree and are **certified by the College of
Physical Therapists of BC**, as well as **members of the Physiotherapy Association of BC and the
Canadian Physiotherapy Association.**

Contact Us

## Services provided at our physiotherapy in Langley, BC

#### Our Services

Post-graduate education in physical therapy enables us to assist you in treating a wide range of
health and wellness conditions. Some of the conditions we can address include:
* [Pelvic Floor Physiotherapy][68]
* [Orthopedic Physiotherapy][69]
* [Neurological Physiotherapy][70]
* [Manual Therapy][71]
* [Vertigo Treatment and Vestibular Rehabilitation][72]
* [Sports Physiotherapy][73]
* Pre and [Post-Surgical Rehabilitation][74]
* [Laser Therapy][75]
* [Shockwave Therapy][76]
* [Posture Correction][77]
* [Telehealth][78]

Contact Us

### Our physiotherapist use their in-depth knowledge to
* Improve your range of motion
* Reduce muscle tension
* Increase your strength and endurance.
* Ease your pain
* Correct your posture
* Improve your balance and mobility
* For Injury prevention

### Utilizing diverse expertise in physiotherapy we address a wide range of conditions

We are dedicated to improving our patient’s health and well-being, and we are delighted to provide
our Fraser valley community with physio treatment that has helped many people restore their health.
We want to ensure that everyone has access to our expertise, so we have a platform that offers a
range of services.

At Opal Physio center, we have a team of physiotherapists with diverse skills. Although all of our
therapists can diagnose and treat many [musculoskeletal conditions][79], each of our therapists has
their specialization. Our team comprises of therapists who have taken post-graduate courses and have
excellent experience in their fields.

Learn More about the [conditions treated][80] in our physical therapy centre.

Our physiotherapists use manual therapy techniques on muscles, joints, and soft tissues to reduce
muscle spasms and pain and improve mobility. They can also advise patients on how to avoid injury or
prevent re-injury by advising them about appropriate exercises, stretches, posture and work
positioning.

## Physiotherapy can help to maintain, restore and promote good health.

Physiotherapy is an integral part of the rehabilitation process for people who are recovering from
injury or surgery. It can also help people with persistent pain, and other chronic conditions work
collaboratively with therapists and empower the clients to manage the symptoms independently.

Contact Us

## Trust our Langley Physiotherapy Clinic

## Your recovery is in good hands!

### We understand that everyone is unique!

If you have been diagnosed with a condition, we understand that your symptoms could be different
from another person, and we strive to provide you with the best treatment which can specifically
target these symptoms.

At Opal physio, during your initial appointment, we focus on detailed assessment, which will help us
diagnose your condition based on clinical reasoning. We review your clinical findings and can
prescribe a comprehensive rehabilitation plan.

### Managing a wide range of pain conditions: Our experience and expertise

# Registered Massage Therapist in Langley | RMT in Langley

We’re pleased to provide **registered massage therapy (RMT) services in Langley** at Opal
Physiotherapy and Health Clinic. This specialized service caters to various health and wellness
needs of clients. Our registered massage therapists are committed to promoting your overall health
through the healing power of touch.

## Meet our massage therapists in Langley.

Our highly skilled and **certified massage therapists** specialize in various areas, ensuring that
we can provide the right care for your unique needs. Our therapists are registered and trained to
offer personalized treatments, making your wellness journey our top priority.

Contact Us

## What is registered massage therapy (RMT)?

Registered Massage Therapy (RMT) refers to massage therapy performed by a registered massage
therapist who is licensed or certified to practice massage professionally. RMTs are highly trained
healthcare practitioners who manipulate the body’s soft tissues to treat physical dysfunction,
injuries, pain, and disorders and promote overall health and well-being.

Learn more about [our Registered Therapist][62]

## Our massage therapy services Include
* **Senior Preventative and Rehab Care:** Tailored massage therapy to address the specific needs of
seniors, promoting mobility, preventing injuries, and supporting overall wellness.
* **Prenatal and Postnatal Care:** Gentle and nurturing RMT alleviates pregnancy-related pain and
discomfort and promotes postnatal recovery.
* **Women’s Health:** Specialized massage therapy to support [women’s health][63] concerns,
providing relief and promoting balance.
* **Migraines:** Targeted massage techniques to alleviate migraine symptoms and provide relief from
headache-related discomfort.
* **Recurring Daily Pain Issues:** Address everyday muscle discomfort and muscle tension through
***personalized massage therapy*** sessions.
* **Postural Issues:** [Target and improve postural imbalances][64] by targeting the tight muscles
to enhance overall comfort and flexibility.
* **Relaxation and Tension Issues:** Indulge in a calming massage experience designed to promote
relaxation and alleviate tension.
* **Chronic Pain:** Comprehensive massage therapy to manage and alleviate [chronic pain
conditions][65].
* **Sports Injuries:** Tailored massage techniques to aid in the recovery and prevention of
sports-related injuries.
* **Anxiety and Depression:** Holistic massage therapy to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and
support mental wellness.

## Benefits of RMT Massage

Registered massage therapy provides many benefits for both physical and mental health:
* [Relieves muscle tension][66], spasms and pain.
* Improves joint mobility and range of motion.
* Enhances circulation and lymphatic drainage.
* Reduces stress, anxiety, and depression.
* Promotes relaxation and sleep quality.
* Speeds recovery from injuries.
* Improves posture and body mechanics.

RMTs use several techniques to address issues like back/neck pain, headaches, arthritis,
fibromyalgia, sports injuries, and more. Massage can also be used as part of treatment plans for
various chronic illnesses.

## Choosing an RMT

When selecting a registered massage therapist, look for one who is licensed and insured.
* Ask about their training, experience, and specialties.
* Make sure you feel comfortable with them.
* RMT treatments should be customized to your needs through assessment, consultation, and feedback.
* A good RMT will provide aftercare instructions as well.

Regular massage therapy from a *qualified RMT* can be highly beneficial for overall health and
comfort.

# Dry Needling In Langley | IMS | Intramuscular Stimulation

Discover the power of precision healing with our **dry needling and Intramuscular Stimulation
(IMS)** treatments in Langley!

At Opal Physio, we’re revolutionizing pain **relief and muscle recovery** using these cutting-edge
techniques. Imagine melting away tension, easing chronic pain, and unlocking your body’s natural
healing potential – all with the gentle insertion of ultra-thin needles.

Whether you’re an athlete looking to **enhance performance** or someone seeking **relief from
stubborn aches**, our expert physiotherapists are ready to tailor this innovative treatment to your
unique needs.

Say goodbye to persistent discomfort and hello to a new level of wellness. It’s time to experience
the transformative effects of dry needling and IMS for yourself!

# Dry needling / intramuscular stimulation (IMS) at Opal

At Opal Physio, we proudly offer dry needling in Langley as part of our comprehensive physiotherapy
services. These specialized techniques can provide significant pain relief and improved function for
many of our patients dealing with chronic muscle pain, tension, and dysfunction.

Contact Us

## What is dry needling / IMS?

Dry needling, also known as intramuscular stimulation (IMS), is an evidence-based treatment
technique used by specially trained physiotherapists to **treat myofascial pain and muscle
tension**. It involves inserting thin, sterile acupuncture needles into specific trigger points or
tight bands within muscles to elicit a therapeutic response.

While IMS **uses similar needles to acupuncture**, it is based on Western medicine principles and
scientific research rather than traditional Chinese medicine. The goal is to target neuromuscular
dysfunction and stimulate a healing response in the affected tissues.

## How does dry needling work?

When a needle is inserted into a trigger point or tight band of muscle tissue, it can elicit a local
twitch response – a brief, involuntary contraction of the muscle fibres. This twitch response is
associated with various therapeutic effects:
* Increased blood flow to the area
* Release of endogenous opioids and other pain-relieving chemicals
* Decreased muscle tension and knots
* Improved nerve function and communication
* Stimulation of the body’s natural healing processes

The needle insertion creates a small, controlled lesion that triggers the body to increase
circulation and initiate tissue repair. This can help reset dysfunctional muscle tissue and restore
normal function.

## Conditions treated with dry needling / Intramuscular Stimulation

Dry needling and IMS can be effective for treating a wide range of musculoskeletal conditions,
including:
* Chronic [neck pain][62] and [back pain][63]
* [Shoulder impingement][64] and rotator cuff issues
* [Hip pain][65] and [knee pain][66]
* [Plantar fasciitis][67]
* Tension [headaches][68]
* [Muscle strains and spasms][69]
* [Myofascial pain syndrome][70]
* [Fibromyalgia][71]
* [Tendinopathies][72]

It can also be beneficial for improving overall muscle function, flexibility, and range of motion.

## What to expect during treatment?

**Initial assessment:** Before beginning dry needling treatment, your physiotherapist will
thoroughly assess whether this technique is appropriate for your condition. They will review your
medical history and evaluate your muscle function, movement patterns, and areas of pain or
dysfunction.

**Treatment session:** During the dry needling session, you will be positioned comfortably on a
treatment table. Your physiotherapist will use palpation skills to locate the specific trigger
points or tight muscle bands to be treated. They will then insert thin, sterile needles into these
areas.

You may feel a slight prick as the needle penetrates the skin, followed by a deep ache, muscle
twitch, or cramping sensation as it reaches the trigger point. These sensations are normal and
indicate that the treatment is targeting the correct areas.

The needles may be left in place for a short time (30 seconds to a few minutes) or manipulated
gently to elicit the desired response. Depending on your condition, your physiotherapist may treat
multiple points during a single session.

**Post-treatment:** After the needles are removed, your physiotherapist may perform additional
manual therapy techniques or prescribe exercises to complement the dry needling treatment. You may
experience some muscle soreness for 24-48 hours following treatment, similar to the feeling after an
intense workout. This is a normal response and usually resolves quickly.

## Benefits of dry needling / IMS

Dry needling and IMS treatment offer several potential benefits for patients:
* Rapid pain relief
* Improved muscle function and flexibility
* Increased range of motion
* Decreased muscle tension and knots
* Enhanced blood flow and tissue healing
* Reduced chronic inflammation
* Improved nerve function
* Complementary to other physiotherapy treatments

Many patients experience improvements in pain and mobility following dry needling treatment.
However, depending on the chronicity and severity of the condition, the full effects may take
several sessions to achieve.

## Safety and side effects

Dry needling is generally considered a safe treatment when performed by a qualified practitioner.
Our physiotherapists have undergone extensive training in IMS techniques and anatomy to ensure safe
and effective treatment.

Common side effects may include:
* Temporary soreness or bruising at the needle insertion sites
* Fatigue or lightheadedness
* Minor bleeding or bruising

Serious complications, including infection or injury to blood vessels or nerves, are rare. Our
therapists take all necessary precautions to minimize these risks.

## Is dry needling / IMS right for you?

Dry needling can be an excellent treatment option for many patients, but it may not be appropriate
for everyone. It is contraindicated in certain conditions, including:
* Acute inflammation
* Bleeding disorders or use of blood thinners
* Compromised immune system
* Local skin infections or lesions
* Lymphedema
* Needle phobia
* Pregnancy
* Vascular disease

During your initial assessment, your physiotherapist will determine if IMS is a suitable treatment
option based on your condition and medical history.

## Combining dry needling with other treatments

At Opal Physio, we believe in providing comprehensive, individualized care to our patients. Dry
needling is often most effective when combined with other physiotherapy treatments and modalities,
such as:
* [Manual therapy techniques][73]
* [Therapeutic exercise][74]
* Joint mobilization or manipulation
* [Postural education and ergonomic advice][75]
* Taping or bracing
* [Shockwave][76], [low-level laser therapy][77] or ultrasound therapy

Your physiotherapist will develop a personalized treatment plan that may incorporate IMS and other
appropriate interventions to address your specific needs and goals.

## Our expertise in dry needling

Our physiotherapists have received specialized training in dry needling techniques, allowing us to
offer this advanced treatment option to our patients. We stay up-to-date with the latest research
and best practices in dry needling to ensure we provide the highest quality care.

## Getting started with IMS In Langley

If you’re looking for dry needling near me and are interested in exploring whether dry needling or
IMS treatment could benefit your condition, we encourage you to schedule an initial assessment with
one of our experienced physiotherapists. During this appointment, we’ll evaluate your condition,
discuss your treatment options, and determine if [dry needling][78] is appropriate for your
rehabilitation plan.

Don’t let chronic pain or muscle dysfunction hold you back any longer. Contact Opal Physio today to
learn more about how dry needling in Langley can help you achieve your health and wellness goals.

# **Shockwave Therapy **in Langley

At Opal Physio, we offer the latest and most effective treatments to help our patients achieve
optimal health and wellness. One of the advanced therapeutic services we provide is Shockwave
Therapy. This non-invasive treatment has been proven to accelerate healing, reduce pain, and improve
mobility for various musculoskeletal conditions.

Contact Us

## What is Shockwave Therapy?

**Shockwave Therapy (SWT)**, also known as **Extracorporeal Shockwave Therapy (ESWT)**, Radial Shock
Wave Therapy (RSWT) or Pressure Wave Therapy, uses acoustic waves to deliver high-energy sound waves
to injured tissues in the body at cellular levels. These waves stimulate the repair and regeneration
of bones, tendons, and other soft tissues.

## How Does Shockwave Therapy Work?

Shockwave Therapy is a noninvasive treatment that delivers acoustic waves which induce mechanical
stress, creating microtrauma (controlled damage) in the targeted tissues. This microtrauma
stimulates the body’s natural healing processes by increasing blood flow, promoting the formation of
new lymphatic vessels, and enhancing collagen production. The overall effect is accelerated tissue
repair and reduced inflammation.

## Therapeutic Effects of Shock Wave Therapy

**Tissue regeneration:** Shock wave therapy promotes tissue regeneration by stimulating cell growth
and repair mechanisms. The high-energy sound waves that pass through the patient’s body enhance
blood circulation and trigger the release of growth factors and stem cells, which aid in repairing
and regenerating damaged tissues. This is particularly beneficial in treating tendonitis, ligament
injuries, and fracture healing.

**Elimination of calcification**: SWT effectively breaks down calcifications, particularly in
conditions like calcific tendonitis of the shoulder. The shock wave triggers the growth of new blood
vessels and aids in fragmenting the calcium deposits, which are then reabsorbed by the body,
reducing pain and restoring normal function to the affected area.

**Pain relief**: Pain relief is one of the most considerable benefits of shock wave therapy. The
mechanism involves reducing the transmission of pain signals in the nerve fibres, desensitizing
nerve endings, and subsiding inflammation. The shockwave decreases the substance P levels,
responsible for pain transmission, providing long-lasting relief. The treatment also stimulates the
production of endorphins and enkephalins, natural painkillers produced by the body, providing
immediate and long-term relief from chronic pain conditions.

**Muscle relaxation**: SWT promotes muscle relaxation by reducing muscle tone and tension. The
mechanical energy from the shock waves disrupts the hypertonic muscle fibers, reducing local
ischemia and increasing blood flow, allowing connective tissues to relax and restore normal
function. This effect is beneficial in treating muscle spasms and tension-related pain.

**Chronic inflammation reversal**: SWT effectively addresses chronic inflammation by reducing
inflammatory mediators and promoting the release of anti-inflammatory substances. SWT helps resolve
chronic inflammation and its associated symptoms by improving blood flow and stimulating cellular
repair.

The combined effects make shock wave therapy a versatile treatment for most musculoskeletal
disorders.

## Benefits of Shockwave Therapy

Extracorporeal Shockwave therapy offers numerous other benefits for treating various medical
conditions. Here are some other key advantages:
* **Non-invasive treatment:** SWT offers a non-surgical treatment approach, reducing the risk of
complications and recuperation time associated with invasive procedures.
* **Quick and effective:** Most treatments are completed within 20 minutes, and patients often
experience significant pain relief after just a few sessions.
* **Minimal side effects:** There are few side effects, and most patients experience only temporary
discomfort or redness at the treatment site during the procedure and are generally well-tolerated.
* **Accelerated healing: **This treatment speeds up the healing process for soft tissue injuries,
bone fractures, and chronic pain. It promotes faster recovery and return to regular daily
activities.
* **Versatile application:** Effective for various conditions, including tendinopathies, plantar
fasciitis, epicondylitis, and more.
* **High success rates:** Proven efficacy in numerous clinical studies for various conditions.
Provides sustainable relief and improvement in function, reducing the need for repeated
treatments.
* **Enhanced quality of life:** It improves mobility by reducing pain, increasing the ability to
perform physical activities, and leading to a better overall quality of life for patients.

## Conditions Treated with Shockwave Therapy

Shockwave Therapy is effective in treating a wide range of chronic conditions, including:
* **Plantar Fasciitis:** Inflammation of the [plantar fascia][62], the thick band of tissue running
across the bottom of the foot.
* **Tennis Elbow (****Lateral epicondylitis****/Lateral Epicondylalgia):** Pain and inflammation on
the outer part of the elbow.
* **Calcific Tendinopathy****:** Calcium deposits in tendons, often in the shoulder.
* **Achilles Tendonopathy****:** Inflammation of the Achilles tendon.
* **Patellar Tendonitis (Jumper’s Knee):** Inflammation of the patellar tendon.
* **Myofascial Pain Syndrome****:** Chronic pain in muscles and soft tissues.
* **Trigger Points:** Localized areas of muscle tightness.
* **Hip Bursitis:** Inflammation of the bursa in the hip.
* **Stress Fractures:** Small cracks in bones caused by repetitive force.
* **Chronic Pain**** Conditions:** Various other chronic musculoskeletal pain conditions.
* **Heel Spur**: Bony calcaneal growths in the heel
* **De Quervain Tenosynovitis**: A condition caused by overuse injury to the thumb and wrist tendons
* **Knee** **Ligament Injuries**: Ligaments can be injured in the knee after a fall or twisting
during sports, work, or any regular activity.
* **Whiplash Associated Disorder (WAD): **[Whiplash injury][63] is caused by forceful movement of
the neck during car accidents, any trauma, and sports. This can cause neck pain, headache, reduced
movements and muscle tightness in the neck.
* **Carpal Tunnel Syndrome:** The median nerve gets compressed by the surrounding tissues, causing
inflammation and leading to pain, numbness and tingling of the hand and wrist

## What to Expect During a Shockwave Therapy Session?

When you go for a shockwave treatment session, you can expect a non-invasive treatment that uses
high-energy acoustic waves to help alleviate pain and promote healing in various musculoskeletal
conditions. the procedure is as follows:

### Initial Consultation:
* **Assessment and diagnosis:** Your physiotherapist will assess your condition, review your medical
history, and determine if shock wave therapy is appropriate for you.

### Preparation:
* **Explanation of procedure: **The therapist will explain the procedure, its benefits, and what to
expect during and after the treatment.
* **Positioning:** You will be positioned comfortably, often lying down or sitting, depending on the
area treated.

### Treatment Session:
* **Application of gel:** A special conductive gel is applied to the treatment area to ensure
efficient transmission of the shock waves.
* **Clinical application of Shock Waves**: The therapist uses a handheld device to deliver shock
waves to the targeted area. The device is moved over the treatment area in a controlled manner.
* **Sensations:** You may feel a tapping or pulsating sensation. The intensity can be adjusted based
on your comfort level. Some discomfort may occur, but it should not be painful.

### Duration:
* **Treatment session length:** Each session typically lasts 15 to 30 minutes, depending on the
condition being treated.

### Post-Treatment:
* **Immediate aftercare:** The therapist may provide advice on managing any temporary discomfort or
swelling.
* **Activity recommendations:** You may be advised to avoid strenuous activities for a short period
after the session.

### Follow-Up
* **Scheduled sessions:** A course of multiple sessions (usually 6=8) is often recommended for
optimal results.
* **Progress monitoring:** The therapist will monitor your progress and adjust the treatment plan as
needed.

### Side Effects
* **Side effects:** Expect possible mild redness, swelling, or bruising at the treatment site, which
typically resolves quickly.

By understanding these steps, you can approach your shock wave therapy sessions with confidence and
a clear expectation of the process and its benefits.

# Active Rehab Services In Langley (Including ICBC Insured)

## Regain your mobility, strength, and confidence with Active Rehab Services including clients
## insured by ICBC

Have you been in a motor vehicle accident and are suffering from pain, discomfort, stiffness and
other symptoms? You may also be experiencing emotional distress due to the impact of your injuries
on your life. The Active Rehab Services offered by kinesiologists can help reduce anxiety about pain
and movements and get you back to your normal activities and tasks as quickly as possible also for
people insured with ICBC.

**Achieve your physical rehabilitation goals with a kinesiologist.**

### Get back to the life you love

Book an appointment today

Contact Us

## How do the MVA Active Rehab Services work for clients insured by ICBC?

After a motor vehicle accident, you may be referred to an ICBC-approved kinesiologist for
rehabilitation. This MVA active rehab service is available after your accident and can be accessed
through your ICBC claim adjuster.

[Certified Kinesiologists][62] offer Active Rehabilitation after a motor vehicle accident for people
insured by ICBC to help recover from their injuries.

## What can you expect from Active Rehab Services for the ICBC insured?

Active Rehab Services for people insured with ICBC with Kinesiologist will provide a comprehensive
assessment of your physical condition to create an individualized rehabilitation plan based on your
current level of function, limitations and the type of injury you sustained. Our services include
one-on-one sessions focusing on improving mobility, strength, and overall physical health. In
addition, kinesiologists provide support and guidance throughout your rehabilitation journey.

Our kinesiologist will work with you to improve your range of motion, strength and balance so that
you can safely return to daily tasks after an MVA. They also provide education on performing
everyday tasks safely and ergonomically and individualized home exercise programs designed just for
you.

Learn more about our [Strength Training In Langley][63]

## What does Kinesiology Active Rehab sessions involve?

Kinesiology [active rehab][64] sessions involve a combination of exercises, stretches and movement
patterns that are designed to improve your overall flexibility and strength. These exercises are
based on your specific goals and requirements, which are discussed with you before the therapy
sessions.

As part of the session, you will be asked to perform specific exercises designed to help improve
your range of motion and posture while strengthening your body’s core and weak areas. The goal is to
help you achieve more freedom of movement in your joints, muscles and tendons so that they can
function correctly.

Contact Us

## Benefits of Active Rehab Services

Our Kinesiology services provide many benefits, which include the following:
* Pain relief
* Improved physical performance and function
* Increased strength and flexibility
* Improved mobility.
* Offer support and guidance throughout the recovery process, so you can stay focused on achieving
your rehabilitation goals.
* Guidance to return to the activities you enjoy as quickly and safely as possible.

Active Rehab Services for ICBC insured people aims to restore ROM, strength, flexibility and balance
so that you can return to work or school without pain or discomfort. The program may also include
exercises that help reduce anxiety related to your injury and movements.

If you’ve been injured in a car accident, imagining a future where you can do the things you love

get back on your feet and start living your life again.

# Physiatry Services

## Pain Management & Physical Rehabilitation Specialist in Langley, BC

## Physiatry

Physiatry is the branch of medicine that integrates the knowledge of neurology, orthopedics,
physical therapy, rehabilitation medicine, psychiatry and psychology for the rehabilitation of
people with functional limitations due to chronic or acute pain, illness or injury.

Physiatry Langley

## Physiatrist

A physiatrist is a medical specialty doctor who focuses on preventing, diagnosing, and treating
physical disorders and injuries, especially those that affect the musculoskeletal system and spine.
It also utilizes physical therapy, exercise, and other rehabilitative techniques to improve
mobility, relieve pain, reduce or prevent muscle spasms, and promote general health and wellness.

## Advantages of physiatry services:
* Physiatry is a form of rehabilitative care that helps the patient recover from an injury or
illness more quickly.
* Physiatrist also helps people with chronic pain to manage their discomfort so that they can lead
an active life without any restrictions.
* Physiatry services also provide support and guidance to effectively help them cope with their
condition.

Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation – Langley

## Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

**Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation** practice include assessing and treating neurological and
musculoskeletal diseases such as spinal cord injuries, traumatic brain injuries, stroke, and
degenerative neurologic conditions, including multiple sclerosis, amputations, and chronic pain.

We at Opal have Physiatrist [Dr. Lawrence Kei][62] to provide physiatry services to people in the
Fraser Valley region. He can now provide outpatient **Physiatry** services at Opal Physiotherapy and
Health Clinic. He is a medical specialist who aims to make Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation
(PM&R) accessible to Langley and surrounding communities.

A significant component of his physiatry practice involves using ultrasound for interventions,
including
* corticosteroid injections
* nerve blocks
* trigger point injections
* percutaneous needle tenotomy
* spasticity.

Physiatrist Langley BC

## Frequently asked questions on physiatry

### 1. What is physical medicine and rehabilitation?

Physical medicine and rehabilitation physicians, also widely recognized as Physiatrists, are medical
specialty doctors specializing in assessing and treating patients suffering from pain and functional
impairments.

Physiatry employs a comprehensive, multifaceted approach to care that considers how a patient’s
medical condition impacts all parts of their life, including their role at work, at home, and in
their regular activities.

A **Physiatrist** can help a person’s functional abilities by providing medical treatment and
reducing the need for surgery. They integrate a rehabilitation program that includes physical,
occupational, speech therapies, psychological, prosthetic, orthotic, and vocational services.

A PM&R specialist diagnoses diseases, develop treatment plans and provide prescriptions for
medicines. Their primary focus is improving the overall quality of life. To that aim, they treat
patients as a whole rather than simply a single area of the body. The ultimate objective is to
return patients to their usual daily activities or the best degree of performance that they can,
despite their limitations.

In addition, they may prescribe additional treatments such as [physiotherapy][63], massage therapy,
electrotherapy, prescription braces, and other assistive equipment depending on the patient’s
requirement.

### 2. What kind of treatment does a physiatrist provide?

Diagnostic tests and treatments performed and prescribed by **PM&R** specialists include:
* Musculoskeletal ultrasound
* Prosthetics/orthotics
* Pain medications
* Spine injections
* Interventional spinal therapeutics
* Soft tissue injections
* Joint injections
* Spasticity management
* Interventional spinal therapeutics

### 3. When should you see a physiatrist?

Whether your pain or discomfort originates from neurological injury, chronic health disorders,
ageing-related mobility challenges, or short-term pain after an injury, physiatrists develop a
treatment plan to improve your quality of life.

If you experience any of the following issues, you should visit a physiatrist:
* You have an injury, disease, or disability or have had previous treatments for a disease that has
left you with restricted physical functioning and discomfort.
* You’re thinking about having surgery to relieve persistent pain or discomfort.
* Have a stroke or other neurological injury that has limited your physical functioning.
* You have persistent back pain, neck discomfort, pain from a repetitive stress injury, or chronic
arthritic pain.

### 4. What procedures do physiatrists follow?

A pain specialist can determine the source of pain and provide pain management and treatment to
assist a patient in regaining mobility and function.

For this, the rehabilitation specialist looks at the entire body, not just one problem region, and
puts together a therapy plan to maximize care and rehabilitation.

### 5. What conditions can a physical medicine and rehabilitation specialist treat?

The specialist may focus on one or more of the following areas, depending on the cause of the
problem. They diagnose and can treat a wide range of patients suffering from a variety of disorders,
including:
* Treating pain or mobility issues arising from a spinal cord injury, traumatic brain injury,
stroke, Parkinson’s disease, Multiple sclerosis, Guillain-Barre syndrome etc.
* Chronic pain conditions
* Symptoms of autoimmune diseases like rheumatoid arthritis
* Tendonitis, stress fractures, and concussions
* Post-operative care after joint replacement, organ transplant, and heart surgery
* Sports injuries
* Arthritis
* Carpal tunnel syndrome
* Herniated disc
* A pinched nerve in the neck or back
* Sciatica
* Fibromyalgia
* [Work Injuries][64]
* Amputation
* Cancer rehabilitation
* Pelvic floor disorders
* [Myofascial pain][65]

### 6. Do physiatrists see patients of all ages?

Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation specialist have a wide range of medical skills to treat
patients with various pain-causing illnesses that can arise at any age.

### 7. Can a Physiatrist do pediatric rehabilitation*?*

A Pediatric Rehabilitation Medicine physiatrist employs an interdisciplinary approach to preventing,
diagnosing, treating, and managing congenital and childhood-onset physical disabilities. They can
identify functional capacities, select appropriate rehabilitation intervention techniques, and
comprehend the continuum of care throughout the disability.

### 8. How do physiatrists diagnose patients?

Pain specialist employs procedures such as electrodiagnostic medicine and nerve conduction tests in
addition to the standard diagnostic tools (physical examinations, imaging studies, and clinical
history)—these highly specialized diagnostic techniques aid physiatrists in the diagnosis of
disorders that cause pain and disability.

### 9. How do physiatrists differ from a physiotherapist?

The important distinction between a physiatrist and a physiotherapist is that a physiatrist has a
medical degree. Thus, a physiatrist is a qualified, board-certified physician who has finished
medical school, internship and residency.

Physiatrists have more comprehensive training allowing them to have a deeper understanding of the
structure and function of the human body. They also comprehend how the neurological, cardiovascular,
and other systems interact with the musculoskeletal system.

A physiotherapist acquires certification after completing a post-graduate degree in physiotherapy.

### 10. Is a referral required to book an appointment with physiatry specialist?

Yes, seeing a physiatrist / [PM&R][66] Specialist requires a referral from your primary care
physician, who is best qualified to assess your need for this specialty.

# Strength Training In Langley

## Strength training by kinesiologist

### Gain a strong body and improve health with strength training from a kinesiologist whether you
### have a previous injury or want to get fit.

Kinesiologist can help you devise a safe, effective strength training program. In addition, our
kinesiologist can help you safely start your strength and conditioning program after an injury or
surgery.

#### Get personalized guided exercises to improve your strength and endurance.

We can help you start your strength training program in Langley today!

Contact Us

## What is strength training?

**Strength training exercises** focus on improving muscle strength and overall physical health. It
is an essential part of an exercise program.
* Strength training can be performed with free weights, weighted gym machines, or resistance bands.
* This can be accomplished at home with a few basic equipment or in a gym with more sophisticated
equipment.
* It helps increase muscle strength, balance, and coordination by using resistance or weights. It
also helps reduce the risk of re-injury.

## Strength training After Injury or Surgery

Strength training after an injury or surgery is a vital part of your recovery process, as it can
help you regain strength and mobility more efficiently.

**If you have recently sustained an injury or had surgery, taking the time to recover adequately
before starting any strength training is crucial.**

Learn more about our [ICBC Active Rehab Services In Langley][62]

When you have an injury, your body naturally uses its muscles to compensate for the weakness.
Unfortunately, this can lead to muscle imbalances, making future injuries more probable.

Strength exercises helps to correct these imbalances by strengthening the weak muscles and improving
their coordination with other muscles in the body.

Combining strength training with other forms of exercise helps people recover faster from surgery or
injury and allows them to return to regular activities safely and efficiently.

Contact Us

## Benefits of strength training

Strength training is an ideal way to enhance your general health and wellness. Some of the benefits
can include:
* **Reduce pain** and inflammation by improving circulation.
* Lengthen and strengthen muscles.
* Reduce the risk of injury.
* Prevent further injury by strengthening the muscles, and connective tissues weakened by injury.
* [Improve posture][63], balance and coordination, which is essential for preventing falls and
injuries.
* Help regain mobility and flexibility.
* Strength training can help you **build your muscles** so they’re stronger and can handle the
stresses of day-to-day life.
* Improves ability to perform daily tasks and enables you to preserve your functional strength and
independence as you age.
* **Boost metabolism**.
* It also helps increase bone density, reducing osteoporosis risk.
* Lowers stress levels by increasing blood flow throughout the body, releasing endorphins, and
promoting relaxation.

## How can kinesiologists Help?

If you have been injured and need help getting back on your feet, have had surgery and require
[active rehabilitation][64], or are trying to start fitness training, a [kinesiologist can
help][65].
* They can help you develop a **strength training program** to serve your requirements and goals.
* They can also guide how to strengthen muscles weakened by injury or surgery so that they can work
appropriately during your daily tasks. They can also teach you exercises that will **improve your
range of motion** to reduce pain and discomfort while helping your body recover.
* A kinesiologist can also help you develop a strength training program to help you reach your goals
safely and effectively.
* A Kinesiologist will consider your age, gender, physical abilities and any medical conditions you
may have when designing your [strength training][66] program. They will also consider what
equipment you have access to at home or work so that they can maximize its use in your exercises.
* A Kinesiologist will teach you how to use proper form when performing each exercise so that you do
not put undue stress on any joints or muscles while working out. They also know which activities
and exercises are best suited for each body type so as not to cause injury while trying different
exercises out on yourself!

## Start your strength training program today

If you have had an injury or just getting started with strength training and looking for tips on how
to begin strengthening, consult our kinesiologist.

### Don’t wait to improve your health – get started with strength training today!

Contact us now and start your strength training program with a kinesiologist.

# Treanna Skoda – Registered Massage Therapist

Treanna Skoda

## About Treanna Skoda – RMT

Treanna Skoda is a dedicated Registered Massage Therapist (RMT) Joining the team of healthcare
professionals at Opal Physiotherapy and Health Clinic. With 13 years of experience in the field,
Treanna brings a wealth of knowledge and expertise to her practice.

## Education and Background

Treanna Skoda graduated from the prestigious West Coast College of Massage Therapy in 2010, where
she received comprehensive training in various massage techniques and therapeutic practices. Since
then, she has been committed to continuously expanding her skills and staying up-to-date with the
latest advancements in the field.

Learn more about our [massage therapy][62] services.

## Passion for Health and Wellness

Treanna is deeply passionate about both physical and mental health. She is fascinated by the
intricacies of the human body and firmly believes that movement is the key to leading a happy and
healthy life. Her ultimate goal is to help individuals understand their bodies better, enabling them
to move through their day with improved functionality and reduced pain.

## Empowering Through Knowledge

Treanna firmly believes in empowering her clients with knowledge. She understands that education
plays a vital role in any healthcare service. She helps her clients make informed decisions about
their health and well-being by providing them with a deeper understanding of their bodies.

## Areas of Expertise

Treanna has extensive experience in caring for clients with various needs and conditions. Her areas
of expertise include:
* Senior preventative and rehab care
* Prenatal and postnatal care
* Women’s Health
* Migraines
* Recurring daily pain issues
* Postural issues
* Relaxation and tension issues
* Chronic pain
* Sports injuries
* Anxiety and depression

## Extended Medical Benefits

If you have an extended medical plan, you may be eligible to claim RMT treatments through your
extended medical benefits, which can cover partial to full reimbursement, up to a certain amount
each year.

You can schedule an appointment with Treanna Skoda at Opal Physiotherapy and Health Clinic, where
she will provide personalized care tailored to your specific needs.

# Ben Unsworth

## About Ben Unsworth

Ben is a Registered Kinesiologist with the British Columbia Association of Kinesiologists (BCAK) and
graduated from Simon Fraser University with a Bachelor of Science degree in [Kinesiology][62].

He specializes in rehabilitation and helping individuals regain their health post-accidents. He’s
passionate about promoting functional strength and mobility, inspiring clients to achieve their
fitness goals.

Ben, a Registered Kinesiologist and an active member of the British Columbia Association of
Kinesiologists (BCAK), holds a bachelor’s degree from Simon Fraser University and bears
certification in Kinetic Link Training geared towards rehabilitation.

With his specialized expertise, he has guided numerous individuals recovering from motor vehicle
accidents back to health, enabling them to embrace their regular routines feeling revitalized.

Being a swimming coach since 2016 gives Ben an added edge in offering unique aquatic therapy
options. He champions functional strength and managed mobility during the rehab process to mitigate
pain and forestall future injuries.

His dedication to helping his clients move effortlessly and confidently fuels his passion for
inducing individuals towards pursuing their fitness objectives and attaining sustainable results.

When not working, Ben is an avid sports enthusiast. Volleyball, racquet sports, swimming, or
snowboarding—you can find him engaged in any of these activities during his leisure time.

Learn More About Our [Kinesiology Services In Langley][63].

# Dr. Lawrence Kei – Physiatrist

Dr. Lawrence Kei

## About Dr. Lawrence Kei

Dr. Lawrence Kei is a specialist in **Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation** (PM&R). He completed
his medical degree at the University of British Columbia medical school in 2014 and his residency in
PM&R at the University of British Columbia (UBC) in 2019. He is a Fellow of the Royal College of
Physicians and Surgeons of Canada in PM&R.

His [Physiatry][62] practice includes the assessment and treatment of patients with neurologic and
musculoskeletal disorders such as spinal cord injuries, traumatic brain injuries, stroke, and
degenerative neurologic conditions such as multiple sclerosis, amputations, and chronic pain. A
large component of his practice involves using ultrasound for interventions, including
corticosteroid injections, nerve blocks, trigger point injections, percutaneous needle tenotomy, and
spasticity.

He holds an academic position as a clinical instructor at the University of British Columbia
([UBC][63]) Department of Medicine and is actively involved in the training of residents from the
University of British Columbia and the University of Alberta.

He also currently practices at New Westminster Rehabilitation Medicine as well as Body Restoration
in Edmonton, Alberta. He is excited to work in a team environment at Opal Physiotherapy and Health
Clinic, Langley, to provide the best care possible.

# Cynthia Pathipati – Registered Physiotherapist

**Cynthia Pathipati**

## About Cynthia Pathipati – PT

[Cynthia Pathipati][62] completed her bachelor’s in physiotherapy and is a qualified Registered
Physiotherapist in good standing with the College of Physiotherapists of BC with more than 15 yrs of
experience. She is knowledgeable and caring and has built her career as a physiotherapist working in
Public health settings and private clinics, helping individuals overcome pain and regain their
active lifestyles.

### Post-Graduate Credentials and Certifications

#### Orthopaedics
* Lumbopelvic Complex
* Cervico-Thoracic Complex
* Upper Extremity and Lower Extremity Complex
* The McKenzie MDT Certification Program Levels A,B, C D

#### Pelvic Health
* Level I: Physical Therapy approach To Female and Male Urinary Incontinence.
* Level II: Female and male pelvic pain
* Level III: Pelvic Girdle Pain and Pelvic Floor
* Pregnancy and Pelvic Floor
* Mobilization of Visceral Fascia for pelvic Dysfunction – Urinary System
* Integrated Systems Model for Treating Women’s Health
* Pediatric Incontinence and Pelvic Floor Dysfunction
* Pelvic Floor Dysfunction in Female Athletes
* Manual Assessment and Treatment of Nerve Dysfunction in Pelvic Pain.

#### Neurological
* Manual Therapy Techniques for Adults with Neurological Impairments – Lower Quadrant
* Bobath basic and advanced level courses
* BPPV-Vestibular Rehabilitation – Assessment and management
* BPPV – Beyond the Basics

#### Memberships
* Canadian Physiotherapy Association (CPA)
* Women’s Health Division of CPA
* Physiotherapy Association of British Columbia (PABC)
* College of Physical Therapists of British Columbia (CPTBC)
* Canadian Society of Pelvic Medicine (CSPM)
* International Urogynecological Association (IUGA)

Cynthia pursued her passion for physiotherapy further by attending professional courses in
Orthopedics and advancing her skills through various post-graduate training. She has done several
courses in Orthopedics with mechanical diagnosis and treatment by The McKenzie Institute of Canada,
The Institute of Advanced Physiotherapy Education and courses in manual therapy.

With a strong foundation in musculoskeletal physiotherapy, specialized knowledge in pelvic floor
physiotherapy, and a special interest in neurological physiotherapy, Cynthia is dedicated to
providing compassionate care tailored to each individual’s unique needs.

Cynthia, along with upkeeping her skills in [orthopedic physiotherapy][63], developed a special
interest in [Pelvic floor health][64] and has completed advanced-level courses in the management
of Pelvic floor dysfunction for both men and women. She is passionate about bringing the
latest research into everyday practice and increasing general awareness of pelvic health issues in
the community.

She integrates internal and external pelvic floor physiotherapy assessment, treatment and management
techniques to provide clients with a specific, evidence-based recovery program.

Cynthia is also trained in the ‘Bobath Concept’ treatment approach for adults with [neurological
disorders][65] and can provide treatment services to clients affected by neurological injury and in
helping rehabilitate patients post-acquired brain injury/ stroke to restore their abilities to their
full potential.

She is [passionate about empowering her clients][66] to take control of their health, be actively
involved in their rehabilitation, and enable them to reach their rehab goals. This motivated her to
start Opal Physiotherapy Clinic In Langley, BC.

# About Opal Physiotherapy and Health Clinic

## Physiotherapy clinic designed to help you recover.

We are a professional and friendly multidisciplinary clinic located in central Langley. We
prioritize building strong relationships with our clients. Our clients begin as patients and end up
feeling like family. We like getting to know every individual client and are dedicated to assisting
them in developing the skills they need to achieve their physical goal and progress by providing
personalized care and guidance.

Achieving your physical goals can be challenging, but our team at our Langley clinic is here to help
you set realistic targets and make real progress. Our professional, welcoming, and family-friendly
atmosphere makes it the perfect place to start your journey toward a healthier and more fit
lifestyle.

Contact Us

## We are here to help

Opal Physiotherapy and Health Clinic was started with a passion and commitment to offering a
complete approach to injury management, prevention and recovery.

Our clinic offers a variety of [services in physiotherapy][62], including; [neurological][63],
[pelvic health therapy][64], [orthopedic rehabilitation][65], vestibular rehabilitation,
musculoskeletal physiotherapy and sports injury rehabilitation.

We also offer active rehabilitation and Kinesiology personal training services to help with your
injury recovery and any exercise needs. We also are proud to offer [Physiatry services][66] at our
clinic to help patients recover from pain and injury.

Our professionals have undergone extensive training and have experience and knowledge in their field
of interest to provide service.

We at Opal Physio are passionate about helping our clients improve physical function and quality of
life and are happy to serve the community.

Our clinic is spacious, has private rooms, is wheelchair accessible and conveniently located in the
heart of Langley.

### Our work is never complete until we meet and exceed our client’s treatment expectations.

Contact Us

## Multidisciplinary clinic designed to help clients in Langley, BC

### Our Core Values

**Respect** – It is integral to our clinic culture. We believe everyone deserves to be treated with
dignity and respect, no matter who they are or where they come from.

**Quality** – It is the guiding principle of our organization. We take pride in the fact that we
have consistently built a reputation for providing our customers with high-quality services.

**Integrity** – It is the foundation of everything we do. It’s how we treat each other, our clients,
and our colleagues. Integrity means that we always act with honesty and fairness in every situation,
and it extends to all aspects of our business.

**Commitment** – to providing best practice standards for patient care through our continuing
education and professional development.

### Our Mission

At [Opal Physiotherapy and Health Clinic][67], we offer quality health services with a one-on-one
personalized treatment approach and high-quality care to our clients. We believe every individual
deserves the best treatment possible and are committed to providing it to support them on their
journey toward wellness.

At our clinic, we prioritize the health and well-being of every client and strive to empower them to
live their best lives. Our goal is to provide the highest quality of care and support to help our
clients recover from injuries, manage chronic conditions, and improve their overall health and
function.

### Our Vision

Build a team of healthcare professionals driven by passion and performance to meet our clients’
various health and rehabilitation needs. Our foundation is built on evidence-based practice to help
our clients achieve their state of well-being.

We believe that the best outcomes are achieved when clients and professionals work together as a
team. Our vision is to provide the best possible care for our patients through a combination of
specialized services and a holistic approach to health.

Our emphasis on quality customer service makes Opal Physiotherapy and Health Clinic stand out from
other organizations. We work to deliver the highest level of clinical care in a timely manner.

We ask for feedback from our patients and use it to help us stay in focus on offering the best
clinical treatment. We ensure that our patients get the best care by comparing their clinical
outcomes to their past rehabilitation and treatment experiences.
