## Transforming Lives at Opal Physio: Expert Care for Optimal Wellness

We make a difference at our Physio Clinic by providing quality physical therapy services. Our team
is skilled, knowledgeable, and focused on client care. We will listen to you, thoroughly assess your
condition, develop a unique evidence based treatment plan that’s right for you; then guide you every
step of the way towards recovery.

### One-On-One Individualized Approach to Injury and Pain Management:

We provide One-on-one therapy offering individualized, high-quality care. Our focus is on client’s
whole-person approach to their injury. We strive to build a therapeutic alliance to make our clients
comfortable and confident during the treatment process with ongoing client engagement for best
outcomes.

We are always one step ahead in delivering the best possible care to our patients. Our registered
physiotherapists are committed to providing excellent manual therapy or, if required, on a
case-by-case treatment using modalities to help pain relief and recovery process.

### We Offer Customized Physiotherapy Treatment To Our Clients:

Physical therapists at Opal use individualized exercise prescriptions and programs to help patients
recover from injury and chronic pain. You will find that the exercise approach by our health
professional is highly customized. We help you get back to activities you enjoy with improved
mobility, flexibility and quality of life.

We also provide unique services in Pelvic Floor rehabilitation. Our registered physiotherapists have
a high level of training in managing Pelvic floor-related condition assessment and management. We
offer private and customized physical therapy sessions to our clients to help their rehabilitation
process. Our treatments are provided in private treatment rooms to maintain patient confidentiality
and comfort.

### Unique Hands-On Approach To Patients’ Pain and Conditions:

The physical therapist at Opal provides a unique hands-on manual therapy approach to treatment and
management, resulting in the most effective and efficient treatment plan for our patients. The
techniques utilized at Opalphysio allow us to get to the root cause of your problem as quickly as
possible so you can return to your life and activities with fewer symptoms and improved quality of
life.

Our highly trained therapists have extensive education in biomechanics, soft-tissue physiology,
joint mobilization and experience in providing appropriate care and injury prevention. We take pride
in providing expert care for [all conditions][90] that require physical rehabilitation and healing
utilizing new techniques and treatments.

### Evidence-Based Physiotherapy Treatment:

Our physiotherapists always provide current, improved evidence-based exercise prescription, injury
prevention and pain management techniques based on the latest developments to provide the best
possible care and pain relief.

Our physiotherapists are highly trained, experienced and have a membership with the Canadian
Physiotherapy Association and Physiotherapy Association of BC. All our Physiotherapists are licenced
with physiotherapy regulators – College of Physical Therapists of BC. We are proud to offer you an
unparalleled and excellent service

If you are searching for a physio clinic, look no further! Opal is one of the best physiotherapy
clinics in Langley, BC, providing exceptional physio services to various conditions at our location.

## Transforming Lives at Opal Physio: Expert Care for Optimal Wellness

We make a difference at our Physio Clinic by providing quality physical therapy services. Our team
is skilled, knowledgeable, and focused on client care. We will listen to you, thoroughly assess your
condition, develop a unique evidence based treatment plan that’s right for you; then guide you every
step of the way towards recovery.

### One-On-One Individualized Approach to Injury and Pain Management:

We provide One-on-one therapy offering individualized, high-quality care. Our focus is on client’s
whole-person approach to their injury. We strive to build a therapeutic alliance to make our clients
comfortable and confident during the treatment process with ongoing client engagement for best
outcomes.

We are always one step ahead in delivering the best possible care to our patients. Our registered
physiotherapists are committed to providing excellent manual therapy or, if required, on a
case-by-case treatment using modalities to help pain relief and recovery process.

### We Offer Customized Physiotherapy Treatment To Our Clients:

Physical therapists at Opal use individualized exercise prescriptions and programs to help patients
recover from injury and chronic pain. You will find that the exercise approach by our health
professional is highly customized. We help you get back to activities you enjoy with improved
mobility, flexibility and quality of life.

We also provide unique services in Pelvic Floor rehabilitation. Our registered physiotherapists have
a high level of training in managing Pelvic floor-related condition assessment and management. We
offer private and customized physical therapy sessions to our clients to help their rehabilitation
process. Our treatments are provided in private treatment rooms to maintain patient confidentiality
and comfort.

### Unique Hands-On Approach To Patients’ Pain and Conditions:

The physical therapist at Opal provides a unique hands-on manual therapy approach to treatment and
management, resulting in the most effective and efficient treatment plan for our patients. The
techniques utilized at Opalphysio allow us to get to the root cause of your problem as quickly as
possible so you can return to your life and activities with fewer symptoms and improved quality of
life.

Our highly trained therapists have extensive education in biomechanics, soft-tissue physiology,
joint mobilization and experience in providing appropriate care and injury prevention. We take pride
in providing expert care for [all conditions][90] that require physical rehabilitation and healing
utilizing new techniques and treatments.

### Evidence-Based Physiotherapy Treatment:

Our physiotherapists always provide current, improved evidence-based exercise prescription, injury
prevention and pain management techniques based on the latest developments to provide the best
possible care and pain relief.

Our physiotherapists are highly trained, experienced and have a membership with the Canadian
Physiotherapy Association and Physiotherapy Association of BC. All our Physiotherapists are licenced
with physiotherapy regulators – College of Physical Therapists of BC. We are proud to offer you an
unparalleled and excellent service

If you are searching for a physio clinic, look no further! Opal is one of the best physiotherapy
clinics in Langley, BC, providing exceptional physio services to various conditions at our location.

PathwayCare Solutions: Your Trusted NDIS Service Provider and Home Help for Elderly in Sydney

Quality life requires proper support for the elderly as well as people with disabilities. Do you need a trustworthy elderly home care provider in Sydney? Look no further than PathwayCare Solutions. We guarantee comfort, independence, and an improved quality of life because we are passionate about truly caring.
This dedication ensures every individual feels valued and supported, no matter their needs. What sets our approach apart is skilled care delivered with a compassionate touch, treating each participant as family. Whether you're looking for compassionate home help for elderly loved ones in Sydney or a trusted disability provider, our comprehensive support is tailored to fit everyone's unique needs. At PathwayCare Solutions, we believe everyone deserves care that makes them feel truly at home. As a trusted NDIS service provider in Sydney, we offer more than assistance, ensuring your loved ones receive the companionship, understanding, and dignity they deserve.

About Us

At PathwayCare Solutions, we believe quality care is rooted in empathy and respect. As a provider of NDIS support services in Sydney, we offer personalized assistance, from helping elderly clients at home to delivering specialized care for individuals with unique needs.

Our Vision

We, therefore, redefine elderly home care provider and disability support by their capacity to be caring, compassionate, and individualised. This is because every person has his or her own needs and goals, which we consider for each person's condition to enable our services to flex enough in adapting to their situation.

Our Values

Our core values that constitute all our services include respect, dignity, and empathy. Everyone deserves great NDIS support services in Sydney and quality care that goes further than mere assistance.

Our services

PathwayCare Solutions is a company that provides a wide selection of services to empower disability service providers in Sydney and provide compassionate care to seniors. We work with families to create a plan that suits their preferences and needs to ensure that each service contributes to enhanced independence and well-being.

Get Started

Mobile Allied Health

Bringing experienced therapists directly to our clients, our mobile allied health services specialize in all types of therapy. Our specialists tailor their approach to address each client's physical and emotional needs, including improving mobility, managing chronic pain, and simply helping individuals lead healthier lives that improve the quality of the life in which the person lives.

Discover More

Disability & NDIS

As one of the leading NDIS service providers in Sydney, we offer services for NDIS participants that include support in activities of daily living, community participation, medication management and personal care. Our team will guide each participant through all the necessities of the NDIS so that participants get the right kind of support to meet their goals.

Discover More

Home Care

We provide home care for seniors in Sydney, helping them age comfortably and independently. We include daily activities like meal preparation, mobility assistance, medication management, and personal care. You can feel confident knowing their loved ones are well cared in a compassionate and secure environment, always feeling at ease in familiar surroundings.

Discover More

Agency Staffing

In addition, PathwayCare Solutions offers flexible staffing solutions for aged care providers. Our caregivers and support staff are well-trained to help aged care agencies and facilities provide quality care in response to increasing demand. With this service, we assure our clients and their respective organizations that highly skilled, compassionate professionals will serve them.

We work with families to create a plan that suits their preferences and needs to ensure that each service contributes to enhanced independence and well-being.

Mobile Allied Health

Bringing experienced therapists directly to our clients, our mobile allied health services specialize in all types of therapy. Our specialists tailor their approach to address each client's physical and emotional needs, including improving mobility, managing chronic pain, and simply helping individuals lead healthier lives that improve the quality of the life in which the person lives.

Discover More

Disability & NDIS

As one of the leading NDIS service providers in Sydney, we offer services for NDIS participants that include support in activities of daily living, community participation, medication management and personal care. Our team will guide each participant through all the necessities of the NDIS so that participants get the right kind of support to meet their goals.

Discover More

Home Care

We provide home care for seniors in Sydney, helping them age comfortably and independently. We include daily activities like meal preparation, mobility assistance, medication management, and personal care. You can feel confident knowing their loved ones are well cared in a compassionate and secure environment, always feeling at ease in familiar surroundings.

Discover More

Agency Staffing

In addition, PathwayCare Solutions offers flexible staffing solutions for aged care providers. Our caregivers and support staff are well-trained to help aged care agencies and facilities provide quality care in response to increasing demand. With this service, we assure our clients and their respective organizations that highly skilled, compassionate professionals will serve them.

# Welcome to ** PathwayCare Solutions**

services such as [mobile allied health][40], [disability support & NDIS services][41], [home

delivering quality and tailored services, ensuring each individual receives the necessary support to
lead an independent life and achieve personal goals. At PathwayCare Solutions, we prioritise the
individual – their preferences and support needs take precedence in our approach. Empowering our
clients involves identifying the most effective ways to support them and delivering services
according to their preferences and schedules. Choosing PathwayCare Solutions means aligning with a
genuine team that values open communication, collaboration, and service excellence. We are here to
offer personalised care, compassion and expertise, enabling you to live independently and achieve
your goals.

We are committed to providing an excellent professional care to ensure that every patient receives the best quality treatment tailored to each individual’s needs. We provide flexible hours and One-on-One treatment sessions to help our patients get pain relief, regain motion, increase strength and help them maximize their independence and quality of life.

We believe in result and goal oriented therapy based on evidenced based practice focusing on regaining physical strength and well being, learning how to prevent future injuries as well as rehabilitating and conditioning the body.

#### WHAT IS PHYSIOTHERAPY?

Physiotherapy is a profession of health sciences, characterized by seeking the appropriate
development of the functions that produce the body’s systems, where his good or malfunction, affects
the kinetics or human body movement.

It intervenes when human beings have lost or are at risk of losing or altering temporarily or
permanently proper movement and thereby form the physical functions by using scientifically proven
techniques. The professional in this area receives the title of Doctor or Physiotherapist.

#### Recover your well-being!

Our Physiotherapy treatment sessions are exclusively manual therapy, carried out by our qualified
physiotherapist. The approximate duration of each session is 45 minutes, to provide quality
treatment and most timely manner possible.

What Makes Priestley Family Chiropractic So Different?

We are a neurologically based chiropractic practice in Newport Beach, CA, who takes a different approach than most chiropractors. We know that everything in our body is controlled by the brain. The brain communicates with the rest of the body through the nervous system.

Our office has more than 63 years of clinical experience between Dr. Priestley and Dr. Yocum. Through those years, our team continues to attend monthly seminars and conferences to stay up to date on the newest research and findings. We also collaborate with other successful chiropractors on a weekly basis reviewing difficult cases so you get the experience from chiropractors from around the country.

Continue Reading

We have sophisticated technology that can detect problems before they become symptomatic. This equipment helps us be more accurate on where and how to adjust our patients. We specialize in diagnosing and helping resolve conditions like sciatica , neck pain , headaches , numbness & tingling in the arms and legs, pregnancy, infants with colic, and so much more. We x-ray everyone (except pregnant moms ) because we are working with your spine and the joints and nerves that interact with it. This helps us see if there is reason why we shouldn’t adjust certain areas. It’s for your protection. We don’t guess with your health, we test!

Over 1/3rd of our practice is children under the age of 12! We’re here to support you as a parent and teach your kids why it’s so important to focus on their health from an early age. Kids under care from a chiropractor also do better in school, sports, and are sick less often. We have the best staff – read our reviews! Our staff is real and genuinely care about you and making sure you get the best care and results at our office. We tell it like it is by thoroughly explaining what you need, how to do it, and what will happen if you don’t do it. It’s up to you to decide.

How The Better Results Faster Plan Works

Stop masking the symptoms and get to the root cause of the problem

1. Thorough

Exam

We will perform an in-depth consultation, palpate your spine for misalignments, and document your posture. Nerve scans will tell us exactly where pressure on your nervous system is causing muscle tension and affecting organ function. A chiropractor will also do a stress test and, if necessary, take digital x-rays.

2. Receive A

Plan Of Action

The chiropractor will review your test results and have you come back the next day to review their findings. They will give you their best recommendations on where to begin correcting your problem and the most cost effective way to take care of your health challenges. Each body is different and needs individualized care.

3. Get Back

To Living Life

At Priestley Family Chiropractic in Newport Beach, CA, each chiropractor believes you should be able to live your life the way you choose, without physical limitations or fears of injury. When your nervous system is functioning at its best you feel better, have more energy, sleep better, concentrate properly, and are an overall better person.

(949) 640-7030 Schedule Appointment

What Could Not Fixing This Problem Cost You?

Health problems can make daily tasks more challenging, create financial stress, and even jeopardize your ability to earn a living. Stress can present in three different ways: physical stress such as a car accident , emotional stress such as selling a house, and chemical stress such as taking too many medications. Stress itself can exacerbate health issues from the common cold to more serious conditions and diseases. Poor physical health can lead to poor mental health which can perpetuate or even worsen physical problems.

Maintaining a healthy nervous system will pay off in the long run. When you don’t have good health it not only affects you but everyone around you at home and at work. When you don’t feel well it affects your self-esteem and self-image. Maintaining a healthy nervous system through care from a chiropractor is the right thing to do for your body.

# Chiropractic Care in Newport Beach, CA

The musculoskeletal system includes all the muscles, joints, and ligaments that support the
skeleton. It also consists of the bones and cartilage that form a protective sheath around each
joint. The spine is the most complex part of the musculoskeletal system. It consists of a series of
bones (vertebrae) that link together to form a flexible column of support for the upper body. The
disks between each vertebra act as shock absorbers, allowing the spine to bend and twist while
providing stability.

When the spine becomes misaligned, it irritates the nerves that pass through those joints and can
lead to serious health complications. Chiropractic care was developed as a natural, alternative
solution to many health problems that previously required numerous prescriptions and surgeries.

Pain is the body’s way of warning us about a more severe problem. Treating only the pain is like
turning off the alarm and not addressing the raging fire. Pain is the last symptom to present itself
and the first to go away, meaning once in pain, you’ve had a spinal misalignment for a while. That’s
why it’s so important to seek care as soon as possible to stop the condition’s progression. The
longer you wait to seek care, the more challenging the healing process.

## What is Chiropractic Care?

Misaligned vertebrae can cause physical pain and other nagging symptoms that are difficult to treat
with medical care alone. While traditional medicine treats the symptoms, usually with drugs and
surgery, chiropractic care is a natural, non-invasive, holistic approach that optimizes the nervous
system to relieve pain, improve nerve and joint function, and accelerate healing. By correcting
misalignments in the spinal column and joints, the body experiences improved circulation, increased
nerve response, decreased muscle tension, and improved overall health. Chiropractic adjustments can
address musculoskeletal issues and imbalances as well as regulate hormones and other systems of the
body.

## Common Chiropractic Adjustment Techniques in Newport Beach, CA

Webster Technique

The Webster Technique is primarily used for pregnant women to address their pelvic imbalances,
improve uterine spacing, and optimize their body for [pregnancy][66] and delivery. This is achieved
by reducing interference to your nervous system. This technique is a specific type of diversified
adjustment that combines specific contact points on the vagus nerve and adjustments to the pelvis.

The vagus nerve is a vital part of your parasympathetic nervous system which is where your body is
in rest, digest, growth, and development. This is where we want you to be during pregnancy! By
activating your parasympathetic nervous system, our patients experience pelvic alignment and ideal
fetal positioning. This technique is done lying down on an adjustment table and we can adjust the
middle part of the table to accommodate for pregnancy.

Activator Technique

The Activator Technique uses a handheld, spring-loaded instrument to deliver low-force,
high-velocity chiropractic adjustments. The instrument provides a gentle and precise adjustment
without manual manipulation or twisting of the body.

The force stimulates the proprioceptors (sensory receptors in the muscles, tendons, and joints) and
promotes reflexive changes in the neuromuscular system. The goal is to restore proper joint
function, improve nervous system communication, and alleviate pain or discomfort associated with
misalignments or subluxations.

Individuals who may be uncomfortable with traditional manual adjustments or have certain health
conditions requiring a more conservative approach favor the Activator Technique’s gentle approach.
The instrument-based nature of the technique allows for precise targeting and may be particularly
suitable for children, elderly individuals, or those with fragile bone structures.

The Thompson Technique

Also known as the Thompson Drop Technique, this method focuses on analyzing and adjusting the spine
using a specialized chiropractic table with drop mechanisms. The table sections can be elevated and
quickly dropped when the chiropractor applies a specific force during the adjustment. This drop
mechanism helps to enhance the adjustment’s effectiveness by reducing the required force and
allowing for a more precise and comfortable adjustment.

The Thompson Technique is known for its gentle and precise approach, making it suitable for
individuals who may be uncomfortable with more forceful manual adjustments or with certain health
conditions requiring a more conservative approach. It is often used to address a variety of
musculoskeletal conditions, including back pain, [neck pain][67], and joint dysfunction.

Diversified Technique

The Diversified Technique is one of the most commonly used chiropractic techniques worldwide. It is
a manual adjustment technique that focuses on restoring proper alignment and function to the spine
and other joints in the body. It combines specific manual thrusts, or adjustments, to correct
subluxations and improve joint mobility.

Once areas of subluxation or joint dysfunction are identified, the chiropractor will use their hands
to apply quick and controlled thrusts to the specific vertebrae or joints that require adjustment.
These adjustments are typically performed with the patient lying on a chiropractic table.

We may prescribe a therapeutic exercise program to you as a natural way to help treat any health

### Arthritis

[Arthritis][66] is a condition that causes swelling and tenderness of the joints, and different
low-impact exercises can offer relief from the resulting pain and discomfort. The right workout
movements can improve joint mobility and strengthen the muscles around the joints to alleviate the
strain that often worsens arthritis symptoms. Exercise has also been shown to reduce arthritic

mobility, is further stimulated with exercise.

### Back Pain

Therapeutic exercise offers one of the most effective ways to treat back pain that resulted from an

Through a series of gentle exercises, you may recover better from a sprain or broken bone and regain

If any tendons have become inflamed from overuse, therapeutic exercises can strengthen surrounding
muscles to offer better support and alleviate tendon strain. You may experience additional relief

tendons.

If you have a muscle imbalance because of a weaker part of a muscle group, exercises can be done to

healing, and you also likely won’t experience much of the stiffness that’s known to limit range of
motion after surgery.

# X-ray Services in Newport Beach, CA

Whether you’ve just learned that your chiropractor recommends that you get an X-ray or you’re headed
for your first appointment, you may be wondering about how [chiropractors][63] use this diagnostic
tool. Not every chiropractic patient will need an X-ray before beginning treatment. However, there
are a few reasons that a chiropractor might order one.

While chiropractors will carry out physical examinations, not every condition can be identified in
this way. We may need to do chiropractic X-rays to diagnose certain conditions in order to determine
the best course of treatment as well. For example, if you have osteoporosis, certain treatments are
not appropriate.

If you have scoliosis or kyphosis, we can get a better idea of what’s going on in your spine with an
X-ray. If we suspect that you have spondyloarthritis, which can cause your spine to degenerate,
we’ll need to do an X-ray to confirm it. Finally, we’ll do an X-ray if there’s a likelihood that
you’ve had a recent fracture. Chiropractic X-rays can alert us to any issues that require
consideration as we move forward with your treatment. They also help ensure that we are addressing
the root cause of your symptoms so that we can offer treatment that will help you over the long
term.

If you’re told you need an X-ray, what happens next will depend on whether the chiropractor you’re
seeing has an X-ray machine at the office or if you need a referral to a radiology facility. If
you’re getting the chiropractic X-rays on-site, you might have them done at the initial appointment.
Otherwise, the X-rays might happen on another day, depending on your schedule and that of the
radiology facility. When you get your chiropractic X-rays, safety precautions will be taken,
including ensuring that you are shielded from radiation as much as possible.

## What Are Chiropractic X-Rays?

A chiropractic X-ray is one that is done with a specific focus on your spine and other bones and
joints. It helps determine whether you have the types of problems discussed above, such as fractures
or misalignments, and helps us determine how best to proceed with your treatment.

In terms of the technology that they use and how they are done, chiropractic X-rays are not
different from hospital X-rays. However, they are different in how we use them. Medical
professionals in a hospital setting are generally looking at more parts of the body and for
different things. They may be looking for something very specific, such as a tumor or signs of an
infection. As chiropractors, we are specifically concerned with your musculoskeletal health.

The vast majority of chiropractic X-rays are digital. These provide clearer images and faster
results than traditional film X-rays, and they also use less radiation. However, some facilities
still use film X-rays, and these are still effective for [chiropractic diagnoses][66].

Once we have an X-ray, we can identify [arthritis][67] and similar degenerative diseases. We can
also see fractures and other injuries caused by trauma as well as congenital disorders, such as
scoliosis.

### Why Do Chiropractors in Newport Beach, CA, Use X-Rays?

X-rays help a chiropractor make a diagnosis because not every condition can be identified with just
a physical exam and your description of the pain you’re experiencing. For example, chiropractic
X-rays can help us determine if the pain is caused by bone spurs, a misalignment, a fracture or
something else entirely.

In fact, hairline fractures are one example of a problem that can only be clearly identified on an
X-ray. Chiropractic X-rays may also be necessary to diagnose scoliosis and similar spinal
conditions. Some misalignments can be more easily identified with an X-ray rather than just a
physical exam.

It is not necessary to use an X-ray on every patient. While chiropractic X-rays contain a very low
dose of radiation, we still try not to expose patients to them unnecessarily. When we suspect issues
such as fractures or degenerative conditions or when we need more information to correctly identify
a misalignment, we may order an X-ray. However, many of the problems that patients come to see a
chiropractor about are straightforward and don’t require X-rays.

There are benefits to doing chiropractic X-rays instead of just a physical exam since they can help
us determine whether you have such issues as a fracture. They can also help us identify the degree
of spinal degeneration or other problems. With chiropractic X-rays, we can be certain that we are
treating the right root cause of your pain. This keeps you safe and helps us ensure accuracy in our
approach.

Another big benefit of chiropractic X-rays is that they can help you better understand what’s
causing your pain or other symptoms. This in turn helps you make informed decisions about how you’d
like to proceed with your treatment.

## What is a Subluxation, and How Can X-Rays Detect It?

You’ve probably heard of a dislocation, such as someone having a [dislocated shoulder][69].
Essentially, it means that a joint has been pushed out of its usual position. A subluxation is a
partial dislocation. It may show up on an X-ray as a misalignment or as a disc being out of place.
It could also look like your spine is lacking its normal curves or that a vertebra is rotated out of
its normal position. An even easier way to understand subluxation is to simply remember that it’s a
situation in which the bone is not where it’s supposed to be.

There are a few reasons that chiropractors need to be able to visually confirm a subluxation with
X-rays. First, it allows for the necessary precision in identifying exactly where the subluxation
is. With this information, a chiropractor can move forward with a treatment plan that’s specifically
designed for the patient. In addition, the X-ray can reveal whether there are additional issues that
the chiropractor needs to take into account.

If you have a subluxation, chiropractic X-rays won’t show the severity in terms of how much pain it
may be causing you. However, it can show the phase, which can include details such as whether there
are bone spurs or if vertebrae have fused.

### What Other Issues Can Chiropractic X-Rays Reveal?

We can see a number of structural problems on chiropractic X-rays that you may not be experiencing
any symptoms from yet. This might include scoliosis and other birth defects in the spine,
misalignments and some loss of bone density. In addition, it’s also possible to detect bone spurs,
the narrowing of space between discs in your back and signs of arthritis.

We have a few tools for assessing spinal curves and posture using chiropractic X-rays:
* We can measure specific angles on the X-ray to identify issues.
* There is specialized software to examine images for signs of problems.
* X-ray images may clearly show some obvious deviations that we’re trained to identify.

In addition, we can see old and new injuries, fractures or trauma on an X-ray. For example, the
shape or density of a bone may have changed even after a long-ago fracture has healed. Past trauma
can also cause subluxations and bone spurs while old injuries can exacerbate degenerative disc
disease.

## What Should Patients in Newport Beach, CA, Expect After X-Rays?

A chiropractor will review X-rays alongside their own observations during the physical examination
and the patient history. Once they have completed this assessment, they will sit down with you and
discuss the findings. This may be part of a separate appointment in order to give them time for a
thorough review.

The “report of findings” should pull all of this information together. This will include basic
information about you as well as medical history, any symptoms you’ve reported and what the
chiropractor found in both the physical exam and the X-rays. The chiropractor will also add any
recommendations for further assessments and a treatment plan.

Chiropractic X-rays have a substantial effect on how treatment is approached because they can
provide so much more information than is available simply from a physical exam. The chiropractor may
create a treatment plan based on fractures, spinal issues or other diagnoses that are the source of
your pain but that only became apparent with the X-ray findings. Of course, chiropractic X-rays can
also reveal spinal abnormalities and other issues that aren’t causing you any problems. It’s
important that chiropractors correlate symptoms with what they see on the X-ray. We want to avoid
unnecessary treatment.

### Who Should Consider Getting Chiropractic X-Rays?

There are several types of patients who can benefit from chiropractic X-rays. X-rays may be
necessary to diagnose a condition such as [scoliosis][70]. For patients with recent trauma or for
those who are still in pain after several weeks of treatment, chiropractic X-rays can identify
fractures or other issues. Older adults, particularly those over 70, can benefit from X-rays because
they can help identify whether osteoporosis is a factor. Chiropractors will generally recommend

## Dr. Kevin Priestley, D.C.

*“My entire family is involved with helping people.”*

##### A Family Tradition of Serving Others

As a teenager, Doctor Priestley spent his summers working as a lifeguard on Long Island. His father
worked for the New York City police department for 45 years, and his younger sister is also a police
officer. The other two sisters in his family and his mother are registered nurses. Dr. Priestley
realized early on that he wanted to help people and decided to major in premed.

Everything changed when a friend invited him to a lecture presented by a [chiropractor][63]. The
information given was so simple but made perfect sense to Dr. Priestley. ‘’How can someone get
healthy by taking drugs? The idea that you could restore people’s health without medicine by
adjusting their spine was a revelation to me.” It was that evening he decided to become a
chiropractor, and he continues to be thankful to the friend who took him to that lecture.

## Our Vision

ReLiva is focused on being a preferred partner of choice to other Healthcare Providers for their
physiotherapy requirements.

## Our Approach

Our approach to your recovery is what makes us UNIQUE. We believe in involving you in your
treatment. That is why we educate you about your physical condition, its causes and effects. We
determine your current level of functionality and your expected goals. Together, we set out a plan
for achieving and maintaining those goals making it the treatment that works best for you.

It is a joint process - WE bring the EXPERTISE; YOU commit and follow through with IMPLEMENTATION.
The end result is that you recover and get back to your life; and take ownership of your physical
health too.

Awareness & Goal Setting
Being educated about your condition/injury is the most important factor towards your recovery. After
a thorough assessment, our experts help you understand body mechanics, your condition/injury, types
of treatment, exercises and help you set specific goals. This personalized therapy guides your
treatment to expedite recovery and more successful results.
Recovery
We recognize that you are in pain and/or unable to move the way you want to. Experience relief with
our experts through drug-free modern therapies like Mulligan, McKenzie, Kinesio-taping, Cupping, and
more. Our physios can offer the best of methods to reduce pain, improve mobility and functionality.
Maintenance
Pain relief is just the start but the key is to get back to your previous level of function. We
tailor exercises to restore mobility and full function, best suited to your lifestyle for long term
results. Home based rehab programs also involve caregivers for enhanced support.
Prevention & Lifestyle
At ReLiva, we believe that our true success lies in the fact that our client can maintain the
physical recovery on his/her own even after the completion of therapy. Before leaving, we equip you
with a home exercise plan with a clear list of “Dos and Don'ts" and suggestions to improve your
lifestyle or the steps to maximize benefit after a specific surgery.

# Important Information and FAQs

### Where are SMARTPHYSIO's London clinics located?

SMARTPHYSIO has four physiotherapy clinics in London: Hampstead (North West London), Highgate (North
London), Bishopsgate in the City of London, and Soho in the West End. We also offer home, care home
and office visits across all of Greater London, so you can be seen wherever is most practical.


Each clinic is led by experienced Chartered Physiotherapists (MCSP, HCPC-registered) and shares the
same SMARTPHYSIO team standards, with the same approach to assessment and treatment.
* Hampstead. The original SMARTPHYSIO clinic on Finchley Road, founded in 1993 by clinic director
  Sammy Margo
* Highgate. Convenient for North London patients. 5-minute walk from Highgate Tube Station, located
  near Highgate Wood.
* City (Bishopsgate). Inside the City of London. The closest tube stations are Liverpool Street and
  Shoreditch High Street, both around a 7-minute walk from the clinic
* West End (Soho). In the heart of central London, within walking distance of Leicester Square
  Station with Northern and Piccadilly Line access


Home, office and care home visits are available across all of Greater London. The team matches you
with the closest available physiotherapist to minimise travel and waiting time.


To book at any SMARTPHYSIO clinic, use online booking or call 020 7435 4910. For a home, office or
care home visit, call or use the enquiry form (online booking is not available for home visits).
First appointments can normally be arranged within 24 to 48 hours.

### Can I see a private physiotherapist in London without a GP referral?

Yes, you can see a private physiotherapist in London without a GP referral. SMARTPHYSIO accepts
direct self-referrals at all four clinics and for home, office and care home visits. If you plan to
claim through private medical insurance, your insurer may want pre-authorisation or a GP referral
first, so check your policy before booking.


Private physiotherapy in the UK is direct-access by default. The NHS itself confirms that most
private physiotherapists accept self-referrals, and recommends choosing a physiotherapist who is
Chartered (MCSP) and registered with the Health and Care Professions Council (HCPC). All SMARTPHYSIO
physiotherapists are MCSP and HCPC-registered.


Common reasons people choose private physiotherapy over the NHS pathway include:
* Speed. NHS waiting times can be long; SMARTPHYSIO can usually offer a first appointment within 24
  to 48 hours
* Choice. You can choose the clinician, the location and the time
* Continuity. The same physiotherapist sees you throughout your treatment
* Setting. Clinic, home and office visits are all available


Insurance is the one variable. If you intend to use private medical insurance, the insurer (not the
clinic) decides whether they want a GP referral before they will pay out. Ring your insurer fir

strength, reduce pain, and improve mobility. Our compassionate approach ensures you feel supported
every step of the way, with clear advice and exercises designed for long-term wellbeing.

# Important Information and FAQs

### Where are SMARTPHYSIO's London clinics located?

SMARTPHYSIO has four physiotherapy clinics in London: Hampstead (North West London), Highgate (North
London), Bishopsgate in the City of London, and Soho in the West End. We also offer home, care home
and office visits across all of Greater London, so you can be seen wherever is most practical.


Each clinic is led by experienced Chartered Physiotherapists (MCSP, HCPC-registered) and shares the
same SMARTPHYSIO team standards, with the same approach to assessment and treatment.
* Hampstead. The original SMARTPHYSIO clinic on Finchley Road, founded in 1993 by clinic director
  Sammy Margo
* Highgate. Convenient for North London patients. 5-minute walk from Highgate Tube Station, located
  near Highgate Wood.
* City (Bishopsgate). Inside the City of London. The closest tube stations are Liverpool Street and
  Shoreditch High Street, both around a 7-minute walk from the clinic
* West End (Soho). In the heart of central London, within walking distance of Leicester Square
  Station with Northern and Piccadilly Line access


Home, office and care home visits are available across all of Greater London. The team matches you
with the closest available physiotherapist to minimise travel and waiting time.


To book at any SMARTPHYSIO clinic, use online booking or call 020 7435 4910. For a home, office or
care home visit, call or use the enquiry form (online booking is not available for home visits).
First appointments can normally be arranged within 24 to 48 hours.

### Can I see a private physiotherapist in London without a GP referral?

Yes, you can see a private physiotherapist in London without a GP referral. SMARTPHYSIO accepts
direct self-referrals at all four clinics and for home, office and care home visits. If you plan to
claim through private medical insurance, your insurer may want pre-authorisation or a GP referral
first, so check your policy before booking.


Private physiotherapy in the UK is direct-access by default. The NHS itself confirms that most
private physiotherapists accept self-referrals, and recommends choosing a physiotherapist who is
Chartered (MCSP) and registered with the Health and Care Professions Council (HCPC). All SMARTPHYSIO
physiotherapists are MCSP and HCPC-registered.


Common reasons people choose private physiotherapy over the NHS pathway include:
* Speed. NHS waiting times can be long; SMARTPHYSIO can usually offer a first appointment within 24
  to 48 hours
* Choice. You can choose the clinician, the location and the time
* Continuity. The same physiotherapist sees you throughout your treatment
* Setting. Clinic, home and office visits are all available


Insurance is the one variable. If you intend to use private medical insurance, the insurer (not the
clinic) decides whether they want a GP referral before they will pay out. Ring your insurer first,
ask whether they need a referral or a pre-authorisation code, and then book the appointment. If you
are self-funding, none of this applies and you can book directly.


To book a private physiotherapist at SMARTPHYSIO without a GP referral, use online booking for a
clinic appointment or call 020 7435 4910 for home and office visits. We have four London clinics
plus home, office and care home visits across all of Greater London.


The NHS confirms that most private physiotherapists accept direct self-referrals, and recommends
checking that any chosen physio is Chartered (MCSP) and
HCPC-registered:[ ][73][https://www.nhs.uk/tests-and-treatments/physiotherapy/][74].

### Does SMARTPHYSIO accept private health insurance (Bupa, AXA, WPA)?

SMARTPHYSIO is recognised by most major UK private medical insurers, including Bupa, AXA/PPP and
WPA, with the full list published on our Insurance Checklist page. We recommend calling your insurer
first to confirm cover and any pre-authorisation needed, then booking.


The insurers SMARTPHYSIO is currently registered with, as published on the[ Insurance Checklist
page][75], are:
* Allianz
* AXA/PPP
* Bupa (and Bupa International)
* Cigna
* CS Healthcare
* Exeter Family Friendly
* First Assist
* Freedom
* Health Online
* HSA
* PPP International
* Vitality (typically pay-and-claim-back)
* WPA


If your insurer is not on this list, it is still worth a quick call to the clinic. New agreements
are added periodically and your policy may still be claimable on a pay-and-claim-back basis.


The simplest order of operations is to call your insurer and confirm physiotherapy is covered under
your policy, get a pre-authorisation or claim number, tell SMARTPHYSIO your insurer and pre-auth
code when booking, then attend your appointment. SMARTPHYSIO can sometimes invoice the insurer
directly; in other cases you pay at the appointment and claim back. The team will explain which
applies once they have your insurer's details.


To check whether your specific policy is covered, call SMARTPHYSIO on 020 7435 4910 or visit the
Insurance Checklist page. The team will explain how to provide your insurer details and which
insurers can be invoiced directly versus pay-and-claim-back.

### Do you offer same-day or weekend physiotherapy appointments in London?

Yes, SMARTPHYSIO offers weekend appointments and, where availability allows, same-day appointments.
Clinics are open Monday to Friday 8am to 8pm and Saturday 9am to 2pm. Sundays and bank holidays are
available for emergencies.


Clinic opening times across all four SMARTPHYSIO sites:
* Monday to Friday: 8:00am to 8:00pm
* Saturday: 9:00am to 2:00pm
* Sunday: available for emergencies
* Bank holidays: available for emergencies


For same-day appointments, the best route is to call the clinic directly on 020 7435 4910 and ask
what is available at each of the four London locations. If you can be flexible on clinician or
clinic site, you will usually be seen sooner. Online booking shows live availability for clinic
appointments.


For acute or urgent issues, such as a freshly injured back, a sudden flare-up, or a recovery setback
after surgery, mention the urgency when you call. First appointments can normally be arranged within
24 to 48 hours.


Home visits are also possible at weekends and during bank holidays. Home visits are not bookable
online; call the team to arrange.


For the soonest available appointment, including same-day or weekend slots, call SMARTPHYSIO on 020
7435 4910 or use online booking to see live clinic availability. Home and office visits across
London can also be arranged by phone or via the enquiry form.

# Introduction to Somerton Physiotherapy Clinic in Blanchardstown, Castleknock, and Tallaght.

**Somerton Physiotherapy Clinic** with locations in **Castleknock** and **Blanchardstown Dublin 15**
and **Tallaght Dublin 24**, provides expert chartered physiotherapy treatment to restore, maintain
and make the most of a patient’s mobility, function, and well-being.

We have an experienced team of Dublin Physiotherapists best known for the treatment of back pain,
neck pain, sports injuries and physiotherapy of children and older adults.

**What services does Somerton Physiotherapy in Dublin 15 and Dublin 24 provide?**

Somerton Physio Castleknock, Blanchardstown and Tallaght provide physiotherapy treatment for the
following:
* Neck and back pain
* Pelvic Health – (Male and Female)
* Muscle and joint pain
* Foot and Ankle pain and Orthotics
* Sports injuries
* Chronic Pain
* Sports massage
* Osteoporosis
* Children’s physiotherapy
* Osteoarthritis
* Paediatric physiotherapy
* Orthotics
* Dry Needling
* Work-related injuries
* Pilates classes
* Road traffic accident injuries
* Vertigo

[ab1][ab1]

**Why You May Need Physiotherapy – What are the Benefits of Physiotherapy?**

Physiotherapy helps to restore mobility and normality to a patient’s life after an injury, disease,
or disability. Components of a physiotherapy session include listening to your problem or concerns,
exercise prescription, manual therapy, advice and educating the patient. Physiotherapy can help a
patient of any age to manage their pain and prevent a recurrence of the injury. All our therapists
have an expert knowledge of the musculoskeletal system, including muscles, bones, ligaments, joints
and tendons. Our mission is to provide you with a clear diagnosis and a comprehensive treatment plan
so that you can recover from your injury successfully.

**What Specialist services does Somerton Physio in Dublin 15 and Dublin 24 provide?**

Somerton Physio Castleknock, Blanchardstown and Tallaght provide the following **specialist
physiotherapy services** at our clinics:
* [Athletic Performance Testing][32]
* [Fit4Golf Assessment][33]
* [Strength and Conditioning][34]
* [Running Performance Lab / Gait Analysis][35]
* [Pilates classes][36]

[ Book Now ][37]

## **Physiotherapist Treatment – Dublin 15 and Dublin 24**

At a Physiotherapy appointment in our Castleknock, Blanchardstown or Tallaght clinic, treatment will
include manual therapy to the soft tissues, tendons, ligaments, muscles and joints. Manual therapy
can include stretching, massage, manipulation, dry needling and myofascial release.

Physiotherapy can help give pain relief in most cases but often it depends upon the individual and
the longevity of the injury or problem. The rate of healing is different for different individuals.
The duration of your treatment plan depends upon variations in pain, motivation, perception, and the
healing rate of the individual.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

#### [ What is physiotherapy, and how can it benefit me? ][45]

Physiotherapy, a comprehensive healthcare approach, aids in restoring movement and function
post-injury, illness, or disability. At our Blanchardstown, Castleknock and Tallaght physio clinics,
personalized treatment plans accelerate recovery and prevent future injuries.

#### [ Where can I find a sports physiotherapist near me? ][46]

Somerton Physiotherapy Clinic, provides professional sports physiotherapy services. We cater to
players of all levels and operate in a convenient location, such as Blanchardstown, Tallaght and
Castleknock

#### [ Is physiotherapy only for athletes? ][47]

No, physiotherapy benefits everyone! From office workers to athletes, it enhances mobility and
prevents injuries in diverse lifestyles.

#### [ What is Pilates? ][48]

Pilates is a low-impact exercise designed to strengthen muscles and condition the body. Our Pilates
classes at Somerton Physiotherapy provide a holistic approach to enhance your physical well-being.

#### [ How much does a physiotherapy session cost? ][49]

Initial appointments are €75. Follow-up sessions, recommended after the first visit, also cost €75.

#### [ Do I need a referral from a doctor to see a physiotherapist? ][50]

No referral is necessary to visit our physio clinics. Book an appointment directly, and our team
will conduct a thorough assessment to tailor the best recovery plan for you.

#### [ What can I expect during my first visit to your physio clinic? ][51]

Your initial visit involves a detailed assessment, including a medical history review and physical
tests. From this, we develop a personalised treatment plan aligned with your needs and goals.

#### [ How many sessions will I require? ][52]

The number of sessions depends on your condition's nature and severity, discussed during your
initial assessment to align with your treatment plan and goals.

#### [ Does private health insurance cover my treatment? ][53]

Most private health insurance plans cover physiotherapy. Contact your provider for details, or our
staff can assist with insurance inquiries and billing at our Tallaght physio clinic.

#### [ How can I schedule an appointment at your physio clinics in Blanchardstown, Castleknock and
#### Tallaght? ][54]

Reach our Patient Services team Monday to Friday, 9 am to 5 pm, and Saturdays, 8 am to 2pm. Contact
us via email at [[email protected]][55] or phone at (01) 9069566. You can also view available
appointments and book online via our website.

post-injury, illness, or disability. At our Blanchardstown, Castleknock and Tallaght physio clinics,
personalized treatment plans accelerate recovery and prevent future injuries.

#### [ Where can I find a sports physiotherapist near me? ][46]

Somerton Physiotherapy Clinic, provides professional sports physiotherapy services. We cater to
players of all levels and operate in a convenient location, such as Blanchardstown, Tallaght and
Castleknock

#### [ Is physiotherapy only for athletes? ][47]

No, physiotherapy benefits everyone! From office workers to athletes, it enhances mobility and
prevents injuries in diverse lifestyles.

#### [ What is Pilates? ][48]

Pilates is a low-impact exercise designed to strengthen muscles and condition the body. Our Pilates
classes at Somerton Physiotherapy provide a holistic approach to enhance your physical well-being.

#### [ How much does a physiotherapy session cost? ][49]

Initial appointments are €75. Follow-up sessions, recommended after the first visit, also cost €75.

#### [ Do I need a referral from a doctor to see a physiotherapist? ][50]

No referral is necessary to visit our physio clinics. Book an appointment directly, and our team
will conduct a thorough assessment to tailor the best recovery plan for you.

#### [ What can I expect during my first visit to your physio clinic? ][51]

Your initial visit involves a detailed assessment, including a medical history review and physical
tests. From this, we develop a personalised treatment plan aligned with your needs and goals.

#### [ How many sessions will I require? ][52]

The number of sessions depends on your condition's nature and severity, discussed during your
initial assessment to align with your treatment plan and goals.

#### [ Does private health insurance cover my treatment? ][53]

Most private health insurance plans cover physiotherapy. Contact your provider for details, or our
staff can assist with insurance inquiries and billing at our Tallaght physio clinic.

#### [ How can I schedule an appointment at your physio clinics in Blanchardstown, Castleknock and
#### Tallaght? ][54]

Reach our Patient Services team Monday to Friday, 9 am to 5 pm, and Saturdays, 8 am to 2pm. Contact
us via email at [[email protected]][55] or phone at (01) 9069566. You can also view available
appointments and book online via our website.

# Betul Dorik MISCP

#### **Old Bawn Clinic**

Betul is a Chartered Physiotherapist registered with CORU and a member of the Irish Society of
Chartered Physiotherapists (ISCP). She is dedicated to providing evidence-based, patient-centred
physiotherapy focused on pain reduction, functional recovery, and improving quality of life.

With clinical experience in both Ireland and Turkey, Betul has worked in hospital and outpatient
settings, developing her experience in musculoskeletal and orthopaedic rehabilitation. Betul
graduated with a Batchelor’s degree in Physical Therapy and Rehabilitation from Abant Izzet Baysal
University, and later completed a Master’s Degree in Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation at Usküdar
University. She is also co-author of a published study examining vibration sense following Anterior
Cruciate Ligament (ACL) reconstruction and meniscus interventions.

Betul treats a range of musculoskeletal conditions including back and neck pain, sports injuries,
post-operative rehabilitation, and lymphoedema management, using a combination of manual therapy,
dry needling, lymphatic drainage techniques, and tailored exercise programmes.

She has a particular interest in women’s health issues and pelvic pain and dyspareunia (painful
intercourse) and has completed additional training in chronic pelvic pain and women’s health. Betul
aims to provide a respectful and supportive environment where patients feel comfortable discussing
sensitive concerns. Her approach focuses on detailed assessment, education, and personalised
exercise-based rehabilitation.

Before moving to Ireland, Betul worked in major hospitals in Turkey, including Medipol Mega Hospital
and Medicana Çamlica Hospital, where she treated both inpatients and outpatients with spinal and
orthopaedic conditions.

# Adam Kinsella MISCP

#### **Adam Kinsella MISCP – Head Physio Castleknock Clinic**

Adam graduated with a First class honour’s degree in physiotherapy from University College Dublin.
Since then, he has been working with numerous sports teams and in private practice.

Adam has worked in a variety of sports settings. He has provided match physiotherapy and sports
injury rehabilitation services to Academy players in Everton Football club, the Welsh FA’s Female
Champions league, various league of Ireland football teams, numerous AIL Rugby teams and Multiple
GAA clubs.

Additionally, Adam has extensive experience working in private practice working as a Musculoskeletal
Physiotherapist in both Ireland and New Zealand.

Adam has a passion for sports medicine and all Musculoskeletal related issues. He has a particular
interest in the rehabilitation of back and lower limb injuries. Adam set up and oversees our Running
Performance Lab, which caters for both Adult and Juvenile runners hoping to avoid injury or increase
running performance.

Adam believes that continued professional development is extremely important to him and his clients
and regularly ‘up skills’ to provide the highest quality service.

Adam is our Head Physiotherapist based in our Castleknock GAA clinic and is also the Men’s Senior
Football team physiotherapist for Castleknock GAA.

Outside of his passion for all things musculoskeletal physiotherapy, Adam enjoys football,
weightlifting and travelling.

# James Sherry MISCP

#### **Head Physio Old Bawn Clinic**

James Sherry MISCP is an experienced Chartered Physiotherapist with the majority of his practice
focusing on the treatment of back and neck pain, sports injuries and adolescent physiotherapy. He
has worked extensively with GAA players and athletes at all levels over the past 18 years.

Previously James has been a member of the GAA’s Medical, Scientific and Welfare Committee. He
currently sits on the GPA’s (Gaelic Players Association) Player Welfare Committee.

James played for the Fermanagh Senior Football GAA team for 11 years. While studying physiotherapy
at UCD he captained the college team when they won their last Dublin senior football championship in

wins between 2010 and 2014.

James has a keen interest in all sports. He competed internationally for Northern Ireland and Irish
schools in cross country running. He continues to play club football with Castleknock GAA club in
Dublin.

James established Somerton Physiotherapy Clinic in 2015.

# Peter Lynch MISCP

#### **PhD, MISCP**

Peter completed his Master’s degree in Physiotherapy at Queen Margaret University, Edinburgh, in
2018. He is CORU registered and a practising member of the Irish Society of Chartered
Physiotherapists with almost 8 years of clinical experience across Ireland and the UK. He recently
completed his Doctoral degree at the now-named Atlantic Technological University (ATU) Sligo. Peter
also holds a Bachelor’s degree in Health Science & Physiology and Health Promotion from the
Institute of Technology (IT) Sligo.

Peter has a strong interest in sports medicine and has a depth of experience working as a
Musculoskeletal Physiotherapist, both in clinical settings and with various sports clubs. He has a
specialist interest in treating sports injuries in adults and adolescents. A strong advocate of
evidence-based practice, he applies his research expertise to critically appraise current literature
and deliver up-to-date, effective physiotherapy.

A large portion of Peter’s practice focuses on the treatment of shoulder pain and neck and back
pain. He enjoys helping patients return to pain-free movement and daily activities through a
combination of education, manual therapy and exercise prescription. Throughout his academic career,
Peter received multiple awards and scholarships in recognition of his research achievements. He has
worked as an Assistant Lecturer and remains actively involved in research through his current role
as a Postdoctoral Researcher at ATU Sligo.

Peter views pain as a complex experience influenced by more than physical factors alone. He is
passionate about empowering individuals to take an active role in their recovery, supporting them in
becoming more physically active and improving their overall quality of life.

# Kevin Cooney MISCP

**Blanchardstown/Castleknock Clinic**

Kevin specialises in the treatment of back and neck pain and sports-related injuries. He takes a
holistic approach to physiotherapy, focusing on treating the whole person rather than just the
injury. He combines evidence-based practice with individualised care to help each patient achieve
their goals and return to optimal function.

Kevin completed his Honours Physiotherapy degree in Eindhoven, Netherlands. During his training, he
had the opportunity to work in Malta, where he treated a wide range of patients, including athletes
associated with the Malta Olympics Committee across multiple high-level sports. This experience gave
him valuable insight into sports-specific rehabilitation and high-performance care. After returning
to Ireland, Kevin worked within the HSE, treating both inpatients and outpatients across hospital
settings. Kevin also gained experience in private clinics, further developing his ability to provide
tailored treatment plans for patients with diverse needs and conditions.

Kevin is passionate about using a holistic, evidence-based approach to help patients recover,
improve their movement, and maintain long-term health and wellbeing.

# Pierce O’Connor MISCP

#### Head Physio Blanchardstown Clinic

Pierce graduated from UCD in 2018 with an honour’s degree in Physiotherapy. Prior to studying
physiotherapy Pierce graduated from NUI Maynooth with an honour’s degree in Science.

Since graduating from UCD in 2018, Pierce has worked in Our Lady’s Hospice in the areas of
Rheumatology and Palliative care. He also worked in Connolly Hospital Blanchardstown and completed
rotations in the various areas of Physiotherapy.

Pierce has a keen interest in sports medicine and is currently with Bohemians FC Academy as their
head physiotherapist. Pierce also has a keen interest in the rehabilitation of knee injuries
especially ACL reconstructions and shoulder conditions. Away from sports medicine, Pierce is a firm
believer in exercise prescription for the elderly to keep our older generation fit, active and
strong.

Combining his science background and Physiotherapy knowledge, Pierce applies an evidence based
approach to his care of clients and strives to enhance his clients self management. Pierce strives
to keep up to date with continuous professional development. Away from physio, Pierce is an avid
cyclist.

# Kaitlin O’Halloran MISCP

#### **Blanchardstown and Old Bawn Clinic**

Kaitlin is a CORU registered, chartered physiotherapist. She received her bachelor’s degree in
physiotherapy from the University of Limerick. Kaitlin’s professional journey began in hospital
settings, where she gained extensive hands-on experience in complex patient care.

Kaitlin now works exclusively in private practice specialising in the treatment and rehabilitation
of neck and back pain, shoulder injuries and sports injuries. She has a keen interest in working
with females (adolescent and adult) who have sustained a sports related injury.

Kaitlin focuses on helping individuals achieve their goals through tailored rehabilitation and
education. She values working collaboratively with her patients, providing them with the knowledge
and tools needed to build confidence, stay active, and return to the activities that matter most to
them.

Outside of work, Kaitlin is committed to staying active and embracing the outdoors. She enjoys
keeping fit through regular gym sessions and hiking. Kaitlin plays senior camogie with her local
club, Burgess-Duharra in Tipperary. Her background in sports and fitness complements her work as a
physiotherapist, giving her a unique insight into injury prevention and recovery for athletes of all
levels.

# Caoimhe Lynch MISCP

Caoimhe Lynch is a CORU and ISCP registered chartered physiotherapist with a BSc in Physiotherapy
from University College Dublin. During her training she gained clinical expertise across a wide
variety of settings, including musculoskeletal rehabilitation, neurorehabilitation, paediatrics,
surgical respiratory care and acute stroke recovery. This diversity of inpatient and outpatient
specialist training helps Caoimhe to adapt treatment plans to suit each patient’s progress and
goals.

Caoimhe enjoys helping people return to their everyday activities, whether that is recovering from
injury, managing a long-term condition, or building strength and confidence through exercise.

Caoimhe has a specialist interest in treating sports injuries in runners and GAA players. She has
vast experience in treating back and neck pain in all ages. Through her own sporting endeavours, she
has gained valuable insights around injury prevention and rehabilitation.

Outside of work, Caoimhe is actively involved in Gaelic football and plays for her club
Bailieborough Shamrocks in Cavan.

## What is VO₂ Max Testing?

**VO₂ max **(short for maximal oxygen uptake) is a measurement of the maximum amount of oxygen your
body can use during intense exercises and is widely recognised as the **gold standard** for
measuring cardiovascular fitness and aerobic endurance.

Think of VO₂ max as your body’s **engine capacity**—the bigger and more efficient it is, the better
you perform and the healthier you are.

[ [v02 5 scaled][v02 5 scaled] ][34]
What Does VO₂ Max Tell You?

VO₂ max is expressed in the amount of oxygen consumed per minute, per kilogram of bodyweight
(ml/kg/min). It shows how well your **heart, lungs, and muscles** work together to use oxygen
efficiently. Essentially, the higher your V02 max, the better your body is at:
* Delivering oxygen to your muscles
* Sustaining high-intensity activity
* Recovering after exertion

Why does VO₂ Max matter?

**Beyond performance, VO₂ max is a powerful predictor of long-term health. **
* **Higher VO₂ max = Better fitness and endurance**
* **Improving VO₂ max** has been proven to decrease the risk of early mortality.
* **It can **reduce your risk of heart disease, stroke, high cholesterol, diabetes and dementia.
* Athletes and the general population can use VO₂ max data to tailor training, boost performance and
improve overall health

In Short, improving your VO₂ max is like a **cheat code for better health and longevity.**

How is it Tested?

VO₂ max test is measured during an **incremental exercise test**, usually on a treadmill or bike,
while wearing a **breath analysis mask**. As intensity increases, the system tracks how much oxygen
you inhale and how much carbon dioxide you exhale until you reach your limit.

How the Test Works

You’ll perform an **all-out effort** through a graded exercise protocol that progressively increases
in intensity.
* **Sedentary individuals** may do a brisk walk
* **Active or athletic individuals** may run on a treadmill or cycle on a Wattbike

As you exercise, the equipment captures every breath to calculate how efficiently your body uses
oxygen. When you reach the point of **maximum exertion** and can no longer continue, the system
records your peak oxygen uptake—this is your **VO₂ max**

Who is it for?

VO₂ max testing is suitable for **everyone**—from those just starting their fitness journey to elite
athletes. Whether your goal is to:
* Improve general health and energy levels
* Enhance endurance for running or cycling

Train smarter using precise heart rate zones
— VO₂ max testing provides valuable insights to guide your path.

Benefits for Athletes & Active Individuals

For athletes and regular exercisers, VO₂ max testing offers strategic advantages:
* Tailor your **training zones** more precisely
* Optimize **nutrition and recovery plans**
* Avoid **overtraining** and reduce injury risk
* Improve **energy levels, performance, and endurance**

Accessible, Affordable Testing

While professional athletes often undergo VO₂ max testing at high-end labs, these can be expensive
and time-consuming. With our **advanced technology**, we bring **affordable, high-quality VO₂ max
testing** to the general public—giving you the same performance insights at a fraction of the cost.

## Benefits of VO₂ Max Testing

VO₂ max testing offers a wide range of health and performance insights, whether you’re just starting
your fitness journey or aiming for peak athletic performance.

**💪 Improve Fitness & Longevity**
* Research shows that previously sedentary individuals training at **75% of their VO₂ max for 30
minutes, 3 times per week over 6 months** can increase their VO₂ max by **15–20%**.
* This improvement is directly linked to enhanced **quality of life** and **increased life
expectancy**.

**🫀 Train Smarter, Not Harder**
* VO₂ max testing is the **most accurate method** for identifying **personal heart rate training
zones**.
* This helps you **optimize workout intensity**, reduce fatigue, and lower the risk of overtraining
or injury.

**🔥 Tailor Weight Loss Plans**
* The test measures the **number of calories burned** at different exercise intensities.
* This data is invaluable for creating **effective, personalized fat-loss programs**.

**🥗 Optimize Fueling Strategies**
* When **carbon dioxide (CO₂)** is measured alongside oxygen use, the test can reveal how much
energy you’re getting from **fats vs. carbohydrates**.
* This allows for more precise **nutrition planning** and fueling strategies for endurance sports.

**🏅 Boost Athletic Performance**
* VO₂ max testing provides elite and recreational athletes with detailed insight into
**cardiorespiratory capacity**.
* It’s a powerful tool for evaluating current fitness, tracking progress, and fine-tuning training
programs for peak results.

**VO₂ Max** isn’t just a number—it’s the **industry standard** for measuring cardiovascular fitness
and performance potential.

### Frequently Asked Questions

1. How accurate is VO₂ max testing?

VO₂ max testing is considered the **gold standard** for measuring aerobic capacity. When conducted
using a breath analysis mask and graded exercise protocol, it delivers highly accurate, lab-grade
results.

2. Can I improve my VO₂ max over time?

Yes! With regular aerobic training—especially at moderate to high intensities—you can improve your
VO₂ max by **15–20%** over several months, depending on your fitness level and consistency.

3. What happens during a VO₂ max test?

You’ll wear a **breath analysis mask** and perform exercise (walking, running, or cycling) that
gradually increases in intensity. The equipment measures your oxygen consumption and carbon dioxide
output in real time.

4. How long does the test take?

The test itself takes **10–20 minutes**, depending on your fitness level. The full session
(including warm-up, setup, and recovery) typically lasts **30–45 minutes**.

5. What should I wear or bring to the test?

Wear comfortable **athletic clothing** and supportive running or training shoes. Bring a **water
bottle** and a towel if you prefer.

6. Do I need to prepare in any special way?

Avoid **vigorous exercise **for 24 hours prior and avoid** caffeine, alcohol, and large meals** for
at least 3 hours before the test. Make sure to continue all medications as usual and bring any
respiratory medications such as inhalers with you to the testing session.

7. Is the test physically demanding or uncomfortable?

The test requires a **progressive effort to near-exhaustion**, but it’s brief and closely monitored.
You can stop at any time if needed. Some find the mask slightly uncomfortable at first, but most
adjust quickly.

8. Is VO₂ max testing safe for everyone?

Yes, the test is safe when conducted by trained professionals and you will be asked to fill out a
questionnaire to determine your suitability prior to your appointment. However, if you have any
underlying medical conditions, it’s best to consult your GP or healthcare provider first.

9. Can older adults or people with medical conditions take the test?

Yes, with medical clearance. The intensity and protocol can be **customized** for safety and comfort
based on individual needs.

10. What if I have asthma or other respiratory issues?

Testing can still be performed safely. Just let us know in advance so they can adjust the protocol
and monitor your breathing carefully.

11. How will I receive my VO₂ max results?

Results are provided **immediately after testing**, either digitally or in print, along with a
breakdown of key metrics like heart rate zones, calorie burn, and fuel usage. After your
appointment, we’ll send you a full breakdown of your results so you can explore them in more detail.

12. What is considered a good VO₂ max score for my age/gender?

“Good” varies by age, gender, and fitness level. You’ll receive a **personalized interpretation**
with your test results, placing your score in context (e.g., average, above average, elite).

13. How often should I test my VO₂ max?

Most people benefit from testing every **3–6 months** to track progress. Competitive athletes may
test more frequently around training cycles.

14. Can I use this test to track progress over time?

Yes! VO₂ max is a **reliable and repeatable metric**, making it ideal for monitoring training
adaptations and improvements in aerobic capacity.

At a Physiotherapy appointment in our Castleknock, Blanchardstown or Tallaght clinic, treatment will

Physiotherapy can help give pain relief in most cases but often it depends upon the individual and
the longevity of the injury or problem. The rate of healing is different for different individuals.
The duration of your treatment plan depends upon variations in pain, motivation, perception, and the

# Sports Injury Clinic

[spcli 1][spcli 1]

**At Somerton Physiotherapy Clinic, **our Sports and Exercise medicine department is focused and
dedicated towards the prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and rehabilitation of sports injuries.

We treat all sports injuries from high level athletes who are competing competitively to individuals
playing 5 a-side with their friends to recreational runners. Every patient that visits our Dublin
Physio clinic is treated with empathy and a guarantee of 100% commitment from your therapist.

At our Blanchardstown Physio, Castleknock Physio and Tallaght Physio locations our fully equipped
sports injury clinics allow us to use several different techniques to treat sports injuries
effectively and efficiently. Our promise is to rehabilitate you back to your full pre-injury
potential. This can be achieved solely with the patient, or if applicable, in unison with the input
from other members of the sports medicine team i.e., surgeon or sports medicine consultant.

Using our state-of-the-art facilities and high-tech equipment, we aim to empower you to rebuild both
your physical and mental fortitude to enable a full and swift return to your sport!

* Shoulder: Dislocation, Frozen Shoulder, Rotator cuff tear, AC joint injury

** **

#### **Returning to your chosen sport after injury:**

Our sports and injury clinics in Dublin boast the best equipment needed to guide you back to your
sport. You can rest assured that your therapist will guide you through every aspect of your rehab
journey. The use of any gym equipment will be fully demonstrated and you will be coached through
each component of your rehab programme.

**At Somerton Physio we have implemented a 4-step treatment pathway to ensure a swift return to your
sport in a timely and safe manner. Pathway components include:**
* ** Functional testing:**

This is an aspect of sports and exercise medicine that is crucial in allowing your therapist to
assess your current ability. Functional testing is where we look at specific tasks and compare your
injured side to your unaffected side. Most up to date research and evidence tells us that passing
functional testing can reduce your risk of re-injury when you return to your chose sport.
* ** Digital Dynamometry:**

This is how we compare the strength of one joint/muscle to another. Our state-of-the-art digital
dynamometer accurately records your strength in kilograms, thus showing any deficits in muscle
strength.

By providing the ability to make precise measurements of muscle strength, the digital dynamometer
allows us to assess and monitor ongoing progress. It allows us to give more accurate feedback,
enabling us to provide more scientific and meticulous patient care and tailored rehab.

Extensive research into injury prevention and recovery from injuries such as ACL rupture and
tendinopathy has shown the importance of limb symmetry. This is yet another expert toul we can offer
you in your journey towards full recovery.
* ** Plyometric testing:**

Plyometrics is the development of power through muscles relaxing and contracting at a rapid pace.
Plyometric training builds your muscles ability to generate force and power. When testing
plyometrics we use a series of well documented tests, these give your therapist reliable data on
your readiness to return to your sport.
* ** Sport simulation:**

As simple as it sounds, sports simulation is based on your specific sport. Your therapist will use
various techniques to emulate the rigors and demands of your sport. High speed running, twisting and
turning, cutting, hopping, jumping for a high ball while being opposed, the list is endless. This is
the final stage of your rehabilitation and you will start to feel ever closer to your goal of
getting back to your sport or activity.

Throughout the 4-step treatment pathway your therapist may use manual therapy techniques to enhance
your recovery and return to play. These techniques can include massage, joint mobilisations, joint
manipulation, stretching, trigger point therapy and dry needling.
